body_en: I’m pleasantly surprised by this smartwatch. It was easy to set up, connects smoothly to my phone, and has a bright, easy-to-read display. The fitness tracking features, notifications, and heart rate monitoring work well for everyday use. The watch is lightweight, comfortable to wear, and the battery lasts a long time on a single charge.

I’m really impressed with this smartwatch. It looks modern, feels comfortable on my wrist, and was easy to pair with my phone. The display is bright and responsive, and I like that I can receive notifications, track my daily activity, and monitor my health. It offers excellent value for the price and works better than I expected. Highly recommended!

review_title: The absolute best value-for-money fitness tracker on the market!
body_en: After testing several wearables, the Samsung Galaxy Fit3 has completely blown me away. If you are looking for a device that delivers premium health tracking without the bulk or price tag of a full-scale smartwatch, this tracker is an absolute home run. ​Here is my breakdown after putting it through its paces daily: ​Superior Sleep Analytics: The sleep tracking feature on this device is incredibly sophisticated for its price point. It doesn't just log when you fall asleep and wake up; it breaks down your sleep stages (REM, light, deep) and gives you a legitimate, actionable sleep score. It’s light and slim enough that it doesn't bother my wrist at night at all. ​Flawless Menstrual Cycle Tracking: The health tracking integration is seamless. Logging and predicting periods is straightforward, reliable, and integrates perfectly with the Samsung Health app dashboard, keeping all my data in one clean, easy-to-read spot. ​Accurate Step Counting & Daily Metrics: The pedometer is highly accurate and doesn't pick up phantom steps from just moving your arms around. The beautiful, crisp 1.6-inch AMOLED display makes checking your step goals mid-stride incredibly satisfying, even in direct sunlight. Unbeatable Battery & Value: Because it runs on a streamlined operating system rather than a heavy smartwatch OS, the battery life is spectacular. You can easily go days and days without even thinking about a charger, which completely outperforms premium smartwatches that require daily charging. Final Verdict: At this price tier, the build quality and premium aluminum frame feel luxurious, and the feature set rivals trackers double its price. It provides total reliability for daily health monitoring. If you want top-tier metrics on a budget, this is the one to get!

review_title: Fits comfortably on my wrist, easy to read bright colored perfect size screen
body_en: Arrived quicker than scheduled so that was a nice surprise. I love the soft pink color and I also like the larger screen. My last fitness tracker was smaller screen. This looks similar to a well known expensive brand watch. I just got it today and got right to programming it so I could start wearing it. I can't rate it on durability or accuracy yet but I sure hope it will be more reliable than my last fitness tracker which I won't mention the brand. I like the brightness of the screen which I find easier to read outdoors. UPDATE: Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 (2024) review continued: I'm quite pleased with this item as it seems to actually work each day! Imagine a fitness tracker that actually works and doesn't randomly stop mid day!! Another plus that I discovered by accident is my watch reminds me when I'm out of range of my phone. This helps me to remember to not leave my phone behind if I'm working outside or over at my son's house. I have gotten home and realized an hour later that my phone isn't in my bag. This watch vibrates right away when the phone isn't in range. As an older person this is a help for me. I want to have my phone nearby in case I have a medical issue. I also love the bigger screen and the watch is very responsive which was another frustration with my last fitness tracker. I love the long charge battery life. I doubt I'll ever go back to my prior fitness tracker as it was so maddening to NOT be able to figure out the issues and sometimes it would "wake up" and start working again. This Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 is easy to wear and provides the health tracking numbers that matter to me. Thumbs up.

This watch is honestly almost perfect. Literally like a 9/10. The design is sleek, the watch face is not too big for my tiny wrist, has a vibrant and attractive display, and the watch band is really nice and soft! I had a fit bit charge 4 before this one and it finally quit on me. I wanted a low budget option because I haven't been consistent and don't have 300 dollars to waste for it to sit around if I end up not staying consistent. For 50 dollars this beauty fits nearly all my needs. Paired to my samsung phone immediately when I pulled it out of the box. Super easy to set up, and tons of different ways to customize the watch face. Have I mentioned its so pretty?? I don't typically wear a watch but I wanted the health metrics to track my heart rate and steps. This is one of two mild caveats. It doesn't actively track your heart rate. Every couple minutes or so it pings your heart rate to get more of a time line than a live feed. No worries, it pings often enough you get a good idea. Only mildly sucks because I use the live feed heart rate monitor to help clue me in to if I might have a panic attack or if I'm overreacting. Another thing. I have been using google health to track my calories and set specific goals for some of my macros I'm trying to hit. Unfortunately, the samsung health app doesn't get this specific and just gives you the suggested daily intake as a metric rather than letting you set your own. What sucks more is that these two apps don't sync with each other. So now I have 2 seperate apps to track my health. All in all. Its really a fantastic little gadget. For $50 I would 10000% buy it again if they came out with a newer version. Will update again after I've had it a few weeks.

I just received my watch today 2/15 it came fast as promised. I can already say that I like the watch. The color, it was easy to setup and pair to my S24 Ultra with no problems. It's slim, sleek, and cute on my wrist. When I got the watch it was already at 76% I used my phone to charge it to 100% I love the different functions the watch offers. You can adjust the brightness to your liking. In will update on the battery life after a week. It has many different options face changes for the watch and it's easy to read. And for the price it's really affordable. I'm not disappointed at all about purchasing this watch. I'm a HUGE FAN of Samsung products. Update 2/17 - I wanted to vive an update after me having the watch since Sunday afternoon 2/15. The battery life does not live up to as it is advertised for 13 days. You'll probably get about 4 or maybe 5 days at best. Right now as I'm updating my review on this watch I'm at 39% and it's Tuesday evening 2/17 so I know maybe tomorrow I'll have to charge it. The accuracy of the sleep tracker is good. In the Samsung Health App it gives a breakdown of how many hours you slept, if you snoring it records your snoring and you can hear yourself snore. On "smart thing" samsung app it shows you where your watch is or you can go under the wear app and click on "find my band" and it'll take you right to the "smart things" app and it'll show you where your watch is located. Overall I'm satisfied with the watch. So many features. I changed my 5 star to 4 due to the misinformation on the battery life. Would I recommend it to someone that's looking for just a "fitness" app I definitely would. I how the review helps the next purchaser. 3/07/26 UPDATE: The charge on the battery last 6 days. I tracked how long the battery would last without notifications. I charged it last Sunday (afternoon) & this morning 3/07 it was at 3%. Another cool feature that I came across. The walking feature has a voice commentary that tells you how far you been walking, the length of time it comes on when you reach your 1st mile in thought that was cool that it actually talks to you.

I am really impressed with how user-friendly the SAMSUNG Galaxy Fit 3 is. The 1.6" AMOLED display is incredibly vibrant, clear, and easy to read at a glance, showing all my essentials like the time, date, and activity stats perfectly. The setup process was a breeze—the companion app is very easy to install, and navigating through it is smooth and intuitive. I love how hassle-free it is to scroll through my health metrics. Two of my favorite features so far are the outstanding battery life—it easily keeps up with me without constant recharging—and the sleep tracking. It has been incredibly helpful and insightful to check my sleep quality each morning. It’s a fantastic, straightforward device that delivers exactly what it promises! I bought Meliya 2-Pack for Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 Screen Protector Case for only $5.99

I change to this one from fitvii and I don't regret it. The price is very affordable and has a great quality. Even the band feels more expensive that it looks on photos. You can customize the tiles on the face. It pairs beautifully with the wear app on my Samsung phone. It doesn't take calls, but gets notifications, which is good when you are working and dont want to be interrupted. It has all main health tracker functions. I was specially interested on the sleep tracker. And it looks nice and fit for my small size wrist. Great find!

My wife and I have been fitbit fans since the Charge 2 (2016).  Before the google purchase, fitbit was a strong leader in lower cost fitness trackers.  It did concern us that our fitbits would die frequently (nearly each one we had died within a year from the Charge 2, 3, 4). However after talking with customer service they would send us replacement.  So, ok, we can deal with that.  (Even though in the past few years you had to provide a ton of documentation including, IIRC, your drivers license.) I had a fitbit 6 that I got for Christmas 2024.  Wow, a color screen.  LOL.  I needed a replacement as the screen on my Charge 5 kept getting dimmer, and dimmer, to the point when I could not read it outdoors and barely indoors.  So I was gifted the Charge 6 and it was big step up.  But it took me a few months until I realized that the floors option was gone, not just not working, but removed, to make space for other features I could care less about. So I looked around in late June and discovered the Fit 3.  So I bought one.  I am SO GLAD I did.  What do I need?  Step counter, heart rate, floors, distance, calories.  Oh, and the kicker for me was AIRPLANE MODE.  I study various energetic sciences including BioGeometry and the EMF coming from our devices is not benign.  I don't wear a tracker to sleep, don't want anything live, and keep my blue tooth turned off unless I am actively syncing. This is what I see comparing Fit 3 to Fitbit Charge 6.   What the Fit 3 has as an advantage:  Larger screen, airplane mode, beautiful faces, much cleaner UI on the watch and in the android app(s) (I am using this with a Pixel 7 phone).  The ability to sync only turning on bluetooth.  A few years ago fitbit/google basically said we aren't syncing your fitbit unless you have both location/GPS and bluetooth turned on.  Sometimes you could get the fitbit to sync with location off but this was tricky/spotty. What advantages did the Charge 6 have for me, personally.   None really.  It cost about 3x the amount for the Charge 6 compared to the Fit 3.  That's ridiculous. In a head to head comparsion of measurements this is what I see.   Fitbit Charge is often slower to start your step counts and the Fit 3 is quicker on that.  So you steps counts are going to go up and perhaps the Fit 3 does count some arm motions as steps when it should not.  But the Fit 3 is still very close (within 1-3%) with the Charge 6.  The Fit 3 tends to undercount calories compared to the Charge 6, I can't tell which is more accurate.  On the Charge 6 bluetooth syncing was always a laborious pain taking sometimes minutes to get the past few days of data and often having to turn bluetooth off/on and/or restarts to get it to sync.  The Fit 3 is very fast *most* of the time.  I did have one instance where the Fit 3 was not syncing in the Health App and I had to open the Wearable app and trigger a sync from there, which worked. The big thing is battery life.  I have automatic activity tracking turned on and except when syncing in the evening I keep it on airplane mode.  I charged it overnight last Thursday/Friday before I first put it on.  It's now Wednesday evening, nearing 6 complete days of use and my battery level is at 55%.  That frugal energy use is really good and is on par with the earlier monochrome fitbits. I am very pleased with my Fit 3 purchase.  Back in the early to mid 2000's I was very excited about Timex was doing just in digital watches (Iron Man, etc).  The Fit 3 harkens back to those kind of days for me when you could get a very full functionality wrist device that looked good, worked great, and was a good deal.  This is definitely worth a close look if you don't need an higher priced fitness/communication device that is emitting EMFs into your pericardium meridian 24x7.  Well done.

I've had a long line of Fit Bits and when I found out Samsung has a non-smart watch tracker, I decided to give it a chance. (I don't want to pay smart watch prices.) Out of the box, the Fit 3 was in Spanish, but when I put it on the charger, it reverted to English. It stayed English until I got a new phone and had to reset the tracker in order to pair it with the new phone. The tracker reverted to Spanish and putting it on the charger did not change that this time. I pressed the top option on the device's screen and got to choose from a whole list of languages. I chose English, but this is where someone who wants another language will find it. The charge on this item is supposed to last up to 13 days. I've had this device for 3 months, and I got 6 days out of each charge (7 if I let the device die) for the first 2 months or so. Now, it last 4-5 days. I don't have the display always on and I don't consider my use of this device heavy by any means. 6 days is what I got out of my most recent Fitbit. My Fit 3 charges from 20% to 70% in about 20 minutes and to 100% in about an hour. The trick is to get the charger properly seated, because the first couple of times, I don't think it was on correctly, as I got the main display, not the charging percentage display, and it took about 2 hours to reach 100%. I wore the new Fit 3 side by side with my old Fitbit Charge 6 for 24+ hours to compare - 2 nights and one active day. The first night, the Fit 3 recorded 20 more minutes of sleep and the second night, the Fitbit recorded 20 more minutes. I don't know how either determines when I am asleep and not quietly reading, so I figure the results are comparable. The Fit 3, while behind on step count early in the day, ended the day with almost 1,500 more steps than the Fitbit. Both counted activity (cleaning, for instance), not just pure steps. I'm OK with this - I figure any movement is better than no movement. There are many more features that I don't use. I may in the future, but I'm happy with what I do use. I tried taking photos on my phone (also a Samsung) with my Fit 3 as a remote shutter button. I like that feature! Text notifications come to my Fit 3, but not all of them. When I am using my phone, notifications do not go to the tracker (I have found that this is the default and I can change it if desired). Group texts never do (they will go to my car, so I don’t know why they won't go to my Fit 3), and random regular texts don't. I found in the Health app where I can pick and choose which apps will send notifications. All told, I like this device. It’s not perfect, though. I miss the feature that Fitbit has that reminds me to move each hour. I'm now forced to choose between step count, floor count (I assume that means how many stairs I climb), or active hours. I like counting steps, so that's my main goal. I like seeing the hearts light up throughout the day as I get closer to my goals. I also have active minutes and active calories burned as goals, but I don’t care as much about those.
Excellent smart watch to pair with your Samsung phone. Many functions such as monitoring sleep, heartbeat, stress etc.

review_title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Cute, sleek and does everything I need — obsessed with it!
body_en: I picked up the pink one and it looks absolutely gorgeous on the wrist. The colour is a soft, subtle pink — not loud or plasticky at all — and the slim band sits really comfortably without feeling bulky. I've worn fitness trackers before that felt like a brick on my arm, but this one is so lightweight I genuinely forget I'm wearing it sometimes. The screen is bright and clear, easy to read even in sunlight, and swiping through the menus feels smooth and responsive. Setting it up with my phone was quick and straightforward — no technical headaches, just paired it and it was ready to go. For day-to-day tracking it covers everything I need — steps, heart rate, sleep, calories, stress monitoring. The sleep tracking in particular is really detailed and I've found myself actually paying attention to it and adjusting my routine. The battery life has also genuinely impressed me. I charge it maybe once a week which is so convenient compared to smartwatches that need charging every day or two. The band is comfortable enough to sleep in and the clasp is secure so I never worry about it coming loose during workouts. It handles sweat well too and I've worn it through some pretty intense sessions with no issues. For the price, this thing punches way above its weight. It's not trying to be a full smartwatch and it doesn't need to be — it does its job brilliantly. The pink colour just makes it even better. Highly recommend, especially if you want something stylish, lightweight and reliable without breaking the bank.
Excellent battery life
Difficulty with the connection
So far so good not worn for very long yet so may change to 5 star after more use

review_title: A Simple and Affordable Fitness Tracker
body_en: I purchased the Xiaomi Mi Smart Band 10 after comparing it with several other fitness trackers, and the value for the price was hard to beat. After watching multiple YouTube reviews, I felt confident it was the right choice. The Smart Band 10 is simple, clean, and not overly flashy. The setup process was straightforward, though you do need to pair it with the Mi Fitness app, which requires creating an account. Once set up, the device tracks heart rate, sleep, steps, and provides handy notifications like incoming text messages. It covers all the essential features most people need. The Smart Band is pretty light weight and sometimes I don't feel it on the wrist which can be worrisome as you may bump it into things around, which I've done a few times but no scratches just yet but that's something to take note of. The battery life is truly impressive. I fully charged the device on November 22nd, 2025, and as of writing this review, it has been running for 14 days straight on that single charge and is sitting at 45% battery. With power-saving mode, you can extend it even further. However, there are a couple of downsides to consider. The most noticeable is the lack of physical buttons, which you can see in the product photos. You can power the Smart Band 10 off from the settings menu, but the only way to turn it back on is by connecting it to the included charging cable. This hasn’t caused any issues for me yet since I haven’t needed to turn it off, but it's something potential buyers should know. I also question the accuracy of the calorie and step counters at times, as the numbers don’t always feel consistent. Overall, if you’re looking for a simple, affordable, and reliable fitness tracker, whether for personal use or as a gift, the Xiaomi Mi Smart Band 10 is a solid choice. **Update on December 13, 2025, the Xiaomi Mi Smart Band 10 is currently on 19% of charge after a 21 day period going off one charge cycle. The Smart Band estimates that it could last for 4 more days. This device has been really impressive so far.

The band is great. The battery literally lasts me like 10-11 days with a single charge. The screen quality is stunning (amoled) and it can go really bright. It has those essential features such as heart rate, weather, compass, camera button, flashlight (using the screen), media/music controller. It is also water proof. I use this band to work at a restaurant. Especially when i work in the back of house. If you work rough job this band is good. And before i forget, this band is super light when i use it for sleeping monitoring i can barely feel it

This smart band has been super helpful for tracking my step count and workouts. I feel that the readings are accurate, and I am amazed at how well this works for the price point. It's very sleek and cute, and you can customize the home screen. You can also get notifications from your phone, which is a great addition. It holds a charge for weeks!

This is a fantastic fitness tracker! I love the rose color. It is comfortable, feels to be of quality, has a beautiful bright screen that is very responsive to touch unlike others I have tried. Tracks , calories, steps, time working out for a variety of exercises and sports activities. Also includes Sp02 , stress and sleep monitoring. I love this watch. I like it better than others I have tried ...including fit bit. Only downside is I am unable to change to Imperial system from. Metric on the watch or through the app. It is a small inco vengeance compared to the other benefits. People have complained about the app but it has been fine with the apps ease of use and functionality with exception of metric units only. I was able to change weather to Farenheight from Celcius though. Overall I am very happy with this purchase!

review_title: Good for casual use, not monitor exercise.
body_en: Its exercise features are limited but is excellent for casual activity monitoring; sleep quality, steps. It does continuously monitor vitals during exercise but does not sound alarms or inform you without having to touch the screen to see current vitals, heart rate etc. For SpO2 you need to swipe the screen and click measure and keep still for several seconds for the oxygen level reading to complete. Build quality is good, interface is smooth, and easy to use. Great attention to detail. Materials and finish is excellent so far, the band is okay but a little tricky to get the prong to find an opening sometimes. It is very lightweight and fairly small too so is easy to sleep with and wear in general. It is great for what it does, but I had to knock off a star for lack of workout monitoring capability and actually reflects mismanagement of customer expectation or misalignment between product advertisement and actual product.

I previously owned the Fitbit Charge 6 and was constantly disappointed. Its step‑tracking data was inconsistent, and the wristband felt heavy and uncomfortable for all‑day wear. Switching to this Xiaomi smart band has been a night‑and‑day difference, and I am truly amazed by its performance. Its step counting stays accurate during daily walks. The 1.72‑inch AMOLED screen is much bigger than the small display on the Fitbit Charge 6, with tons of free watch faces for full customization. It includes many practical tools that Fitbit does not have, such as real‑time weather updates, a handy flashlight, stress monitoring, and my favorite feature: remote camera control. I can take self‑shots easily by using the band to trigger my phone camera, which works perfectly for taking photos alone. Battery life is outstanding. A full charge lasts up to 21 days, while my Fitbit Charge 6 needed charging every seven days. Best of all, this tracker costs far less, with no mandatory subscription fees for health analysis. This lightweight, well‑designed fitness band gives fantastic value for money. I absolutely recommend it.

review_title: High Quality Watch for a Great Price!!
body_en: Had to retire my old Fitbit because it was very faulty, and I was no longer able to sync to the app (ever since Google bought them out, their quality has drastic gone downhill). Through some research, many people recommended the Xiaomi Mi Smart Band. From a quick glance, it has everything that I was looking for. I don't use my watch for any heavy activity or exercises. However I do track things like my sleep, heart rate, O2, steps, and stress levels. This watch has an incredibly long battery life, and is very easy to navigate on the watch and in the app. Wish I would've known about this band sooner, I would've switched over a long time ago.

review_title: Good Value Good Accuracy POOR WATCHBAND
body_en: I have purchased two other low-priced watches of this ilk (both around $30). At first I reviewed them favorably, but their lifespan was not long. I wanted something that did not require synching to my phone. This watch has now been with me only about a month, BUT it's much better than the others, at its roughly $50 price. I have resisted purchasing the high-priced Garmin and others, hoping to go a cheaper route and spend money on something else. So far, this is EXTREMELY better than the previous cheapo watches. Good tracking of sleep and informative. THE ONLY CAVEAT is this: the watchband is designed "backwards." It is very difficult to snap back on.
Nice watch, I changed from 4 and there is a huge difference, my button is a bit stuck when changing the strap
I bought the watch for my mom, who only wanted to see her notifications and some health tracking data. It has a great screen, and the battery lasts for weeks.

review_title: 導入に最適　この価格帯で非常に品質が高い商品です
body_en: I think it's a really satisfying quality product in this price range. Of course, there may be some errors compared to higher-priced models, but you can display your heart rate, daily calorie consumption, and number of steps on the screen, which is very useful for managing your daily life. It also has a lot of extra features such as sleep time management, a timer function (it's convenient to use it right away without having to open your phone), and a function to find your phone in the house. It lasts more than a week without charging. I would recommend this product to anyone who is thinking about getting a smartwatch. Even if it doesn't fit, it's only around 5,000 yen, and I want this function to be a little more accurate! I think it's a good option to get one before thinking about changing to a higher-priced smartwatch. This will also prevent you from suddenly spending more than 50,000 yen and realizing that you don't need something that high-performance after all. I am quite satisfied with this product, and thanks to this product, I am also concerned about the high price range. I think this is a product of such quality.
Works great and easy to carry
I fell for this watch and no regrets, I started sport again and it analyzes everything, sleep, cardio, training, weight changes via the application... great for the unbeatable price

A great watch! I love this a lot more than all the various fit bits I’ve owned. Lots of fun watch faces, the phone works well, and the steps are accurate. I got the rose gold color. Picked up some replacement elastic watch bands that were easy to switch out. I do think that the heart rate can be under by 5-10 as compared to my other device ekg app. But, going with that, in a price point like this? No biggie! The app is great and best of all FREE! No monthly charges. Battery lasts a week before needing charging.

I wasn't sure I even wanted a smart watch because I don't really want tons more notifications during my day and don't need to answer calls or texts on a watch, but I have been using this for a week and it's great. It accurately charts my runs, my HR, my VO2, my steps and has a whole lot of other features that are handy like an alarm and calculator. The app has some sample exercise routines and settings (so you can change how the temperature and day/mo/year and time appear) and it's all very user friendly. It came fully charged and I haven't had to charge it yet. I turn it off at night but it's been six days and I am still at 70% battery life. If you're not looking to spend hundreds just to track your activities I highly recommend this watch.

review_title: Good Smart Watch for a Good Price
body_en: I am pleased with the appearance, features, display, and charging of this watch. It is reasonably priced for the functionality it offers. The phone app and the watch work together well. I would buy it again. The advertisement claims a five-year warranty - I'm not sure that is true. I haven't seen any proof of that.

My smart watch has exceeded my expectations. I was a long time fitbit user and got tired of paying the money after it stops working when the warranty ends. This smart watch has many features and most times it gets mistaken for an Apple watch. Lol. I ❤️ it. It does the job I need it to do with long battery life.

Love the watch. I had trouble getting text notifications for first like 3 days but finally the simple fix was to restart my phone lol and all worked fine. Lots of awesome features. Can’t reply to texts and messages by typing but I found that you can use AI Voice to text a contact. You can also use it to make a call. Another problem I had was that AI voice volume was too low so I finally figured out you have to turn up volume for Siri on your phone. I didnt know Siri had its own volume until my bf showed me. You just say “Hey Siri, turn your voice volume up to 100%” you have to specify Siri’s voice/talk volume or else she will turn up regular volume. Or just say “Hey Siri” and then when she activates you use the side volume button to turn it up. Turning Siri up made it louder on watch. I’ve never had an Apple or Android watch so can’t compare but I found this watch an awesome buy for a great price.
I am enjoying my first smart watch; many functions on my wrist: emails, messages, tracking my walks, monitoring my sleep, and many others. The battery lasts one week. Good purchase.

review_title: Works great when you try to return it
body_en: Generally I find I like the watch. It didn't seem to have any problems connecting with its app. It seems to keep pretty good time. When I flip it up to look at it five times out of 10 it turns on and shows me the time. The rest. I have to click a little button on the side to get it to show me the time. It has some pretty fancy features like while I'm walking it pops up a little message asking me if I'm walking outside or inside. I'm not quite sure what the point of that is. Maybe just to keep me engaged in some way. I like that. It counts my steps pretty well. It seems to match what my phone thinks my steps are. I connected it to my Android phone. The only thing that's really weird about it is that when I it try to get it to read my blood oxygen levels and pulse - the only time it will do it is while I'm trying to return it to Amazon. I was in the process of trying to return it last night which of course is my last day to return it and I wanted to capture what it did and it worked flawlessly. Of course, this morning when I try to do it it gives me the same message which is rather frustrating. See the attached screenshots. Maybe that is to be expected for a pretty cheap watch of about $40.

I like the Fitpolo smart watch. I opened the package and the charging cord, watch and imformation all were neatly included. First I connected the watch to charge per the instructions. Amazing the watch was 100% charged right out of the box. The process to install the app on my phone was easy to accomplish. I selected the watch face. Paired the watch to my android phone. It is very easy to used. I checked my blood pressure and O2. I am very pleased with this purchase.

review_title: Cumple las expectativas perfectamente. Ideal para niños
body_en: I have not had any problems with shipping, the product is exactly what was advertised and the monitoring application seems perfect to me. Good quality/price ratio and very attentive after-sales service that offers a 1-year warranty extension.

review_title: Great inexpensive watch for runners. Connects to Strava!
body_en: Great value simple to use watch that connects to the Strava app. I have recently taken up running and didn’t want to purchase an expensive branded watch which was complicated to use and had far too many functions. This one is just great - it tracks my runs/walks which get uploaded onto Strava. It’s own app is so easy to use and completely free in terms of all the extra functions. The colour is on trend - I have had many compliments. I am now considering buying it for my mother and teenage daughter- it looks the part too! Very impressed.
Very beautiful, functional and with many functions, the dial as large as I wanted. You can hear and speak very well when a phone call comes in.

review_title: Nice watch at a good price
body_en: Update (July 7, 2024): I have used many watches like this and all had a feature to update the firmware. I never, ever received a firmware update before this watch. It actually updated and fixed the one thing I didn't like (the snooze feature)! Yay! I am adding the extra star for this! Now my favorite watch. -------------------------- I got this FitPolo smartwatch when it was listed at $24, a very nice price. It is almost identical to my go-to watch. It looks good, very apple-ish. It has the 'stem' button that turns on the screen, takes you to the features or, when held, calls up Alexa. Awesome! You can make calls from the watch via an on-screen dial pad. You can answer calls on the watch. You can read headers to your emails, and most of a text message. You can set quiet time so as not to be disturbed at night. The usual wake-on-wrist-turn is here too, with the advantage that it turns off when you put your arm down. You can set how long the screen stays on. I am almost a week in with the watch and I still have 44% left on the first charge. A feature I really like is that you can do many things, like setting new alarms, right on the watch. All other models I have used required that you use your phone to do this. One feature this has that my other watch does not, is a snooze feature. Some might like this, but I find it a problem. The issue is that pressing the stem button is snooze. You have to look at the screen and select the right button to turn the alarm off without snooze. I suppose that really wakes you up, but I would like the option to disable the snooze feature. There are many, many faces to choose from both free and paid. It was easy to pick out some I love. The strap is a traditional watch strap. I would swap it for a velcro sport strap. This is a well designed watch well worth the $50 listing. Since it also had a $15 coupon, it was outstanding! Nice!

Very pretty watch with a beautiful marriage of colors and a disconcerting lightness! However, the quality seems good and the screen is very bright. Responsiveness is good and the watch does not slow down. The instructions indicate that the watch can last 5 and 7 days without being recharged, which is already excellent autonomy for this type of connected watch. You can make calls and respond directly with it, a speaker and a microphone being present, which is really practical when you are driving, for example, or cycling. The translations are good and the Very Fit application to download is well thought out! For me and given its price, it is a very good watch for a controlled budget! I recommend! 👍🏻

review_title: So pleased with this Galaxy 3 fit. Great value for all that this does!!
body_en: This Galazy fit 3 is amazing with all the functions. I fell twice last year so I was thrilled that this has a fall detection on it and will call emergency help. Everything is really accurate. It was super easy to set up. It comes with a couple instruction booklets. Plus it has steep by step instructions to follow on the screen. The battery lasts a long time when I turn down the display light. Great value for all you get at an affordable price. I linked it to my health records. My Dr recommended me getting one of these a long time ago and I'm glad I finally did. It is compatable with amazon music so I can put on my headphones and control volume from my wrist. I still have to have my phone on me. But that's not a big deal. It's nice to know how I'm sleeping too. I have narcolepsy and it heals me show my sleep specialist how I'm sleeping at night.

review_title: Incredible value and the ultimate everyday companion!
body_en: I am honestly so impressed with this watch, especially for the price point. It does pretty much everything the more expensive "big name" smartwatches do, but without the high price tag. It has become an essential part of my daily routine. The activity tracking is spot on, and it’s been incredibly helpful for keeping me accountable and motivated to reach my goals. I love that it tracks my sleep and monitors my stress levels—that stress tracking is a huge plus for me. But my favorite part is how durable it is! It is completely waterproof—I wear it swimming in the pool, in the shower, while washing dishes, and even out in the rain, and it has never failed me once. Plus, it charges incredibly quickly, so I barely have any downtime with it. If you’re looking for a reliable, sleek feature-packed tracker that actually keeps up with your busy life, I highly recommend this one!

I'm replacing an old and now dead Fitbit that lasted far longer than most. It was always unreadable in sunlight. This Galaxy is perfect for me so 5 stars, but the heartrate is not accurate. Besides that, it's great! Light weight, comfortable wristband even playing golf or pickleball. Phone call and text notifications very handy and the phone finder has saved a lot of time searching. Large numerals, brightly lit and super easy to read in the brightest light. Claims to be water resistant but with some caveats so I remove it when water is involved. Sweat is no problem. Battery lasts about 5 days and recharges fast.

This little watch does everything I need. I didn't want a "phone on my wrist" but wanted something light weight that tracked my steps, was a timer, was connected to my phone for messages. Thus does all this and more! It tracks my sleep better than my old Galaxy watch ever did. It's lightweight and comfortable to wear. I can see my messages, and control my audio on the watch. While I can't personalize the watch face, there are enough choices that I have the face I like. Perfect little watch for what I need. I do NOT need nor want AI on my watch (nor phone for that matter) and was happy to find one that does not offer it! I gave it four stars due to the faulty fall detection function. Twice it tried to call 911 just because I rolled over in bed. Then when I actually fell, it did nothing. I turned off the fall detection as it's useless. But other than that, it is a great little watch for those who want a simpler life!

This watch is 100% AMAZING! I recently left the Apple ecosystem and switched to the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, and I absolutely LOVE it. I am NEVER going back to Apple. I've owned several top-of-the-line Apple Watches over the years, but when I really thought about it, I only ever used them for the heart rate monitor, telling time, and tracking my runs. I couldn't justify spending hundreds of dollars on another smartwatch. So I decided to give the Galaxy Fit3 a try, and I'm honestly blown away. When I ordered it, I thought it would just track my steps, heart rate, and the time and I was perfectly fine with that. Instead, I found a fitness tracker packed with features I wasn't expecting. If you have a Samsung phone, this is an absolute no-brainer. It pairs perfectly, does way more than I ever imagined, and for around $50, the value is unbelievable. Save your money and get this you won't regret it!

Wanted something simple to use, and this is just that. Set up was pretty easy. I couldn't get my notifications to work properly when I first set it up, but all I had to do was reboot it and had no issues after that. Stays charged for about 2 weeks. Had a generic watch prior to this I that I had to connect to the app everyday so it would stay linked.... I dont have to do that with thus one. I think its great and especially at this price!!!

review_title: Heart rate and Sleep tracking FTW
body_en: Great for heart rate and sleep tracking. If you don't want to get a full blown smart watch get this one. The other features are decent. For the 45ish bucks I am quite happy with it. Step counter seems to register +10% higher than actual. Battery life is 3-4 days. Charging is super fast and easy.

The product works great. No subscription to use. The only issue I had was that Samsung takes 2 weeks to switch your phone number over for 2 step verification. So for about a week I was unable to even start using the device. I said screw it and made a new account. The band is to small for my large wrist, but it was easy to replace with a better band. Not sure why all watch manufacturers do that.. Anyway tech side, you get what you need. Stress, heart rate, sleep, step, food, calorie, period tracker all in one. You can also connect with your doctor on there, but I have not tried that function yet. It's worth the price and I even got my wife one.

review_title: A near full smartwatch for a fraction of the price.
body_en: At this price? This is 80% of a full smartwatch and a fraction of the cost. I'm extremely happy with it as a fitness tracker. Can control my music playback, works as general purpose HR tracker. Very light and comfortable with excellent battery life, goes for many days. (Since I don't sleep with it, I stretch it to weeks) What it lacks from a full smartwatch? Payments (I don't need), answering calls plus some fancier health tracking like ECG or VO2max. But for the price, who cares? I wear it and don't worry about it. I would prefer I could set the watch without phone and also use standard watch straps, but hey the price! The Samsung app is one of the best for general health tracking. Best by far for nutrition tracking. Serious fitness enthusiast may find it a bit lacking. Shame the watch doesn't work with iPhone. This is a highly recommended device unless you are CERTAIN you need all the fancy features of a Galaxy or Pixel.
The products are 100% working and as same as it shows on amazone . So i am happy to buy .

The battery of this lasted me 5 days with always on display on and without turning on the sleep mode at night. i also kept my phone connected all that time.. So maybe the 13days claim isn't right. but 5 days seems like a decent enough time. Connectivity is really great with the phone. I got notifications in real time. The band is of great quality. there is no itching or anything. Accurate workout calculator. Steps counter is 90 percent great i think. I would say there is an error of around 500 steps give or take during the day. That's not much of a problem according to me. Sleep tracking is really really good. Loving being able to track my sleep so accurately. I love this watch overall. Looks great on my wrist . The dial isn't too big. Doesn't feel heavy and clunky.
Not bad, battery lasts about a week
High quality, more than two years old and in excellent condition

The Galaxy Watch 8 Classic looks and feels premium right out of the box. The display is bright and easy to read, the performance is smooth, and it connects quickly with my Samsung phone. I also like the health and fitness tracking features, and the battery easily lasts through a full day of regular use. It’s comfortable to wear, stylish enough for everyday use, and packed with useful features. I’m very happy with this purchase and would definitely recommend it.

review_title: Phenomenal(ESPECIALLY IF YOU USE A DIABETIC CGM!)
body_en: The negative: Qi wireless charging removed with the watch 8 generation. That means you can't charge the watch from a power-sharing compatible phone(like my S23 Ultra). ....really, though, that's all the negative. Power-sharing has always been fiddly anyway. The neutral: I get about 1.5 days per charge, with battery protection on(max charge @ 90%), and ALL the bells and whistles(including always-on display). If you want it for sleep tracking every night, have a charger at your desk during the day to keep it topped-up. Slightly smaller screen/chassis ratio than expected. The body feels like they COULD have made the display a smidge bigger, but ymmv. That would have impacted weight, durability, and battery life, so it's probably for the best. The good: Feels good. Substantial. Beefy, but not clunky. Get a metal band to replace the sweaty faux-leather/rubber one. Fast. Responsive. Voice commands using google. Built-in digital compass. Gestures(shake your hand in a...suggestive fashion to clear notifications because...um...you're busy...feeding geese 0_o ). The rotating bezel is back, absent on the other variants of the watch 8 generation(and a deal breaker for me). Best of all, though, as an insulin dependent diabetic, the ability to check my blood sugar without unholstering my phone is PURE GOLD. If this applies to you, Google "gluroo watch app". Recap: Not perfect, but it still phenomenal. Not cheap, but I've worn it every day for a month. Every day, I think to myself: "WORTH IT".

review_title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 Classic (2025) 46mm — A Worthy Return to Form ★★★★★
body_en: After putting the Galaxy Watch 8 Classic through its paces over the past few weeks, I can confidently say Samsung nailed the comeback. The rotating bezel is back, and honestly, that alone made me hit "buy" — but there's so much more to love here. Build Quality That Feels Premium The 46mm stainless steel case has real heft without feeling clunky on my wrist. The brushed finish looks sharp whether I'm in a t-shirt at the gym or wearing a button-down to a meeting. The sapphire crystal display has shrugged off everything I've thrown at it — no scratches yet, despite my best (unintentional) efforts. The crown bezel clicks with that satisfying tactile feedback Samsung fans have been begging for since it disappeared. That Display, Though The Super AMOLED screen is gorgeous. Bright enough to read in direct Florida sunlight, vibrant when scrolling notifications, and the always-on display sips battery rather than gulping it. Colors pop and text is razor-sharp. Health Tracking Is Genuinely Useful The upgraded BioActive sensor is the real star. Heart rate tracking is accurate compared to my chest strap, sleep tracking finally feels reliable (with actually actionable insights instead of just data dumps), and the new wellness features — including the energy score and vascular load metrics — give me a real sense of how my body is recovering day to day. ECG, blood oxygen, and body composition all work as advertised. Performance and Battery Wear OS with One UI Watch is snappy. App launches are instant, transitions are smooth, and I haven't experienced the lag that plagued earlier generations. Battery comfortably gets me through a full day with the always-on display enabled, and closer to two days if I turn it off. Fast charging tops it back up while I shower. Fitness Tracking GPS lock is fast and accurate on outdoor runs, workout detection actually catches the workouts I forget to start, and the suite of supported activities covers basically anything I do. The running coach feature has been a pleasant surprise. The Ecosystem Bonus If you're in the Samsung world, this watch is a no-brainer. Pairing with my Galaxy phone was seamless, Samsung Pay works flawlessly, and notifications mirror perfectly. It also plays nicely with non-Samsung Android phones, though you'll lose a few features. Minor Nitpicks The proprietary band connector means you'll want to budget for first-party or compatible straps. And while battery life is solid, power users tracking long workouts with GPS will still want to charge nightly. Bottom Line The Galaxy Watch 8 Classic is the watch Samsung should have been making all along. The rotating bezel transforms the experience, the build quality justifies the premium price, and the health features have genuinely changed how I think about my recovery and sleep. If you've been waiting for Samsung to bring back what made the Classic line special, the wait is over. Highly recommend.

I love the style, the look, and the feel on my wrist. It's a little heavier than I expected but once I startes wearing it, I don't feel the weight. I like the seamless pairing and compatibility with my Samsung S23 Ultra Smart Phone. I am still getting acquainted with all the features since I've only had it on for less than 2 weeks. I love the vibrant colors on the screen, the many choices to change the face, the ability to change the font size is a nice feature. It works well with the Samsung Health app that's already on my phone, the Echocardiagram feature is pretty cool (not for medical use), battery life is good, I like the fact that I can check my text messages. I haven't tried the AI Assistant yet, but given time, I'll adjust to it gradually. BTW, I am a Senior Citizen so it may take a little while longer to enjoy the full benefits this smartwatch offers. I've tried other less expensive smartwatches in the past but this one hits all the marks for me. I am well pleased so far.

review_title: Strong health features and keeps time.
body_en: The options on this watch are insane! I bought it for the health features and I find comfort in being able to check my blood pressure and ekg. The sleep monitoring is great. If you are pushing a cart in a store and you are walking the watch doesn't see it. But it has picked up walking and bike riding automatically for exercise tracking. If your phone updates overnight then it disconnects until you restart your phone which means no alarm. Overall happy with this watch I haven't figured out why but a couple of times the watch battery has been dead in the morning but most of the time there is over 40% in the morning so not sure what happened the other two days. The watch does more than I have tried to use.

review_title: Amazing device! Battery life is not an issue for me.
body_en: My five years old Galaxy Watch 4 was giving me signs. It was time to replace it. I bought the Watch 8 Classic because there is no Watch 9 Classic. I have it tweaked to my liking and I am blown away at what it can do. Battery life is an issue for some users, but not for me. I spend an hour on my PC flying my RC helicopter simulator every day. I charge the watch while I practice, and it is fully charged when I'm done. I have disabled the features that I don't need or use, and I have no issues or "charge anxiety". The rotating bezel is the bees knees. My Watch 4 had the software bezel, but the metal bezel is much much better. The build quality is excellent, and I have no problem with the size and weight. I am surprised at how lightweight it is despite the size. I got some strap adapters so that I can use my Watch 4 straps. Yes, it is a bit pricey, but you get what you pay for! It is a good investment in my opinion. The only time I take it off is when I shower. I have no trouble sleeping with it. The gestures feature is waaay cool. I'm very pleased with it; no buyer's remorse here. I watched several YT videos to help me to set it up. I highly recommend this watch.

I've been very brand loyal to the watch I owned prior to this one. Never thought I would switch. If you're a Samsung phone person then this is a must have. It's a beautiful smartwatch that does everything you would hope for. Very user friendly. Whether you're tracking steps, listening to music, or reading text messages you can't go wrong here. I wish the battery lasted a little longer but that's the only improvement I can comment on. For the money you can't go wrong. Highly recpmmended!
I got this for my brother, Great fit, everything he needed to stay on top of his health this watch exceeds. Looks awesome too. Easily connects to his phone. Little pricey but worth it.

review_title: Original Samsung galaxy Smart watch vadnam
body_en: Good quality

I recommend it, it arrived in a timely manner, the truth is that the smartwatch surprised me, I've been using it for a day with the battery at 90% full (due to battery life) all day in the office and at night training. Very good functions, materials in general, it is an excellent smartwatch
بطاريه ضعيفه جدا
Very good, except that the cover is somewhat large, it contains many useful functions.

I use the Garmin Forerunner 970 every single day, and buying it has been one of the best investments I've made. As a triathlete, it has everything I need for swimming, cycling, and running—and much more. The training and performance metrics are outstanding, and the sleep tracking has been incredibly useful. Coming from the Apple ecosystem, I was especially impressed by the battery life. It lasts so much longer than I expected, making it easy to wear 24/7 without worrying about charging. Despite all of its features, the watch is incredibly lightweight and very comfortable to wear all day and night. I barely notice it's on my wrist. Paired with the Garmin HRM-Pro Plus, it becomes an exceptional combination for running and swimming metrics, and overall training analysis. I highly recommend it to anyone who is serious about running or triathlon.

review_title: The Best Sports Smartwatch I’ve Ever Owned
body_en: Absolutely phenomenal. The Garmin Forerunner 970 exceeded all of my expectations. The AMOLED display is stunning, incredibly sharp, and easy to read in any lighting condition. GPS accuracy is outstanding, the training metrics are extremely detailed, and the battery life is impressive even with heavy daily use. I use it for workouts, walking, and everyday health tracking, and it performs flawlessly. The build quality feels premium, it's comfortable to wear all day, and every feature works smoothly and reliably. If you're looking for a high-end sports smartwatch with advanced performance metrics, excellent battery life, and top-tier quality, this is worth every penny. Without a doubt, one of the best tech purchases I've ever made. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

review_title: One of the best smartwatches as a Triathlete
body_en: One of the best smartwatches I’ve used as a triathlete. Comes with a built in triathlon function that can track all 3 sports + transition times. Battery life lasts pretty much 2 weeks and recharges while I’m in the shower. Garmin also syncs all data from the Forerunner 970 with the Edge bike computers and connects with their heart rate straps and if you use a Wahoo/Zwift trainer everything syncs together as well. Display is super bright and comes with an always on display now + built in flashlight at the top which is probably one of the best things about the watch. I’ve also seen zero scratches on the display so I can attest the sapphire display they use is definitely more durable than my last Apple Watch’s display glass. It takes some getting used to compared to how easy Apple Watches are to pick up immediately but everything just makes sense once you figure it out.

review_title: The gadget that i always want to have.
body_en: As a recreational runner, the Garmin Forerunner 970 has proven to be a tremendous gadget that has truly transformed my training. The amount of data it collects is impressive, allowing me to monitor my progress with professional-grade accuracy. The device stores and translates complex metrics into a simple format, making it easier to make decisions to improve my fitness. I must admit that, at first, it is complicated to understand so much information and navigate through all the features it offers. However, once you get past the learning curve, it becomes indispensable. It is a powerful tool that, while offering elite-level functions, perfectly adapts to those of us who run for passion and health. A high-quality investment that keeps me motivated to keep clocking in miles!

This is one of the best Garmin watches I've ever had. The bright AMOLED screen is awesome, and the features are second to none. I love the color scheme with the gold bezel and buttons. I also love the color of the watch band, but found it too long as it wraps around my wrist almost twice, and also don't like that the band is not a QuickFit band. I like to switch out colors occasionally, so I replaced the band with similar 22mm QuickFit bands. I just wish Garmin would make this original band with a QuickFit connector. The battery life on this watch is amazing!! It lasted through a 5-hour race while playing music on it, and normally only needs to be charged every couple weeks. It's also really cold you can download and customize your watch faces. If you buy this watch you won't be sorry!

review_title: This watch is worth every penny!
body_en: This is the absolute best "smart watch" that has all the performance features I want even though, realistically, I won't use as many of them as I talked myself into believing when I made the decision to buy it. The Venu 4 was the other contender but I really wanted the on wrist color maps of the 970 even though the price was nearly $200 more. Another positive note on the new Garmin watches in general is the marked improvement in the UI and how customizable it is. My old Venu 2 Plus was very clunky and everything was buried deep in a chaotic menu structure. That watch, however, is still running strong. Other than theses points and the basic high quality of Garmin devices, the biggest advantage is the phenomenal battery life! I am getting 10-15 days depending g on how I use it. I have a Galaxy Ultra which I absolutely love but it needed to be charged everyday, even when not using workout features, which is why I was looking for replacement in the first place. If you can take the price hit, this is the beast to get.
I'm very happy with this purchase. It has everything I need to track my workouts and health. I recommend it to everyone. It's a very nice watch and easy to use.

I was concerned about making a switch from Fitbit to Garmin and in price shock, but it has been 2 months with my 970 and I LOVE it! The options are many and I am still learning to use more each week, but I like it. I love stats. This watch provides me with LOTS of stats and tracking from health to fitness for me. The battery life is a what caught my eye on this model, but the stats are beyond what I imagined. Garmin has challenges available. Each month I have been joining quite a few of thier challenges and that is very motivating for me. If you are on the fence about purchasing this, I truly don't think you will be disappointed once you pull the plug. This will last me for years to come.

review_title: Muy recomendado pero actualicen su dispositivo
body_en: I had bought the forerunner in white as a gift for my girlfriend and she loved it a lot so I was intrigued to buy one but in black for myself but when using it I noticed that the settings alone changed, the language etc., I returned it and changed it for another one and the same thing when charging my backup, and I bought another simpler one, the instinct 3 thinking that that one would work better but the battery still consumed in a week, so I started to investigate and my Garmin Connect app was not updating my devices, So I was looking for information and I downloaded Garmin Express, which is for both Windows and macOS and when you connect your device it updates it without any problem. I updated the Forerunner 970 and it works great for me. Whenever you purchase a Garmin product, update it via PC for better performance. Now the problem is solved, I have used it for running and the gym and the truth is that it gives me very good metrics and the battery is a thousand times better than an Apple Watch Ultra.
It is just as it appears in the photos.

review_title: ساعه ممله ولا تستاهل سعرها ابدا ولا انصح بها
body_en: The product is less than normal and not worth its high price. Worse than that, Amazon brought the watch in a deplorable condition, an open carton. I expect the watch to be used, and the packaging was bad. The watch is boring and not worth its price at all, and I do not recommend it at this price.
I'm super satisfied so far - good battery, lots of functions, etc. 🤗

review_title: Excellent product, best sports watch available.
body_en: Fantastic item, worth the expense. Lots of running data (probably more than I need, would be enough for an elite runner). Upgraded from a Forerunner 165 mainly for the maps (which are excellent, almost OS map quality) and the ability to plot courses on the watch. Music and lap times through bluetooth headphones. The watch also has a speaker to give times and warnings about pace (too slow/fast) which are useful during races when I don't wear headphones. Also has inbuilt torch which is good enough to assist when running after dark, and suprisingly useful at other times (think searching in dark cupboards, examining fuse box, etc). Battery normally lasts me about five days, with running everyday and on a fairly bright setting. Would be less if you used the "always on" setting. Screen bright and easy to read, even when racing (without my reading glasses!), and the screens are all customisable whether you are interested in pace, distance, heart rate, time in heart zones, ascent/descent, etc. The watch has metrics for loads of other sports, including cycling, swimming, snowboarding, etc, which I cannot comment on, but for a distance runner this is probably the best sports watch available today.

I absolutely love my new smartwatch! From the moment I started using it, I was impressed with how easy it was to set up and navigate. The watch has a sleek, attractive design and feels comfortable on my wrist. I especially like being able to keep up with my notifications, track my activity, monitor my health and stay connected without constantly reaching for my phone. The features are easy to use, and the display is clear and bright. For the price, I feel like I got a great value. It looks good, works well, and has many of the features I was looking for in a smartwatch. I’m very pleased with my purchase and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for an affordable, reliable smartwatch!

review_title: Fantastic Smart Watch for the price, AMAZING battery life!
body_en: UPDATE after 2 weeks of owning this Smart Watch for Women: WOW! It's been a week and a half since I last charged this smart watch, and it is only down to 16%! The battery in this watch is AMAZING! SO much better than the Versa2 I had before! [Earlier] So far, I am very impressed with this smart watch! (I previously had a Versa 2 and after about a year the battery barely lasted 2 days, which became very annoying, and then it just stopped charging at all) This Smart Watch for Women is VERY user-friendly. Its time, date, timezone, heart rate, steps etc all work extremely well. And it does much more than my Versa 2 ever did. This smart watch also receives AND sends calls, and did it seamlessly! I haven't yet used the text function to send, however, it has received all my texts and alerted me. It works well with the app, which was easy to download and set up. The BluTooth works well also. I'm also happy that this watch is waterproof (up to a certain depth) because I will be paddleboarding this summer, and swimming. The watch came with two bands from which to choose, which is nice. And it came with its own charging cord, proprietary at one end, but USB on the other. It seems to charge quickly. I would definitely recommend the Smart Watch for Women, especially for those who want a lot of the functions of an Apple Watch, but don't want to pay that exorbitant price! This watch is SO much more reasonable, AND it looks very nice on.

I absolutely love this watch! It looks beautiful, has so many useful features, and it’s been working great for me. The battery life is good, it’s easy to use, and the customization options are amazing. I also have to disagree with one of the 1-star reviews claiming that you can’t use your own photos as the watch face. That’s simply not true. I was able to set a personal photo with no issues at all. Maybe they didn’t know how to use the app or set it up correctly. Overall, this watch exceeded my expectations. It’s stylish, functional, and offers a lot for the price. I highly recommend it!

Had this watch for a couple of weeks now. This watch is not bad, it is also not the greatest. I don’t think it accurately measures steps and heart rate is hit and miss, seems like it depends on how you hold your wrist or how tight you wear the watch. The phone locater feature doesn’t always work either, and you can’t customize the watch face with your own photo or answer text messages. That being said, the workout features that track distance and speed, etc. are great. The sleep tracker works well and just about all the other watch features are pretty cool. I do like that you can answer your phone and talk through the watch because there’s a microphone which has the ability to connect to Siri. All in all I would say 3.5 stars. Oh and the charge does holds well, just like with anything though it depends on how much you play with it. Update: After writing this review I was contacted by Nora from the company’s customer service team and offered either a replacement or refund of the watch that I purchased. It was super unexpected but highly appreciated, and gave an undoubting sense that this small company cares about their products and the reception they receive. The interaction and level of customer service alone is enough to give the watch a higher rating, as it’s obvious the company cares and that’s more than most places these days. I would overall recommend

So realistically, I have gone through 4 (yes this is my 4th) smart watch this year (I think?! Might be 3 but anyways) and thos one by far has FINALLY given me everything I've been looking for. Well, almost everything. Still cant text out on it but, it is what it is. So, some interesting things about this watch compared to the others ive had are the accuracy of the biometrics taken, the screen quality, and overall battery life. I am even liking that when I misplace my phone is actually rings MY ringtone and not some weird built-in one from the watch company. I even love that you can change the notification tone ON the watch itself too. Pretty snazzy there. Now here's some downfall in my opinion (this is my personal opinion, use its information as you see fit). Firstly, the paid membership app im not thrilled about and its not for the price, thats fair across the board. Its the lack of knowing the time frame parameters used as well as this being noted in the listing itself. Another is, the lack of it being fully customizable (i.e. you make it your very own) backgrounds as well as the limited number you can have (4 is the max). But again, this is my opinion and im one who likes fully customizable things as I like to be different. Only other "flaw" is that it only has 1 button which sticks out a fair ways for my liking and digs into my wrist... Do wish it was a little more, sleek if you will in that department. But ive added photos to show the level of things offered as well as how it does look very asteticly pleaseing. Which is nice little bonus! So maybe im nitpicking on some things, oh well! All in all though, its beyond worth getting.
