review_title: The best “professional work” webcam I’ve personally used, especially for virtual backgrounds
body_en: I bought the Logitech MX Brio after spending years using a mirrorless camera setup (Lumix GH3 + prime lens) as my desk webcam. I work remotely full-time and spend most of my day in video calls (99% in Microsoft Teams), so my priorities are a little different from the average streaming-focused review. What I wanted was: • excellent image quality at normal desktop distances • reliable performance in Teams • strong virtual background segmentation • stable autofocus/exposure • easy to set up For my use case, the MX Brio has honestly been excellent. The biggest surprise was how good the image looks in real-world meetings. Yes, my GH3 (and other mirrorless cameras) can still produce a more cinematic image in ideal conditions, but in Teams specifically (where video is heavily compressed and usually capped at 1080p), the practical gap is much smaller than people think. As far as the camera is concerned, what matters most is consistency and signal quality, and this camera delivers both. The MX Brio handles exposure transitions smoothly, autofocus has been reliable, and image sharpness is very good without looking overly processed. Logitech also seems to have improved color handling compared to some older Brio models that could occasionally look harsh or over-sharpened. Where this webcam REALLY shines is virtual background and portrait segmentation. I use a virtual background almost 100% of the time, and this camera consistently gives cleaner edge separation than several other webcams I’ve tested. Good lighting absolutely helps, but the MX Brio seems to provide a very clean image feed that works well with Teams’ background processing. A few other things I appreciated: • solid low-light recovery without becoming a smeary mess • flexible field of view options • sturdy physical build • built-in microphone • easy mounting and positioning There are a couple tradeoffs worth mentioning: • Logitech’s software ecosystem is still a little fragmented (Logi Tune, G Hub, etc.) • if you are primarily a streamer/content creator, there may be better options depending on your workflow • this camera, like any, benefits significantly from proper lighting and good positioning. It's worth it to invest in a couple lights and proper mounting system But for a professional desk setup focused on video meetings, presentations, collaboration, and hybrid work, I think Logitech understood the assignment here surprisingly well. This is the first dedicated webcam I’ve used where I no longer feel tempted to drag a mirrorless camera back onto my desk.

review_title: Stunning 4K Clarity and Incredibly Easy Setup!

Having a built-in privacy cover is a great little bonus for peace of mind when I’m not on camera. If you want a high-definition webcam that’s simple to use but performs like a premium piece of equipment, the EMEET NOVA 4K is a fantastic choice. It’s been a reliable, high-quality addition to my workspace setup! Would you like me to refine this for a specific platform (like Amazon or a professional blog), or is this tone perfect for your needs?

I was super excited to purchase this 4K webcam to help myself have crisper, clearer video chats when teaching online. Since changing from an established workplace to freelance, I had to return my previous company computer, and that left me with my old 2012 HP running Windows 10. The built-in webcam on my laptop is terrbile! At my brother's recommendation, since I needed something better (and since simply using my cell phone wouldn't work for the long-term), I began looking into external webcams. I asked Google's AI to help me find something suitable for my laptop in particular, and somehow this 4K camera came up. However, when it came in the mail and I plugged it in, my computer didn't seem to recognize it at all. No blue light! Anyway, I was beginning to wonder if I'd have to return it, but I had already attached the "privacy" adhesive over the lens and was concerned that this might mean I couldn't send it back. Also, I really wanted it to work! So I did a ton of troubleshooting, updating things on my computer here and there, installing drivers, etc. Nothing worked. I then bought an external USB 3.0 hub since my laptop's hubs aren't powerful enough for a 4K webcam evidently. Plugged everything in. Still, nothing! Then finally, I asked AI for recommendations regarding that particular webcam and my specific laptop, once again. The final recommendation it gave me was to "install Native EMEET Software." I had read earlier that everything would be supplied automatically as soon as you plug it in, but it turns out that's not always the case. I went onto the website, and there's a place listing "downloads" where you can get the needed software for either Windows PC or Mac. So, I downloaded the Windows one ... and voila! At long last, after installing that software, the camera worked! Apparently it's still not perfectly displaying in 4K, but no matter! The quality is is a step down from that, since my computer cannot quite support 4K. What it can display though is still a MASSIVE upgrade from what I had before! The low-light performance is excellent, and you can adjust the camera settings (contrast, saturation, etc.). I've never used an external webcam before so to me this is pretty cool. Plus, I can always use this camera on a newer laptop whenever I'm able to purchase one, and then I can have perfect 4K. But for now, attached to the laptop that I have, this camera quality is still beyond "good enough"; it's great. I'm glad I didn't give up and send this back. So it's completely worth it -- just know that if you have an old computer running Windows 10, you might have to jump through multiple hoops first before getting it to work. ;)

review_title: Video streaming is your job = PASS ... Casual video for mtgs/life = BUY IT -- checks all the boxes
body_en: If video streaming is a way you make money, do NOT buy this. This webcam + microphone is not for professional level video streaming. If you need a webcam + mic device that is good enough, and performs better than most/all laptop integration webcams, then just buy this and call it a day. There are a lot of options, but I promise that unless you are a really particular human, you will be happy with this product. a) WfH business person taking video calls for work = YES b) private individual streaming to connect with friends/family = YES c) a recreational streamer = YES Detailed review notes below.... **MOST IMPORTANT THING TO KNOW** The camera can only go so far, but a lot of what determines the final video quality is what YOU do to create a good video streaming environment. Read: If you are in a windowless cave 50' below Earth's surface with no artificial lighting, poor video quality is on you, not the device. Lighting and distance of the camera from your face are THE MOST IMPORTANT VARIABLES in determining whether this camera performs well or not. I posted a photo of my specific camera placement and lighting and desk situation, and have tested out four different lighting scenarios (listed below) to show the impact of lighting on the video quality. **REVIEW NOTES** Each number 1-4 below has a matching image that I have attached to this review: 1. Only natural light from my office windows (indirect sunlight) 2. #1 + clip-on desk lamp with warm colored LED *MY FAVORITE SETUP* 3. #2 + recessed ceiling lights (3" white colored LEDs with 8' ceilings) 4. Natural light from windows + recessed ceiling lights (NO desk lamp) *NOTE*: Each image was taken via Windows Snipit tool while waiting to join a Google Meeting BOTTOM LINE, you have to mess around with your lighting and camera distance to get the sweet spot for your specific environment, and may require additional lighting sources (e.g. lamp) to get it right. The EMEET app is super easy to install and provides decent enough picture settings to tweak the image quality without being overkill. No login/account/signup required. I recommend keeping the "white balance" on AUTO at all times.

review_title: A great 4K cam with Sony sensor
body_en: The box for this is quite sturdy although not very visually impressive. Acer should put more effort into their packaging, particularly on a premium product like this. These are my main likes and dislikes for this product: Like: Sony 1/2 “ sensor 4K HDR Premium lenses Full metal body Compact and portable Good overall build quality Fully Plug & Play Dislike: Expensive at £79.99 rrp Lens cover falls off too easily As you can see there is a lot I like about this webcam. The image it produces look very natural, being not too colourful or contrasty, with just the right balance. The sharpness at 4K is a noticeable improvement over 1080p or even 1440p, as long as you have a monitor good enough to see the difference of course. The Sony CMOS sensor is good at controlling signal noise, so the fuzziness is kept to a minimum in low light, and is far better than a standard webcam with a generic cheap sensor. The autofocus is surprisingly good, again this is due to the sensor and chip combination. Tracking actually works in most instances, which I have not seen on a webcam before. The dual mics work very well and remove background noise almost completely. Voices are clear, even multiple voices can be heard perfectly within about six feet of the camera. Installation was a few seconds, as it is plug and play. This is being used on Windows 11 but it should also work on Apple Macintosh computers. The lens cap is a bit of a disappointment, it is not strong enough and is easy to knock off when handling the camera. A more powerful magnet is needed. The current price for this is £66 which I think is reasonable, and at that price it’s going to get a solid five stars.

The product listing on Amazon is brilliant and exciting, with many promises. Is some ways, the actual product exceeds the claims but in other ways it is "different". Skip down to " * " for the good news The little cardboard box it comes in is function but visually generic or industrial. No blame, but underwhelming for the magic of the promise of studio-quality visuals, making it ideal for gamers, educators, and professionals seeking streaming camera​ precision. The claim is that the USB cable is "5.9in" when, in fact, it is close to 57 inches or 1.4 meter. The claim is that it is USB plug-and-play when, if fact there may be some issues. On this Windows 10 computer, the device manager reports this as a 4K camera but with the caution "was not migrated due to partial or ambiguous match" I don't know. Some APPS can't find it but the important ones ( like ZOOM ) like it a lot. Don't bet on instant installation. The low-light performance is adequate. Kind-of OK but not outstanding. However, the auto-focus really goes nuts in very low light. It "hunts" and cannot resolve prime focus though it tries and tries. Works good with adequate light. The instruction manual is microscopic but well written, in good English, somewhat optimistic: claims OS compatibility with Window XP / Vista 7/8/10/11 Linux2..6.24 or later / Ubuntu ( ?? not IOS ? ) Again, don't bet on it. And why would you think that poor old Windows XP doesn't need a driver. * - the good news The form factor is small and pleasing. Maybe 2-1/2 inches wide and rather graceful, not aggressively rectangular like most. The image quality is exceptionally good, Snapshots indicate 3840 x 2160 resolution. FYI: this is considered 4K UHD (Ultra High Definition) — 3840 × 2160 pixels,as used in TVs, monitors, and consumer devices The activity light is actually an oval around the lens that slowly changes colors when the camera is active. It is interesting and a good excuse to keep looking directly into the camera - resulting is a better sense of "presence" in online meetings compared to appearing "off camera" and disinterested. The privacy flap is very small and easily overlooked - resulting in a dark, black picture of course - but handy and effective The camera HAS AUTOFOCUS ( some apps turn it off ) and can focus sharply down to 3 inches. Almost macro. I would keep it just for this feature. The mount is a ball attachment giving 360 degree rotation, about 90 degrees vertical and great latitude in how the clamp is positioned. The clamp-mount has a high quality metal insert for a 1/4-20 tripod screw The sound quality is very good. It is claimed to have AI properties and noise suppression. You will have to make your own determination. My video space has good acoustic qualities. I would have to test it in a tiled bathroom or a noisy coffee shop before I could comment on AI since everything, maybe even toilet paper, is now "AI". At a competitive price-point, this may be best among equals. If you purchase this camera, you will get to like it as part of your Zoom or Teams setup. note: pictures are selfie in a mirror ( maybe 4 inches away or less ) and a US quarter resting on the product box

review_title: Clear Webcam With Simple Plug and Play Setup

review_title: Works well and has privacy cover
body_en: This is a straight forward plug and play webcam. There’s no setup involved other than putting it on top of your monitor and connecting the USB cable. It’s 1080p so it’s not going to be as sharp or as clear as some of the other ones on the market. For example, the gold standard for me has been the instalink 360. Super detailed and clear and most importantly, it gets skin tone right. Compared to that, the Xoclon is just okay. It’s a bit darker, or a bit too light when it attempts to focus. But does it make sense to compare it to a $200+ webcam? No it doesn’t. What this Xoclon is good for is as a camera for your kid for remote learning or for your home office to use in a pinch. Not everyone cares about the quality and skin tones anyway. The microphone works well and doesn’t muffle my voice either. There is also a privacy flap for the camera lens itself. Now it’s worth mentioning that there is no hardwired privacy switch or button for the microphone and to be fair, most webcams don’t have that. There is also a light strip that indicates when the camera is in use. It’s purely to let you know when you’re using the camera and won’t do anything to illuminate your face or anything like that. For a plug and play camera that is about the cost of a fancy salad bowl, yeah this will do nicely.

This one is a hit or miss. So the clarity is definitely there and the quality is on poiny. No pixelating, no weird screen none of that. However, depending on the app you use the zoom will not come out. We have adjusted it several times and only on a specific app will it stay stuck in zoom. Honestly it is a 5 star product with clarity that most cameras don't give unless you spend hundred and hundreds of dollars and even then it isn't guaranteed. It was too easy to setup. And it mounts beautifully! With this one it is! So go ahead spend the money and invest in this product. It is truly worth it.

review_title: Easy Plug-and-Play 4K Webcam With Colorful Activity Lights
body_en: I recently picked up this webcam and have been pleasantly surprised with how well it performs for its size and price. Setup was about as easy as it gets. I connected the webcam to a Microsoft Windows 11 laptop, and there were no drivers to download or install. Simply plug in the camera to any USB-A port and it should be recognized as both a video and audio device. Windows Settings>Bluetooth & Devices>Cameras and Settings>System>Sound>Input configuration menus allow further adjustments if needed. I found it easiest to start with the Windows Camera app to preview and tweak the image. Windows 11 shows the highest 16:9 resolution for the webcam is 8.3 MP (3840x2160). The camera image was quite good when there is adequate light. The sound quality is certainly very usable. The listing mentions "Smart Noise Cancellation," but I was not able to verify that feature specifically during my testing. Physically, the camera is very small compared to my old Logitech webcam. It also has fun lights that rotate through many colors when the camera is in use. This is a great visual reminder that the camera is active. For privacy, there is a physical lens cover that can be folded down to ensure no video can be captured. This adds real peace of mind beyond just relying on the colored lights being off. One minor gripe is that the lens cover can be a little difficult to flip up if you have larger fingers, since there is no handle to grab to flip it up. Overall, this is a nice camera for use with Windows video capture, video conferencing applications, live streaming, and general everyday use. If you want an easy plug-and-play webcam with solid image quality, this one is definitely worth considering.

review_title: Exceptional Quality for Streaming and Video Calls!

The 1080p resolution at 30fps provides crystal clear, sharp images, and the autofocus works seamlessly to ensure that the picture remains clear even with movement. Logitech's software provides additional customization options, allowing for fine-tuning of video settings to get the perfect shot every time. Overall, the Logitech C922x Pro Stream is an exceptional webcam that I highly recommend to anyone looking to enhance their streaming, video conferencing, or content creation experience. Its superior video and audio quality, combined with easy setup and useful features, make it a top choice for professionals and hobbyists alike.

I bought this product close to a month ago as a quick solution to use on discord calls with a freshly set-up gaming pc. Since I wasn't going to be using this for anything professional, I wasn't a stickler for the quality. That being said, I was pleasantly surprised to find that it did look better than the built-in webcam I had been using on my gaming laptop previously. I don't use the webcam microphone at all, so I can't speak for any of the audio-related aspects of this device. I was worried about it's ability to fit on my monitor before purchasing, but the clip mechanism is surprisingly easy and universal across the 3 monitors I've mounted it on. I would say as long as your not rocking a CRT, this should fit on any flat-screen monitor. It was also a bonus that the clip design allowed me to slide the webcam from one end of the monitor to the other. The length of the cord was just under 5ft, I loosely measured 4'10". It helped that I already had a usb extender on-hand, since it wouldn't reach my middle monitor while plugged in. For any privacy enthusiasts, it does not have an LED indicator for when it's in use, and doesn't come with a built in cover either. In my case, this was actually a good thing since an LED would annoy me when gaming in the dark, and a cover would just add useless weight. I've only tested on a Windows PC, but the plug-and-play was definitely functional. The Windows camera app would register it around 5 seconds after plugging in. I can speak for the low-light adjustment, it was able to pick up my face clearly during gaming sessions with the lights dimmed. Overall, this was perfect for my use-case, and was supringly better than what I had in mind for a $10 webcam.
It is good
terrible quality can't stream with it it's so dark and grainy
Great value for 20 bucks

I purchased the EMEET S600 primarily for my trading card business, and it has been a fantastic upgrade. The image quality is sharp, colors look accurate, and the autofocus locks onto cards quickly, making it easy to showcase details during live streams, recordings, and product photos. The 4K resolution provides excellent clarity, while the 1080P 60FPS mode delivers smooth video when streaming or creating content. I was especially impressed with how well it handles close-up shots of trading cards, allowing text, artwork, and card conditions to remain clear and easy to see. Setup was simple, and the webcam worked right away without any complicated configuration. The Sony sensor produces a clean image even in less-than-perfect lighting, which is a big plus for desk setups and hobby rooms. If you're a trading card seller, collector, streamer, or content creator looking for a high-quality webcam with reliable autofocus and excellent image quality, this is an easy recommendation. Great value for the performance it delivers.

I've only had it for a day, but based on some testing it seems really great. For me this is an upgrade from an older Logitech 920 - and this new EMEET beats it hands down. The sharpness of the image and the colors are really awesome. The lens angle is about the same, it's perfect for work meetings. I really appreciate the mechanical shutter and the little light that comes on when there is video capture. It's really adjustable - once you have the base fixed on your monitor, you can further adjust the camera itself to look a little down, helps if you use large monitors (mine are 27"). It's easy to use as no drivers were needed - and I checked Windows 11, Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 (work computer), web browser based capture as well as the Linux Zoom app. It's connected through a USB switcher I'm using with all my peripherals, and I am not seeing any connection flakiness. The webcam has a feeling of quality, it's well made and quite heavy to be honest. I think the design is attractive.
Bought this for my husband. He streams games and he's obsessed. Very clean image, easy set up with plug and play. Free software to download to adjust settings. 10/10 recommend.
Webcam works great, very clear. Packaging by Amazon was awful. They packaged in a bag not a box and it came damaged with a broken cord due to packaging. Luckily other cords fit it.

I'm in the process of interviewing for a new job and want that first impression to make an impact. I remember when I interviewed for my current job years ago they later commented on how good my streaming quality was. I used my school's AV room which had excellent webcams, mics, and a studio booth. I'm on the job market again and need an AV setup that won't break the bank. This camera fits the bill perfectly because it's cheap enough for just a few uses but still delivers an excellent picture. As with any camera, always learn how to connect and adjust software settings before going live; that aside, I didn't have any issues connecting and making adjustments (mirror, brightness). You'll need to download their app to make adjustments. Very intuitive from there. Seems to be forgiving of lighting technique so long as you simply have adequate lighting. White balance is dead on (5000k Walmart light bulbs), just be ready to adjust light source angles and brightness settings. Microphone works, but any monitor-mounted camera mic won't be great. I bought a $30 lavalier mic and it made a huge difference. You can have excellent video quality, but if the audio sucks it's all for nothing. If I could nitpick I wish it shot in 24 FPS. 60 is nauseating, and luckily most streaming services will knock it down to 30 anyway. More fps is not better. It just looks unnatural and consumes more resources in doing so in the process.

review_title: Clear Video Quality and Great for Streaming or Video Calls
body_en: This webcam is a great option for streaming, online meetings, video calls, and content creation. The video quality looks clear and sharp, and the design is modern and easy to place on a monitor or desk setup. I like that it gives a more professional look compared to a regular built-in laptop camera. It is useful for work, school, gaming, or recording videos. Overall, it is a good webcam for anyone who wants better image quality and a simple setup.

review_title: Work pretty well against light. Still light up you face pretty well
body_en: Really good quality. Good image and works pretty well agains light.

It's... fine. The picture quality I've experienced is nothing like the crystal clears pics they use to advertise. Doesn't handle low light well, and even in high light, the picture quality is ok. Though it's perfectly serviceable. Integrates with my comp and programs very easily so no complaints there. Onboard microphone is pretty low quality. Again, works, but kinda muffle-y and ugly sounding. It's a solid 3/5. Fairly priced. Works well enough. But you're not maxxing production value on anything. At least with my experience.

This is an excellent camera for its intended purpose- web conferencing in much better resolution than most built in laptop cameras or conferencing monitors. It's not really meant for streaming (you'll want a DSLR setup for that). It suits its purpose very well! The biggest plus is that it can do 1080p FHD in 60 fps. There are cameras 2x-3x the price that still only shoot 1080p in 30 fps. The camera is very solidly built, and the twist-to-open privacy shutter isn't flimsy like many are. The camera also has 45° of swivel on its mount, very handy for compensating for angled dual monitors, or for keeping unwanted objects out of the background. The retro tubular "This is a camera" shape also looks cool! There are 2 inbuilt microphones, which would be useful if you're using a desktop that lacks an inbuilt speakerphone or a monitor that has one. I have an external microphone so I only used the feature to test it. It's better than most conference monitor mics, but not an external dynamic or condenser microphone. The Emeet Link software is very basic, and resolution is altered in your camera settings instead of the app. The only complaint I have is the lack of a manual focus option, but considering the features for the price, and the use case, it is forgivable. Overall, it does everything I want it to, the price was right, and it works. Highly recommended!
I loved the image quality, good value for money option

review_title: Solid Performer – Clear Image, Great Audio & Smart Design
body_en: I’ve been using this webcam for almost 12 months now and I honestly can’t fault it. It’s well designed, reliable and performs exactly as expected for video calls and streaming. The camera mounts securely on top of my monitor, with a clever design that allows it to sit flush and hug the screen without slipping or wobbling. It feels stable and unobtrusive, which is ideal for day-to-day use. A standout feature is the built-in privacy cover—a physical lens flap you can close when not in use. This is a must-have in today’s digital environment and offers peace of mind in the unlikely event your system is ever compromised. When closed, you’re completely protected from any unauthorised access to your webcam feed. It connects via USB-A to USB-C, while it does come with a cable (I believe around 1m long), I opted to purchase a 2m extension with a right-angle USB-C plug. The angled plug was important to me, as it allows the cable to sit neatly without jutting out from the back of the camera—especially helpful for keeping things tidy and adjusting placement when your PC isn’t close to your monitor. As for performance, the image quality is excellent for a webcam, especially considering the price. It delivers a sharp, vibrant picture with fast autofocus and smooth frame rates, particularly noticeable at 1080p @ 60fps. It’s absolutely up to the task for Zoom meetings, live streaming, or content creation. The built-in microphones were a pleasant surprise too. I had a separate desk mic on standby assuming the webcam mic would be subpar, but so far I haven’t needed it—the onboard mic does a great job and captures audio clearly with minimal background noise. All in all, I highly recommend this camera. Between the thoughtful design, impressive performance, and practical privacy features, it’s a well-rounded piece of kit that’s been a great addition to my setup. 5 stars without hesitation.

review_title: Fantastic camera - great value for money!
body_en: Very good camera!

review_title: Great Webcam for Online Teaching, Streaming, and Content Creation
body_en: I purchased the eMeet S600 4K webcam to upgrade my home recording setup for creating tutorial videos and online training sessions, and it has turned out to be a very good choice. Image Quality The webcam uses a 4K UHD sensor which produces very sharp and well-exposed video, even when recording at 1080p. The image looks much clearer compared to typical built-in laptop cameras. It also supports 1080p at 60fps, which makes motion look smooth during presentations or live sessions. � Amazon +1 Autofocus and Light Handling One feature I really appreciate is the fast autofocus and automatic light adjustment. The camera quickly locks focus on the face and keeps the image clear. The automatic exposure also balances shadows and highlights nicely, which helps when lighting conditions are not perfect. � Best Buy Ease of Setup Setup was extremely simple. It’s truly plug-and-play and worked immediately with recording software like OBS Studio, video conferencing apps, and Windows without needing additional drivers. Extra Features Some small but useful features include: Physical privacy shutter Wide 88° field of view Dual noise-reducing microphones Custom settings available through the eMeetLink software. � Forbes Best Use Cases This webcam works very well for: Online teaching Video calls and meetings Streaming and recording Content creation Tutorials and presentations Final Verdict For the price, the eMeet S600 delivers excellent video quality and useful features. When paired with good lighting and an external microphone, it can easily produce professional-looking recordings. Highly recommended for anyone looking to upgrade from a built-in laptop webcam.

I’m really happy with the OBSBOT Tiny 3 Lite. The video quality is very clear, and the 4K resolution looks great for online meetings, video calls, and content recording. The AI tracking works smoothly and keeps me centered without needing to adjust the camera manually. It is also compact, easy to set up, and feels well-built. The microphone quality is also decent for daily use, and the overall experience is much better than a regular laptop webcam. For the price, I think this is a great option if you want a smart webcam with good image quality and useful tracking features. Highly recommended!

review_title: Great image clarity and a very good value.
body_en: Great small webcam. It is very easy to use. Good quality. It follows your movement. It adjusts to different lighting and has very good image clarity. I like it a lot.

review_title: I am in love with it
body_en: My first impression was that the webcam’s smaller than I expected, I thought it would be double the size, not that I mind it as long as it doesn’t affect the quality. I figured microchips nowadays are way too powerful. I have been using the webcam for a couple of weeks now and oh boy I am impressed. The image quality is amazing, I don’t use 4k, 1080p is all that I need and it beats other webcams I have tested. Inside this tiny body, even the built in mic works great, it picks up audio very efficiently, and I love it has different audio mode to choose from for different sound effects. To control the webcam, It offers gesture control and voice control, both are good, I find myself use voice commands more often for its convenience. Another great feature is the beauty filter, I don’t use it myself, but it’s a lot of fun. It’s a bit costly compared with other cheap webcams, but it’s totally worth the money.

The camera was awesome for about 1-2 weeks. Then they released an update that is absolute trash and tanked my camera quality. The cameras auto-focus and auto-exposure features are also not performing as well anymore either, and now the camera is constantly focusing and adjusting it's exposure. The app is also utilizing way too much of my PCs resources now (pretty significant draw on my PSU).

review_title: Works well depending on what you are using it for.
body_en: Great picture quality and works great for my vlogs however it keeps shutting down in the middle of a Zoom.

review_title: Solid premium product either strong AI capability
body_en: I need to upgrade the webcam for my home office as I need to video meeting a lot. The biggest value of OBSBOT Tiny 3 Lite is an impressive AI-powered capability that combines sharp 4K video with smooth automatic tracking. Its motorized PTZ design follows you as you move, keeping you centered without needing to manually adjust the camera—great for video calls, presentations. Specially for long hour video calls when you need to move around instead of sit still. The 4K image quality is excellent in good lighting, and 1080p at up to 120fps provides smooth video for more active use. The built-in three-microphone array also delivers clear audio for meetings and calls. Overall, the Tiny 3 Lite really worth the money for anyone looking for a smart, versatile webcam with reliable AI tracking, excellent video quality, and convenient built-in audio.

Using this mainly for video calls and work meetings, and it has been excellent so far. The video looks clear, it connects reliably, and I haven’t had any issues during calls. Setup was straightforward, and it just works without needing much adjustment. Definitely a solid upgrade over my laptop’s built-in camera.

I’ve been using the OBSBOT Tiny 3 Lite 4K AI Webcam with a Mac mini dual-monitor setup, and it feels far more premium than its compact size suggests. Setup on macOS was quick and essentially plug-and-play, while the AI-powered PTZ tracking works smoothly and makes Zoom meetings, teaching, and presentations feel much more dynamic than with a standard webcam. The 4K image quality is sharp, HDR handles indoor lighting well, and the 1/2” sensor performs noticeably better than most built-in laptop cameras, especially in low light. I was also pleasantly surprised by the microphone clarity and the clean industrial design that matches modern desktop setups nicely. Overall this is one of the most impressive compact webcams I’ve used for meetings, streaming, and content creation.
Excellent video quality, tracking, very small and discreet.

review_title: OBSBOT Tiny 3 mit leichten Schwächen die sich sicherlich per Update beheben lassen.
body_en: Small and good camera that does what it's supposed to do. It has excellent video and audio quality. The camera was immediately recognized by the PC with Win 11. To use it, however, you have to download the manufacturer's app. This takes some getting used to; setting the desired parameters is not very intuitive. A second small drawback for me is the alignment in multiple person and tracking mode. You have to speak very precisely towards the camera so that it then switches to the relevant person. The panning is then slow. There is a fear that people with a similar voice pitch will confuse the camera. However, the camera has no problems following a single person. This happens quickly and without any problems. The camera was completely convincing. I give the camera 4.5 stars (rounded up to 5). The problems with multiple people can certainly be fixed with an update, as can the app and its operation. For me it works great as a webcam, you get used to the app. The camera is relatively heavy for its size, which becomes noticeable when it rotates. There are no jerks to be seen. The base also has a connection for a tripod with a standard screw. All in all a purchase recommendation for this price. The camera is delivered in a sturdy box, including documents and USB cable. A power supply is not included.
Tiny is amazing! Although it was small and I didn't care if it was installed or not, the data seemed to be on par with a high-end broadcasting station camera.

review_title: best webcam I have ever have
body_en: This is the best desktop webcam I have ever owned! I used it during a Zoom meeting with my sister and family, and the AI tracking worked incredibly well. As I moved from left to right, the camera smoothly followed me and kept me centered in the frame. The 4K video quality is clear, sharp, and detailed, making every call look professional. I am impressed by the wide-angle view, HDR performance, and smooth video. The built-in microphones pick up my voice clearly, and the voice control is very convenient. It is easy to set up and works perfectly with my computer. The camera feels well made, and the compact design looks great on my desk. Whether you need a webcam for family calls, business meetings, streaming, or recording videos, the Tiny 3 Lite is an excellent choice. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a smart, high-quality 4K webcam.

Cannot fault this webcam! I run an ultra high spec PC and OLED monitor, so I wanted a camera with the same degree of quality, which this is! Very user friendly via the app. Autofocus and all tracker functions have fast reaction times. The video quality is stunning and sharp. Very well priced in my opinion.

review_title: Fantastic desk light for non-big light people
body_en: I LOVE this thing! I'm an online college student, so I use my computer desk for all my learning. This light is super nice. The max brightness is VERY bright - it lights up my entire workspace. The other settings are great for low light/late night use. I also really enjoy the touch power on/off remote it comes with. Very easy to power on/off or choose my light setting. I also like that I can adjust the direction and angle of the light bars quickly and easily. Setting it up only took 1-2 minutes, and it's securely fastened to my desk. Even when I need to adjust the gooseneck or the light bars, it's sturdy. I've never had any issues with the lights, and I've been running them almost 8-10hrs a day for the last 5 months straight. Overall, probably one of my better purchases this year. I'm not a "big light" kind of person, so this is perfect for when I want darkness but still need to do my math homework, haha.

review_title: Worth every penny and then some!!
body_en: Only 1 regret related to this purchase; that I waited this long to finally add a lamp to my makeshift “office” at home and subsequently finding this lamp. For years I’ve worked under an overhead light in my dining room (I own a townhouse, not huge so no extra room for an actual office, therefore my desk is downstairs in between the LR and DR) with my headaches and migraines becoming more and more frequent. I set the lamp up almost immediately upon delivery. Super simple to set up, no hassle at all, clamp it to the desk, tighten the clamp, plug it up and throw 2 AAA’s into the remote and BAM! You’re done. The strain on my eyes and my head was almost instantly relieved. The numerous light settings to choose from, AWESOMENESS. After trying them all I finally found my sweet spot (and It took less than five minutes to find). I love that it has a nightlight setting (didn’t notice that in the description) and a timer. It appears to be made very well, very sturdy but easily flexed to your liking. Love that the lights are two different bars and can be adjusted individually as well. Overall, best money I’ve spent on my workspace since I discovered the almighty mouse jiggler, honestly. If you’re on the fence and looking at every lamp Amazon has listed, save your time and energy and just click to buy, I promise, you won’t be disappointed!!

This is hands down one of the best desk lamps I’ve owned. Assembly was quick and easy, and the metal clamp base feels very sturdy once installed. It stays in place even when adjusting the arms. I love the flexibility the 360° standing pole, 180° swing arms, and 270° rotatable head let you position the light exactly where you need it. The 25 lighting combinations (5 color temperatures + 5 brightness levels) make it perfect for reading, working, or content creation. The touch controls are simple, and the wireless remote is super convenient. The LED lighting is bright, even, and easy on the eyes with no glare or flicker. Sleek, adjustable, and worth every penny. Highly recommend! 💡

review_title: The Lamp that does it all!
body_en: Great Lamp..Does everything you could ask for. Lights up spread out, lights up pushed together. Has a long goose movable neck and i mean perfect height as they could not have made it more perfect for me. Adjusts to your desk perfectly. Has a light up remote base that sits near it and is easy to use. The base gives you an on and off push on button in middle larger size button that the five others. Gives youTiming, Nightlight, Natural Light, Color Temperature and Brightness. You could not ask for more!

Setup in less than 5 minutes without looking at the instructions. Looks great. The levels of brightness and temperature options are fantastic. My little corner office was extremely dark and, without installing a light in the ceiling directly above it, i was having trouble finding a way to light it. This worked perfectly and is easy to use. The remote is very user-friendly and doesnt feel cheap like most remotes. Worth every penny.

review_title: Great for big monitors, but overpriced for what you get
body_en: Solid monitor light, but probably not worth the price unless you have a huge screen This has been a nice addition to my desk setup. I chose it because, as you can probably tell, my monitor is massive (49 inches), and I needed something that would actually cover a decent portion of the screen. Pros: Brightness: This light really helped brighten up my space. My office tends to be pretty dark, so it’s been great for overall visibility and eye comfort. Size & Flexibility: I love how large it is and that I can move it around to get the angle I want. Quality: It feels well-made and doesn’t look cheap at all. (To be fair, this is the only monitor light I’ve tried, so I don’t have a ton to compare it to.) Cons: Price: Even though the build quality is solid, I still don’t get how this costs over $50. It’s just white and warm light with brightness adjustments. No RGB, no standout features. If you don’t have a large curved monitor like mine, I’d say go with a cheaper one that offers more features. Remote only: This part is wild to me. There are zero controls on the light itself. Everything depends on the remote. So if you misplace it, you’re basically out of luck. Final thoughts: Overall, the light works well, and the size is perfect for my ultra-wide monitor. I just think it’s overpriced for what it is. If you specifically need the large size and basic lighting, it’s a good pick. But if not, there are more affordable options out there with better features.

Excellent. One of the best deck lamps in this segment that I’ve ever used. Not a single cent wasted. The weight, mounting system, and especially the quality of the long flexible arm (it’s light but holds its shape confidently) are impressive after trying many other cheap (and not-so-cheap) mounts. The brightness and light quality are finally sufficient for painting — I’m an artist, and this one lamp alone is enough. I no longer need to turn on additional light sources to work comfortably on smaller formats. It seems the manufacturer, unlike most others, uses powerful new-generation LEDs here. The lighting is well-designed, with high build quality and adjustable color temperature. The wireless remote is excellent — very convenient, high-quality, and you definitely won’t lose it or spend time searching for it. Fantastic ergonomics. I’ve been using the lamp for six weeks now and just decided to write this review because I can confidently recommend it to anyone who values high-quality workspace lighting — at a price four times cheaper than professional equivalents. The only thing worth noting is that the working part of the lamp gets warmer than similar models with cheaper LEDs, but it’s not a problem — it’s just warm, not hot, and the plastic housing is also of very high quality.

review_title: Best light setup in my office!
body_en: This is perfect. I can adjust the brightness or the shade/color of the light. I can move the arms to where I need the light, so that it isn’t glaring in my eyes. I just love it. Half my coworkers like it they may buy one too!

The perfect light for a desk. Lots of light and I mean lots, intensity, colour, timer all very easy to set. Adjustment are easily made with the flexible goos neck, various rotations provided. No reflections on screens. Your eyes do not even see the lights if you carefully but easily set up this light. The WIFI controller is neat, small and very effective. This design met all my expectations and then some. The price/quality ratio is SUPERB! Well done.

review_title: Gran espectro de cobertura y luminosa!
body_en: Excellent lamp, great spectrum it covers, very bright light if required (I have another one and it is not as powerful) very pretty!! I loved it!!!

review_title: Amazing bright light with sleek design
body_en: I am beyond impressed with this lamp, so much that I have ordered a second one. It has a sleek design so takes up minimal space and love the flexibility of the lamp for positioning and height. This lamp was set up in a darker basement room corner and brightens everything up like sunshine coming in!! The adjustable light settings are awesome so can suit to type of light needed (warm light, cool bright light etc) I will note that it took about 4-5 tries to pair the lamp with the remote (only way to operate it is by the remote), but it was well worth my few minutes of grumbling once got it to cooperate !!!!

review_title: Great lighting solution for dual monitor setup
body_en: I needed a desk lamp that could work with two 27-inch monitors in a fairly dim room. While this doesn't stretch all the way across both screens, it covers the center area toward 3/4 of the each monitors comfortably, which is more than enough for what I need. The brightness levels are great and make it easy to switch from screen work to writing or handling small parts on the desk without needing extra light. The gooseneck holds its position well once adjusted, and the remote is surprisingly responsive and handy. The build feels solid and I haven’t had any issues with it drifting or sagging. The various color temperature settings also help a lot depending on the time of day. If you're not looking for something that eliminates every shadow like a photography setup, this light does the job for 99% of daily work needs. Definitely a solid buy for any home office or study space.

I think this is a great product. I needed something for work that helped ease my eye strain due to light sensitivity. When searching for a monitor light I saw that there were many less expensive options available, however I went with this one because of the reviews and multiple settings (4-5 brightness levels, yellow lighting or bright lighting, timer, etc.). It is working great so far and I am really impressed. I really appreciate the very easy and functional touch settings pad that is battery operated and not attached to the light fixture itself. This allows me to keep it close by and adjust the settings when necessary. I also really like that the lights tilt so I can have them directly projecting onto my screen or I can turn them around to bounce off my cubicle wall, allowing for a more soft overhead light. I recently purchased a different model from a computer store that was on sale for $17 (single light, not double like this one) for my home computer, and it just does not compare. It feels cheaper and does not come with the same settings as this one. I have learned to buy quality items that I will only have to buy once versus less expensive items that require replacing more often. This light feels heavy duty and does an amazing job.

It’s always fun to order from Amazon and get something that’s even better than you imagined. I was pleased from the moment I picked up the well constructed manufacture’s mailing box from my porch. Inside thick precisely cut foam covered the pieces of the lamp, and helped to ensure the lamp arriving in perfect condition. It was easy to put together and literally took less than a minute. It is a great work surface lamp and all of the features mentioned on Amazon were easily assessable and enhance the purpose of the lamp. I liked the heaviness of the base, the adjustable arm, and the brightness options. Its modern design and clear cut features make it pleasant to look at, and it doesn’t take up too much space. It’s great for detail work, and you can tell the designers put careful thought into function and user satisfaction. I love it, it’s exactly what I needed, and is definitely worth the money!

review_title: Visually appealing, nice size, sensible controls that remember your previous settings!
body_en: First of all, I really appreciate a desk lamp that can simulate the warm glow of an incandescent lamp (this is 3k, not 2.7k which is close enough for me). The harsh white/blue colors of many LED lamps don't do it for me but if that is what you want, you can get that here too! In addition, I think it is nice to have a consistent light color throughout the entire house and the warm color is consistent with the rest of my home. I also really appreciate that I can turn it on/off and have it come back on at the LAST SETTINGS that I had previously!! I don't have to re-set my preference every time I turn on the lamp which is not uncommon (I have other lamps that I have to press the button 3-4+ times to get it to the intensity and/or color that I want every time I turn it on). Once you set your preference, it remembers it! It is somewhat of a minimalist design, just enough equipment to do what it needs to do. The black color matches the other things on my desktop. It does have quite a lot of brightness levels which I also appreciate. I find the height to be about right. If it is too tall, it can get in the way, and if it is too short, it may not be flexible enough for enough circumstances. I have my lamp behind the computer monitor, but then position the light over and towards the desktop in front of my screen. I can then reach underneath or around the monitor quite easily to turn the light on/off. Overall good value and nice, thoughtful, functionality.

Excellent lighting and adjustability! This is exactly what I needed for my hobby space. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Pros: - Adjustable brightness and color temperature make it easy to get the perfect light wether it's bright out or not. I do use a floor lamp as my main light source, and then this on my desk to focus on what I'm working on. - Great for detailed work like paint-by-numbers and helps with reducing eye strain from an overhead light. - Does not heat up, even after hours of use. - Sleek, modern design looks great on my desk. Cons: - Only wish the base had a built-in phone charging port and that would make it perfect to the point where I would buy this for everyone who has a home office. - Adjusting the angle of the rods does make it tilt just a tad. It should've been sturdier for the price.

review_title: Great lamp and easy to use!
body_en: This lamp is perfect for my office space and has many great features such as the tap function to turn on and the ability to dim and adjust it as needed. I initially had issues getting it to turn on in the morning so I reached out to customer service. Not only were they very responsive, but they were kind and very helpful. I was able to resolve the issue and everything works great!

easy to assemble, feels solid, varying color temperature and intensity makes this useful for a variety of functions. Most of the time it just lights my desk, but when I get on a video call, I can set the light to warm, rotate the light toward me, and see a professional-looking image. it’s nice and tall, and flexible, so I can reach everywhere I need to. I haven’t really used the timer feature, but I’m sure that’s cool for the people who need it. The base is nice and heavy, but very thin so it standstill and never seems ready to tip.

Very good light, flexible and I really like the variable intensity and temperature. Great for arts & crafts and good for using even during video calls. For the price, highly recommend it. Granted, I have had it for about a week and so far it is great but can't speak of its longevity. The only issue for me, so far is that the base is unstable as the top is heavier so when one extend or move the arm, it is important to press down on the base so that it does not flip over. The instability of the lamp only occurs when the arm is moved or pulled down otherwise it remains stable on the table. Purchasing the top screw version may be a good choice to avoid the lam from falling over. The lamp is very easy to assemble and is aesthetically pleasing.

review_title: The Light is awesome. The support is better.
body_en: Bought this light almost two years ago. Provided easy to use and versatile service, until the day I moved it. Then it stopped working. Couldn't get it to function at all. Contacted support, who asked for a video demonstrating that I was using it correctly. Took a quick video and sent it, and immediately Shirely arranged to have a new unit sent to me. No additional cost. I was pleasantly surprised when it arrived a few days later. New unit works just like the original. One of the best customer service experiences ever. About the light, its functionality is great. Variable brightness, ability to change color frequency and easy of positioning all make this light damn good. My only comment for improvement would be the website. If you register the light, the warranty is extended from two to three years. Unfortunately, even after trying multiple ways, I was never able to complete the registration. Hopefully I won't need any more support. Thanks LitONES!

This lamp is sturdy and versatile. The base is heavy enough to hold in place without tilting, the pivot points hold in position you place it in, yet easy to position. The 3 modes of function and the dimmer switch, I have found to be a big positive. Surprised how much I use the timer (30 mins or 1 hr). Only issue I have is I have other uses for it. It doesn't sit in one place. My solution is to buy a second lamp.

Why did I not get this item sooner??? I've been using different desk lamps for my art with much difficulty seeing at night in the basement, despite the light. I bought two of these lamps, one for each side of my desk. So much brighter and easier on my eyes!! They are easy to put together and look very sleek sitting on the desk. Also, I can't wait to see how my photography works using these.

Bought as gift for my niece who often works from home and who’s desk is in a room with poor lighting for computer work, zoom meetings etc. She is delighted with how it can be focused, adjusted, how sturdy, attractive it is and how it has improved her work station without taking up much desk surface. She would definitely recommend!!
Easy to use. Attractive. Great light for Zoom calls.
Perfect for my little office at home. Solid base, very flexible arm, excellent lighting with 10 x brightness and 3 x colours. And easy to use - you hardly need instructions.
Great lamp, it’s bright, adaptable, dimmable and great for the night time hobbyists.

review_title: High Quality With Many Functional Options. Love It!
body_en: I was so impressed when I received and opened this JACKYLED LED Desk Lamp. First impression - HIGH QUALITY. It is not cheap and flimsy. It has impressive quality weight to it. It extends to 32" high and is crafted from Aerospace-Grade Aluminum. It offers 5 brightness and 5 color temps for 50+ task lighting modes. You can control it from the included (batteries not included) remote control or from the controls on the lamp upright bar. The remote control has stepless dimming. I really prefer not to have to deal with another remote control around the house so I am loving the controls on the lamp. The light is easy on the eyes from the 5-layer eye caring technology which provides soft, glare free uniform illumination. Also has a reading mode, video conferencing mode and a timer mode. The swing arm provides 4 flexible mechanical joint providing many positional options. The light itself also rotates 45-100 degrees side to side. The base is heavy to prevent sliding around. To change the options on the lamp controls you give it a short touch - hold it too long and it won't respond. Everything you need is in the box except the batteries for the remote. It does include the plug adapter for the wall. A lot of companies are not giving you that anymore. When you find that perfect light setting for your needs it does have a memory function. It also has 95+ CRI technology making it more comfortable on the eyes and makes colors look more natural and true to life. This is no ordinary desk lamp. You won't find all these features on most other desk lamps. It's great for computer work, video conferencing, crafts, reading and more. This lamp is true quality. It's really a positive addition to my computer area.

review_title: Exceptional Versatility for Detailed Tasks and Office Work! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
body_en: Product: JACKYLED 18W Bright Soft LED Desk Lamp with Remote Clear, Adjustable Illumination for Detail Work I’ve been using this lamp at my desk setup for both general office work and detailed bench tasks, like cleaning and maintaining firearms. The soft, glare-free panel casts a broad, shadow-reducing light that makes fine-detail work significantly easier on the eyes. You can clearly inspect tiny components, springs, and surfaces without struggling against harsh hotspots or dark spots. Smart Controls & Infinite Customization With over 50 light combinations (adjusting both brightness and color temperatures), it’s easy to switch between cool, bright light for focused workbench projects and a warmer tone for evening computer work or video calls. Having the dedicated wireless remote control is a huge convenience—you don't have to reach up or fumble around with switches on the lamp arm when your hands are full or dirty from working. Flexible Position & Sturdy Build The multi-axis swing arm and adjustable head allow you to position the light exactly where you need it—whether angled directly down on a mat or positioned higher up over a monitor. The weighted base keeps it completely stable even when extending the arm out. Final Verdict Whether you need high-CRI lighting for detailed crafting, gun cleaning, and hobby work, or just an exceptional light for video conferencing and desk work, this lamp delivers on all fronts. Outstanding quality and incredible flexibility for the price!

review_title: Flexible reading lamp with adjustable brightness/warmth
body_en: This desk lamp is very versatile for many different applications. The main stand rotates 135°, there is a hinge about 3/4 of the way up and another hinge where the lamp attaches. Additionally, the lamp head can rotate 280°. This flexibility makes it easy to direct the light exactly where you need it. The brightness and temperature of the light can been adjusted using the buttons on the lamp stand or the included remote (2 AAA batteries required). The remote has two preset options for reading or computer video, which is really convenient. You can quickly switch modes and create a natural lighting look for video calls instead of harsh overhead fluorescent lights. The lamp also has an automatic shut off option for 30 or 60 minutes. The base is flat and heavy to prevent tipping, and has pads on the bottom so it won’t scratch your desk or table. The only downside is that it uses kind of a bulky AC adapter plug rather than a USB or small size plug. So you have to have enough clearance to plug it into the wall or a power strip. The cord is pretty long though so that is helpful (about 6 ft or just under 2m) Overall this is a nice desk lamp and I like the flexible options in directly the bright light where you want it, or just giving some ambient lighting.

I really like the different light levels and color temperatures this lamp provides. It works particularly well as a desk lamp because you can adjust the lighting to suit what you're doing. I've primarily been using it for soldering, where the bright light makes it much easier to see what I'm working on. My daughter also commented that it would be great for the artwork she does (and that she is likely to steal it from my desk)... The touch controls work very well. It comes with a remote, but I haven't needed to use it much since the touch controls are sufficient for me. The remote does provide some additional control, though, including independently adjusting brightness and color temperature up or down. The touch controls essentially cycle through the available settings. The remote also includes reading-light and conference-light modes. The lamp uses a wall power adapter ("wall wart"), with a barrel connector on the cord about 12 inches from the lamp base. According to the specifications on the adapter, it's rated at 24V × 0.75A, or exactly 18 watts. What could be improved The biggest limitation is the range of motion. The base rotates only about 100 degrees, and the first joint allows roughly 90 degrees of front-to-back movement. I'd like to see it swing farther forward because, starting from the vertical position, it can only lean forward about 20 degrees. The middle and upper joints have considerably more range of motion. I suspect this limitation was intentional to help prevent the lamp from tipping over. At its furthest forward position, the lamp does feel like it could potentially tip, although it hasn't done so. A slightly heavier base would probably allow for a greater range of motion without sacrificing stability. The joints themselves are nicely stiff. The lamp stays where I position it, and I don't have to worry about it gradually sagging or shifting over time due to gravity. Overall, I'm very happy with it. The adjustable brightness and color temperature are the biggest selling points for me, and the excellent lighting makes it especially useful for soldering and other close-up work.

This light is really awesome. You can angle it in so many directions you're pretty much guaranteed to get the white where you need it. It does have a timer on it. You can also change the tone of the light from warm to cool. It even has a setting that uses both a warm and cool. You can dim and brighten it. I really love that it comes with a remote control. The bottom of it is weighted so that it doesn't tip over no matter how far you lean it on the hinges. This does have a plug-in cord. The color is a nice matte black. This is great for on a desk, a shelf, or project area. This is lightweight enough that you can grab and take it wherever you need to use it. It is very sturdy. The materials used to make it are very strong and durable. It seems higher quality materials were used to create it. It seems like it's built to last. The wiring for it has a nice thick wire so that it won't crimp, bend or break. This would be a nice gift to give anyone who does arts and crafts or her needs extra light in the office for paperwork. The price value for the product quality is very good.

This desk lamp is fantastic and has made a huge difference in my workspace. The 5 layer lighting produces bright, even illumination without harsh glare, making it much more comfortable for reading, working, and spending long hours at my computer. The 95+ CRI is especially impressive since the colors look natural and true to life, which is excellent for video calls, crafting, and detailed work. There are so many ways to customize the lighting, with multiple brightness levels and color temperatures, plus stepless dimming. The touch controls and wireless remote make adjustments convenient, and the memory function saves my preferred settings. The timer is also a thoughtful feature for reminding me to take breaks. The four joint swing arm is another standout feature. I can easily adjust the height and angle to illuminate my entire desk without annoying dark spots. The 32 inch height provides excellent coverage, and the aluminum construction feels sturdy and premium. This is much more than a basic desk lamp because it’s a versatile, well designed workspace light that combines excellent illumination, adjustability, and durability. It would be an excellent choice for anyone working from home, studying, creating content, or spending significant time at a desk.

Give this little light a try; I think you'll really like it. The box arrives mostly assembled, so you should have it up and running within five minutes. At first, I was a bit disappointed thinking that the lamp could only be controlled with a remote. With dozens of remotes scattered throughout my house, the last thing I needed was another one for a simple lamp. However, I was pleasantly surprised to find that you can adjust everything that you would normally control with the remote using some conveniently placed buttons on the bottom stem of the lamp. These controls allow you to change the color temperature from warm white to cool white and adjust the brightness level, from mood lighting to super bright. There are also a couple of presets for reading light and ambient lighting, along with an on/off switch. A quick note about the on/off switch: you need to press the button briefly. If you hold it down, the lamp won't respond, which initially led me to believe I had a defective unit, but that wasn’t the case. If you’re looking for a small, well-built lamp that offers complete flexibility, you’ll be hard-pressed to find a better option, especially at this price point.

review_title: Too short, clunky to handle, and shines right in your eyes.
body_en: Decent light-wise, but it's pretty clobhoppy, awkward to handle, and difficult to place where you actually need it. Worse, it's far too short to illuminate your desk without shining directly into your eyes. If you raise or tilt it up to cut down on the blinding glare, it completely misses lighting up your workspace. It really needs a taller, more flexible pole design to be functional as both a desk lamp and a video light.

review_title: Basic desk lamp that delivers on features, quality and value
body_en: Great basic desk lamp, I like the ability to adjust the intensity and tempreture. controls are easy to use. positionig of lamp head gets the light where I need and then easy to reposition also. base is very stable, important with a busy desk. sleek style doens't take up much room. I like that the controls are on the stalk, my othe lamp the controls are on the base and often get covered with paperwork.

1. The controls are at the base of the vertical riser. They do not get obstructed by other items on the desk. Controls are very intuitive except for the 45-minute shut-off timer. No silly remote control to lose. 2. The base is about 6" by 6" and is made out of steel plate. It is large enough and heavy enough that the lamp is very stable. There is a soft, non-skid pad on the bottom that protects the table surface while keeping the lamp from being inadvertantly pushed around. I specifically wanted a lamp with a base such as this rather than a clamp-on type. 3. There is enough vertical adjustment to clear the top of large monitors. 4. The arms and lamp came pre-assembled. The only assembly requirment is to slip the upright post onto the base and plug in the power supply. 5. The power supply transformer plugs into a standard 120 VAC outlet. The cord is over 6 feet long so placement is not an issue. 6. Color temperature and brightness adjustments are easy. The lamp is sufficiently bright for reading printed material. 7. The light diffusion is quite uniform and has a wide dispersion angle. I originally was looking for a unit with a light bar ("wings") but this has proven completely adequate. I hope that it lasts for quite a while. The manufacturer states that there is an 18-month waranty but that is hard to count on with Chinese manufacturers. Really happy with this lamp, especially for the price.

I couldn’t be happier with my LitONES desk/office LED lamp! From the moment I set it up, it impressed me with its sleek design and reliable build. The adjustable brightness is a game-changer — whether I’m working late, reading, or just relaxing, I can always find the perfect light level. It’s incredibly easy to use, with intuitive controls that make switching settings feel effortless. The light itself is bright yet gentle on the eyes, keeping me comfortable even during long hours at my desk. This lamp truly elevates my workspace, combining style, practicality, and reliability. I’m thrilled with this purchase and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable desk lamp that delivers more than expected!

I tried several other lamps before getting this one, and they all had one problem or another--not bright enough, not high enough to put the light up over my monitor, too large a base that took up too much desk space, etc. This one is just about perfect. It has a small flat base that other things can sit on, but is still heavy enough to balance the lamp at the top. The brightness is adjustable, it's tall enough that the light is over my head instead of right in my eyes, and it even has a timer to turn off automatically if you forget. Excellent design and execution.

review_title: Excellent lamp for use with tall monitor configurations
body_en: After purchasing an Omorepa lamp to place behind my Dell UltraSharp U5226KW monitor, I discovered it was not quite tall enough to position properly without shining directly into my eyes. I ended up returning it and trying the LitONES desk lamp instead because it was slightly taller and, importantly, allowed the lamp head to rotate independently. That flexibility turned out to be exactly what I needed. I initially bought one lamp just to test the setup and quickly realized I had finally found the right solution. The lamp is tall enough to work well behind the 26.5-inch-tall Dell monitor, and the adjustable head makes it easy to angle the light over the monitor and down onto the keyboard and work area without glare. The light itself provides a soft white glow and the brightness can be adjusted easily. Because the monitor is extremely wide, I eventually purchased a second lamp and positioned one on each side behind the display. The only minor inconvenience is that each lamp must be turned on separately since there is no remote control. But honestly, that is a very small complaint — I can lean over and switch them both on in about five seconds. A pretty good sign that I may be a little spoiled at this point. If you have a tall monitor and prefer placing lights behind it so the illumination projects over the display onto your workspace, these lights are definitely worth considering.
I've been through a few, and this is a winner. Perfect for lighting your keyboard, nice smooth controls which are really useful- level of brightness, etc. Well work the $

Aesthetic design, sturdy base, functional control pad at base plate. I'm totally pleased with this purchase and the simple assembly confirmed the design team did their homework. Wide array of lighting options for every task. A+ product.

I like this lamp because it's taller than many other models. The brightness and color temperature are adjustable. The control buttons are integrated in the stand, clear and straightforward. But they are hard for me to access since I positioned my light behind my monitor. But it's a minor inconvenience so I still give this five stars.

review_title: Solid build and design. Fine for desk use, not sure if bright enough if full height
body_en: Great build, good brightness (wouldn't offer much at full height I think)... good choice of temperatures and brightnesses
Great spec and all as described

​I am absolutely thrilled with this desk lamp! The wide, linear light design provides incredibly even and bright illumination across my entire desk, without any annoying glare or shadows. I love the clamp-on feature—it securely attaches to the edge of the table, saving so much valuable desktop space. The flexible neck allows me to adjust the angle perfectly for working or reading. It looks sleek, modern, and high-quality. If you need a reliable and space-saving light for your home office or study area, I highly recommend this one!

review_title: A must have for your home office!
body_en: If you're looking for a small, versatile, and energy-efficient lamp, this will get the job done. With 3 light settings as well as a dimming option, the clamp secured everything to my desk without any issues. Furthermore, the wiring didn't interfere with my monitor, keyboard, and other accessories on my desk. Highly recommend as this only took a few minutes to set up.

This lamp is so great! Different types of light you can choose from, varying brightness settings, and the pink color one I got is awesome! Matches with the pink theme I have going on with my desk. Easy to set up and arrived quickly. Very happy with my purchase!

review_title: What a great adjustbable, dimmable desk light.
body_en: What can i say other than I love the LED desk lamp and that it is dimmable, easy to adjust, and operate. It does not take up much space on the back of my desk and is easy to setup. You can plug it into a USB-A port or plug it into the USB-A block it comes with. We are considering buying another one for my son's desk. This attached easily to my stand up desk and allows me to work in the lighting that I enjoy.

review_title: Recommended. Could be improved but good as is.
body_en: TL;DR: Recommended but could be improved. I'm using this lamp in my living room to illuminate a bluetooth keyboard in the evening. The gooseneck keeps the lamp where I put it and feels like it's well made and will last. The lamp has 3 color settings - white, amber and off-white(?). I'm not sure why they choose off-white rather than red, which is useful when you don't want to compromise your night vision any more than you have to. The lamp seems to be quite efficient; I've been running it on an old no-name (and over-rated IMHO) 30,000 mA USB power bank for about 12 hours, and I've got 87% of the battery left. It's wide enough to illuminate a full-size keyboard, but the LED strip is designed so it's easy to keep glare off the screen. I've got two power banks, neither of which start when the lamp is plugged in; you must push the button on the power bank to turn on the output. This is because the lamp (and other devices) don't draw enough current when the lamp is off for the power bank to notice it's connected! As a result, if I turn the lamp off (such that the lamp's blue standby light comes on) the power bank thinks nothing is connected and shuts down after a few seconds (and thus losing my dimmer adjustments). The lamp has a wide illumination range; it gets quite bright, and dims to a very low level, such that I can keep it on when I'm not using it and it isn't distracting. This is important because WHEN HE LAMP LOSES POWER IT FORGETS HOW MUCH I've DIMMED IT (for which I have deducted a star). To compensate for this, when I turn the light on for the evening I set the default (white) light to the level I need to view my keyboard; I set the other two colors to the lowest level. When I want to take a break and watch TV for a bit, I select the amber color and I can dim the light is enough that I don't notice it. Then when I want to type some more I switch to the white color and I'm in business. I have one other nit: The lamp's gooseneck threads onto the top of a stiff upright tube, which screws into the desk mount. This tube is long enough that I can barely position the lamp perfectly (due in part to my setup - others may not find it too long). This could be solved by shipping a 2nd tube about half the length of the current tube. This way I could use the short tube and it would give the gooseneck more 'reach'. Some may find it useful to use both tubes for added height.

review_title: Bright, Stylish & Perfect for My Desk!
body_en: ★★★★★ I love my Airlonv LED desk lamp! It’s bright, easy to use, and has a sleek design that looks great on my desk. The adjustable lighting is perfect for working or studying, and it was definitely worth the purchase! I just purchased one more for my Husband.

This is my third desk lamp purchase. At a certain point, I was really frustrated with paying $45+ on ones that would end up breaking or are just jankier than what they're presenting. So when I needed to get a third one, because my last one broke, I wanted to get something that made sense from a price standpoint, as well as, quality standpoint. And after receiving this, I've been really impressed with my purchase. It is so simple. It's sleek. I like that it has just three light options instead of my last one, which had six plus all these different dim settings (it was overwhelmingly too much). This light quality is fantastic. The material quality is much stronger than some of the more expensive ones I purchased from other brands. It was extremely simple to install and get set up. I recommend heavily. This has been a great product, especially coming from someone who's used the more expensive ones that you see on Amazon.

I've been using this desk lamp for a few weeks now and it's been great for both work and reading. The dimming makes it easy to find exactly the right brightness for any task. It's bright enough for detailed work I need to work on, while at the same time soft enough for evening use without straining my eyes. Build quality feels solid, and the arm is adjustable and wide enough to point light exactly where I need it. It looks sleek and doesn't take up any space since you just have to clasp it to the side of your desk! Overall, a really versatile little lamp and would recommend it for a home office or study space.

I’m using this as a shared lamp between 2 desks facing each other. It gives adequate work lighting at night while I’m on my laptop. When I need it, I can turn it to face me so I’m illuminated during video calls. I like that you can change the light brightness and colour.

I bought the lamp to save space on a small work desk. And it does its job perfectly. Installation was simple and all three types of lighting are very good. It doesn't dazzle you even when the light is at its highest.
Really bad quality and didn’t work, I’ve reported issue at the email and no response, never worth! +too expensive.

Great desk lamp! The clamp is strong, it’s easy to adjust, and the flexible neck lets me put the light exactly where I need it. I love the different brightness levels and modes—it’s perfect for working at my desk without eye strain. The black metal design looks nice and feels sturdy. Great value for the price!

review_title: Great lamp to add to your desk!
body_en: This is a great little lamp. It easily secures to the side of a desk surface. It is height adjustable and seems very sturdy and well made. The light has different features such as bright light, natural light, and dim light selection. The light comes with its own power block and this is VERY appreciated! All-in-all this is a fantastic item for the price.

review_title: Versatile light source for home office, workshop, or craft area.
body_en: TL;DR: A really great desk lamp and even better customer support. I’m really enjoying this desk lamp. I appreciate that you can adjust the color and brightness of the light and the gooseneck such that you can adjust the position. It clamps right onto the edge of my adjustable stand-sit desk. It’s been the perfect addition to my home office. I also had an exceptional experience with the support team this past week. Oddly, when I turned my lamp on to start the week, the light was not bright and it was kind of flashing a bit. I thought maybe there was something wrong with the USB port it was plugged into, so I tried another. It was on the same multi-plug though. Same problem.
