I emailed the support email from their seller page with an explanation and a video and within 24 hours I had a response - one that suggested I try another power source but that also stated if the issue persisted they would certainly make it right. So this time I actually moved it to a different multi-plug (a step I should have done myself before the email) and the lamp was working fine. Clearly an issue with my power source. Sheepishly I responded and acknowledged my mistake. Their response? To offer me a partial refund so that I could purchase a new power adapter - something they obviously did not have to do. All this to say - if you’re thinking about buying this lamp, do it. I can assure you that the company stands by their product. And I will always recommend a company that goes above and beyond with their service, which this one absolutely did.

I was a bit skeptical due to the price of the lamp but it met the specifications I needed so I gave it a try. I am very happy with the quality and utility of the lamp. Easy to install and provides exactly the light I needed for my standing desk. Gave it 4 stars only as I wish it was a bit longer as I am 6’3” and a bit more height would benefit me. But it definitely is a great lamp!

brilliants! i needed a light that was adjustable, flexible and could be moved to multiple angles depending on what i’m working on / taking pictures of. this is sitting on my desk and functions as a light when i do nails, or makeup, or crafts. i like the tone options, so i can decide which lighting looks best for each purpose ! the arm is long enough and sturdy enough to be held above my head and hold position. the white is sleek and blends in with my workstation. it’s been months and i have no complaints.

review_title: Liked it so much, I bought another!
body_en: I bought one about 5 or 6 weeks ago and like it so much I just ordered another. They are very bendable in every direction including the head of the lamp. The clamp is sturdy enough to hold the unit securely in place. Plus, after looking at many available adjustable lamps, this inexpensive light has more lumens than more expensive adjustable lamps. As an artist this is a must have. I do very large paintings as well as small drawings, paintings as well as multi dimensional sculptural art and I wanted a second light to use while drawing on a lap desk outside my studio. I didn’t hesitate to buy another one of these. The long bar that holds the lamp can be twisted to focus in every direction. I also use it for applying makeup since it’s just really utilitarian. It’s a weird looking contraption that reminds me of the old War of The Worlds movie’s depiction of the aliens😂 but the two settings are another handy feature. Use the adapter plug it comes with. It’s cheap but different adapters can cause it to not turn on. Make sure the clamp has a flat surface on the underneath part of the clamp - it must be able to fully accommodate the round clamp that moves up and down from below. Packed in a good box, arrived fast and nothing to put together.
Quick easy transaction and shipping. As described. Work great. Just what I needed. Great price. Would like to have multicolor function.

review_title: Excellent Clamp Lamp for Monitor Setups — Bright, Adjustable, and Easy on the Eyes
body_en: I bought this desk lamp to improve lighting around my dual-monitor workstation, and it’s been a solid upgrade over a traditional desk lamp. The clamp is sturdy and holds securely to the back edge of my desk without wobbling. Installation took less than a minute, and it immediately freed up desk space. The arm has a good range of motion and stays in place once positioned, which makes it easy to direct light exactly where I need it without glare on my screens. Brightness and color temperature adjustments are the standout features. I can switch between warm and cool tones depending on whether I’m working late or just need focused task lighting, and the brightness levels are more than sufficient without being harsh. It’s noticeably easier on my eyes during long screen sessions compared to overhead lighting. Build quality feels better than expected for the price. The controls are responsive, and the lamp looks clean and modern once mounted. I also appreciate that it distributes light evenly instead of creating a harsh hotspot and doesn’t get hot to the touch either. If I had to nitpick, the power cord could be slightly longer for larger desk layouts—but that’s a minor issue and didn’t affect functionality for me. Overall, this is a great choice for anyone working from home, gaming, or needing focused desk lighting without clutter. I’d confidently recommend it, especially for monitor-heavy setups.
easy use, with different levels of light intensity. The product is very good.
I thought it would be bigger but it's fine, it does the job.

Not going to lie I had my doubts but this lamp is it! It’s small light weight but bright it’s perfect for when I do my nails. I love how the top is flexible so you can adjust where you need light. I like the different lighting colors and how you can adjust the brightness great buy

This desk lamp exceeded my expectations! The faux leather finish gives it a stylish, high-end look, and the touch controls are simple and responsive. It offers plenty of brightness settings and color temperature options, making it easy to find the perfect lighting for any project. I primarily use it while painting and coloring, and the built-in phone holder is a thoughtful feature that lets me watch art tutorials hands-free. The charging port is convenient, the base feels sturdy and stable, and I really appreciate that the lamp folds down for compact storage when I’m finished using it.

review_title: Versatile desk lamp with a variety of different settings for different needs
body_en: Nice light for my nightstand. Can be moved easily, and has a nice variety of lighting options. Can be bright white, medium temperature, or warm temperature light. Its smaller size is nice as well. If you need a bright light to work on things on a desk, it gets pretty bright and easy to set up in different places. Also looks nice on my desk.

I love this lamp! I use it on my work table for sewing, embroidery transfers, and jewelry making. It's very versatile; you can adjust the intensity very easily. I also like the USB port. There was no assembly other than plugging in the cords.

Great lamp, very bright and brightness options are perfect! However, it says it can charge my phone at the same time, and I dont know if its just my charger or the lamp itself, it doesnt do that. Other than that, great purchase!

Very happy with the light. Very easy to setup and use. Many choices which is great. I bought it for my art work and the brightness is super. It also allows you to lower the brightness and mode. Really am excited about my purchase!

I really like this. It lights up a small area on my desk so I can draw and write when my room is dim. Its not a studio light or anything but a good little light for the desk. It rotates and bends up and down. I like it.

This lamp is easy to use and well-made. I do a lot of fine, detail-oriented work for various hobbies, and this lamp has been wonderful to use while enjoying working on my projects. The light is steady, easy to adjust into various positions, and a cinch to change the brightness or warmth.

review_title: Great little lamp for desk or night stand!!
body_en: This little lamp is great! I got it to put on my desk and it light up very brightly. It's easy to angle the light if you need to. I really like that it has the USB ports so I can plug in my watch charger and charge my watch every night. I really like this lamp and you can't beat the price!! LOVE IT!!

review_title: More than I bargained from this lamp!
body_en: I recently had to relocate my work desk, and the area is dimmly lit. The lamp I had been using for years just conked out on me. Since I had great longetvity with that desk lamp, I thought I would purschase it again, until my eye caught a glimpse at what Ithought was a similar lamp. This lamp( like my former) was like a long pole lamp, except on this lamp the light pole was about 3 inches shorter-however it had better features for a lesser price!!. However, not only did it have brightness /dimming options, but 4 actual light colors as well.!Of course I like bright light,.But what got me sold( and getting a couple for birthday for high school students,) is that on the lamp itself there are 3 outlets! whether your device is a three prong or just two this desklamp offers 3 plugs. But wait a mnute , It also has four different USB ports! The cord is a good length and is made of thick rope like material, sturdy, and attractive. I was happy as a kid in a candy store!! I charge my phone, my speakers.and my laptop all in one, all at once. Now the price is amazing too. All I can say it's under what other lamps without half the features cost. And the "tray, is thick and compact, unlike my former lamp that was wide and took up a lot of space on my desk. It really is a great deal, and if you are like have have limited wall units, this lamp is incredible~I highly recommend it.
Love the lamp because it provides sufficient lighting and it offers the plugs for my phone and charger. It has multi-purpose use.

review_title: The Ultimate Desk Power Station and Light
body_en: ​This desk lamp is an absolute game-changer for keeping a workspace clean and functional. The light itself is great, but the real star here is the built-in power hub. ​Having two USB-C ports, two standard USB ports, and three standard 3-prong AC outlets built right into the base eliminates the need for extra power strips or crawling under the desk to plug things in. I can charge my phone, tablet, and accessories while running power tools or laptop chargers all from the exact same spot. ​It completely declutters your setup, gives you every connection option you could possibly need, and makes managing your devices effortless. Highly recommended if you want to streamline your desktop power!
I simply love this light. I use it for crochet projects and diamond painting projects. So much light and simply ove the fact that you can plug other things in

This lamp doesn't take up much desk space and is convenient with the outlets in the base, however the beam of light is very sharp and narrow. You have to turn it up all the way to actually have light in all directions. Otherwise it is good quality for a good price.

review_title: Compactible and easy to use for extensions.
body_en: There’s nothing to the assembling the lamp. Love the cord and the outlet the way it goes off to the side. It fits my room, beautifully, lightweight, and easy to use. The plus is the accessibility to the plug-ins for added objects, like plug into the phone. Thank you very much.

I love that this light gives you options on the light tones and how bright! I prefer the soft warm light for bed time! It also has so many charging ports and has freed up my night stand! I would buy again!

This desk lamp is exactly as described. It was easy to assemble and is very user-friendly. The adjustable brightness and color temperatures make it perfect for studying, working, or reading. The flexible design allows me to position the light exactly where I need it. I also love the built-in power outlets and USB/USB-C charging ports—they’re very convenient for charging my phone and other devices while keeping my desk organized. The lamp feels sturdy, works great, and looks modern. Overall, it’s an excellent product with great quality.

Product Review ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I really love this desk lamp! The design is sleek and modern, and it doesn’t take up much space on my desk. I especially like that it has multiple brightness and color settings, so I can adjust the lighting depending on what I’m doing. The built-in outlets and USB ports are also super convenient for charging my devices without needing extra power strips. It’s easy to fold and adjust, and the timer and memory features are a nice bonus. Overall, it’s a great lamp for a desk or college dorm, especially for the price!

review_title: Perfectly good lamp. Works as advertised. Great size and price for dorm room.
body_en: Works as advertised. If you adjust the stalk too far over the base, the light may begin to tip but this is easily solved by placing a weight on the base or adhering the lamp to your desk surface. I purchased this for my college dorm and think it will be great. Good value for the price point. It is a little smaller than the pictures suggest but is still a good desk size. There are four USB ports - two USB C and two USB A - as well as three standard three-prong AC outlets - which is a great way to add some charging options to your desk without taking up additional space. I will be reccomending this lamp to my other friends going into college.

review_title: Great new desk lamp - Adjustable lighting & direction - Charges devices
body_en: It's only been a few weeks, but in terms of function and capabilities it is great so far. Comes in handy charging my phone. The 3 A/C outlets are nice though so far I dont use them. The top light part offers good amount of light for a desk light, and has different strengths of light, as well as a few different styles of lighting for mood/preference. It is light, so you just be cognizant of the chord; and being light weight does make it easy if you want to move it into another room from time to time. Hope this helps.

review_title: Worked well - Great value - looked great - highly recommend!
body_en: This desk lamp was a great product. Great price for very well-made lamp. My grandson will enjoy using it at college this fall. He likes the black color as opposed to the white one he had last year. Great to have all the outlets very handy to get to when you need them.

It provides bright, clear lighting without being harsh, and I really appreciate being able to adjust the brightness to fit my needs. The sleek design looks great on my desk, and it doesn’t take up much space. It’s perfect for working, reading, studying, or using my computer at night. The adjustable design makes it easy to direct the light exactly where I need it. Highly recommended! 👍✨
Love this lamp, lightweight and easy to put anywhere. Very flexible and many light modes as well. The added plug outlets are an extra bonus. would definately recommend.

review_title: Great purchase for your home office desk
body_en: Excellent quality and lightweight and easy to use. I love the black color because it matches my other desk accessories. The charging ports on it works like a charm and I clove that it’s multiple ports. I love that it’s not to bulky and doesn’t take up much space.

Bought one couple months ago for my cutting table. Went in to get something out of my sewing room and my son had snagged it for his art desk, lol. So, I bought me another one. My cutting table sits against the wall with the over head light to my back putting part of the table in shade. This light attaches to the back edge of the table and casts light over the whole thing without being in the way. Absolutely love it. When you're working with very sharp rotary cutters it's best to see what you're doing. Super fast shipping. Comes assembled, well packaged, has multiple light settings with a good size cord and a stable clamp. You can move it around easily to suit your needs. I may buy a couple more to go around my machines. I'll take pictures after I set it back up.

I've been looking for a better lighting solution to several areas I use for sewing and crafting. I needed something that would be easily adaptable to every area and give me the best possible light. I have a couple of desk lamps, one is LED and the other one just uses a regular bulb. Still does not give me exactly what I need because of shadows or glaring light. They don't clamp. And then Amazon recommended this. Not only did I get a $10 off coupon, it was delivered the very next morning by 7 am. I ordered it late in the evening before. I think this is going to take care of all of my issues. Seems to be very well made, very simple to use. It comes folded in a box, you just spread out the lights at the joints. You can easily twist them in the direction you would like. I love all of the different choices for light modes and brightness levels. The clamp seems to be very sturdy and very versatile. Holds up to two and a half inches. That does open up a lot of possibilities and should fit for most people's needs. I'll update later as time goes on as I use this. I think for the price, light quality, and adaptability, this is a very good purchase.

review_title: Excellent Desk Lighting—Flexible, Bright, and Perfect for Work
body_en: This LED architect desk lamp with clamp mount exceeded my expectations. I needed something that could give me wide, consistent light across my dual-monitor setup without glare or eye strain, and this nailed it. The dual light bars provide excellent coverage across my entire desk, and the swing arm design makes it easy to position exactly where I need it. It stays put once adjusted—no sagging or drifting. The clamp is sturdy and doesn’t wobble at all, even when I reposition the arms. ✅ 4 color modes are great for shifting between reading, working, and late-night use ✅ 5 brightness levels give total control, from soft ambient to bright task lighting ✅ No flicker or harsh glare—a noticeable improvement for long work sessions ✅ Sleek, minimal design that doesn’t clutter up the desk ✅ Plug and go—setup took 2 minutes I use this daily for both work and hobby projects, and it’s held up perfectly. This lamp hits the sweet spot between functionality, adjustability, and clean modern design. Highly recommend for anyone setting up a productive and eye-friendly home office or studio space.

review_title: Worth the money, easily adjustable, nice and bright
body_en: This thing is great. It clamps well to the desk, the light and features are exactly what you want them to be, and the adjustability is perfect. It folds up well and looks great on the desk.

I would give this five stars if it weren't for the algorithm, due to the fact that I don't want the price to go up because I would buy more in the near future but if the price is too high the lamp isn't worth it to me. I do love this lamp each section swivels so you can direct it to any direction you want up down and sideways The brightness intensity is awesome for the space that I needed in, it's a pretty dark space And I love the adjustability.
I love this lamp. It was kinda confusing at first when you unbox it but once you get it all set up it’s worth the expense!
Really great so far. Easy to adjust and feels sturdy. Many light color and brightness options.

This thing is great! I got it for my art desk as the task light I had over there wasn't bright enough, and I'm super satisfied. I originally bought this for my husband for painting warhammer miniatures, and got myself a different lamp I thought I would like better, but ended up sending mine back and getting another one of these immediately. The ability to rotate every section individually is a game changer for desk placement options. Having this much light and being able to ensure I'm not blinding myself with it is awesome. I haven't had it for that long so I can't comment on it's reliability yet, but as far as basic function and brightness goes it's getting a 10/10.
The quality is alright, it offers different lighting intensity and can be turned and twisted in a few directions. Good article.

review_title: Premium Desk Lamp That Actually Solves Real Workspace Problems
body_en: I bought this for a multi-monitor workstation and it has exceeded expectations. The build quality is excellent, the arms are sturdy, and every joint holds position firmly without sagging. The biggest highlight is the light spread. It provides even illumination across the desk instead of creating a bright hotspot. The adjustable color temperatures and brightness levels are genuinely useful, and the touch controls are very responsive. The flexibility is outstanding. With multiple rotation points, it’s easy to position the light exactly where needed without interfering with monitors or workspace. Overall, this is one of those rare products that performs exactly as advertised. If you spend long hours at a desk and want a premium lighting solution, this is an easy recommendation. Highly recommended for home offices, study setups, and multi-monitor workstations.
Very happy with my purchase, this lamp illuminates my workstation at home very well and it has a beautiful modern look. I couldn't have had better.

This lamp's level of quality is very surprising! It is made of a heavy gage metal. The way the lights can be adjusted is brilliant design and very easy to do! Lovely, clean lined design. It is slim and takes up very little space. The clamp works very well and stays put. The way you are able to adjust the brightness and the spectrum is perfect. Impressive!

Good modern lighting accessory for office desk/ study desk. Helps with eye fatigue also it gives you the option to direct the light where you want it to be focusing on. This is way better alternative than typical lamps due to not enough light specially when studying or reading. With this desk lamp it also doesn’t bother anyone else in the room with you with overwhelming light brightness. This light can be focused on a certain of the room without annoying anyone who might be trying to sleep or sensitive to bright lights. Really worth the purchase and would highly recommend. Easy to set up and straightforward functionality. It does gets really bright when set to the highest setting and can function as a mood lighting for the room. Multi purpose lighting at a good deal plus it has aluminum body.

I LOVE this ultra sturdy lamp. Clamps on WELL so it stays in place! The neck is also sturdy for moving the light around. Finally i found a lamp that isn't all imbalanced and wanting to tip over and move. Totally dig; the space it saves amongst all my projects, the ability to EASILY adjust the brightness from "mood" to "stadium bright" AND the hands-free off/on feature is FABULOUS when my hands are covered in paint, glue, glitter and other stuff from working. A GREAT FIND!

review_title: Satisfying, functional, reliable, and simple to use.
body_en: I love this product but my favorite feature is when I come into my office to simply wave my hand over the top and it turns on or off. I bought two, one for my work desk and the other for my media-desk. I smile and giggle at the satisfaction this light causes me to simply stick my hand out and wave over the power sensor, on top of the lamp, to turn on or off rather than look to find, reach and pull a chord, squeeze or press a power button to turn on. Oh, the features are great too. You will be satisfied for sure.

Solid build and materials throughout. The clamp means it takes up no desk/table space. Plenty bright, and between the gooseneck and the two swing arms for the lights it’s easy to direct light to wherever I need. And the on/off motion sensor is really convenient. Just very pleased on all counts.

I love it. It’s practical, easy to install. You can put it in all the position that you need it and, also comes with a remote control that you can attach at any surface and you can put it there by a magnet. The only thing I didn’t like it is that the remote control comes without batteries. I think for the prize you could include it.
I really love this lamp it's so many levels & shades of brightness you can use and the touchless option is unique. No need to keep using the remote once you found the correct lighting you enjoy.
Good light cheap price!

review_title: Great value and features for the price
body_en: I just redid my home office, and my expanded standing desk needed a new lamp. The number of options on Amazon is a bit overwhelming. We chose this one because it had multiple features, good reviews (add this one to that list), and a reasonable price. It was super easy to set up and install. Probably not even 5 minutes. I spent more time deciding on which lumen options to settle on using. Extra bonus, I enjoy waving my hand over the top of it to turn the light on and off.

I really like this lamp, it's perfect for my home office, good light, turns on/off with a wave of the hand, nice and tall to get it out of the way... but... it burned out after ~6 months. I tested the power transformer and had good power. I opened up the base of the lamp and tested the circuit board where the power transformer plugs into and that's where the power stopped. I'm assuming the LEDs did not burn out just that the circuit board where power and usb ports connect failed. It's a shame as I really like this lamp and although it only cost around $40 dollars I can't justify buying a new one every year.

It’s the perfect light for my husband when our baby is sleeping so the room can be dark but he can still game without straining his eyes. Lots of settings and a handy little dial remote. The arm is very sturdy and the different light temperatures are nice. I looked at several options and I 10/10 recommend this one.

review_title: Provides excellent lighting for jigsaw puzzles
body_en: Love it. This is almost exactly what I needed for my jigsaw puzzle table. The light is excellent as is the remote and the easy on off with the wave of a hand. Only small problem is that it is not wireless. Has to be plugged in so the cord is an issue when I want to rotate the puzzle table. My fault though for not checking the specs closely enough. The light is easy enough to unclamp and re-clamp however so I can live with that.

review_title: great product and ease of installation.
body_en: Great light, easy to install. I do beading so bright light is so important. I love the 3 light of which 2 are movable so you can direct the lights where it is needed. the remote is great to have on your desk however I do not use it much as there is another turn on button on the light itself. Different warms is great in case I decide to do other things that do not require the brightest light. In all very satisfied. Would buy again.
If I could give it zero stars, I would. It doesn't hold its shape at all and sags with time. The light is not very bright a d the settings don't change the brightness very much.
I like the brightness, and adjustable, movable arms of the lights to my liking. Different light settings. I use it for my craft and work area. Best lights I bought.

review_title: As someone who studies late into the night, this lamp is a game-changer.
body_en: The 2000LM output is bright enough to light up my whole desk, and the stepless dimming means I never have to settle for "too bright" or "too dim" — it's always just right. The LED light is flicker-free, which makes a huge difference during marathon study sessions
Good brightness, smooth stepless dimming. Multiple lighting modes. Solid lamp for desk work.

review_title: Great for for Work Spaces and has hands free operation!
body_en: Finding a desk lamp that has great "task lighting" and general workspace illumination is notoriously difficult, especially for modern multi-monitor or ultra-wide setups. The Syrinx Dual-Head LED Desk Lamp delivers great light coverage, has customization, and smart hands-free. Coverage Area: Up to 70" workspace Light Bar Length: 23.7" extended dual-head Color Temperature: 3000K – 6000K (5 presets) Brightness Levels: 10 distinct levels (50 total lighting combinations) LED Count & Quality: 96 LEDs, CRI90+, flicker-free, low-blue-light Adjustability: 360° flexible gooseneck + 180° foldable arms Controls: Hands-free gesture control + inline wired controller!! Timers & Memory: 15 / 30 / 60-minute auto-off timer + settings memory My Notes >Unmatched Coverage for Complex Workstations >The 23.7-inch extended dual-head light bar is unlike standard single-point desk lamps that cast harsh shadows or leave dark edges, the Syrinx easily spans large desks up to 70 inches. By spreading the dual arms flat, you can completely eliminate glare on dual-monitor setups; by angling them inward, you get concentrated, shadow free light directly over your workbench or reading area. >Precise Control & Eye Comfort: With 50 total lighting combinations (10 brightness steps paired with 5 color temperatures ranging from a warm 3000K to a daylight 6000K), dialing in the exact light needed for the time of day or task is effortless. The CRI90+ rating ensures accurate color rendering—a must for artists, crafters, and photo editors—while the flicker-free, low-blue-light array minimizes eye strain during late-night work sessions. >Smart, Practical Usability: The built-in hands-free gesture sensor is a huge quality-of-life upgrade for hands-on projects. If your hands are covered in paint, ink, or dirt, a simple wave over the sensor toggles the light on or off. For permanent settings, the inline controller, built-in memory function, and selectable auto-off timers (15/30/60 mins) make using this lamp very smooth. *Massive 70" illumination footprint easily covers dual monitors and large craft tables. *360° gooseneck plus 180° arm flexibility allows virtually unlimited positioning options. *High color accuracy (CRI90+) and flicker-free design drastically reduce eye fatigue. *Gesture control keeps the fixture clean when working on messy DIY tasks. *Supported by US-based customer support and a 12-month technical warranty. Cons: Wired inline controller means extra cord management is required behind the desk. The wide physical footprint may feel overpowering on very small, minimalist writing desks. If you need a heavy-duty lighting solution that adapts to complex desktop setups and hands-on creative projects, this lamp is an outstanding addition to your workspace.

review_title: Nice lamp - a little too large for a normal desk
body_en: The lamp is very nice, has multiple white color settings and multiple brightness settings. The Wave on/off is a nice touch, and works well. It does not return to previous setting after power outage - so if you unplug it, it defaults to the first setting. The entire thing is very large - takes a decent amount of room on the desk, and if you already use a screen mount it will be off center due to that. It's also very tall - This is needed so it can lean over large screens but honestly it feels overwhelming on a desk, it's almost too big for an average desk even with 2 screens. If that's not an issue then this is a great lamp for you.

review_title: Wow, what a difference in my workspace
body_en: This over monitor light has a remote that is hardwired inline with the power cord and comes with a full plug. The remote has dimming but also allows for change of the color of light as well. The coolest feature is the sensor above light band that allows one to wave their hand over it to turn it on and off. Great convenence. Also love that the two light bars are adjustable at angles to the pivot point as this allows more light to be projected at distance from above the monitor lighting up the entire desk in front of the monitor. Just this light above the computer monitor provides great light down to my keyboard tray and mouse as well as surface in front of the monitor. Hard to capture in last picture, but it is very nice light. The weighted base on this keeps it upright and stable. Really could not ask any more of how this was designed. Very solid materials. Can HIGHLY recommend. I love it!

review_title: Bright, Adjustable, and Even Better the Second Time Around
body_en: This is actually the second one of these desk lamps I’ve gotten, and I liked the first one enough that I wanted another. What I really like about this design is how the light folds open, giving you a much wider area of illumination than a basic desk lamp. When opened up, it spreads the light across the whole workspace instead of focusing everything in one small spot. It is also very bright, which makes it great for a desk, home office, computer setup, reading, paperwork, or any task where you need strong, even lighting. Even with the brightness, the design still looks clean and modern and doesn’t take up a lot of space. The folding arms are probably my favorite feature because you can adjust the light depending on what you’re doing. You can keep it more compact or open it wider when you need to light up a larger work area. It feels much more versatile than a standard lamp. Since this is my second one, that alone says a lot about how happy I am with it. It’s bright, adjustable, practical, and works exactly how I need it to. Definitely a 5-star product for me.

I put this LED dual‑head desk lamp to work in my Waikiki home office and immediately appreciated how well it performs once the 360 degree gooseneck settles into position and the wide light bar floods my workspace with even, shadow‑free illumination. The functionality is excellent because the stepless dimming and five color temperatures let me shift from warm evening reading to bright task lighting without ever feeling locked into a preset, and the gesture control is surprisingly responsive when my hands are busy with tools or paperwork. Usefulness is high whether I’m working across dual monitors, doing detailed craft projects, or lighting a larger desk surface since the extended bar covers far more area than a traditional lamp. My British Retriever likes them in her own way because she always curls up beside the soft glow and seems soothed by the flicker‑free light instead of harsher overhead fixtures. Accuracy is solid because the brightness, color range, and gooseneck flexibility match the published specifications, and the lamp stays stable on the base without wobble. For the money, the value is strong since it delivers wide‑area lighting, thoughtful controls, high CRI performance, and a versatile design that makes everyday work feel more comfortable and precise.

review_title: Excellent Desk Lamp With a Slightly Overeager Motion Sensor
body_en: I have been very pleased with the Syrinx LED lamps, and this model fits my desk particularly well. It provides bright, broad illumination without taking up much working space. The stepless dimming also makes it easy to adjust the output for anything from general computer work to detailed close-up tasks. The arm has a very good balance. It takes only a light touch to reposition, yet it holds the selected position without drifting or sagging. That makes it easy to direct the light exactly where it is needed. The hands-free control is a double-edged sword. It is genuinely convenient when you want to turn on the lamp quickly without fumbling for a switch, especially when your hands are occupied. However, the sensor can also interpret an innocent stretch or arm movement as a command and unexpectedly switch the lamp off. Despite that minor annoyance, this is a bright, versatile, and well-designed desk lamp that I enjoy using.

review_title: Excellent coverage for a larger desk
body_en: This desk lamp has been a great upgrade for my workspace. The wide light panel spreads the light across a much larger area than a traditional desk lamp, which is especially helpful with a computer and other things spread across the desk. It gets plenty bright without creating one harsh spot directly underneath it, and the adjustable arm makes it easy to position the light exactly where I need it. I really like having both brightness and color temperature adjustments. I can use a cooler brighter setting when I am working and switch to something warmer when reading later in the evening. The remote is surprisingly useful too, especially with the dedicated reading and video call settings. The weighted base feels stable, and because it is flat I can still use some of the desk space above it. The memory function remembering my previous setting is another small feature that I appreciate every time I turn it on.

review_title: Great compact desk lamp with column controls
body_en: This lamp delivers clean, effective light with a design that feels more premium than a typical desk lamp. The build is compact without feeling cramped, and it doesn't take up excessive desk space while still covering the area it needs to. Controls are conveniently placed directly on the main column, making adjustments straightforward without needing to reach for a remote every time. That said, the remote itself is intuitive when you do want to use it, with quick access to presets and modes without a learning curve. Light quality holds up well across brightness and color temperature settings, staying consistent and comfortable for extended use. For anyone wanting a task lamp that combines physical build quality with an easy control setup, this covers both bases well.

The product came as expected. I really like the sturdy base and height of the product. The light is bright enough for most tasks unless you are looking for super bright. The slim design allows this lamp to easily fit behind my monitors and the setup is effortless. They even supply the screwdriver needed for the two tiny screws. Highly recommend. The only reason its not 5 stars is the one and off switch should be on the base and not top of the lamp.

This LED desk lamp is a fantastic addition to any home office setup. The wide 18W LED panel provides 1200 lumens of glare-free light that spreads evenly across my workspace. It is designed to reduce eye strain during long hours in front of the computer, which is a huge benefit in my work-from-home routine. The lamp features a tall metal swing arm with reinforced joints, allowing easy and precise positioning without sagging. The dimmable settings include five color modes and brightness levels, plus a memory function that remembers your last setting. It also offers a timer option for 30 or 60 minutes, which helps conserve energy. One thing to note is the lamp’s size, which might be too tall or wide for smaller desks. Also, the touch controls can sometimes be overly sensitive, causing accidental adjustments. However, the included remote helps mitigate this issue. This lamp combines durability, functionality, and eye care features perfectly for a demanding workspace. It works well for reading, computer tasks, and video calls without creating screen glare or cluttering the desk.

At first glance, it's almost hard to picture such a large lamp by looking at the small box. Once unpacked you see the true size of this thing. See the photo with a full size Sharpie for scale. It has a pretty large and heavy base to keep the whole lamp steady. The arm pivots are very nice. Everything moves easily and very smoothly so it's easy to make adjustment and everything stays exactly where you want it. The lighting portion is interesting. The large lighting panel produces very uniform light. The back of the panel allows a small amount of light through so your surroundings are not completely dark. Touch control is very responsive and intuitive. I REALLY light the tiny light they placed next to power button. I have several other touch control lamps and it's always a struggle to find the power button in the dark. Nice touch! I only wish this lamp had a clamp mount option so it wouldn't take up any desk space.

I ordered this for use at a workbench/desk in my maker space. The product generally works as described: there are various lighting levels and changeable color temps. It assembles easily and seems sturdy enough. However, it is not very bright - even on its brightest setting - for working in an already lit room. This makes some sense since it is relatively low wattage. One final "plus": it is powered by USB so can easily be used via a PC.

review_title: I love this lamp for everyday reading
body_en: This light is amazing it's on my table next to my reading chair. It's nice and bright but has a timer so that If I fall asleep it's not on for hours. I love that I can change the brightness so it doesn't hurt my eyes, but it will also go super bright to brighten up the whole room. It's better than I could have hoped for and doesn't take up a lot of space. It has a long enough cord that I had no issues plugging it in any of the spots. The lamp is easy to set up and adjustable perfect for everyday use. I don't have to turn all the lights on just the one. My favorite lamp.

I've been using this LED desk lamp, and it's been a great addition to my workspace. The 16-inch wide light provides ample coverage, eliminating shadows and ensuring uniform lighting across my entire desk. What I really love is how super bright and glare-free it is. No more eye strain or squinting under harsh lighting! Plus, it’s flicker-free, so I can focus for hours without distractions. The lamp's versatility is another big win. With five dimmable levels and adjustable color temperature from 3,000K to 6,500K, I can easily customize the lighting to suit my needs. The high Color Rendering Index (CRI) of over 90 ensures accurate color reproduction, which is perfect for detailed work. The flexible gooseneck design allows me to position the light exactly where I need it, whether it’s direct illumination on my work surface or ambient light in the room. The heavy base keeps the lamp stable, so it doesn’t tip over or move around during use. As much as all functionality of this lamp is great, I have to subtract one star for the build quality. The build quality leaves a lot to be desired for. The materials feels cheap, and may easily break if accidentally falls or tips over. Overall, this LED desk lamp has significantly improved my workspace, making it brighter and more comfortable. If you don't mind the build quality, then this should be fine for the most part.
Very good solar lights, they have a good duration and very good lighting

Had them up for 5 months and they are brilliant and work really well. Very bright LED with a couple of options for set up, motion activated or on permanent. Easy to install either with screws or sticky pads provided. It's hasn't been that sunny since Nov 2019 but the charge is fantastic and never ran out.
Easy to install, excellent product. Possibility of having various intensities of lights, both fixed and with motion sensor. Excellent time duration
the lights look very good, a great view of my driveway.
Really nice and bright, everything works and still very bright even when there isn't much sun. Really good.

The BOHON LED Desk Lamp is the perfect addition to my workspace and bedside setup. This lamp is packed with features that make it an ideal choice for reading, working, or relaxing. 💡 3 Color Modes & Dimmable Brightness I love that this lamp offers three color modes (warm, cool, and neutral light), which can be dimmed to my preferred level of brightness. Whether I’m reading at night or working during the day, there’s a setting to suit every situation. 🔌 USB Charging Port The built-in USB charging port is incredibly convenient. I can easily charge my phone or other devices without needing an extra outlet. It’s a great feature, especially for bedside use. 🌟 Intelligent Induction Auto-Dimming The auto-dimming function is a standout feature. The lamp adjusts the brightness based on the ambient light in the room, creating a comfortable environment without me having to fiddle with the settings. 🌀 Flexible Gooseneck Design The flexible gooseneck allows me to adjust the angle and position of the light effortlessly. It’s sturdy yet easy to maneuver, making it perfect for focused task lighting. ⚡ Included AC Adapter The inclusion of an AC adapter is a thoughtful touch, saving me the hassle of purchasing one separately. The lamp is easy to set up and works right out of the box. 🎉 Final Thoughts The BOHON LED Desk Lamp is a versatile, well-designed product that delivers on both functionality and style. It’s ideal for anyone needing a reliable, adjustable, and feature-rich lamp for their workspace, bedside, or office. Highly recommend!

review_title: good lamp with decent features but auto dim questionable
body_en: good size for small spaces, various types of light color and dimming option with a USBA charger -- sturdy and not likely to tip over with a small platform base that will allow for small items to rest on it as well. It does have an auto dimming feature, but I found it to be annoying as the light will change brightness w/o notice several times per hour -- I guess depending upon the light from a window for instance. In a stable environment, it might stay steady, but I find it better to just dim it myself when appropriate. easy to Assemble, uses a type C slot and plugs into the wall with its own cord and adapter. Nice matte finish and stylish

As a treat to myself I did a work desk refresh and did a purple desk haul. Getting all the same shade of purple is a challenge, but I am picky about what I want out of a desk lamp. I can't lie I was prepared to be disappointed but I found myself pleasantly surprised with this little lamp. I found the size of the lamp to be just perfect. I love that I can change the lamp from a warm light to a cold light. (I prefer warm light most days) You can make the light as bright or as dim as you want, I just have it turned all the way up. Its got a sturdy base and is powered by USB-C so you can give it a longer cord if needed.

I like that this desk lamp has a small footprint and can be placed off to the side, out of the way, but then using the gooseneck the light can be brought in where it is needed. I also like that it is quite bright and can be dimmed from low light to full output. The light color itself can be adjusted between 3 levels, warm, cool or a mix of warm and cool. I personally prefer the white cool light as it seems like a better color for a work light. I don’t use the ambient sensor function so can’t comment. The base is heavy and holds the lamp without tipping even when the gooseneck is cantilevered far out. There is a light diffuser on the end of the lamp shade which can be removed if you want the full blast harsh light, which may be more useful in some situations. There is a usb charger port. The dimming control is a little funky and the click stops were not expected. I would rather have a smooth silent dimmer than one with detents. Also the range of lowest light to highest light is not very wide. Nevertheless, at this price point there isn’t much to complain about. This is a nice bright lamp with more functionality than one would expect at such a low price and seems well made. It is recommended.

review_title: Great Lamp, Great Price, Features as Described
body_en: This is a great little desk lamp. It is sturdy, stylish and has more features than you would expect at such an affordable price. The features work well. I would definitely purchase again.

AMAZING!!! This product is very much the same product that it said it was going to be! It is perfect at night or when my eyes are hurting from the ceiling light. It’s the best thing to use when you are reading and turning down the light can make it a diy light-night. And on top of that, the bendable neck works perfectly well and can twist in any direction! 10%10

Great lamp But it has to be plugged in to work It does not hold charge I don't have plugs around my old home, so I use a buddy charger with it! It's good just annoying that it dies not have a battery to keep charge and work on its own But a great little lamp I use it to paint Sits on the table beautifully and has many brightness choices It's pretty too!

I bought this when my old halogen desk lamp finally gave out after 20 years. It’s been an great replacement. The ability to adjust the brightness and the fact that doesn’t generate nearly the heat of the old lamp have made it an excellent upgrade.

review_title: Good lamp, feels like real value.
body_en: Surprisingly good little tabletop lamp. Simple and timeless design. The controls and features (CCT, brightness, auto dim) are intuitive and the light output is adequate and well diffused. The flexible lamp neck is adjustable but firm and stays in position. Given that it relies on an external and thus replaceable USB-C power supply, it should last a long time. If I was pressed at gunpoint to come up with a negative it is that the little LED mode indicators are too faint and can only be seen when looking directly down at the control panel.
Love this lamp would recommend and I would buy again
I loved the color and everything just like the photo and the beautiful little box where pink arrived 💖

I have purchased 3 of these total and they are excellent lights for what I use them for. I have them mounted on the back side of my work benches. I have a Guitar workshop and these lights provide excellent lighting. They were easy to install/setup and perfect size. They are light weight and maneuverable and easily light up my entire work area. I have had no problems with these lights at all and have had one of them for over a year already. I was an easy decision to add 2 more when I added more workbenches in my shop. Great product!

review_title: Just what I was looking for!
body_en: I'll be honest. I was looking for something in my local brick and mortar stores. Target, Walmart, Home Depot, Lowes... every place let me down because they all had the same unimaginative junk. And certainly not in store so I can just go get it. I have a pretty deep computer desk with dual 27" monitors on moving arms. I also have a separate soldering table. I wanted good, shadow free illumination on both and nobody had anything that would work. Lo and behold, I stumble across this on Amazon. I love when someone has a good idea and turns it into a great product. Unboxing is just ridiculously easy. There is no building. All you have to do is screw clamp it to your surface and plug it in. It seems it'll fit a pretty thick surface too. 1 1/8" (almost 3cm) thick shelf stock for a desk and it has enough space for another inch or so. No flickering that I can see. It's clean smooth light. The color temperature options are plentiful and you can cycle through presets of both temp and brightness or do a smooth transition to what you want. The side panels are separately turned on and off (together) and can fold down 90° (if you really wanted to) or all the way up to upside down on top of the main lamp. It's all folded together in the box, so just unfold and use. Only real issue is there's no telescoping function. So if you have a small desk and want it mounted at the back AND close to your surface, you might have to get creative. The auto brightness is interesting... it gets brighter when the ambient light goes down. I expected the opposite. But maybe this makes sense. I prefer manual control anyway. Overall, very great product for anyone working at a desk, writing, making, what have you. I love this thing already. There's a really good video review that will show you all you need to know. I bought two right then and there (for both tables) and I do not regret my decision at all.

This is a fun-to-use desk lamp with a clamp. It doesn't have the stability of a lamp with two side-by-side arms, however, when I type, it only wobbles a little. I've gotten used to it, so it isn't really a distraction. My favorite part of the lamp is the side arms that swing up or down, depending on where you want to put the light. For more focus on your desk; swing down. To illuminate the ceiling, or the entire room, swing up. You can control the brightness or illumination of each type of element, so that the arms that are pointed up can have light, while the ones pointed down can be dimmed or turned off altogether to prevent glare. The brightness starts as very dim and goes all of the way up to very bright (with some glare), and many steps in between. Nice! All in all, I've had this lamp for over a month now, and haven't noticed any defects or bad design, except for the slight wobble. It's great if you like to have a room for computer use while having the ability to light the whole room without glare. That's why I give it a '5'.

This is hands-down the best lamp I’ve ever owned. The Micomlan LED Desk Lamp with Clamp is incredibly bright, versatile, and perfect for any workspace. The adjustable arm and multiple lighting modes make it easy to dial in the exact lighting you need—whether it’s for studying, working, or detailed tasks. The clamp is strong and secure, and the lamp feels solid and well-built without being bulky. I love how wide the lighting coverage is; it easily lights up my entire desk without glare or shadows. The settings for brightness and color temperature are a huge bonus and make it super customizable. Setup took just a minute, and once it’s in place, it stays exactly where you put it. For the price, the quality is unmatched. This lamp instantly upgraded my desk setup, and I honestly wish I had bought it sooner. Highly recommend—best lamp I’ve had!

review_title: Maneuverability and space problem solved with one light.
body_en: Very versatile and well made piece of equipment. I needed to replace a standing lamp that just doesn't work for me anymore for desk lighting. Don't have the space I once did. So I got something that could attach to my desk. and move around as needed. This did not disappoint. As someone else noted it can get too hot if you turn it to the highest brightness setting. I like more natural light (not blue or yellow) and so this works great. The extreme maneuverability is one of its best features. And it doesn't take up much space do it's design. I have it attached to my glass desk and I have a desk riser that sits on top of it and it works with the riser up or down. The arms also make it really good as you can put them up so the light goes to the ceiling or down on what you are doing. I only give it one less star than five for overheating at the highest setting. I won't be using the highest setting but briefly sometimes but they need to work on that. I bought the soft white and I like how the color works with my walls and my desk. Great buy.

I didn’t realize how badly my office needed real lighting until I bought this lamp. My workspace has no ceiling lights — just floor lamps and small desk lamps — which looked nice but never provided enough usable light. By the end of the day my eyes were tired, and if I dropped something under the desk I needed a flashlight. This lamp completely fixed that problem. The LED lighting is adjustable between warm, cool, and neutral tones, and the three light bars can be positioned independently to direct light exactly where you need it. The clamp-on design is fantastic — it mounts to the back of the desk and sits high above even large monitors, so there’s no clutter and no loss of workspace. The light output is stronger than all my other lamps combined, yet it’s comfortable to work under for long periods. Eye strain is gone. For about $49, this feels like an incredible value. It also looks clean and modern — not cheap or distracting — and blends right into the office. I rarely write reviews, but this one earned it. If you need better task lighting for a desk setup, this is absolutely worth trying.

OMG I love this. I got a second one for me and one for my son for his room. Pretty much good to go out of the box, very easy to put up, stays where I want it, and good range of motion. An unexpected plus point: it resumes whatever settings it was on when power is restored. I have them connected to smart plugs, and I can turn them on and off that way. IME these touch button devices usually default to off if you unplug/replug them, so they can't really be used with smart plugs. That is a HUGE plus for me. The one issue, if you can even call it an issue, is that it feels like it should rotate where the main lamp part is connected to the arm, but it doesn't. It rotates where the short little part connects to the long par of the arm. Just be careful not to absent-mindedly grab it and try to rotate it in the wrong place. I've done that a couple times and heard a bit of a crack, but it doesn't seem to be broken. Which actually goes in the plus column now that I think about it. It's pretty sturdy, even against stupidity, LOL.

review_title: Perfect Desk Lamp for Late-Night Studying
body_en: My son often studies late into the night, and he is very happy with this lamp. The light is comfortable and does not glare into his eyes. It shines directly onto the desk, and he can easily adjust it to the exact position that works best for him. I especially like that the light stays focused on the work area instead of spreading throughout the entire room. It gives him excellent lighting for studying without disturbing the rest of the room. Highly recommended - 5 stars!
Excellent lamp. It gives very good light

review_title: Smart Lighting for Home Offices – A Must-Have for Eye Comfort and Flexibility
body_en: This LED desk lamp is one of the best purchases I’ve made for my home office. What sets it apart is the innovative design that allows light to be directed toward the ceiling, creating a soft ambient glow that significantly reduces eye strain—especially helpful during long hours of computer work. The lamp offers multiple lighting modes and brightness levels, which is perfect for adjusting the atmosphere depending on the task or time of day. Whether I’m working, reading, or just relaxing, I can easily switch between warm and cool tones to suit my needs. Its sleek and understated design blends seamlessly into any workspace, and the adjustable arm provides excellent mobility. I can position it exactly where I want, and the sturdy clamp ensures it stays securely in place without damaging my desk. Overall, this lamp combines style, functionality, and comfort in a way that’s ideal for modern work-from-home setups. Highly recommended for anyone looking to upgrade their lighting and reduce eye fatigue.

I’ve been using this desk lamp for a month now, and I absolutely love it! I had been searching for a functional, lightweight lamp with multiple settings, and this one checks all the boxes. The light options are versatile and the LED is very bright, the quality overall feels excellent. I even use it for time-lapse recordings by placing my phone on it. truly multifunctional. Highly recommend!
Versatile and nice finish with modes and sectional control

The Desk lamp arrived on time and well packaged. Easy to assemble and no parts missing. Very sturdy, the light is soft an an bright at the same time. The light spreads well over the screen and not overbearing. It has adjustable lighting and evening light, very convenient when tired. I would highly recommend if you ae in front of a screen for many hours,

I’m very happy with the this purchase for my son’s dorm room desk. All the different outlets are great, and the multiple brightness/natural light color options are nice. We did use a non-slip coaster under the base so it doesn’t move because it’s light weight, but it also comes with little stickers as well.

review_title: First one was a dud. Second one is perfect
body_en: The first one I bought lasted less than an hour, then the light went out and it stopped charging my phone (that was the only extra thing I had plugged into it). I switched outlets twice and unplugged it for an hour and tried it again (even though I knew that wouldn't do anything) and it was done. It wouldn't work. I was disappointed because it was a perfect lamp for my needs. I almost just returned it for a refund but it was too good not to try one more time. I'm glad I did. The second one was sent to me about a month ago and it's worked perfectly since. I use this on my desk at work so on average it's used, either as just a charger or a charger and a lamp, for an average of 40ish hours a week for a month with no issues. The light brightness is adjustable so it's as bright as you want it to be (very bright on its highest setting). The neck adjusts in 2 spots so you can easily get it to the angle you need. The charging ports all work great and I use those every work day, as many as 3 at a time (there are 4). I haven't used the plugs much because I haven't needed them but they all work. If you think this fits your needs then definitely buy it. Just use it way before the return date in case you happen to get a dud like I initially did.
Perfect desk lamp for my son’s college dorm room. He loves the power surge strip on the lamp; with few outlets in his room, this is a great use of space.

review_title: One of my favorite Amazon purchases but still could improve slightly.
body_en: I really like this product, so far probably in my top 5 Amazon purchases ever and I buy a lot so. The lighting really good, the colors are nice, I like that I can change its brightness which is has a pretty large range of. Worked to charge my stuff, and over all very reliable. 2 things they can improve on however, if the bottom just had a little more weight it would make it way more sturdy. Secondly, I wish the buttons had more texture to them as in if they had a bump so that I could feel them in the dark as I was using this lamp to help me wake up at very early hours of the morning. So instead of using my phone light to turn on the light, I could just use my hand to feel where the button to turn it on is. That also would really help those with disabilities. The last 2 reasons are the only reason why I gave it 4 stars.

review_title: nice but can use some improvments
body_en: It has a light, cheap feel but seems to function OK. The base could use some weight to it; When the lamp arm is tilted forward too much, the lamp falls over. All of the controls are flat, no texture, no bumps. It's difficult to find the on switch if it is dark; you would need a flashlight. I had to put some tape on the base so I can find the on switch in the dark. Having extra plugs and charger ports is convenient.

review_title: Great for home, school or college!
body_en: I love this lamp. It is on my desk and it’s so easy to turn on. I love how you can change the angles and lighting shades. The plug-in cord is sturdy and very nice, not like thin plastic cords. The lamp doesn’t take up a lot of room.
RETURNED

This thing lights up a whole room! It's fantastic. Dimmable with mildly bright hyper whites. Plugs work great and tilt and rotate is cool. Biggest downside? HEAT! This is the ONLY LED desk lamp I've ever owned that puts off heat. The piece where the actual lights are are get so hot that you can't hold it to adjust it. That's CRAZY to me. Sending it back due to fire hazard from that alone.

This desk lamp is bright, easy to adjust, and perfect for working or reading. The stepless dimming lets me choose the ideal brightness, and the adjustable height makes it easy to position the light exactly where I need it. It feels sturdy, was simple to set up, and provides excellent lighting without taking up much desk space. Overall, it's a great quality lamp and well worth the price.

I was in a need of a desk lamp and I'm so glad I got this. It has adjustable light modes, so you can adjust it to your liking. It's light weight and so easy to move around, but still sturdy. It doesn't take up much space. Simple, practical, and great purchase.

This lamp is bright, adjustable, and perfect for my workspace. I love being able to change the height and brightness depending on what I’m doing. It provides good lighting for reading and working without taking up much desk space. Easy to set up and very useful.

review_title: Excellent for a desk for task lighting!
body_en: Excellent lamp for task lighting for reading and writing! Has a sliding scale for brightness and a special option for reading papers and books. The 45-minute timer is nice too. I like that the two arms can be adjusted independently for wider area coverage and also placed side-by-side for a heightened brightness over one smaller field. The height and the angle of the arms are adjustable too to keep the light from glaring into one's eyes. The base is sturdy and the vertical arm stays wherever it is placed without drifting. The cord is okay but longer would be better for my limited wall plugs and L-shaped desk. I'm pleased and would buy it again.

I bought one of these for myself and one for my mom. We were looking for an alternative to an Ott Light for crafting since those are so expensive. SO happy with these lights!! The range of movement on them, how high they go up, the light dim options, the reader setting, just everything! Absolutely love love love!! And I love that when I'm done with it it folds down to this really slim profile and uses up very little space. It's really great. The worst thing I can say is that the buttons are TOO easy to use cause my cat can use them herself and will change the setting sometimes when she gets nosy and walks by. But that's her prerogative in life I suppose haha. But seriously, just get it, you'll be glad you did
Great addition to my room. Nice looking, easy to use and has multiple options. Can adjust brightness of the light with Does not need any assembly

review_title: Versatile lamp that adjusts for height
body_en: I have an architect's lamp that I've enjoyed for over 20 years. It runs on a small fluorescent bulb that I replaced about two years ago. But, I've discovered adjustable LED lamps and I'm hooked. I like the white color (though it can be adjusted if desirable) and the ability to dim it. This is useful if I'm up early and don't want "full blast" in my face. I've owned a different single-head lamp from Amazon for about six years that I use as a reading lamp; this goes on my desk. So I like the dual head for over the computer and pages off to the side. NOTE: There are similar ones cheaper on Temu, but this is the only one I've found with adjustable height. I wanted that for over my monitor, so this won out. Good, bright versatile lamp.

***This review is updated to reflect 5 stars for amazing customer service. The lamp when working is a 5 star lamp on its own.*** Lamp is great when it works, which was about 6 months exactly. Lights flicker and die out on the brighter lumens within about 2 minutes. Lamp has to then be rebooted by unplugging and plugging back in to even turn on. Went to the website to seek support and the product page no longer exists.
Adjustable height, brightness and tone. Happy with this purchase.

review_title: Excellent Desk Lamp for Work and Reading
body_en: This lamp has been a great addition to my desk setup. The double-head design gives much better coverage than a regular desk lamp, so my whole workspace is evenly lit without dark spots. I really like how many brightness and color options it has. It’s easy to switch between warm light for reading in the evening and a brighter white light when I’m working during the day. The light is soft on the eyes, even after sitting at my desk for a few hours. The adjustable height and flexible arms make it easy to position exactly where I need it, and it feels sturdy once it’s set up. The 45-minute timer is also a nice feature when I’m reading before bed and don’t want to remember to turn it off. Setup only took a few minutes, and it looks clean and modern on my desk. Overall, I’m really happy with it and would definately recommend it to anyone looking for a quality desk lamp.

Great lamp. Heights, light modes adjustable. I have macula. The lamp illuminates a large area. This also makes me see much better with my sewing machine - I was already worried that I would have to give up my hobby. I now have 6 pieces. The low price of the offer is unbeatable.

review_title: Bright adjustable desk lamp that really helps with detailed work
body_en: I picked up this double head LED lamp to brighten my home desk and it quickly became my go to for late night craft sessions and detailed tasks like soldering and sketching. The two adjustable heads flood the work area from different angles so shadows are minimal and the five colour temps with ten brightness steps make it easy to find a comfortable setting for reading, painting or computer work. The touch controls are simple and the memory function means I get the same light each time I turn it on. The lamp stays cool and I had no flicker during long sessions, and the joints held position reliably. Two practical notes, the small pen holder is more decorative than useful and if you plan to run the USB port and the lamp at once use a good quality 5 volt 3 amp adapter to avoid flicker. Overall it met my expectations for flexible, eye friendly task lighting.

Great desk lamp for working or studying. The brightness levels and color modes are really useful, and it was easy to set up. The light feels comfortable on the eyes, especially at night. Good value for the price.

I love this lamp! I changed the desk in my home office, so I can no longer use lamps that clamp to the desk. I’ve tried other lamps, but they are not tall enough. This lamp is so adjustable. You can twist the three different sections individually. It has multiple light brightness and a timer.

review_title: Well built and very stable; modern and minimalistic
body_en: This desk lamp certainly isn’t your typical desk lamp. The first thing I thought is that it looks like something straight from a science fiction movie. It’s not the prettiest lamp, but it has more of a clean, modern design with a black matte finish and slender profile. In my opinion, it’s just a more modern version of the swing lamp from back in my day. It obviously has more functionality when it comes to temperature and brightness levels, but to be honest, I find the height and angle adjustments to be a bit clunky. I suppose it’s because the arms are so long, not that they’re hard to turn. I like the slender profile of the lamp, though, because I can place the long, top light over my work space, and it brightens the area without getting in the way. I would say that the LED lighting is on par with most lamps of this type. I can adjust the brightness and temperature that’s suitable for my tasks: warm light for computer work, natural for crafting or writing. As you can see in the video when I turn off the lights, it casts a nice bright light over the desk area, but the rest of the room is fairly dark. Of course, you can adjust the angle of the light if needed, but it’s not going to brighten the entire room like a regular lamp could. But I suppose that’s why it’s called a DESK LAMP, not a table lamp. Concerning the build, unlike a regular lamp (and the old-timey swing lamp), the base is nice and flat, which means it doesn’t take up space. It can be used to hold a cup of coffee, your phone, or whatever else can fit on there. The base is not heavy, either, but it works well to counterbalance the lamp arms. The bottom post that’s connected to it is a little wobbly, though. Even so, it doesn’t seem to affect the stability. This lamp looks like it would be very tippy, but it’s surprisingly stable, even at the craziest angles. The design was obviously planned out well. Other than the post being a bit wobbly, the craftsmanship is good, too. So far, I’ve used this lamp almost every day since I received it. I might actually personalize it a little by putting a small plant on the base or put some pretty stickers on it. For now, it’s doing what I need it to do, and it doesn’t tip over easily, so I’m happy with it.
Love It Many Choice settings
Good lighting. Easy to put together!

review_title: Build Quality Doesn’t Match the Great Lighting
body_en: The light itself does a good job and has a lot going for it, but the overall build quality left me wanting more, especially considering the price. It is made of metal, but it uses a very thin gauge that feels hollow and doesn’t give the impression of a premium desk lamp. The biggest drawback is the articulating arm. The pivot and rotating joints are extremely stiff and don’t move smoothly, so adjusting the lamp usually takes two hands and more force than it should. Making small positioning changes can be frustrating because the movement isn’t fluid. On the positive side, the lighting is excellent. It gets plenty bright, offers multiple brightness levels, and lets you switch between warmer and cooler color temperatures depending on what you’re doing. The slim, low profile design also looks nice on a desk, and the base is sturdy enough to keep the lamp stable even when the arms are extended into different positions. Overall, it performs well as a desk lamp and the lighting quality is hard to complain about. I just think the mechanical design and build quality should have been better at this price.

This is a nice desk lamp. You fan select your preferred color tempature. It has 5 light levels. Theree are two joints each side of the joint can pivot 360 degrees so you can get light where you want it. There is some light assembly to connect the light to the base with two set screws I like this light his light came with our own power adapter. The material is nice... matte black finish.

This Desk lamp body is made entirely of high-quality aluminum for excellent heat dissipation, extending the lifespan of the desk lamp. It's paired with a weighted, non-slip base and stays stable on any surface without wobbling or tipping. I like the differnet adjustments available. The light has 4 rotatable joints, allowing you to freely adjust direction and angle to deliver precise light exactly where you need it—onto your book, keyboard, or crafts. It reproduces true-to-life object colors and provides even illumination with no glare, no flicker, and no blue light hazard. Reduces eye fatigue and creates a comfortable environment for jigsaw puzzle or computer work. This LED desk lamp offers 4 color temperatures (3000K–6500K) and 5 brightness levels (20%–100%). Adjust both to fully customize the light, creating the ideal illumination for any task. It even has a built-in auto shut-off timer. Set it for 30 minutes before bed, and the light will turn off automatically. It also remembers your last lighting settings, so next time you turn it on, it instantly restores your preferred setup. I'm enjoying this desk lamp and hope it lasts a long time.

review_title: Highly useful sturdy metal lamp with true-to-life color lighting!
body_en: I needed a desk lamp that would work well for both desk work and artwork such as sketching. So far, this lamp has been excellent for these activities. The lamp is sturdy and well made, with a solid metal construction that feels durable without being too heavy to move around. One feature I really like is that it sits on a flat base rather than using a clip. That gives me more placement options, and the flat base doesn’t take up much desk space. The lamp has two adjustable joints that allow me to position the light exactly where I need it, or I can extend it fully upright to function more like an area lamp. It also provides a wide coverage area and can be adjusted quite high when needed. For art projects, I appreciate that it is designed to reproduce true-to-life colors. According to the description, it is flicker-free, glare-free, and emits no blue light, making it easier on the eyes. It offers five brightness levels and four color temperature settings ranging from white to warm white. The timer function is a unique feature, although I’m not sure how often I’ll use it. One thing that confused me initially was the power adapter, which looked like it might charge the lamp. So far, I have only been able to use the lamp while it is plugged in. My only real issue was that the top and middle sections arrived assembled in the wrong orientation. At first I thought the design was unusual because one section pointed up while the other pointed down. Fortunately, I was able to unscrew and reposition the sections correctly, and everything worked fine afterward. Overall, this is a sturdy, versatile lamp with excellent adjustability, wide light coverage, and features that make it especially useful for desk work and art projects.

review_title: Probably the most versatile work light I've ever used
body_en: I can't think of anything I don't like about this light; it's nice and bright, adjusts easily to all kinds of positions, holds its adjustment well, all the brightness and color temp settings are easy to set, it seems reasonably sturdy, and the remote is very nice to use. There are little thoughtful touches - like the red LED on the lamp's power button that makes it easy to locate, on the otherwise flush black switches. It might be a little pricey (if you are used to the cheap stuff), but so far it seems well worth it.

I needed a light above my monitors for virtual calls at my home office. I have a window to the side which makes half my face dark, but this light works perfectly to light up my whole face. The different light modes & brightness levels help to match the light and the desk remote is easy to use, even while on calls. Thus one had the most lumens when compared to others and I'm glad I went with it.

DO NOT BUY! Purchased the lamp last June. Initially it worked well and I really enjoyed the different modes, brightness, and wireless remote. I the last two months, the lamp has had issues and will not turn or will flicker when you attempt to turn on. Only solution is to unplug, cross your finger that it works when you plug it back in. It's a roll of the dice if it will work. DO NOT BUY
This is absolutely what I was looking for on my desk with two computer monitors. It lit up the area under my screens while not blinding me (it is adjustable). Great product!

Nice light that fit my purposes well. Very light construction and very light weight. The light does not wrap around the fixture but is oriented straight down which is what I want, so there is no spill. Color temp is nice and works fine, the overall illumination is ok but not super bright. Happy with this economy product. Pros - downlight orientation, no spill - rotatable individual heads - lightweight - flexible Cons - picture indicates that the mounting base has slots in it, they do not. Since I did not use the clamping method and just screwed the base to a vertical surface, I had to drill holes into the base - light setting does not go to a very low level - not a robust build

review_title: Versatile desk light with lots of variety
body_en: Great office light. Lots of different temperatures of light. Needs at least an inch of clearance under the table top to clamp it on a desk. Love that it has a remote. A good option for sewing and reading.

review_title: This isn't awful but shop around. The brightness isn't as high as you expect
body_en: I haven't quite figured out how I feel about these. I don't like how these manufacturers will give you wattage or Kelvin rating which is more so temperature and not necessarily the brightness output. Brightness should be measured in lumens so to be honest I expected something way more bright when listed as being 24 W between two lamps. If you're looking for something that isn't going to light your office up like the 4th of July, then maybe this is for you, but I wanted something to help me with my art projects and with no other lights on in the room you'll see in my photo just how bright it goes and it really isn't very impressive. I'm going to stick with the product and not return it but nine times out of 10 I probably would return this and try to find something of better quality with better lumens or light output and quite possibly off of a different site. As you can see in my photo, this is a room that doesn't have any other lights on except for this desk lamp and it really isn't going to meet the need for any sort of detailed work like soldering or electronic work or artwork. I'm sure if you just wanted something for a gentle ambiance to compliment or help with a laptop then this is for you.
