Easy set up. Works like it should.
Quality lamp that doesn't look "cheap", looks great, very efficient, practical remote control, visual comfort ++, I use it to assemble Lego sets, I recommend this purchase.
A stylish, almost inconspicuous lamp provides good light, various beautiful colors of light and is wide enough to cover two screens. I would buy them again.
Excellent product. It works perfectly, at least for the moment. I recommend it.

A successful product with all the functions described in the images. Compared to classic table lamps, it does not take up space on the table, it is much more satisfactory since the angle of incidence of the light comes from above, it has the color of sunlight, and it is a visually cool product. Definitely worth buying. Only the keys could be a little more user-friendly; It's a bit stiff and also not fast. Although, I can say that this is an unimportant detail since we will not be pressing the buttons very often.

review_title: Perfect for all types of work!
body_en: I bought this out of necessity for working at home during the winter. I was expecting this lamp to be a lot bigger than it actually is. It comes in amazing compact box. The box could fit through your letter box (in its own box not the amazon one on top). Nicely packaged and very easy to expand to the desired height. The clamp has a good range of widths to fit a variety of surfaces. Even on a thin desk top it clamps really well i did not have to add any additional wood or anything to balance it. As light position is important to me as i suffer from migraines now and then. I was able to position this neatly behind my dual monitors to provide light on my desk without hitting my eyes. It looks smart and professional and easy to angle and adjust to suit. Lighting from it is fantastic. The different settings to choose are amazing. Warm, Daylight and Cool Light and adjustable light levels! Not only can you adjust the colour preference you can adjust how bright it is! Powering the lamp with USB IS THE BEST THING EVER! I run this from my desktop PC for various reasons. Mainly as my PC always has power (no its not always running, just has access to constant power supply) the lamp can still be used when the PC is off as it pulls power through the motherboard. PERFECT! No additional plugs into the madness of extension leads I already have! If you plan to run this off of a laptop not really ideal but will work. Just don't complain it kills your battery quickly. Ideally get an adapter or a USB extension lead to run it from instead. For the price the quality is pretty fine. The head is plastic and the cover is also plastic so no glass. The frame is a nice light metal possibly aluminum. Basically for its price its a damn good lamp. Suitable for office use. Models, artwork. reading even a quirky bedside lamp. I'm not including photos because my setup hides the lamp and doesn't do it justice anyway. However other buyers have kindly posted.

Bought one of these and immediately liked it, so I bought a second one. Product description is accurate. Vendor response to questions I put was prompt and helpful. Construction is excellent. Product has multiple pivots allowing both flexibility and control over positioning and use. There are two color temperatures - a bluish white light, and a warm, amber light, both with four levels of brightness. When I want maximum illumination, I can turn the main lamps downward over my desktop and use the white light (there is a preset option on the control remote, MAX, "reading and writing"); when I am working on my three screens, I can change to the warm light, reduce the brightness, and turn the main lamps toward the ceiling for ambient illumination, while the auxiliary lamps provide gentle illumination of my desktop and keyboard. To top it off, it is easy to set up the two lamps to run off a single remote, so the two behave as one. Very, very nice feature. This is a terrific product, one I enjoy every time I use it - multiple times a day - and worth the $52 I paid for each of them. If I had another use for them I'd buy more.
Great light , sturdy , functional , perfect lighting - just perfect for close up work and nice looking lamp .

The light components swivel which helps direct the light. The remote will turn on the last used brightness settings. The table clips works well. This is worth the money and a great addition to my drawing table.

Love this light, I bought it to help with jigsaw puzzles. I wear glasses and lighting is key. From the moment I turned it on it was an absolute delight and I was able to see the colors like I need to.

The lamp is as advertised. Everything works fine and looks great. The design is flexible/adaptable to give you light at your desired angle. It seems to be well built with a price that reflects this. I should have paid attention more to the description. While the lamp works great, it does not illuminate the desired workspace. This lamp is works with a smaller work surface of a maximum of 48". Mine however is Tim Allen sized table that is 72" so I'll need to find another solution.

My son likes the light overall. He says the brightest setting is a bit too much and gives him a headache, so if you need a bright light, this definitely fits the bill—luckily there are plenty of light settings, so he has options. His only real complaint is that the lamp is a bit stiff to maneuver, but it does hold its place well.

review_title: GREAT for dual side mount full desk lighting
body_en: Love this light. Only mounted for my hobby desk a few days. I had previously intended to make a 'Light Arch' to maximize lighting across the desk. While shopping planned area updates including clamp on lighting, this store had a picture of these light bars on both ends of a desk, and that was the spark I needed. Desk top is 65 inches wide. with lights adjusted as pictured, there is about 1 inch gap between ends of the heads. In CAD I modeled a simple rectangle tube with limit ridges for ends of heads. This tube acts as a coupler, so the hanging light bars not only help support each other, but also exhibit almost no wobble when the desk is jarred. Lights are wonderfully bright. I can adjust warmth to my liking. Construction is solid and high quality. The remotes are a great touch. Both sides of clamp come with non slip pads already attached. The control design is not particularly intuitive, but I give a pass for that given the memory to return lighting to previous state when turned on. Worst case, I turn on and touch the reading/writing button for maximum illumination. Improvement recommendation: adjust remote programming so touching reading/writing (MAX) button turns all lights on to that state, without needing to turn on first. I enjoy these lights for my purposes and am pleased 2 of them were my optimal solution as intended

I really like this one. Bright enough for my projects. I use it for my art, painting with acrylic, and pencil drawing. I hope this one lasts. I bought another type, and it did not work for just a few months. This one is brighter and comes with a handy remote. This does the job for me. I would give it a 5-star rating.

Phenomenal for my kiddos! They both love to read before bed, so the timer as well as the nightlight function is great. Regular levels of brightness are fantastic but too bright for nighttime reading for littles in my opinion. Functions perfectly, and my littles can operate it on their own! Comes with everything needed to get started straight out of the box. 10/10 would purchase again!

This LED desk lamp is fantastic! It provides bright, even lighting without being harsh on the eyes. The adjustable brightness and color settings make it perfect for working, reading, or crafting. It's sturdy, easy to adjust, and doesn't take up much desk space. Great quality for the price, and I would definitely recommend it!
Excellent desk lamp at a great price. I'm a teacher and it is perfect for my needs. The tone of the light and brightness are adjustable. The Charging ports are a nice additional also.

It works good and is very versatile but a little top heavy if you move the light wrong. It wants to fall over. I would still buy again because I do like the light and you can adjust it to your liking.

review_title: It is a well built product and affordable, too.
body_en: I am very pleased with the looks and quality of this lamp. I especially like how I can change the brightness and tones of the light. At night I can have just enough light for watching TV or reading a book, and when I need a brighter light, I can do that as well. When I viewed the product online, I was afraid that it could easily become top heavy and fall over if the gooseneck hung over too far, but I didn’t find that to be the case at all. It is very well balanced for all of my needs. The last feature I really like is that it has a timer I can set to have it turn off by itself. This is perfect at night when I sometimes fall asleep reading in bed. If I had any changes I would make to the lamp it would be to have the power button raised or textured so that I could feel it and find it quickly in the dark. But that is a minor issue. I would definitely purchase this product again for someone else.

I bought this for my daughter to use for her bedazzling hobby and she really likes it. It’s bright enough for her to see the small rhinestones and details, and the bendable neck makes it easy to position the light exactly where she needs it. She’s been very happy with it.

review_title: Nice lamp, bad charger, top heavy
body_en: This works well and has nice settings. However, if you want to plug in a charger to the base, it isn't compatible with real apple chargers for some reason. It will work with random off brand chargers, but not my apple ones-- which is really annoying. The character also sticks half way out the plug in, which is pretty scary electrical wise. Adjustment wise, it's VERY top heavy so it's not as adjustable as I'd like, so it just falls over often, or I'll have to set something on it to keep it down. It works really nice as a lamp and I like all the different color and brightness options a lot.

The light is great, multiple brightness settings. Some charging cords work others dont but they may be pretty old. On a flat table the light does not tip over. I use it in a craft room for painting with small details and its perfect.

Very beautiful and useful lamp. Adjustable light, for intensity and color; perfect for every reading condition. The long stem and the large ceiling light allow diffused lighting over the entire work surface. After trying different LED lamps, I finally found the right one so as not to strain my eyes. The two USB sockets on the back allow you to use the power supply supplied for the lamp to simultaneously charge other devices.
Very good. It provides good light, isn't large, fits in various spaces, and is easy to handle.

The 15W LED desk lamp from ZAPLIT impresses in the workplace with its enormous variety of functions. With 3 color temperatures and 5 levels, the eye-friendly light can be perfectly adapted to any situation. Operation via remote control including timer and night mode is particularly convenient. The flexible 360° gooseneck allows precise alignment, while the integrated USB-A and USB-C ports enable smartphones etc. to be charged directly at the desk. The lamp is stable and has a high quality workmanship. A clear recommendation!

review_title: Iluminación inteligente y versátil para cuidar la vista en cualquier espacio de estudio o trabajo
body_en: Having an adaptable lighting source that is respectful of visual health and capable of offering multiple configuration options is essential to optimize the hours of reading, working or studying at home. This advanced desk lamp offers a highly practical and versatile solution to illuminate any surface with complete comfort and precision. Quality analysis The article stands out for its solid construction that integrates seventy-eight high-efficiency light-emitting diodes with a power of fifteen watts, designed to provide uniform and long-lasting lighting performance. Its structure features a forty centimeter flexible gooseneck with full rotation, a base equipped with USB type A and type C charging ports, and a dual control system that includes touch buttons and a practical remote control. Using experience Thanks to the 360-degree gooseneck, the light cone can be adjusted exactly to the desired position, and the combination of different color temperatures and brightness levels ensures extremely pleasant and eye-friendly work, whether you are concentrating on the screen at night or reading. The integrated USB ports for charging devices, as well as the practical remote control and night mode, are also plus points in daily use. Its performance remains impeccable after prolonged use, adapting perfectly to each environmental need. Points for and against ✨ Great flexibility of adjustment thanks to the 360-degree gooseneck that guides the light effortlessly. 🧩 Multiple lighting options with three color temperatures and five adjustable brightness levels. 👀 USB charging ports integrated into the base to conveniently power other devices. 🛠️ Base with considerable dimensions, taking up a little more space on small desks. Final Verdict This smart desk lamp represents a fantastic and highly recommended purchase for any workspace or bedroom that requires quality, versatile lighting. Its excellent combination of performance, eye care and additional functions ensures total satisfaction. As a member of the Vine program, I have completely independently and honestly reviewed this product. I remain at your entire disposal to resolve any additional questions or queries that may arise in this regard.

review_title: Needs a heavier base for maximum positioning. Good desk light.
body_en: This is a lightweight desk lamp. The base of the lamp is covered in a felt material. The head of the light can be easily rotated so it can swivel left and right and the flexible arm is coated in a soft silicone material and bends easily. It also maintains the position you bend it into and doesn't sag since the head of the light is relatively light. The button controls are not individual buttons, they're plastic bubble buttons. Once the flexible arm is connected, it cannot be removed. The back of the lamp is just a plastic housing, no metal there to help dissipate heat, but even so I found that the back of the light only got slightly warm even at maximum brightness. Not even warm enough to be used as a hand warmer. The light has 5 brightness levels and the light is a very even diffuse light pattern and a wide cast area. The light output at maximum is quite bright, but not bright enough to over saturate printed material which would make it unreadable. The night light mode provides a much dimmer light output than is achievable with the brightness controls. It works very well as a night light. By default when pressing the night light button, the color temperature is warm. You can cycle through the other color temperatures after selecting night light mode. In order to get out of night light mode, you need to increase the brightness. When you turn the light off and turn it back on, it will remember which mode it was in last and use the same mode as it was in when it was turned off, this also applies to the night light mode, not just the brightness and color temperature. The brightness of the light isn't controlled via PWM, so it is flicker free. The 4 LEDs on the base illuminate to tell you which timer setting you're on. Due to the fact that the base is very lightweight and doesn't have any heft to it, you cannot move the head of the light too far away from the base. If you do, the imbalance of the weight will just cause the light to fall over. Also accidental bumps can knock it over easily. A heavier weighted base would help a lot here to allow for maximum range of positioning. I have another old fashioned halogen bulb desk lamp and it has a very heavily weighted base even though the head is lighter than this unit's head and it has very good stability as a result. The remote is a wireless remote and not an IR remote so there's no need to point it at the lamp to use it. I tested it, and it has very good range, going through 3 walls with ease. The base has a felt layer on the bottom providing some grip to keep it from easily sliding around. Although there is a USB-A and USB-C ports on the back, you need to provide your own cables. Included is a 12V/2A barrel connector power adapter, however it isn't UL or ETL certified, but then again neither is the lamp.

review_title: Simple lamp with a great selection of colors.
body_en: I see a lot of confusion about this product. The directions aren’t very descriptive, . 1. This product does have different color lights . 2. You can turn the color cycling off so that it stays on whatever color you desire. 3. You are able to adjust the brightness, there are three levels The thing to keep in mind is you navigate this one button device with the timing of your button presses. A long 3 second tap will turn it on and off. The default when you turn it on is the white color. The white is not too cool, nor too warm. You can adjust the brightness and at the highest level it is plenty bright if you need to find something in the room. I don’t think it will adequately light a large dark room on its own. But you can read using this light if you are within a few feet of the lamp (for most people). . If you want to change to the color setting, then a quick one second tap after the device is turned on. At this point, you will be on the color cycling mode. if you do nothing, the device will cycle through various shades of green, blue, red, yellow, etc. For example, you will see a turquoise blue, a cornflower blue, a hot pink, a pale green, etc. If you want to select a particular color, wait until it cycles to the color you like, and use a one second tap to select. This will pause it on the color that was lit when you tapped the button. If you want to turn the device off, just press the button for three seconds. You will have to repeat the process every time you turn the device on, It isn’t very resource-intensive so I wouldn’t let that deter you unless you are picky and this is a dealbreaker. I’m sure more expensive units have more robust memories, settings, and remote controls with more than one button to navigate. Only two items come in the box, the lamp (which is roughly 7” tall, and 4” wide at the base) and the power cord (which is not infuriatingly short) so setup is easy.. There’s no charging or batteries required. So far I like it and plan to keep it. I have insomnia, and read about light therapy. When I’m ready to sleep, I plan to change the color to an Amber/orangey/pink color to mimic the sunset to tell my body it’s time to get tired and go to sleep. I just received it, so cannot speak to longevity. I always come back and edit reviews if anything changes. If it stops working, I’ll update with a date so you’ll know how long mine lasted. Hope this helps! Edit : 6/1/24 I wanted to amend this review to specify that the color portion of this lamp is not dimmable. This may present an issue if someone is trying to use a color To fall asleep as I mentioned I was using this for. I agree that the lamp is very bright for colors. To fix this, I use a Small canvas bag I received with another product over it. I can still see the color and the lamp but it is much less less bright. If I didn’t have that bag I would use a scarf or some other type of lightweight fabric over it to use it for nighttime.

review_title: Great little bedside lamp. Nightmode is great!
body_en: Touch lamp is small and versatile as you can switch brightness, color or night mode. Great value!

Love it! Touch control is effortless- but not too sensitive, compact enough for a small nightstand, but impressively bright at the highest setting. The brightness stages feel right, and the colors are impressive.

review_title: This lamp has a secret feature (a glowing review)
body_en: This lamp was purchased on 12/6/2025 for $18.99. The quality is more than adequate, but the lamp is very lightweight and definitely not what I would consider a premium product, however it looks good and functions well for the price that I paid. On the lamp that I received which is the model with a cord (not rechargeable) I can touch and hold the top control panel when the lamp is off, and it will come on in an ultra low mode which I absolutely love! Other than that if you were just to tap the top when the lamp is off there there are 3 brightness levels to cycle through with each tap: Low, Medium and High. The light that emits from this lamp is soft, the color temperature is pleasant and leans warm which for me is a great thing. To get to the colored mode you must press and hold on the top of the lamp while the white light is on and then tap the top to start/stop it from slowly cycling through the spectrum of colors, ie once it lands on your favorite color give the top panel a tap and it will freeze there on that color. The lamp also remembers that color too so the next time you enter color mode by holding down on the top panel it will come on directly to that last color which was used. I wish the brightness could be controlled when in the color mode but it cannot. I would guess that the brightness when in color mode is factory set to be somewhere around Medium and is not dimmable or adjustable in any way when in color mode which could obviously appear brighter to your eye depending on which color you have landed on or that the lamp is currently cycling through (if you just leave it continually and slowly flowing from one color to the next in a mostly smooth and seamless fashion). So far this is a nice, cheap and attractive bedside lamp.

Get the advanced one, I can see why it has better reviews than the cheaper ones. Has a long battery life, charges fast, good quality, it’s the perfect size, not too big, not too small, assembling and instructions were very easy, you can adjust the colors and brightness. Such a small purchase for a good price makes such a difference in my living room!

review_title: Quality light with brightness options - can't go wrong!
body_en: I love this light and the various settings it has from a super dim nightlight to a very bright white. The colors are fun options as well but those are not dimmable. I've used this for the last year or so and still love it and will likely get another one or two. It makes a great bathroom nightlight too if you like something more substantial than just a tiny plug-in.

I could be wrong; maybe I didn’t read the product description as well as I thought or maybe I’m just dumb….but I was very disappointed to see that this is NOT a wireless lamp. I swear I looked at all the pictures for it and I read the description twice and no where did I see that it said that it’s not wireless. Which is not totally fair because that’s what my Amazon search was for: a wireless lamp. I wondered once I received the lamp is the wire was just to charge it up and then you could use it wirelessly but that isn’t the case. It’s still a nice light lamp and I appreciate how bright it can be. It’s also nice to be able to change the brightness. I’m just really disappointed by the fact that it needs to be plugged in 24/7 to work
i really like it it looks good and the light is also really good and really bright definitely does not disappoint really good for gaming rooms or for on the side of the bed
It does not work without connecting it to electricity. I was expecting a charge.. but the lighting is strong and comfortable.. and the touch button is smooth and soft.
Touch controls work so poorly that I returned them. Nice design and such

I've been using it for about a year and a half and it's perfect, you need two for a large place, I travel with it and I always use it because I don't like very strong lights, it weighs almost nothing, I totally recommend it

review_title: Perfekte Nachttischlampe – Lange Akkulaufzeit und flexible Helligkeit
body_en: I am very happy with this LED bedside lamp! The battery life is impressive - it easily lasts several evenings without me having to constantly charge it. This makes them particularly practical as I often move them flexibly around the room. The dimmer settings are another highlight. The lamp offers a pleasantly wide range from very soft, dimmed light to a brighter setting that is ideal for reading. No matter whether I need a cozy atmosphere or enough light to work, this lamp serves both purposes perfectly. The design is modern and simple, so it fits well into any bedroom. In addition, the operation is intuitive and easy to understand. Conclusion: A great bedside lamp with long battery life, flexible dimming options and an attractive design. Clear recommendation!
Perfect for a nightstand. I've been using it for months and it's perfect.

review_title: Perfect desk lamp for a music workstation
body_en: I’m extremely happy with this desk lamp. The 42-inch, 4-panel design provides a very wide lighting area, which easily covers my entire workspace without creating dark spots. The brightness is even and comfortable for long sessions. One of my favorite features is the clamp design. Since it doesn’t have a bulky base sitting on the desk, it saves a lot of valuable workspace and keeps everything looking clean and organized. I recently bought a height-adjustable desk for my Yamaha MODX8+ synthesizer, and this lamp has been the perfect addition. It clamps securely to the edge of the desk, doesn’t get in the way, and provides more than enough light whether I’m practicing, recording, or adjusting controls on the keyboard. Setup was quick, the lamp feels well-built, and the adjustable panels let me direct the light exactly where I need it. If you have a large desk, dual monitors, or even a music production setup like mine, I highly recommend this lamp. It has been one of the best upgrades to my workspace.

review_title: Super easy to install, highly practical, and used every single day!
body_en: I bought this desk lamp recently and I’m honestly so impressed. Setup took me like five minutes, and since it clamps right onto the desk, it doesn't take up any surface space or make things look cluttered—super clean and sleek. It also feels very sturdy and well-built. The height and gooseneck are so easy to adjust however you want. Love that it has 5 color modes and adjustable brightness levels—makes it insanely versatile whether I'm working or just chilling and relaxing. Plus, having a remote control is such a nice bonus so I don't even have to reach up to change settings. Highly recommend if you need a great light for your workspace!

review_title: Bright, flexible light + outstanding customer service
body_en: I really love the light itself. The 42-inch bar with four independently adjustable panels is a game-changer. You can fold them in for focused task lighting or swing them out to cover a huge workspace (easily covers dual monitors or a big desk). It’s super bright—up to 1800 lumens—and the light is even and clean with no harsh spots. Perfect for long work sessions. I did manage to accidentally break the clamp, but the company was fantastic about it. They shipped me a brand-new replacement free of charge with no hassle. That kind of customer service is rare and really sealed the deal for me. If you’re looking for a bright, wide-coverage desk lamp and a company that actually takes care of its customers, this one is hard to beat. Highly recommend.

review_title: Bright, Easy to Install, and the Remote Control Is Super Convenient
body_en: Really happy with this lamp. It was easy to install and only took a few minutes. The light is much bigger than I expected and covers my whole desk really well. I also like the remote control because it’s easy to adjust the brightness and light color without getting up. It looks nice, feels sturdy, and works great for my home office. Definitely worth the price!

I use a 6ft by 3ft dining table as a desk because I need to be able to have textbooks and notebooks open while I also use the computer and take notes, and I was having trouble seeing print well without shuffling everything around as I went along with just the regular desk lamp. This lamp is clamped to a long side, and it doesn't take away from the valuable work space. It illuminates the entire tabletop nicely, and at full brightness, I can read everything around me easily. I keep it at about half brightness for a comfortable illumination when I'm not reading/writing, and that is slightly brighter than my other lamp was. The arms adjust easily, and allow for more light in specific areas if needed. The included remote control is very handy, and has several preset brightness/color settings, but also easily adjusts each manually, and includes a timer feature. Batteries are not included, though; it takes 2 AAA. My only reason for taking off one star is because the assembly, while it was essentially simple, was slightly harder because the connector at the top of the flexible arm was on the wrong side of the arm to easily connect to the light bar, and I had to finagle it a while to get it to be able to connect. Overall, I am very pleased with it and would buy again.

review_title: Must have for a large desk
body_en: This LED desk lamp has completely transformed my workspace. The 42-inch light bar easily covers my entire dual-monitor setup, and the four adjustable panels let me direct light exactly where I need it. The included remote is incredibly convenient, allowing me to adjust the settings without reaching for the lamp. This is an excellent investment for dual-monitor setup, It offers outstanding brightness, versatility, and convenience at a great value. Highly recommended!

It was easy to put together and only took me about 10–15 minutes. I mainly use it for working at night and reading, and the brightness is just right for me. The light is soft and doesn't strain my eyes, even after using it for a while. My favorite feature is the adjustable brightness—I usually dim it in the evening, and it's much more comfortable that way. The lamp feels sturdy and stays in place without wobbling. The clamp holds securely on my desk, and it doesn't take up much space. I also like the clean, simple design. I've been using it for a while now and haven't had any issues with flickering or anything else. So far, I'm really happy with it.

I’ve been using this desk lamp for a while now, and I’m very happy with it. The brightness is fully adjustable, making it perfect for both working and reading. It also offers multiple color temperature settings, so I can easily switch between warm, neutral, and cool light depending on the time of day. The flexible design allows me to adjust the angle exactly where I need the light. I also like that it can be extended to provide wider coverage, which works great for my dual-monitor setup. The remote control is very convenient, and the overall build quality feels solid

I loved it, following the instructions you can do the assembly and the light tones very well, I loved the control to be able to turn off and control the intensity and tone. 100% satisfied... my husband really likes me.

There seemed like so many choices out there. How to select the right one. Perhaps we just got lucky in our choice. This LED desk lamp has improved our entire office experience. It was easy to install with very clear instructions. It has brightened our work area with personal choices for brightness and colour tone (my wife and I like different setups. Unexpectedly, it also opened up our work space creating much more desk work space. We have need for another computer work station light and will be purchasing a second one of these. I think that is the ultimate positive review when you not only say you would purchase again, and actually purchase again. I highly recommend this lamp!

review_title: Perfect Desk Lamp for My Home Office
body_en: The Govee RGBIC Smart Table Lamp 2 has been another great addition to my growing Govee ecosystem. I bought it for my home office desk, and it fits the space perfectly. The lighting is bright, vibrant, and easy to customize. I like being able to switch between clean white light while I’m working and colorful lighting when I’m gaming or just relaxing. The RGBIC effects look fantastic, and the app makes it simple to create different scenes and automations. Since I already have several Govee products throughout my home, this lamp integrated seamlessly into my existing setup. Everything works together flawlessly through the Govee app, making it easy to control all of my lighting from one place. The build quality feels premium, and the modern design looks great on my desk without taking up much space. If you’re already invested in the Govee ecosystem—or you’re looking for a high-quality smart desk lamp—this is an easy recommendation. It’s been one of my favorite additions to my home office.

review_title: Fun lamp with great preset modes
body_en: This is such a fun little lamp. The colors are bright, it looks great, and I really like having all the different preprogrammed lighting modes to choose from. It makes it easy to change the mood of the room without having to spend time adjusting everything manually. My favorite feature is definitely the music sync. It reacts to the music really well and makes the whole setup feel a lot more lively, especially if you have people over or just want some ambient lighting while listening to music. The app is easy enough to use, and there are plenty of options if you want to customize things beyond the presets. Overall, it looks good, works well, and is just a genuinely fun addition to the room.

review_title: Love it, love it, love it...!
body_en: What can I say. It's a govee, and has all the variety and quality that name possesses. Excellent ease of programming. Bright colors. User friendly, even to computer illiterate, with a small amount of examples of information about it. Touch control and app running device, has a great fit on my TV stand, and seems made of a superior material, doesn't appear flimsy, at all.

I already own a few Govee products, so I decided to give this smart bedside lamp a try. I really needed a new bedside lamp, so I figured I’d test it out—and I’m so glad I did. I ended up loving it. The brightness is excellent. It can get very bright at 100%, but you can also dim it down as much as you want, which is perfect for nighttime use. I was pleasantly surprised by how many different settings it has. I’ve used the Govee app before with my monitor backlight, but the features on this lamp feel completely different and much more immersive. There are so many fun modes—like fire-like flames, fireflies floating around, night sky effects, and soothing ambient lights. One of my favorite features is that you can actually draw in the app and have your drawing show up on the lamp. It feels creative and playful, not just functional. I was so satisfied with this lamp that I bought one for my sister, and I’m planning to get one for my parents as well. Great quality, great features, and amazing value for the price. Highly recommend.

The Lamp is a stylish and versatile lighting option that adds a great atmosphere to any room. The color effects are vibrant and smooth, with plenty of customization available through the app, including preset scenes, scheduling, and music-sync features. Setup was simple, and the smart controls work reliably. While the brightness may not be enough to fully light a room on its own, it excels as ambient lighting and creates a fun, modern look. Overall, it's a well-designed smart lamp that offers impressive features and great value for the price.

I absolutely love Govee products. I currently have about 15 pieces. Mostly lights but also a temperature gauge and fan. The quality far surpasses any other lighting manufacturer I’ve used before. It seamlessly syncs with Apple and Alexa. I’ve purchased every size light from small and thin to the larger patio lights and just regular bulbs which are all great. The adjustability and color range is absolutely fantastic. It fits my lifestyle and helps me with a smart home. I have only recently had to find out how their customer service is, which is phenomenal by the way. I will always repurchase Govee products and hope they come out with many more smart items in the future.

very nice i love that it really brightens up my room along with my other govee lights. i love the pattern it gives when its on dreamview and the difference options ur able to choose from. love love love. only thing is i thought it was a speaker too for some reason but i guess not. assembly took like 5 minutes. the size is bigger than i thought in all honesty. i like how u have the option to adjust the lightning on the actual lamp and on the phone.

review_title: The best bedside mood lamp you can buy.
body_en: Not only is this matter enabled as it makes it available for remote operation with Alexa, Google Home and Apple HomeKit. This makes the device available for all the systems out there. I really enjoy the lamp and have it as my bedside lamp. This makes it excellent for controlling the brightness with its touch enabled controls and selection of colours and other mixed light scenes. I purchased it in the Amazon Prime sale for approximately $50 and at that price point it is a great buy. I can highly recommend this lamp for creating that mood in the bedroom prior to sleep and its automations are also excellent. It’s a quality product and I can highly recommend it.

I had seen several options and I have had some lamps, but without a doubt this is the best, I thought about it a lot because it is expensive, but one day there was an offer and I decided to try it to see if it was worth it and I was surprised by how good it looks, especially at night or in a dark room, it has several very pleasant light effects, it was definitely worth it

review_title: I'm 35 or 36 and I love this lamp ☺️🥰😅
body_en: 😃🥰 This thing honestly cheers me up every day☺️ its only been 1 week and im still gushing over how cute and fun this lamp is😃 PROS: • Clean, modern, smooth curves. I love that the branding logo is at least blended in nicely and not tacky.. pretty minimal. Not tacky. • I LOVE the DIY functions. Choosing your own colors from the color wheel is awesome. There are many colors to choose from ! #1 reason for buying this lamp was the DIY functions 🥰 • Price was okay, but still a bit steep. I bought 2 for a total of 162$ ... (you got a deal if you bought 2) 80 bucks is a bit steep still... even with all this lamp does. I would not pay more than 80 for this lamp... especially because it's not cordless like the updated one. • I love that they update the app with new options for preset scenes! I didn't even expect that and then I saw new ones appear one day. • I love that you can dim the background color in the DIY Sketch section. Helps a lot with night time chill time... plus looks great paired with bright colors in contrast to the dimmed background. I'm an adult female and I have so much fun playing with this lamp. All in all I LOVE this lamp. The cons/improvements I list below, are just me being very critical of the color limitation. CONS / Improvements • I wish you could get deeper colors.. like a deep striking red, a basic 'green crayon' green, a forest green... etc but it's just not possible. The greens are lime green to aqua. The reds aren't red, they are hot pink to coral pink even on the reddest setting. • The lamp is very bright, even on its lowest 1% setting. I can't have these on at night when I'm sleeping... which is kind of a bummer. Sometimes we have to turn them off when we're watching tv at night too, because theyre just so bright. Even the various sleep preset scenes that do have darker dimmed colors.. it's still quite bright. *** Correction though ... I found in the DIY Sketch that you can actually dim the main background color. Huge plus ! Now night time wont be so bright and I can really make other colors pop against the dimmed background. • Wish it were cordless of course, but I am sure they will make a cordless version since they already did with the Table Lamp Pro JBL speaker one. Hopefully they keep these ones smaller like they are but make them cordless. • For the preset 'scene settings' ..... you can't actually change the colors to anything you want. For the ones you CAN customize (there are a few you 100% can not) There is a list of 8 different color "combos" to choose from. If you don't like a color used in any of those 8 color combos, you cant do anything about it. So for my favorite scene settings, I can only use that scene if I use one of the 8 pre set options provided for that scene. This is shown on one of my review photos. However, I have recreated some of the "preset scenes" using the DIY/Sketch function. That enables me to use whatever colors I choose.. but still there are limitations around this. For example, the "Fire" Preset Scene, you can't choose other colors for that fire movement scene at all. Which sucks. It would look very cool in other colors. *** EDIT --- I stand corrected after exploring some more. In the DIY section, you do have "fire" as an effect and you can change the color of it... including various colors it will morph into. It just doesnt show on the actual 'fire' preset scene. Very happy to have realized this ☺️ • The Ai function is super cool.. and I know it works awesome on their other products such as their light panel or curtain lights... this one has limitations only because of the inability to use darker or duller color. For example in my last photo you can see I asked for a moody greyish blue sky... slate grey/slate dull blue would have been awesome with white clouds... but it can't do those colors (slate greyish blue). HOWEVER now that I know I can dim the background significantly in the DIY section, I can maybe pull this off. Finding a way to realllyy have "millions" of colors to choose from would be great. I'm being really picky here lol I do love the color options it does have. 😍🥰 With most variations of any color on the DIY color wheel, outside of the most obvious variations, the difference is barely barely noticeable, even if on the app they show as very different shades or tints of blue, there is barely a difference once on the lamp...... Though there often IS a difference. You can see the slight change when you switch back and forth, for the most part. You get a lot of pink, since the entirety of the red are variations of pink.. plus the actual entire pink section. Much of the "purples" are actually fuschia pink. You have to go very blue to get a regular "purple". There are way less variations of green, purple, yellow. Green for example, there is only lime green and quickly goes to aqua, or yellow on the other side. Basic green crayon color would be awesome. Purple usually looks more blue or fuschia.. depending what colors you pair it with it or whether purple is totally by itself. Or if you dim the background color, your 'purple'(fuschia) will probably turn more towards actual purple. When I use a red background, (which shows hot hot reddish pink to orangey red.. never real red).... i can get a purple heart on it by making the heart blue. It then shows up purple. So there are tricks. ☺️ I am really happy with the custom colors though despite these few limitations haha I'm making it sound worse than it is. It's an awesome lamp. 🥰 I wish I could draw/sketch white and grey mountains... like light grey with contrasting dark grey and slate grey, with white tips mountains. I will play around with it some more though, because in the DIY "Fire" effect, I see some 'slate' greys possible be used. So it seems possible? Another example of this limitation: 🎅🎄Christmas colors.. there are none. ... Since red is hot pink and green is lime green. So the preset christmas scenes do not give christmas vibes at all. Same with the Halloween... purple is never purple enough unless you have zero colors near it... or place enough blue next to fuschia to turn the fuschia a nice purple. The halloween presets that have orange and purple next to eachother, the purple never shows well enough to look Halloweeny. In my opinion. St Patricks Day Preset Scenes are capable of lime green only... Other than that, These lamps are so awesome. 😁 I'm totally buying more Govee products 😏😛 I ordered the Uplighter off their website just days after I bought these lamps😛 One small annoyance is I ordered from the Govee website 5 days ago and my uplighter still isnt here. I went through the website bc it was on sale for 170 + an extra 8$ off coupon code....... 5 days later today the lamp is here on Amazon on sale for 160..... So I could have got the lamp within 24hrs had I been able to use Amazon but they lagged 5 days on matching their amazon store sale to their website sale. Hopefully it arrives today.

review_title: Práctico, muy brilloso, y adaptable a tu necesidad.
body_en: Excellent and very shiny. I love the theme simulations it makes and that you can synchronize it to your screen if you already have the Govee LED strip as well. I have this one, the LED strip, and the Govee uplighter, and they give all the atmosphere I need to my room, be it light to concentrate on work, tracking my screen to play games or watch movies, or lights to relax.

review_title: GOVEE is where it's at it seems
body_en: I have several Govee products and I have watched a lot of growth over the years. What brought me back to Govee was not only their string lights, but the customer support is amazing. And they probably would win the popularity vote if there was one. Now it is getting to the point that when Govee releases another product, I want to buy it whether I need it or not. This table light is no exception! I wanted it just because it's Govee and who doesn't want a table side light that can do a heck of a lot more than just be a light. The scenes are amazing and there are so many to choose from. So not only can it be a white light that you can change the brightness but it can be programed to similate a sunrise when you get up or a sunset when you go to bed or any other combination in between. I had a night light with a smart bulb in it and was quite happy with it. But the Table light seemed like it would be the perfect companion. No matter what, I like this light, but there are a couple of things that could use help. This goes for just about every light strip that Govee has and it has to do with the music feature. For the most part it syncs well enough to most beats, but what bothers me and a ton of others is that when there is no sound, it still dances with light. So it's not exact. One day they will address this issue. The other issue that is not a problem for everyone, but certainly is for new people and even more so for older people who are not into apps and programing lights to do what they want it to. The presets are great, don't get me wrong, but there is a number of people that have issues in not knowing how to do even basic stuff. Don't be intimidated, there is plenty of support and plenty of communities who are willing to help. I just wish that Govee had their own How to Videos. But the growth has been amazing. I also think that prices are premium and they don't have to be. But once you bite down on the purchase, you will have a lot of fun with their products and for that reason I'm in.

review_title: Good enough that we bought two, Govee app just keeps getting better
body_en: I have two of these lights in my office, and absolutely love how customisable the lamps are. The lamps include touch controls on top for on/off, brightness and cycling between basic scenes, but the Govee app really shines for these. The amount of scenes that come pre-loaded is great, and being able to browse user made scenes, create your own, and curate them with AI is just insane. I especially love that the lighting on these is seamless; there's no ugly LED band that appears on the lamp, and with enough tweaking, there's no lag on the scenes that change light colours. My only complaint is related to that lag, it's quite difficult finding a scene where the colours don't jitter a bit. However, of you stick to the basic scenes or just use the lamp as natural coloured light, it's ideal. It also gets very bright when using the lamp in the white colour temperature mode, and the lamp itself is really stylish and modern, the base is super cool. And lastly for people who like tech specs, it plugs in with a DC barrel jack, with a cable that's about 5 feet long. The lamp also has crazy comparability with Home Assistant via Govee Cloud add one, but I've not dove deep enough into that yet!

I think this light was 100% worth it. I was looking for something better than the entry-level $20-$30 lights as i'm usually working late into the nights and needed something to reduce eye strain given that my room doesnt have the best lighting. I usually stay on the warmer tones at night, and have the white light on during the day on a cloudy day. The setup up was really easy, and my second favorite part is the light control that I can set on my desk. Its super sleek, and simple to understand, and ultimately has been very reliable for the month that i've had it so far. Would recommend.

review_title: Beautiful Monitor Light with Great Features
body_en: I use this monitor light all the time, whether it's daytime or late at night. I simply enjoy having it on. It helps me see my keyboard better, and it also provides a nice amount of light for the plants I keep on my desk. The light has several brightness levels and color temperatures, which makes it easy to customize depending on what I'm doing. The quality is excellent, it's very attractive, and installation was incredibly simple. The only thing I would change is the remote control. The power button on the controller stays illuminated all the time, even when the light is off. I prefer sleeping in complete darkness and don't like seeing any small lights on in the room. Even with that minor detail, I still give this product 5 out of 5 stars. It's a fantastic monitor light and I highly recommend it.

review_title: Good monitor light for a more comfortable workspace
body_en: I’ve been using this monitor light on my desk and really like how easy it is to set up and adjust. The flexible design makes it easy to position the light exactly where I need it, and the fit on my monitor is secure without being complicated. It’s also very easy to use and works well for my computer setup. The simple color and clean design blend nicely with the monitor and don’t make the desk look cluttered. Overall, it’s a practical and convenient light for anyone looking to improve their workspace.

review_title: Surprisingly Premium Monitor Light — Great for Daily Work and Low-Light Days
body_en: I’ve been using this monitor light, for several weeks, on an Acer display for daily work, and overall it’s been a really solid addition to my desk setup. Installation was straightforward — it mounted easily and felt secure once positioned. No complicated setup or tools required, which I always appreciate. The lighting itself is where this really shines (no pun intended). The adjustable color temperature range from warm to cool is useful depending on what you’re doing. It can give you more of a relaxed desk lamp vibe in warmer tones or a bright, focused work light when you need better visibility for detailed tasks. There’s also an auto-dimming feature, but I personally prefer setting a static brightness level once and leaving it there. The included remote control is a nice touch and honestly makes the product feel more premium than the price point would suggest. Build quality feels better than expected — not cheap or flimsy. I use this every day for work, and it’s especially helpful during gloomy weather or late afternoons when natural light drops off. It reduces the need for overhead lighting and keeps the workspace evenly illuminated without glare on the screen. My only real complaint is the articulation adjustment. The mounting design doesn’t provide quite enough tension, so adjusting the angle sometimes requires two hands to keep everything aligned. It’s not a dealbreaker, but it’s an area that could be improved in a future version. Overall, this has been a great upgrade for my workspace and something I didn’t realize I needed until I started using it consistently.

review_title: Excellent monitor light at a great value!
body_en: I'd been considering a monitor desk light for some time now, but I could not justify the price tag giong as high as $200 on the BenQ "original" that sorta started it off with these types of lights. This was a couple years ago now and clearly today there are many different versions of similar monitor lights on the market, the Quntis being among them, and which appears to be a fairly close copy of the BenQ light. I found this one on Amazon, priced around $40 for the non-remote (remote being rather superfluous in my opinion) version and did a little comparison research to see if this might be a good fit. There are many similar monitor lights out there, some cheaper and going as low as ~$25 and some obviously more expensive. I figured the Quntis was a good middle ground price-wise and took a shot to see if this would fit the bill. Indeed it does! Whether or not, or how close a copy to the BenQ the Quntis is I don't know for sure, as I've never seen the alternatives, but I can say this one is very well designed and well constructed, some plastic and also some metal in the construction and on close inspection the quality is definitely there. The mounting system is simple and functional and adapted perfectly to my HP Omen gaming monitor, which I would say has a somewhat non-standard profile shape and thickness, at least at the top where the light mounts. No problem, the mount is easily adjustable and rests perfectly and securely on my top monitor edge with full confidence that it's not going anywhere, or is any way unstable or wonky. The light controls on top of the light are easily accessible, operated by touch and the tactile "buttons" are shaped so they can be easily felt when operating the light. There are stepless controls for brightness and color temperature, as well as a sort of "auto" button that adjusts the brightness based on the ambient light in the room, which is nice. The lightbar throws a very nice pool of light on your keyboard and desk space in front of, and not directly ON, your monitor - right where you need it - without any glare, or being too harsh. Again, the quality, brightness and temperature of the light is easily adjustable to your liking. The monitor mounting system is sensible, simple, highly adjustable and highly functional. Lamp is powered by USB and in my case plugs right into a USB port on my monitor and totally invisible, hidden behind. Anyway, I guess I might have got a little carried away with this review, but tldr; the Quntis is an excellent monitor light and if this is something you've been looking at, I don't think you can go wrong with this one.

I’m not even being dramatic when I say this was the best upgrade for my desk EVER. It is such a reasonable price for how much of a difference it made. Installation was so easy it took maybe 30 seconds to clip it to the stand, set it on the monitor, and plug it in. The stand is flexible but strong enough to hold onto the monitor without falling. It is also super lightweight and doesn't push my monitor down. The lighting is SO good. It’s bright but not harsh, and it doesn’t reflect on the screen at all. I didn’t realize how much eye strain I was dealing with until I started using this. And I love that I can switch between warm and cool lighting depending on the time of day. The remote is also a nice touch. I like that it uses batteries so I don't have to worry about charging it. It honestly just makes my whole setup look cleaner and has made gaming and working much more enjoyable. If you spend a lot of time at your desk, this light bar is definitely worth it.

review_title: Clean look and great lighting control
body_en: This monitor light bar has been a nice addition to my setup. I haven’t really had eye strain with or without it, but I really like the clean look it adds to my desk. I mostly use it at night, but it’s also useful during the day when I’m writing on paper. The brightness works well in both situations, and I like that I can adjust the light temperature depending on what I need. It’s simple, functional, and makes the setup look better overall. A solid choice if you want better lighting without taking up desk space.

This is the best purchase for a home office. I spend 8 to 10 hours a day at my computer, many times analyzing data. Eye strain is real. I tried several desk lamps, better lighting, etc before stumbling on this. It puts the light right where you need it! So many choices for you to settle into the perfect light for you. Brightness and levels of warmth can be changed. It automatically goes off when I shut down my computer and on when I restart. It works seamless for me. I have had it for a month now and my headaches from eye strain are gone.
Good monitor lamp

This thing changed my life. I am facing a window when working on my screen, and had to blind one half of the window. review_title: Un must si trabajas en el ordenador

very happy with my purchase, works properly. you can personalize the brightness, the light temperature and there is an automatic mode, it adapts to the external brightness

I was just about to write a one star review because after only having this lamp for a month, the remote stopped working! It had worked great until I had to unplug it and then after I plugged it back in - the remote no longer worked! So, just as I was about to write a bad review, I read the back of the remote on how to pair the lamp with the remote control. I guess I hadn't thought to do that because I didn't have to do that when I first plugged it up and the remote worked fine then. Pros: Ideal for Wide Setups:Dual rotatable arms easily span multiple 32-inch monitors without causing screen glare. Solid & Secure Build: Sturdy construction with a strong, space-saving desk clamp. All-Day Eye Comfort: Adjustable light temperatures transition smoothly from focused daylight to easy-on-the-eyes evening warm light. Cons: Overhead Clearance Required:Needs sufficient vertical and lateral space around large monitor setups to maneuver the arms. Desk Clutter:The included remote adds one extra accessory to manage on your workspace. Remote is an over-kill in my opinion. Verdict: A high-performing, sturdy lighting solution built for power users with multi-monitor desks. If you spend 10+ hours a day at your workstation, its versatility, wide coverage, and effortless controls make it well worth the space.

I wanted a very bright lamp for my computer desk, one that would clamp on the back of the desk and would go up and arc over the monitor. Looking at all the offerings available, This one stood out to me. It was the right size to clear the top of my monitor, it was 24 volt vs 12 or 5 (USB) so I knew it would be bright. It holds it's shape, doesn't droop, or sag and it is very BRIGHT!. Just what I wanted. It lights up my entire desk, end to end, brighter then I had hoped it would. review_title: Excellent Adjustable Light for Nail Work

Another nice feature is the USB port on the back, which is handy for charging a device while you work. The plastic started buzzing quietly when playing strong tonic chords in that key. This was, of course, horrifying. I assume the same disturbing outcome holds true when playing in C-sharp major, since the identical notes are used, but I only had sheet music in D-flat today. More testing would be needed to determine whether the issue extends to enharmonic keys, but this didn’t seem urgent to share here, since: • I didn’t want to go into too much detail that isn’t relevant to the average consumer (because we all hate that), and • Only psychos play in C-sharp major anyway. I realize this acoustic phenomenon may not affect all potential buyers of this lamp, but it seems like this particular harmonic bug could be mentioned somewhere in the description—if not in the product title itself—just so that members of the five-flats-loving community have some warning. TLDR: Solid build, good light quality, useful brightness and color controls, and a swing arm that does most of what you want. The big catch is that it does not behave the way modern smart home users will expect, and the mounting geometry has some real-world limits the listing photos do not show. Four stars, with caveats worth knowing before you click buy. Let me lead with the good, because there is plenty of it. The light itself is genuinely nice. Plenty of brightness for working, reading, or close-up tasks, and the color temperature options give you warm yellow, neutral white, and a cooler white-blue depending on what you are doing. Eleven brightness levels is more granularity than I expected. The arm extends and folds well, and the head pivots to put light right where you want it. It runs on USB, the wall adapter is included, and the wattage is low enough that you can power it from a laptop port if that is convenient. The clamp mount is solid and holds tight once you have it in place. A note on installation. The clamp wants a specific amount of mounting surface, and my location had less than the lamp wanted in one direction. I pulled out a Dremel and shaved a small relief into the underside so the clamp could sit properly. Not a complaint, just a heads up if your desk has a thick lip, a beveled edge, or a rounded corner where you want this to live. Now, the big thing. This lamp does not default to on when power is restored. If you turn it off and walk away, fine. If your power blips, or if you have it on a smart switch that cuts power, the lamp comes back off. To turn it back on you have to walk over to the lamp and press the little button on the inline cord controller, which sits close to the base of the arm and is not always easy to reach. This matters because the listing advertises a memory function, and modern buyers, especially anyone with a smart home setup, are going to read that and assume something it does not actually mean. Here is what is happening. The memory function does work, in a narrow sense. When you press the on button, the lamp comes back at whatever brightness and color mode you used last. It does not have to be reset every time. That is real and it is useful. What the memory function does not do is preserve the on/off state across a power cut. The reason is that this is a soft-touch push button rather than a mechanical switch. The lamp's electronics have to be powered to know they are on, and when power is removed and restored the default state is off. A traditional mechanical switch physically holds the circuit closed and is why your bedroom lamp comes back on when the power flickers. This one does not, by design. If you live in a fully manual lighting world, this is a non-issue. You will press the button and life goes on. If you have your office lights on a smart switch, or you have ever said the words "Google (or Alexa), turn on the lights," this is going to be an ongoing minor annoyance. I had assumed, like most lights, that I could plug this into the same smart switch as the rest of the room and have it come on with everything else. Instead it sits there dark while everything else lights up, waiting for me to walk over and poke it. The other thing worth flagging is the arm geometry. The first segment, the one closest to the clamp, is not designed to swing forward. It folds up and back, which is fine on an open desk where you have empty wall behind you. If you are mounting this on the back edge of a desk that sits against a wall, on the lip of a hutch, on top of a shelving unit, or inside a cubicle, you are going to discover that the elbow needs room to bow outward behind the lamp. The listing photos all show the lamp on an open desk with nothing behind it, so this is not obvious until you have it in hand. Plan your mounting location with that in mind. There is also a 45 minute auto-off timer button on the controller. Apparently aimed at bedtime reading. I have not used it but it is there if you want it. Four stars. The light is good and the build is good. The memory function exists but means something different than a smart home buyer will assume, and the mounting flexibility has limits that the listing does not show. If you can live with those, this is a nice lamp at a fair price. If you were hoping to drop it into an automated lighting routine, you are going to want to know about the default-off behavior before you order.

review_title: An Excellent Lamp with a Small Caveat
body_en: This is a great lamp. It is VERY bright, and has lots of cool color and warmth settings. It's a very light sheet steel construction, and folds up neatly with a convenient hand screw for quick removal and installation. The boom, arm, and light mantle are highly flexible and have a solid range of motion, and keep their position very well. The light strip is VERY large, with LOTS of LEDs and casts a very significant amountt of light. In it's highest setting, probably several thousand lumens across each LED. It is powered by USB, and draws close to 15 watts. The manufacture rates the light at 12 watts, however, they only supply a 10 watt, 5-volt @ 2-amp USB wall adapter. The supplied wall adapter started to cut in-and-out after about 3 months of regular nightly use at 80%+ brightness plus warmth settings. If you don't run the light past roughly 75%, you won't have any problems. Otherwise, I'd recommend upgrading to a 5-volt @ 3-amp USB wall adapter to save the hassle. For that I'm deducting a star. Your mileage may vary. I paid about $36 in December of 2025. It was worth the money. I do structural engineering and CAD, and like to see my keyboard while up at night. TL;DR: Worth the money, well built, and very bright, but needs at least a 5-volt @ 3-amp USB wall adapter to work to it's full capacity, as the supplied 2-amp adapter is not substantial enough for light levels above 75% plus warmth settings.
