In the support base there is a USB port which nowadays is always convenient even just for charging your smartphone. The two arms that compose it can be adjusted to point the light in every direction. In my opinion a nice article in line with today's needs.

Exactly what I was looking for to work and be visible on video during the heatwave (shutters closed!!). Beautiful expanse of light. The different light temperatures work well, as well as the possibility of reducing the intensity.
By far the best desk lamp. Since you can adjust the color and brightness of the light, you always have the perfect illumination.

review_title: Massive desk coverage and true colors perfect for dual monitors!
body_en: I bought this 4-head lamp for my large workstation setup and it has completely transformed my workspace. If you have dual monitors or a massive 90-inch desk area, this light coverage is unmatched. The Good: Phenomenal Coverage & Flexibility: The 4-head design is a game-changer. With the combination of the 360° flexible neck, folding arms, and rotatable heads, you can eliminate every single shadow on your desk. You can fold them out wide or point them down directly for detailed work. True Eye-Care (CRI 95+): The light is genuinely soft, flicker-free, and anti-glare. Colors look vibrant and accurate under it, which is incredibly helpful for crafting, reading, or long hours staring at a computer screen without eye strain. Dual Controls: Having both the wireless remote control and the hand-wave motion sensor makes adjusting settings effortless. The stepless dimming and adjustable color temperatures (from warm yellow to crisp daylight) work flawlessly. The Not-So-Good: Clamp Clearances: The desk clamp is very sturdy, but make sure your desk has enough of a lip underneath to attach it securely (it fits up to 2 inches thick). Takes Adjustment Time: Because there are so many points of articulation, it might take a few minutes of twisting and bending to find your perfect angle without hitting the tops of your monitors. Verdict: An exceptional, space-saving architect lamp that clears up desk room by clamping to the back. It’s easily worth the price if you need powerful, customizable lighting!

review_title: Excellent Desk Lamp for Home Office Setup
body_en: Excellent Desk Lamp for Home Office Setup I’ve been very impressed with this adjustable LED desk lamp. The light is bright, even, and easy to adjust with the stepless dimming feature, which makes it great for working, reading, or late-night computer work without straining your eyes. The adjustable arms make it easy to position the light exactly where you need it, and it stays in place without sagging. It also doesn’t take up much desk space, which helps keep the workspace clean and organized. The different brightness and color temperature settings are very useful depending on the time of day and what you’re working on. Overall, this is a very well-designed desk lamp and a great upgrade for any desk or home office. Highly recommend.

I got this light to put above my double monitors at work. It provides a great way to light up my area and offers different types of light and different strengths. They are extremely adjustable so that you can make them exactly how you want them. I’ve received so many comments and compliments from my coworkers on the way they look and function. It’s so nice to have the little remote on my desk to adjust the brightness and appearance. They’re very sturdy and stable and I’ve had no problems with them after several months of use.

review_title: Excellent lamp, bright, versatile, and easy on the eyes
body_en: I’ve been using this adjustable LED desk lamp for a couple of weeks now in my home office and I’m really impressed. The four large light sources put out plenty of bright, even illumination without any harsh glare or eye strain. The stepless dimming and color temperature control via the remote make it super convenient. I can go from warm cozy light for reading to cool bright daylight for computer work with just a click. The flexible neck is sturdy and holds position perfectly, and the clamp base is strong and easy to attach to my desk without taking up much space. I love having the 5 different lighting modes too — they cover everything from focused task lighting to more relaxed ambient setups. Great build quality, lots of adjustability, and genuinely eye-caring light. Highly recommend

review_title: So nice I bought it twice!
body_en: Ok, I ordered this on a whim because my desk is where I do a lot of computer graphics as well as painting or drawing. I realized I was straining to see, and couldn’t distinguish colors properly in incandescent light alone. This allows me to see paint color in all different color temperatures and angle the light to reduce glare off paint surface or avoid casting a shadow. GAME CHANGER! I love the ability to change color temperatures and brightness with the knob (which is just fun in and of itself), AND you can turn it off and on without your hands by waving at a little sensor on the light itself. The clamp, the feel of the design, and the bendy arm all feels extremely sturdy and is easy to maneuver to the height (it goes surprisingly high). The best part is that it takes up virtually no space on my desktop which I am severely lacking. This light transformed my workspace and workflow! I even bought a second one because my husband saw it and wanted one for himself.

review_title: Fantastic desk lamp with excellent adjustability
body_en: This is a fantastic desk lamp. The four adjustable light heads make it very easy to spread the light exactly where I need it, and it provides excellent coverage across a larger desk without leaving obvious dark areas. I also really like the range of brightness and color temperature adjustments. It is easy to switch between warmer lighting and brighter, cooler light depending on whether I am working, reading, or just want softer lighting in the room. The stepless dimming is especially useful because I can get the brightness exactly where I want it instead of being limited to a few presets. The clamp design also saves a lot of desk space, and the lamp feels stable once installed. Overall, all of the features work well and the design is very practical. I have been extremely happy with it and would definitely recommend it for a home office or large desk setup.

Shipped on time, packaged well. Easy to set up and useful in my small cubicle space. I have it attached to my desk top stand up desk and it is stable. The adjustable light angles allows me to distribute the light where it is needed. The adjustable brightness is a great feature allowing for the proper necessary lighting. The remote is nice to adjusting the brightness and how "hot or cool" you need it. The motion sensor to turn it on/off is nice and it turn back on at the setting it was on when it was turned off. Overall I am happy with the light. Full disclosure I only have had it up for a couple of days, so I will add any updates good or bad if anything comes up.

review_title: THIS IS THE ARCHITECT DESK LAMP YOU ARE LOOKING FOR
body_en: THIS IS THE ARCHITECT DESK LAMP YOU ARE LOOKING FOR. I researched, read reviews, and ordered multiple other lamps I had to return. I've only had it for a few hours so I will update this review if necessary; however: - This one is made with quality parts and doesn't feel cheap or flimsy - It doesn't flicker - The adjustable joints where the lamps attached are exactly what I wanted (they don't just bend, they swivel) - The little desk remote looks great and is made to sit, rather than another 'click' type remote i'd certainly misplace - The neck extends. The other lamps I tried only had 1 height, so I was limited to how high I could raise my monitor. Not anymore. - Very bright and very flexible I feel like I got my moneys worth this time. I was totally frustrated with my lamp search until now and thought I was going to be stuck with something cheap.
Verry happy with this light !

review_title: Bought for tattoo lighting and it is absolutely perfect!
body_en: Absolutely impressed with the brightness and eaay controls, different colors from soft to really bright, no assembly, just unfold and ready to go. I got this this for tattoo work, some places I would go to just just didn't have the lighting for that kind of work, but this lamp folds up and fits in my tattoo equipment bag to take with me on the go. Definitely more than worth the price.

review_title: Adjustable lighting-dimmable WARM light. Folds and looks nice!
body_en: I have taken this into the office and used it as a task lamp. What a lifesaver. The brightness is adjustable and there are various color options to select. I use it on "warm" so that I can actually read things under it without triggering migraines, etc. It's great if you have fluorescent lights and want a warm task light! It's also very sturdy and stable, yet folds easy for transport or to tuck away, if needed. It has a nice, modern look that doesn't distract.
Perfect! Works great price will buy again.

keeping in mind this is like a $10 light... It's a good light. It takes large rechargeable 1865 batteries and they need to be separately ordered. They look more like shotgun shells than batteries. The charging block it shipped with didn't work. Otherwise the quality of the material is good. There are three light settings that it rotates through via the power button. Adding the batteries does make it a portable battery operated light that's stable enough it will stand in place and be useful. It's not a top of the line light. The materials and build is very much entry level. It works. I think it works pretty well given that it was $10.
Lovee its sturdy perfect size and is really reliable it moves in all different ways,
As described. Perfect for student.

review_title: Amazing Deal - Super Bright - Dimmable - Two Color Temperatures
body_en: This is an amazing light for the money. I would have been happy to spend two or three times as much for this light. It is super bright for a desktop lamp, which was my first need. My mate likes much dimmer lighting, and as it turns out, this light is infinitely dimmable - so it works for both of us. It has two color tones, one is daylight, the other is warm, what you might find from an old incandescent. Both have their uses. I use the daylight when drawing or reading, and the warm when I am on the PC. But I do have two issues. One is the unit is so light, it is easy to knock over. I used some of that thick, transparent, two sided tape to hold it down, and it seems to be doing a great job. The other issue is that the USB on the light side is non standard, it is Mini USB, which is smaller than USB C and not that popular any more. I have not had a mini USB for years. Plus the plug was slightly out of alignment and it was a task to get it plugged in. However for less than $7 this light is a bargain - ordered another for the headboard bookcase.

review_title: Batteries not included, poor service, so far
body_en: No instructions included. One sheet of "instructions" that only has a diagram of the light. It also does not come with any batteries (rechargeable required). The light itself is fine and does the job. No way to tell how to use it. No mention of on/off switch, can't turn it on without the power cord. There is a switch on the back that doesn't appear to do anything, the batteries that are required to turn on the light without the power cord do not charge. I emailed the seller and still waiting on a response. They say they are there 24 hours a day and to write with any questions.
Love this lamp, very bright.
Love it doing puzzle and diamond dots

I take back my other review. I couldn't get it to go on and off with ease, but it turns out I was just being a little too heavy-handed with it. It needs a gentle tap and turns it on and off/dims Pretty good paying for your buck. Perfect for my daughter's room.
Its a good light and for the price u can go wrong.
Great little lamp. Use for sewing.

review_title: I had it on for 1 minute and three co-workers requested the link!
body_en: A Game-Changer for My Workspace! I cannot recommend this over-monitor desk lamp enough—it has completely transformed my desk setup! For the longest time, I struggled with poor lighting, awkward shadows, and eye strain. This lamp solved problems I didn’t even realize I had. The various levels of light and brightness are phenomenal, allowing me to customize the lighting to suit my needs throughout the day. Whether I’m working late at night or need a softer glow during the day, this lamp has me covered. What really blew me away was the free motion and adjustable angles. It’s so versatile and easy to adjust that I can direct the light exactly where I need it. I didn’t think this feature would matter much, but now I can’t live without it—it’s that good! If you’re looking to upgrade your desk lighting, this is an absolute must-have. Stylish, functional, and incredibly useful, it has taken my workspace to the next level. Worth every penny!

This is the most useful computer accessory I've purchased in years. Minimum set up. A variety of light colors and brightness levels coupled with a automatic light sensor. Eliminates shadows between and around the monitor and keyboard. The ability to turn off the central light and/or the wings has been far more useful than I ever thought. Instant on and off, no heat, etc. Worth the money.

WOW! What a great light! I've tried a number of different desk lights to work by and this lamp is the very best. The brightness exceeded all my expectations. It's different illumination settings combined with the physical configurations possible make this a most versatile light indeed. My search for the best desk light is over and I think yours will be too. Great value in every way that matters.

This is a pretty nice light for a workbench (if you need something that gives over head light without getting in the way). The base is decently heavy but could be a bit heavier (it does feel like it could tip forward in some positions). Aside from that it is excellent. The different light temperatures and brightness settings are really good and the light spreads over a pretty good area.
This is a well-made desk light addition, with great lumen output... so far, so good, with an easy out-of-the-box setup... now let's see how long it will last... to be continued.

review_title: Capable desk lamp that creates a lot of light for little space.
body_en: I ordered this for better lighting for miniature painting as well as lighting up my desk area. It is a light lamp and has a heavy base, I incorrectly ordered this instead of the mounting one to gain desk space, which is a small foot print so not terrible. The simple minimalist look is sleek and contemporary meeting almost any desk or setup universally. The lamp feels sturdy and solid but you can tell the material is not all metal but some pressed plastic or much cheaper thin alloy material which is non-magnetic, maybe thin aluminum. The buttons are touch sensors not actual clicky buttons so that could put some folks off but non-issue for me. The lighting has color adjustments so you can light to you preference whether warm, cool, or cold and even has an automatic brightness and stepping feature built in. Honestly I though the brightness feature was a gimmick however using it as a back light in my office has improved my eye comfort from long periods at the computer for work. While the lamp is very easy to adjust and stays in place when moved the information presented makes it seem like the lamp head would rotate 180º which it does just not in the direction expected, meaning the lamp must always be parallel to the surface it is placed on no exceptions. I dinged it a star because of this as the image shown seems to be a bit misleading whether intentional or not. It uses a power adapter with barrel socket to the lamp so is not portable and does not charge, has no remote though there are auto stepping and brightness features you must manually activate the lamp.
This is the second one of these lamps I have purchased. The first one I have had for over a year with no problems. Excellent lamp. Clears the monitors on my desktop, easily.

This replaced a normal living room lamp used for many tasks, from reading to cleaning to eating while watching television. The reason I like this lamp so much is its flexibility. 1) the light is adjustable for warmth, 2) the lamp leds are in 3 sections controlled by a touch, so the larger middle section of leds can be turned on or off just by reaching up and touching an area near them, 3) the main body post and arms have joints so you can move parts of the body around to shine each of the 3 led grouping wherever you want in different directions = ceiling mood light: check, bright work lights: check, mixture: check. The lamp is also sturdilly made and has a heavy base so it doesn't tip over as you move the arms and body post. This is marketed as an architects light, but I think it is the best household lamp I've ever had.

I have had two desk lamps prior to this that were a lot cheaper , but neither of them came near the quality of this one. I mainly use the two side lamps when drawing and the lumination on my workbench is first class with no hand shadow. It even creates a great lighting set up for photographing my finished artwork

review_title: Loving it so far. Used daily with no problems.
body_en: Great light. Seems sturdy, has great brightness and white color options, and has enough angle adjustments for all of my needs. If a multi color version of this light becomes available, I will be sure to get that one as well.
Superb

review_title: Perfect Fit for My Ultra-Wide Monitor Setup
body_en: The lamp arrived today, securely packaged and in perfect condition. Assembly was quick and straightforward, and the build quality feels solid. It works exceptionally well with my setup: a 40-inch ultra-wide monitor with a camera mounted on top. Since a top-mounted light wasn’t an option, this desk stand lamp was ideal—it sits nicely beside the monitor’s large base. One tip: turning off the center light panel improves camera performance during video calls. Overall, I’m very satisfied with this lamp—it’s functional, well-designed, and solves a tricky lighting challenge.

review_title: Fantastic lamp - but No U.K plug included!
body_en: An absolutely brilliant lamp. Easily adjustable and only minimal assembly required. Only needed to attach the main lamp assembly to the lamp stand. A screwdriver & screws are included. Well packaged and the adjustments are brilliant. Not a massive lamp - a decent size and the brightness is adjustable for comfort. Easy to use and if you can get it at a reduced price, or on a “Black Friday” deal - so much the better. My only criticism is that the included plug is an American type A - 2 flat pins so you’ll need to buy an adapter to use it in the U.K. for not being able to use it until I could get a U.K. adapter it loses 1 star.

review_title: Very adjustable, quite bright, lots of options
body_en: Impressive light. It was super easy to mount. Light is quite bright and the dimming option is very useful. Nice that it has 5 (?) different color light selections. Remembers the color and brightness when turned on/off. Remote works well, even from quite a distance. I love the adjustability and various positioning options. The light diffusers work well to prevent hot spots. Looks good too. But will it last for years? Time well tell... About the only thing I don't like is that when the light color is changed, it immediately goes to 100% brightness.

review_title: Amazing Double Head LED Desk Lamp
body_en: The MACASA Double Head LED Desk Lamp has been an amazing addition to my desk, completely transforming my work setup. Its 24W brightness and anti-glare cover provide excellent lighting, making it perfect for work, drafting, and reading. The remote control is a convenient feature, allowing me to adjust the light settings without getting up. What I love most about this lamp is how much it has helped during the winter afternoons when it gets dark outside so early. The bright and even illumination keeps my workspace well-lit and comfortable, boosting my productivity and mood. The dual head design ensures that light is evenly distributed across my desk, eliminating shadows and making it easier to focus on tasks. The lamp's build quality is impressive, and it has a sleek, modern design that complements my home office. It's also tall enough to provide ample light coverage, yet compact enough to fit comfortably on my desk. The versatility of this lamp makes it a great choice for any workbench or study area. Overall, I am extremely satisfied with the MACASA Double Head LED Desk Lamp. Its quality, functionality, and thoughtful features make it a valuable investment for anyone in need of a reliable and efficient lighting solution. Highly recommended!

review_title: Perfect Lamp for Your Home Setup
body_en: This is an awesome, versatile, sleek/modern lamp for your desk. It was very easy to install, it’s sturdy, all you could ask for at its price point. Has an array of temperature and brightness modes to choose from (which I’ve attempted to show in my pictures). All of the cycles haven’t showcase any flickering. The long rubber tube you attach it to allows you to adjust the light at an angle you prefer. You can choose to cycle through on the differ modes on the lamp itself or use the remote it came with. I recommend this to all my fellow people who wfh or has their own setup for home use!

review_title: after nearly a year i still really like it!
body_en: bright enough, adjustable fine for my situation which isn't all that ordinary. i have this fit between the top 2 and bottom 2 of a 4 monitor mount and it sneaks in there fine and looks great. i hope it holds up at least a few more years, but so far so good!

I like the Desk Lamp as it's flexible in height and you can even position it in the depth. I like the multiple color temp options as I change between reading and working on the monitor. The remote control is a gimmick I don't use.

I love this lamp. It is lightweight and slim, not taking up any space. It was a little bit of a puzzle putting it together, but once it was assembled, it was easy to clamp onto the desk. The lights are adjustable any way you want. I love the different modes letting me choose what looks best. The remote control is perfect. It lets you choose the mode, adjust the brightness, set a timer to turn them off, and has an on/off button. They are a perfect size to light up my whole desk. It has a quality feel and I am glad I found it.
Great lamp. Light covers a good radius. Solid product so far. If your desk is not stable, it will wobble a little with it. Overall sturdy and great product!

I bought this light for my computer desk in June of 2024. It still works like the first day of purchase!! I got on my Amazon app to search for a light for my sewing table not only for a brighter view of my work space but also for video recording. I was getting so frustrated with the reviews on the lights that I thought would be perfect for my space. I didn't want a light that would be in my way of recording or working. I also need one that wouldn't be too bright and definitely not a glare. After searching the site for several hours and reading tons of reviews I finally decided to search my order history to see exactly what lights I had already ordered for video recording. This light came up and "ding", a light came on in my head. "Why not get the desk light for the sewing table???" I did place an order for another desk light since I am so pleased with my first one. Not only is the quality of the light amazing, so is the longevity. It's been almost 2 years and I have not had one issue with my desk lamp. I'm sure I will be pleased with the new one. Not to mention that the seller is still on Amazon!! Don't over think it, just get one. You won't be disappointed!

review_title: Great Double Head LED Desk Lamp
body_en: This is a great 24W for my office desk where I spend too much time at LOL. Having good bright and adjustable light and different temperature's is also great when your eyes get tired. When the LED dual head lights are extended, it measures 80cm/ 31.5 inches which covers most of mt (2) 27" HP monitors. Having the dual LED head able to adjust is great for when I occasional light up the desk for when I take pictures. The top of the light has a sensitive touch buttons, it can easy to control color temperature and brightness individually. It has 5 dimming levels and adjustable 5 color temperatures modes (3,200 K-6,500 K). The LED light also has a memory function that remembers your last Settings when turned on and off. The whole light is supported by a heavy screw clamp that should accommodate most solid surface or desk. The shaft or arm of the light comes in 2 pieces, one solid aluminum and the other is a heavy flexible goose neck that can bend at different areas of the shaft to accommodate heights as much as 33"/83.8cm. The dual headed LED light also comes with a remote control that's nice but I personal don't use because if I'm at the desk working, it's easier to just turn the light off and on or do adjustments right in front of me. Once you clamp the light to the desk or table and assembled it, you need to remember to use the screws provided to tighten the arm to the clamp base and the two arms together or it will shake and wobble. I love this dual adjustable headed LED light and when you try to find and compare this light to the big box stores, this is a great value.

review_title: Lovely desk lamp for my mini office.
body_en: I ordered this desk lamp off of Vine for my office because I needed one and was remodeling. I was using just a regular light that is on my ceiling and it was creating a glare on my Monitor that was hard on my eyes. This one is much better. It is adjustable. Bendable, Dimmable and has eye saving features with different colors of light. A White neon type. A medium light and a Warm light that is very easy on the eyes. Setting it up was pretty easy. Clip it all together. put in a few screws. It even came with a mini screw driver. The light has a spot to hide the cord.. Along its side. It clips right in and hides . I thought this was a very nice feature. More should have it. You cannot even see the cord at all. The lamp comes with a remote for hands free operation. It also has 4 buttons on the top to control the brightness. Mode and a timer function. You can turn it off and on to from there. The neck is flexible and bendable so you can set this up in many different ways. The arms of the lamp both pivot 180 degrees. So you can keep it horizontal looking or pivot them to the front for when working on things. reading documents or need to see fine details. The clip was nice and sturdy on my desk. No bends or breaks. I hooked it on pretty tight to. Solid build quality all the way through. All in all I really like it. I think this lamp makes a great office light and can also be a very good workshop light. Or lab light. Or even just a reading lamp for your room. The retail price was more then fair and it just works. No complaints. I love it and can recommend it. Thanks a ton.

I got this for my work as well as my son who gets his homework/ drawings done as assigned in the Google Classroom. When I am not working, I tend to fix clothes - put on new buttons or iron as need be. Other table lamps or celling light fixtures even though bright still pale since they tend to light up the whole area/room , thus the brightness gets lost. Dim lighting can affect your eyes. But with this goose neck lamp which can be adjusted to bring over the monitor adequate lighting is never an issue. The lamp beautifully lights up the area it is in. I have a UV Nail Lamp for curing gel polish which comes with a goose neck and I have been love ever since with this feature as it make the lamps quite flexible and adjustable, you can adjust the LED heads to suite to your preference. Via the button on the remote or the feature on the lamp you can adjust the brightness (+/-), colour and ON/ OFF mode. My son keeps on playing with the brightness too. Overall, I am quite impressed.

review_title: Super lame mais doit absolument être vissée au rebord d'un bureau
body_en: This double-headed LED desk lamp with remote control is an ultra-bright 24 W lamp, ideal for the desk, workbench, drawing table or workshop. Its light is adjustable in intensity and temperature. The two sides of the lamp move and thus offer great versatility. The remote control is also a plus. I love the effect. It's super relaxing and practical for detailed work that requires lighting. Great addition to the office. On the other hand, we would have liked to have the choice of foot to install it: it must be screwed to the edge of the desk, which may not always be practical or ideal.

review_title: Long LED heads, super bright, high and flexible stand
body_en: This is a double-head LED lamp that is very bright and raised high on desk edge. The head lights are two LED panels that can rotate 90 degrees horizontal between front and side. It doesn’t have a lamp stand on desk. It has a desk edge mounting bracket that can be mount to a variety of thickness of desk. A fixed metal pole attached to the mounting bracket. Then a flexible goose neck attached to the metal pole which then hold the LED heads. The goose neck can be adjusted to any angle of your choice. Both the metal pole and the flexible goose neck bring the LED heads very high over desk that you can place monitors underneath the LED heads. Both LED panels can independently rotate at axis of the center of the LED heads. On top of the center of LED heads there are 4 touch buttons: power on/off, light color temperature, dim and brightness. These buttons are very sensitive and responsive. In addition to the control buttons on the LED heads, the desk lamp comes with tiny remote control for convenience. It has exactly the same 4 buttons as those on the LED heads. The desk lamp comes with a special power adapter which provides 24V/1A power for the lamp. The wire attached to the LED heads can be inserted into the slots of the goose neck and metal pole, so that it is not visible. A very detailed design. Excellent. The bottom screw plate of the mounting bracket is kind of small compare to the weight of the lamp that it needs to hold. Not sure if it will be strong enough and durable. So far so good. Very good desk lamp. Highly recommend.

I absolutely love this desk lamp! It has a sleek, modern design and offers great features. The light is bright with multiple brightness levels and color modes, making it perfect for reading, studying, or working without straining your eyes. The built-in wireless charger is a fantastic bonus. I can charge my phone while keeping my workspace neat and organized. The flexible arm also makes it easy to adjust the light exactly where I need it.

review_title: Beautiful color and practical for use on the desk.
body_en: I am very satisfied with this desk lamp. The light is bright and adjustable to my needs, making it very comfortable for working, studying, or reading. I also really like that it has a port for charging my phone, as it helps keep the desk tidier and eliminates the need for an extra charger. It feels stable, takes up little space, and has worked perfectly so far.
Great desk lamp! The light is bright, adjustable, and easy on the eyes. The wireless charger is a nice bonus, and the design looks great on my desk.
Only had it one day but very pleased with. Right size. Looks great. Brightness choices great Love touch control Very happy with it.
For an inexpensive night lamp with some options, even the wife asked me to get a 2nd one for her. Not lots of thrills but does what I need it to do and so far both of us very happy with the product.

Great desk lamp! It provides bright, comfortable lighting, and the three color modes are very useful for different tasks. The flexible arm makes it easy to adjust, and the wireless charger is a convenient bonus. Good quality and easy to use.

I bought this lamp for my mother’s bedroom, and she loves it. The light is bright but gentle on her eyes, and she can easily switch between the different light settings. The adjustable arm is convenient for reading in bed, and the wireless charger is a nice extra feature. Great quality, easy to use, and perfect for seniors.

review_title: Desk Lamp with Wireless Phone Charger
body_en: I love this desk lamp! The flexible gooseneck is one of my favorite features because I can bend and adjust it in any direction to get the perfect lighting. The different light modes and brightness levels are great for working or reading, and the wireless charger is a huge plus for keeping my phone charged without extra cables.

I wanted something sleek, with a few options for different light tones. Something simple that didn’t cost a ton and this fit the bill. I use it every day, it’s very easy to attach to my standing desk and maneuver for different purposes.

Got this to replace a big old lamp in the corner - taking up space. This baby clamped right onto my desk and effortlessly lights up my work space. Plus the different [3] levels of light - especially the reading level are so easy on the eyes when I am working for too long! Easy to position and change the light level as my work needs shift. Going to order one or two more for my art studio!
Nice lamp. Works well. 3 shades of light. Easy to install or move to another table.

First of all I didn’t know how massive this thing is, I ordered 2 so I can have one on each side of the desk but one def does the job 😂 it reaches to midway point and you can see size comparison to Mac in the photo. Love the adjustable arm and clamp makes it so that I can put in anywhere on the desk. Adjustable lighting and dimmer is such a plus!! Great buy for the price

So good that I bought a second one! Works well, nice and bright. Easy setup. Only complaint is that I wish the on off button had a little bump on it. Kinda hard to tell which button you're pushing when it's above your head.

review_title: Awesome light at a great price.
body_en: Easy to set up. Nice and bright. Wish the buttons have a dot or something to make them easier to feel to turn on/off and adjusting the color. This would be perfect if there are brightness settings rather than just only one brightness level. Overall great value for the money.

It takes up very little space on the edge of my desk and I love that I can angle it however I need to. The settings are great with the 3 different choices and the ability to customize them even more by dimming. The price was the real winner!

Provides great light without being too much on the eyes. I prefer to work with the overhead lights off so this provides concentrated light exactly where I need it! It's also easy to set up and position where you need the light to go.
Great for the money
Nice idea and adjustable but once you have adjusted it will stay correct for awhile then starts randomly changing

review_title: Great piano lamp with flexible arm and bright light
body_en: I bought this as a piano lamp, and it works really well. The arm is long and flexible enough to position the light exactly where I need it over the keyboard. The brightness is more than sufficient, even for evening practice, and I really like that the color temperature is adjustable depending on the mood or time of day. The remote control is also very convenient. Overall, very satisfied with this purchase.

review_title: This lamp is excellent and stylish.
body_en: This lamp is excellent—bright, adjustable, and my daughter absolutely loves it.

I'm thrilled with this modern LED desk lamp. The sleek, black design looks fantastic. The multiple adjustable joints provide incredible flexibility, letting me direct the bright, even, glare-free light exactly where I need it. It’s perfect for working at my laptop and studying. Highly recommended for a functional, stylish desk setup!
Very cool. It has a remote controller and the light is good for reading. Perfect for work station desk

review_title: A desk lamp with unbeatable build quality.
body_en: This desk lamp's memory function is incredibly convenient; every time you turn it on, it automatically reverts to your last-adjusted lighting settings. With a wide color temperature range spanning from 3000K - 6000K, you can easily find the perfect, most comfortable lighting whether you're on a video call or reading. The remote control is highly responsive, and the dual-purpose clamp base design saves a significant amount of desktop space.

review_title: Finally, I can work at night without lighting up the whole room.
body_en: I’d been looking for a lamp that would light only my workspace instead of the entire room. I often work or write at night, and I didn’t want to turn on my bedside lamp because it would light up the whole room. This lamp was exactly what I was looking for. The light stays focused where I need it, whether I’m working at my desk or using a small table next to my bed. The flexible arm makes it easy to direct the light without having to move the entire lamp. I also like the touch control because it’s responsive and makes it easy to switch between the three brightness levels. feature I really appreciate is that it’s rechargeable, so I don’t have to keep it plugged in while I’m using it. Since it’s lightweight and foldable, I can easily move it from my desk to my bedside table or fold it away when I’m done. If you need a lamp that lights your workspace without brightening the whole room, I think this is a great option. It has worked very well for my needs.

Great little lamp gets charged quickly and it’s pretty bright for such a small little lamp. I love how small it is because I can take it anywhere. The color of the light is LED white and there are three setting for how dim you want it. It’s really adjustable and it stays in that position.

review_title: Bright, flexible, easily stored, rechargeable, & reasonably priced; recommended so far.
body_en: Review of LED Desk Lamp for Office Home & Battery Operated Lamp Rechargeable Lamp Foldable & Portable Light, LED Desk Light Strip, 3 Brightness Dimmable Small Desk Lamp Wireless Reading Lamp (White) I needed a smaller, lightweight, bright and flexible LED desk light to use for reading and when taking some closer pictures with my phone. With my existing lighting, I had difficulties in getting the lighting correct and without shadows. After looking at several items on Amazon, I opted for this one. The price was better for me too. I ordered the white one but thought that I had received a pink one upon receipt since the one pictured on the box was pink. Apparently, the boxes all show pink ones, I suppose. This is made in China (pictured). Likes: This light is quite flexible and allows different angles. Obviously, if you extend the arm with the light out too far, this will fall forward since it disrupts the center of gravity too much. If I needed it to extend farther, it would not take something of much weight to be placed on the base to keep it from tipping over. The light is quite bright. It has 3 settings of brightness. The easy-to-work single button facilitates on level 1, then level 2, then level 3, and then back off (I tried to show the different levels of lighting in my pics). The button is very easy to operate. The light came charged enough to try. The instructions suggest going ahead and charging it, which I did. A small light near the charging port illuminates red to show it is charging and turns green when completed. The charging cable is a standard USB A to USB C. I like the fact that it is rechargeable. I found this to be a reasonable price. It has a small footprint and easily folds away for storage. It's aesthetically pleasing. There are small pads on the bottom of the base to keep it from sliding around. These would make nice and inexpensive gifts. Dislikes: I really don’t have any dislikes at this time. Neutrals: Some reviewers reported the light not lasting very long, both battery life and functionality. Time and usage will be the judge. I will try to update this review accordingly if necessary. Title:

This item is good overall. Lightweight, compact, and very bright. However, it dies extremely quickly. I think I have spent more time charging it than using it. But I can't complain too badly for the price.

Best lamp ever!! Bright, compact, easy to position. Its rechargeable with a long charge life so no batteries needed and no cords to bother with. With 3 brightness settings it's great for close work like diamond art or sewing handwork. Great purchase!

review_title: Cute, Compact, and will be perfect for Painting rocks
body_en: A lot smaller than I expected BUT, the dimensions are posted so no ones fault but mine! LOL! Really haven't used it yet so I cannot comment on some of the issues in the reviews. I like it and it will work perfectly for what I need it for. Thank You!

review_title: This thing could me much better.
body_en: In spite of only giving this 3 stars, I really love this device. I really wish they would make one that is more heavy-duty with a much better battery. This thing is cheaply made.
I haven't had it for a long time, but so far, it is amazing. Love the design, the practicality of it, the ability to regulate its intensity. Let's see how long it lasts.
Good battery life, it does what it is and is very practical.
Nice bright light for home crafting projects that require lots of light. I use mine when beading and it works well. Love that it’s rechargeable too!

This light is just as described. Compact, dimmable, adjustable angle, lightweight for portability to events such as pub trivia nights, good reading/task light, sturdy, easily recharged. Would definitely buy again.

body_en: The charger port is very weak and does not hold a charge more than five times. This does not prevent the lighting from being okay, but it is unexpected. Likewise, the image in the advertisement is deceptive as it suggests that the product is approximately twice larger than normal, so the advertisement should convey a clear, real image and not deceive.

review_title: Very Nice LED Desk Light with plenty of plug in options
body_en: This is a quicker than normal review for me. I love that this light has several settings for temperature & brightness. It also has 3 AC power plug ins. For me it is almost perfect. Quality seems pretty decent. Time will tell, but it seems like a pretty good, very useful, light for a computer desk.

I've been really happy with this desk lamp. It provides plenty of light, and I like being able to adjust the brightness and color depending on what I'm doing. The built-in charging and power features are very convenient and help keep my workspace organized while saving space on my desk. The lamp has a sleek, modern look and feels well made. Overall, it's a practical and attractive addition to my workspace, and I would definitely recommend it.

review_title: Perfect desk lamp with plenty of outlets for a dorm live.
body_en: I purchased this desk lamp for my son for college. It's perfect because in addition to the basic LED lamp, it's got plenty of outlets and USB outlets. He's going to use all of those. This way, he doesn't need to run another extension cord or USB plug for his phone, airpods, and watch. He's using it next to his computer for now and it provides adequate lighting for him to use his computer. As for the lamp, it fits his needs. Got plenty of adjustable brightness and can change colors to meet his needs. For the price, I don't think you can beat this. He likes it mainly for the amount of outlets this has.

Very nice with lots of features. I like that you can plug 3 things in and has 4 USB ports. The light is bright but you an adjust to your liking. Very nice and very sleek. Looks good on my dest near the computer. Easy touch feature to operate. I highly recommend.
Great bed table lamp. Adjustable lighting.

I purchased this for my daughter who will be heading to college soon. She is using it at home for now. She loves how there are outlets plugs, USB, and USB-C. Her space will be small so having all these outlets is perfect for her to charge her stuff. The lamp is small and compact too. The light is bright. Perfect light for the dorms!
Nice size, adjustable color and intensity.
Perfect for the desk in my son's college dorm.

Excellent, even brightness from this lamp. Lots of lumens and adjustable intensity make it very usable for still photos like Lego sets/MOCs. The neck is quite long, very flexible, and the clip is sturdy. It has a USB connector along with an AC adapter so it can be used with a laptop if AC power is not available. Easy to use once you figure out the different buttons on the control knob. The lamp has a substantial feel to it but is not so heavy that it is overbalanced when adjusting the flexible arm. Very pleased with this purchase. (Photo shows the area light from just this lamp on part of a Lego scene). Also works great for podcasting (obviously).

Love this light! The color and brightness adjustment is fantastic. It’s super bright and works for doing art in darker environments. It also functions as a great ring light for photos or makeup. I wanted something that wasn’t battery powered because we all know that the battery never lasts; so I love that this is USB. The clamp is super useful and sturdy. And the biggest issue that set this light apart from the rest… THE HEAT. This light can stay on for extended periods of time without turning into a branding iron. 10/10 in my book! The only thing I will note in case you are looking at this for a makeup light: it’s a smaller ring which means it is more concentrated towards a center point. This will create more shadows than if you were to use a larger ring. I still have used it for makeup and enjoyed it so to each their own!

review_title: Lights up my desk space really well.
body_en: When I got this, it did not look big enough to produce a lot of light. I was wrong, it's a tiny lamp with plenty of light to do my detailed dot paintings. It clips onto the desk, which my old lamp did not, and so I have more desk space for all of my paint stuff. It's built solid, and looks good. I really appreciate having a flexible lamp that holds the light right where I need it.

I replaced a relatively weak and stiff music stand light with this product. It's a huge improvement. The flexible silicone neck lets me put light just where I want it, and all kinds of light (three temperatures, 10 brightness levels). I haven't begun to explore all the options but I'm happy to have them. One design quibble: the controller for power and lighting modes is small and not as easy to handle as I wish. A larger controller with larger buttons would make this light perfect for me.

Perfect lamp, it's portable, easily clamps with a very firm grip, and my favorite part is the three shades of dimmable light. This is perfect for crafting and doing detailed work. I'm really happy with this purchase.

My wife loves this little light. She uses it as a reading light in bed and it is clamped on the headboard. It adjusts to any angle and position to shine exactly where she wants it without lighting up the entire room and disturbing my sleep. The light has several settings from cool white to warm white. The clamp seems sturdy and stays clamped well to the headboard.
This little light is so bright and amazing and dims great functionality great versatility I've clipped it in so many different places different rooms I absolutely love it.

review_title: Power selector cracks in a few weeks.
body_en: Good light except for the power switch. After a few weeks the on and off touch switch just cracks. I had it replaced but same thing happened.

I loved it. I do Diamond painting and I needed extra light to be able to see the letters, numbers or symbols on the canvases. I first used a table lamp and the light was too bright; When I finished using it, my vision visualized my dark surroundings. Using this lamp, I was able to experiment with the three colors (used the warm one) and brightness levels. I loved it because as you can see in the photos, the canvas doesn't shine as much and the symbols are perfectly visible. In addition, the gooseneck (I selected 70 cm) is very flexible and I adjusted it to my needs. The clamp opened 4.5 cm to adjust it to my table. I am truly happy with my purchase. Aaaah, I forgot, I bought the white one and it's beautiful!!!!!
Bright, flexible and the clip is quality. Worked for me while on a ship so it’s constantly vibrating and being rocked back and forth.

review_title: just ok …It should be brighter to be able to be of good use.
body_en: The illumination is below par. Light Very feeble even when it’s put to the last level. Rest looks ok.

The lamp is ideal for mobile work. I am a mobile chiropodist and very happy with the lamp for my mobile work. In the pictures I have attached it to my nail table. At the beginning it may be enough for doing nails, but for my needs it is not enough for stationary work because it is too small for me personally and unfortunately the area is not illuminated sufficiently. But this has nothing to do with the product or the functionality itself. I think this lamp could also be profitable for influencers or people who create content with their faces. You can adjust the brightness and it is flexible but still extremely stable, which is really great. The clip is perfect for quickly attaching to a table or suitcase. It also has an adapter for the USB connection, great that they thought of that!
Goed

I purchased this flexible led light because my old magnifying lamp finally failed on me. My old magnifying lamp lasted a good twenty years. This new led light is very bright, has multiple lights on it. It’s flexible for what I need. It’s mainly use for my repairs I do. The price was only $32! Really affordable! I have no complaints about it. I’ll definitely buy another one just to have a spare one.

review_title: good work light for desk workbench.
body_en: Nice light with four levels of brightness and four different degrees of color warmth. Daylight to warm yellow. I use at my desk for model building and like the fact that it reaches over and across my workspace which helps reduce shadows.

I was delighted to find and order the AILBTON Bright LED Desk Lamp. It arrived very well packaged and appeared to have been very well designed and constructed. Having installed it about 10 days ago, and using it every day, it is perfect for my situation. I have it installed on the far left side of my desk, and have it extended fully so it lights my keyboard and monitor. Wonderful. It is free of flicker, and the black color fits to office very well. No assembly required. My one suggestion for the manufacturer is that the on button is difficult to find in a darkened office. I have placed a small sticker on the side to find the button easily now. Problem solved. See photo.

review_title: Functional and Adjustable, But Not Extremely Bright
body_en: I purchased this LED desk lamp for my husband, and he really likes the adjustable swing arm design. The clamp holds securely to the desk, and the flexibility makes it easy to position the light exactly where it’s needed. The dimmable feature works as expected, and it provides decent lighting for everyday tasks. It’s not extremely bright, but it does the job for regular desk use. If you’re looking for a sleek, adjustable lamp with multiple brightness settings, this is a solid option. Just keep in mind it may not be as powerful as some larger task lights. Recommendation: Yes — good for general desk use, but not for those needing very intense lighting.
I like the position, brightness, tone adjustments. I like that I can easily fold it away when it’s not in use.

review_title: May work for you, but not as robust as pictured/described.
body_en: Not as expected. While these work - they droop a lot. Causing the first section (with the switches) to have to be nearly vertical to support the arms. If you have at any type of angle beyond 30 degrees from vertical - the lamp parts start to slowly descend. I may or may not return these - If I can get someone to respond I may try to tighten them - since if they worked they would be ok, but my initial reaction is poor.

review_title: Function Over Fashion, and I'm Fine With That
body_en: When this lamp arrived, my first thought was that it looked like something borrowed from a dentist's office, an architect's desk, or possibly a low-budget science fiction movie. My wife immediately clamped it onto her pottery worktable and declared it perfect. As it turns out, she was right. The adjustable arms make it easy to position the light exactly where it's needed, and it does an excellent job of filling in the shadows on cloudy days or late afternoons when natural light isn't cooperating. The light is bright, even, and makes it easier to see texture, details, and surface work without constantly repositioning pieces. It's not the most conventional-looking lamp I've ever seen, but after watching it in use for a while, I stopped noticing how it looked and started appreciating how well it worked. In the pottery studio, that's about as high a compliment as a tool can get.

I have searched for and bought so many different kinds of lights for my sewing machine station. None of them have been satisfactory until this light. There are two important properties I need. Brightness and flexibility. First Brightness: I am 80 and need a lot of light where the needle is stitching. Yes there is a sewing machine light that turns on when the machine is running but even though it gets hot enough to burn skin, it is frustratingly dim. This desk light has 4 color temperature settings from warm to cold controlled by one button and 4 brightness levels controlled by another button so 16 different choices in all. These are regulated by lightly touched buttons on the lowest arm and the highest brightness out shines any other light I have tried. AND there is no flicker like many LEDs. So many lights have claimed amazing brightness only to be completely useless. Flexibility: A sewing machine is a very challenging lighting problem since the needle (where the work is happening) is hidden under the mass of the machine. The light has to be mounted on the right side of the machine so it doesn't block the movement of fabric. The right side of the machine is also solid and won't let any light pass through! Ideally it has to be located between the sewer and the machine so the sewer does not throw a shadow. This desk light offers EXTREME flexibility with 4 joints which all articulate in multiple ways but once the arms are set where I want the angles do not slip. The light might look very awkward in its placement on my table (and please excuse the mess!) but the outermost arm is throwing light exactly where I need it. The fabric can easily move underneath it. The other two arms are lighting up the overall table nicely. It is very well made and the clamp keeps the light steady even with such a long reach. I love this light.
Really good for Miniature painting, this Light Bends and Folds in every position you need it, really bright, easy to use, great great quality. Highly recommend to any miniature enthusiast

This lamp was exactly what I was looking for in a gift for my husband. It not only looks good, it was simple to set up, easy to use / adjust and the variety of colourways lend themselves to many uses. As well as for general office work, the lamp can be used for crafting, remote calling and videos, which is what drew me to it in the first place. The lamp is so good, I may just buy one for myself ...

I bought this around a year and a half ago, and it's been great for my desk. I use it as lighting for zoom calls, detailed sculpting work and also as a bright enough light alternative to the ceiling lights. It's also long enough for my desk with multiple monitors. Generally moving the arms was good, and they would hold position really well- sadly though, it has recently broken at the base between the arm and the desk grip. The screw broke off and has damaged the inside of the arm and the base itself, making it nigh on impossible to repair despite multiple attempts. This makes sense because of the frequency of my moving the arm, but a bit more stability would've been great. Overall a good item, but I'd have loved more longevity.

review_title: A perfect lamp for intricate detail work
body_en: Fully adjustable lamp arm with three lights which have brightness controls. Perfect for providing light in different directions by folding the extendable arm. Perfect for intricate detail work.
Very good flexibility and range of angles. Thought it would be good for crafting and painting minis but even on max light is not bright enough. Good build quality and length of cable for power.
Great option to provide some extra light just where needed. Nice quality, nice looking lamp.
Looks and works great! Have it over our computer in office. Perfect

review_title: Kitchen use: space-saving brilliant white food prep light
body_en: Adjustable light, I prefer brilliant white! I live in a home that was originally built in the 1950s. There isn't task lighting for the kitchen sink or the countertops near the sink. Ironically the overhead light casts a shadow where I stand making it even more difficult than It has a right to be. I purchased this lamp because it took up very little space and was low profile. It's plugged in beside the coffee maker and it swings its arm over the sink or can be folded down. I use it for doing dishes and also task work of cleaning and dicing food. I'm a transplant patient so the way it prepare food is very particular and carefully curated for the best possible outcome. This light has changed the game in the kitchen and food prep. It is a task light that actually keeps you focused because what you're working on is well illuminated. I don't know why I didn't think of getting a kitchen light for this even before I needed better lighting. I even turned it on to read items with small print or prescription bottles. I think the best part is this is thin, low profile and take some very little space visually or physically. I have very limited counter space in this 1950s Florida cottage so it fit the bill perfectly!
Great design and looks amazing. Could be a bit brighter but works great when doing puzzles and board games.
Purchased as a gift for my husband, he loves it so much that he don't use the ceiling light as much much. The different modes of brightness is a nice touch. Also great for small spaces
Substantial contruction, easily adjustable and adequate lighting. Perfect for lighting the desk beside a large monitor.
It's the perfect slim size. And the light is adjustable which makes it perfect

The bottom plate has a screw hole that is beveled so it should sit flat and a foam pad on the bottom of this plate to also enhance sitting, however the foam was put on the wrong side of the beveled hole, so the screw doesn’t sit flush, so the lamp will not sit flat and therefore it’s a little wobbly.

Just like the Phillips hue lamps. App connectivity is seamless, easy to use, and has been very reliable. No issues at all. Considering buying more for other rooms. Only gripe is I wish it was HomePod compatible but it’s only Alexa. However, I will say because the app works so well, it doesn’t bother me as much. Overall it’s a cool lamp for the price and it honestly gets super bright. I have to keep them on 50% because the full brightness is like bright bright. Ended up buying a 3rd one. Can’t say enough good things. No connectivity issues whatsoever and no issue with getting any color light

review_title: Easy to integrate, turn on and automate
body_en: Easy to integrate into alexa or via the app. Set up as a schedule by day, time. Nice ambiance for the space and love the various color options. Exactly what I was looking for. Only using a week but it's great so far.

review_title: Great smart lamp for small areas!!
body_en: I love this little lamp. I do not have a lot of space at the moment and needed something that didn’t take up much room, worked with my Echo, and had multiple light settings. This fit the bill!! It works flawlessly with my Echo, there are a ton of varieties of brightness and color settings to choose from, and it is small so it doesn’t take up a lot of space. It was super simple to setup. It connected through Smart Life and Alexa without any issues. I would recommend this lamp if you need something small, needs to be a smart lamp, doesn’t cost a fortune, and you want a variety of light settings!!

I'm obsessed with these lights—I own two now, one in my bedroom and another in my living room. The only reason I'm not giving it five stars is the night light feature, which ironically is the setting I use the most. It can't be configured through the app, and activating it directly on the lamp is frustrating. You have to turn the unit off and lightly touch both the top and bottom at the same time, which isn't intuitive and doesn't always work on the first try. I also found the preset mood scenes to be somewhat underwhelming. Aside from setting schedules, there isn't much room for customization, so they don't add a lot of value in my opinion. That said, if you're looking for a stylish lamp with excellent ambient lighting and tons of options, I still highly recommend it.
I FREAKING LOVE THIS THING. It’s the perfect alternative to those ugly led lights that get stuck to your wall. It illuminates any space perfectly and totally customizable!!

I looked all over for an actual LAMP that worked with Alexa. Everything else seems to be a lamp with an included smart bulb. The issue begins if you can't really use the app nor can verbalize Alexa commands. Since my mom is able to do neither, she didn't really have a reliable way for the lamp to be turned off at night other than a lamp's physical switch. The issue there is that means there's no power to the smart bulb to have Alexa turn it back on. With this lamp, not only are we able to have her turn it off at night, but I can also have it timed to turn on in the morning with 'sunlight' level light to help her wake up, as well as have it timed to turn on a bit before sunset so her room is lit for when she wants to do things there in the evening. Overall, this is a great lamp, and I am fully happy with the purchase and after setting it up. I will note that there are other features I didn't mention, like different types of light (soft light for reading, 'daylight' for helping wake up, etc.) as well as multiple colors of light available.

review_title: Connectivity Issues but otherwise good product
body_en: At first I really liked this lamp and it was nice to control the brightness and other things from the app. But after a few months, I notice that sometimes there’s an annoying delay while it reconnects to Bluetooth. It normally doesn’t have issues but the main thing is I try to turn the brightness to 100% but after about 10 seconds it goes back down to 20%. It also has a music setting on the app but it doesn’t work at all? I’d just rather have a touch control lamp so there’s no issues with connecting and not doing what I wanted. Sometimes it struggles to turn on or off from the app but touching it always works. I really wanted to like it.

review_title: Highly recommend for ambiance and customizable light!
body_en: I love this little table lamp. I have it set on a smart timer to turn on at sunset and turn off at 9:30. Its in my living and acts as a little ambiance. The color temperature is customization on the app. It was easy to set up. Its corded so no batteries to deal with. The size and quality are perfect. It might be challenging for folks who don't want to set up an app though so I would say its more for the basic-tech savvy. I wouldn't give it to my grandma.

review_title: NO ME DEJA CONECTARLO A MI WIFI
body_en: I've been trying to connect it to Wi-Fi for a while now and it disconnects in the process.
Used these whilst we were away on holiday and set the timer to come on and off - worked a treat. App is easy to use and the lights are very bright. Would highly recommend.

It is without a doubt the best lamp I've had the privilege of buying. It feels, looks, and functions at a premium and high quality. The neck of the lamp is what I'd consider nearly perfectly balanced between flexibility and sturdiness. With the adjustable angles of the light bars themselves, as well as the neck, it will unquestionably meet your positional needs. The touch controls are practically flawless. They work every time they are pressed, as inputted without fail. They are positioned as such you can easily identify and press them at any time without having a clear visual of them. I was extremely satisfied with the quality of light itself. The range of warmth/cool strikes a node of nostalgia and comfort for me that is difficult to explain. They are arranged perfectly, and can satisfy any particular need for a specific light task by task throughout your day. The brightness levels do not fail to complement this standard, there are a satisfactory amount of levels ranging from beautifully ambient dim to possibly light up the room. A more niche comment, my desk has oddly positioned metal framing that goes underneath in a rectangle. It is often difficult for clamp based items to function on my desk because of it, but the size of this clamp was so good it still managed to clamp all the way up and firmly onto the edge of my desk. I saved plenty of space with this lamp. I have literally 0 complaints. I'd buy it again.

review_title: Great execution of a novel designed and versatile LED desk lamp
body_en: This desktop lamp is BRILLIANT! Most items I see from Amazon ads are gimmicky and often overpriced. Such nonsense does not apply to this versatile LED desk lamp. Was shopping for better lighting than the clip-on ring light I have, which is harsh on my eyes and does not provide illumination for my desk. Saw this lamp popped up in my search for webcam lighting. Checked the reviews and was pleasantly surprised on the positive feedbacks. It's a creative design yet priced as the same cost as simple non-harsh webcam/video streaming lighting. Works really well and has plenty of color shades (5) and brightness levels to suit a variety of light settings. Wide enough to handle my home office setup with a laptop screen plus 34" main screen of an external monitor. Dual tilt function means I can cast enough light on my profile on video conferencing calls and rotate back to original position when I am off calls and typing away on the daily grind. Truly happy with the purchase and rarely am I bothered to write a review, but here I am giving the lamp some high raves.

Unboxing: Everything was in the box with no missing parts. Instructions were included. Assembly: Not hard to assemble at all. Took about 5 to 10 minutes. As usual I suggest reading the instructions and following along. Not difficult to understand or follow. Function: Everything has worked as expected. The clamp connected fine to my desk and after setting it up I have not needed to move or change the clamp in any way. Holds nicely and does its job without issue. The bendable arm is easy to move and holds the lights in place. Even when changing the positioning of the lights themselves it does not change the bendable arms position. Its also nice that when I want to adjust the position of the bendable arm it is not difficult to do so. The lights themselves are sufficiently bright for day or night use. I find it particularly helpful to be able to change the light color along with brightness. Rotating the lights with near 360 degree rotation is also helpful. It works great with a web cam. I can easily tilt them to face me to provide better lighting for web meetings and then tilt them down to be out of my eyes when just working. I would purchase it again given the chance and have no regrets thus far.

review_title: Great Desk Light! Love the many light and height settings
body_en: It has the perfect setting adjustments! Can be very bright or very dim, whichever you would prefer. It has great light temperature settings. I find myself personally liking the more yellow/warm lightning as I work from home staring at a screen for 8hrs Mon-Fri. It’s has a good free bending “stem” so you can adjust the height as much as you want. Overall great product! I’ve had this for a while now!
Nice product. Good value. Easy to put together, the hardest thing for me was moving my desk to attach it. Easy to use on/off switch, brightness settings and light color. Sleek design.

Sheepishly I responded and acknowledged my mistake. Their response? To offer me a partial refund so that I could purchase a new power adapter - something they obviously did not have to do. All this to say - if you’re thinking about buying this lamp, do it. I can assure you that the company stands by their product. review_title: Recommended. Could be improved but good as is.
body_en: TL;DR: Recommended but could be improved. I'm using this lamp in my living room to illuminate a bluetooth keyboard in the evening. The gooseneck keeps the lamp where I put it and feels like it's well made and will last. The lamp has 3 color settings - white, amber and off-white(?). I'm not sure why they choose off-white rather than red, which is useful when you don't want to compromise your night vision any more than you have to. The lamp seems to be quite efficient; I've been running it on an old no-name (and over-rated IMHO) 30,000 mA USB power bank for about 12 hours, and I've got 87% of the battery left. It's wide enough to illuminate a full-size keyboard, but the LED strip is designed so it's easy to keep glare off the screen. I've got two power banks, neither of which start when the lamp is plugged in; you must push the button on the power bank to turn on the output. This is because the lamp (and other devices) don't draw enough current when the lamp is off for the power bank to notice it's connected! As a result, if I turn the lamp off (such that the lamp's blue standby light comes on) the power bank thinks nothing is connected and shuts down after a few seconds (and thus losing my dimmer adjustments). The lamp has a wide illumination range; it gets quite bright, and dims to a very low level, such that I can keep it on when I'm not using it and it isn't distracting. This is important because WHEN HE LAMP LOSES POWER IT FORGETS HOW MUCH I've DIMMED IT (for which I have deducted a star). To compensate for this, when I turn the light on for the evening I set the default (white) light to the level I need to view my keyboard; I set the other two colors to the lowest level. When I want to take a break and watch TV for a bit, I select the amber color and I can dim the light is enough that I don't notice it. Then when I want to type some more I switch to the white color and I'm in business. I have one other nit: The lamp's gooseneck threads onto the top of a stiff upright tube, which screws into the desk mount. This tube is long enough that I can barely position the lamp perfectly (due in part to my setup - others may not find it too long). This could be solved by shipping a 2nd tube about half the length of the current tube. This way I could use the short tube and it would give the gooseneck more 'reach'. Some may find it useful to use both tubes for added height.

Plenty bright, very adjustable, etc. The lamp wasn't tall enough for my use case (up from behind and over a rather large computer monitor), but a small stool and some books corrected that, and I knew from the measurements going in that I was going to have issues with the height. Two minor negative issues that folks should know about: 1) The instructions are pictures only, and blatantly misleading at times. (It shows the wrong size screw going in the wrong location at times, etc.) Fortunately, assembly is not complicated, and you can generally work out when you're being lied to. :) 2) The biggest issue: The lamp responds to half the remotes in the house. I have a Vizio TV in my office where the lamp is, and a Samsung TV in the living room, and the directional buttons & "OK" button for both remotes turn the lamp on and off -- and the volume up/down for both remotes changes the lamp "color". This is HIGHLY ANNOYING, and the only reason for lowering the rating to a "3" star (the lamp WORKS; they just picked unfortunate frequencies for it to respond to). That's it. I like the lamp. I just hate having to reset it every time I adjust the TV.

review_title: Compact Air Purifier Best Suited for a Bedroom, Home Office, or Smaller Open Layout Condo

Otherwise, these models offer very similar operation and performance, so do consider the room size and square footage you are looking to cover. Build quality-wise, the 338S is another solid device that is compact in size at just over 14"H x 9"W and weighs under 6lbs. Unlike the 539S model with a transparent lower section of the cylinder style that reveals the 3-in-1 HEPA filter, the 339 opts for a solid white style from top to bottom, with the filter hidden inside. Personally, I prefer this look, but you do have to make a point of opening the unit to inspect the filter regularly for maintenance or replacement. The display is clear and easy to read, along with the 4-colour gradient visual, both of which can be turned off so they aren't a light source in a bedroom. This is a WiFi-connected device that you can also control via the DREO app, which is free and easy to use. It actually has to be one of the easiest apps I've ever used in terms of getting a device connected and set up, in minutes, literally to DREO's credit. This device can also be integrated into either Google Home or Alexa for voice control. I like the real-time monitoring, history and ability to schedule the operating times as well. The app is also your source for upgrading the firmware, when applicable. In terms of performance, the 338S operates relatively quietly and goes about its business of monitoring and cleaning an average-sized room every 15 mins or its max coverage every hour. Like the 539S model, the fan is quiet at level 1-2 and only starts to be more audible above 3. It really isn't too noticeable unless the air particulate matter suddenly worsens from cooking or smoke, which unfortunately has become more of an issue due to summer wildfires each year now. Overall, if you are looking for a compact air purifier for your bedroom, home office or a small condo, the DREO 338S may be the model for you. If you need to have coverage closer to 1,200 ft², then the DREO 539S may be more suited for your needs, but both models perform very similarly based on my time testing them both for review. Price-wise, there is only a $20 difference, so you may want to opt to upsize, so to speak. Both are a recommended buy, and hopefully you'll also perhaps catch either on a deal.

review_title: Clean Design, Strong Performance, and Decent App
body_en: The Blueair 311i Max has been a great addition to our bedroom and has dramatically helped air quality having pets and as someone with typical seasonal allergies. Setup was easy and intuitive, and connecting it to the app was straightforward. The design is modern and clean, so it blends into the room instead of looking bulky or industrial. If you are researching air purifiers, it is important to understand how coverage ratings work. The large square footage number is typically based on running the unit at maximum speed and achieving roughly one air change per hour. In practical use, most people run these at lower speeds for noise and filter longevity. For meaningful air cleaning, around 4 air changes per hour is commonly recommended, and if you are more sensitive to allergens you may want even more. These units are designed to clean a room, not an entire home, so sizing appropriately is key. In day to day use, this model performs very well for particulate matter (PM) like dust, pollen, smoke particles, and general airborne debris. Auto mode responds quickly to PM spikes and adjusts fan speed accordingly. On lower speeds it is very quiet and unobtrusive in a bedroom. At higher speeds you will hear airflow, but it is smooth and not harsh. What is nice is that it has a power loss recovery where it will return to its last set mode when power is restored in case of a power outage. One thing that really stood out to me is how much dust, hair, and other allergens the pre-filter alone traps. It is honestly a little shocking and really puts into perspective how important a quality filtration system is. Even with consistent pre-filter maintenance, when I eventually replaced the main filter it was clearly very dirty with trapped particulate matter. That alone justified the investment. For maintenance, you can vacuum the worst of the trapped debris off the fabric pre-filter, but a proper wash is really recommended. Just slip it off, wash it, let it air dry or gently tumble on low, and put it back on. The app will remind you about filter life and maintenance, including pre-filter cleaning, which is helpful. When it was time for replacement, I switched from the standard filter to the Allergen version. I have been happy with its performance, although I did not notice a dramatic difference compared to the standard filter. Moving forward, I may go back to the regular filter depending on availability and cost. Blueair also offers a SmokeBlock option with a higher carbon density if VOC/ odor control is more of a priority. It is worth noting that this unit focuses primarily on particulate filtration. While it will help somewhat with Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) over time, serious VOC removal requires a significant amount of carbon or carbon zeolite media, which brands like Austin Air are known for. Something I am considering in adding to further improve home air quality. The app is well done and practical. It shows general PM trends, logs spikes, and allows manual control. Being able to adjust it from bed is a nice convenience. It has an auto mode, night (turns off less) and then 3 manual fan speeds as selectable options on the device. App will provide you with some additional timers options, smart location options to turn device off and on when you leave the home etc and gives a little more granularity to the fan speeds allowing you to dial in a speed that you like. I don't use these all I will usually leave it on Auto or manually set a speed. Overall, if you size it correctly for your space and expectations, this is a well-built, effective room purifier. It looks good, runs quietly, is easy to maintain, and delivers strong particulate performance. I would definitely recommend it for bedrooms or medium-sized living spaces where clean air matters. I am very happy with this purchase!
