I have notoriously sensitive teeth and have always avoided whitening strips due to the painful zings they cause. After a month of using Lumineux (three times a week, nine total treatments), I am genuinely impressed. The lack of peroxide is the standout feature--my teeth whitened gradually without any sensitivity whatsoever. After the first week, I noticed a subtle difference; by the end of the month, my teeth were two shades lighter, with no enamel damage or gum irritation. Pros: Completely pain-free application. The strips adhere well and don't slip during the 30-minute wear time. The formula is gentle enough for daily coffee drinkers like me, and the results look natural, not unnaturally white. The dentist-formulated aspect gave me confidence in using it long-term. Cons: The whitening process is slower than peroxide-based strips, so patience is required. You must stick to the schedule to see results. Also, the strips can feel slightly slick if not pressed firmly on the teeth at first. Recommendation: Absolutely. If you have sensitive teeth or want a gentle, enamel-safe whitening option that works gradually, this is a solid choice. For those needing instant, dramatic results, peroxide strips may be faster, but Lumineux offers a kinder, sustainable alternative. I will repurchase.

review_title: Whiter teeth are psychologically better than yellow stained teeth.
body_en: Lumineux whitening strips do work!! You need to follow the protocol to have the treatment last. And I'm sometimes in a hurry. But, I read 15 minutes is even ok for a quick touch up. That's a very good touch up. I know I get better results if I make the strip go into my cracks and crevices on some of my crooked teeth. My family had 5 children. My mom took us to the dentist but actually braces back then were for the affluent people. I am old now and thank goodness I've never had a cavity. Neither did 2 of my brothers. But a sister and another brother had cavities and problems with their teeth. My sister got married and didn't need braces but her teeth due to genetics turned yellow with age. She used Zoom because she could afford it, and it looked nice, but it didn't last. Nothing can last forever. But, using this product, even though, if you stop, it won't last either, will make you (and don't worry about other people seeing your teeth) very happy! Because you look in the mirror at yourself maybe 100 times a day and seeing your white teeth is a feeling that boosts self-confidence, thus self-esteem, and your mood will be more positive, true, and you'll feel more outgoing. There are actually too many, attributes to list. But this important point, no doubt, has made its mark. The most important point is how you see yourself and more importantly, feel about yourself. White teeth is only a " fix it" solution. Inside your head you need all of these affirmations about yourself. You need to start at beating depression down. Even if it is mild, this kind of depression, the kind inside your head that looks for all your faults, and you look at all of them excessively. Bad "self talk" will ruin so much of the good talk that you can't stand up to it and take charge of all your good God given traits that will move you forward in improving your self-esteem. I found that to help my self-esteem was to say "Yes, my teeth are crooked and yellow. I'm embarrassed by how I look. It really makes me feel bad!" So, being much older gives me wisdom on how best to strengthen my self-esteem concerning my teeth, and do something about it. Money plays a part here, too. Therefore, I saw the commercial on TV and looked it up. And I read about it. Then I bought the kit. Money was no problem for this. There can be hundreds of products out there that claim the same things. I received my package and immediately used it. Haha. It did work!! I was very impressed!! Lumineux DOES work!! Once, I was in a hurry and in as little as 15 minutes I was stunned to see actually whiter teeth. Man, next time I used it close to 30 minutes and was thrilled at white teeth! Once I just did the top teeth very quickly. And later I used the left over bottom strip on my top teeth. I made that thing fit and work. And it did. I don't want to waste anything. If I forget or can't use it as I like, I know I can catch up. What I want is to have very white teeth when I'm talking or smiling or laughing. And I know I can achieve that with my whitening strips. I wish I could afford the clear braces. But, they cost at the start, at least $5,000.00. I wish I could afford that. But, I know I would be on a payment plan for the rest of my life. (I'm exaggerating.) Yet, if my teeth look good and white I'll be happy. I have to decide on financial priorities; and, it will be my Lumineux white strips that take the top of the list. It's better to have the white teeth (albeit some bottom teeth are crooked) than to have yellowish teeth. And yes, to never have had a cavity up to age 60 is good, but nobody looks inside my mouth for dental work unless it's the hygienist or dentist. Yes, and that's a plus for me healthwise. However, and I stress this; Having Lumineux Whitening Strips make my teeth whiter is going to win, for me, every time. And that's even if I wore clear braces. Braces DO NOT whiten teeth. So, I've already bought another box of my whitening strips. I don't want to take pictures of my teeth or give my name. I'm telling the truth. And It has to be on trust that what I'm saying IS the truth. And I'm happy about this. Now wouldn't it be wonderful if they made good, Clear Braces infused with Lumineux whitening?? And while you wear them for the duration, your teeth become straight and white together in a happy relationship!! How wonderful. Someone will think of that someday and bring the cost of those braces way down. And a scientist will find a way to infuse Lumineux into the clear braces. So, I am hoping people all ages buy Lumineux to try and boost their self-confidence and be happier than before. I am happier about these ridiculous teeth than ever before just due to Lumineux. And I wrote about it because it is true. Thank you

3:13 June 5 , 2024 I applied the initial application . I brushed with sensodine tooth paste & dried my teeth prior to the application . After fighting & getting the top film off the backing I easily applied it however the bottom film is a little trickier to apply correctly . I jumped into the shower whe while washing my face I could feel both films sliding on my teeth while salivating more than normal . The top stayed close to the applied site but the bottom wrapped around the back of the bottom teeth . Plus I'm thinking the front of the bottom teeth are uncovered . Almost 30 minutes in & I can feel a peroxide like unwanted sensation in a couple of my 71 year old back teeth . 32 minutes later the top film was pretty much where I put it however the bottom film was indeed covering the back of the bottom teeth . The remaining residue which some discribed as snot & the taste wasn't all that bad . After rinsing I brushed again with Sensodine & baking soda which removed said snot . While it's the initial /test run I highly doubt any change in color but the teeth that were treated feel extremely clean . I'm doubting this product will have the anticipated results , so that's why I gave 3 stars . Day 2 results to follow . Day2 , brushed , rinsed with Listerine & dried my teeth before appilying the strips . Left them on for the 30 minute period & this time they stayed where placed due to inactivity . Again I felt sensitivity in my worn down back teeth . Removal of the strips & cleaning of the teeth was not too awfully bad followed by brushing & more Listerine . I'm thinking that I'm seeing a difference that Crest 3D whitening tooth paste didn't help with . The tooth paste works more on coffee & tobacco stains . Day3 , same as day2 except I used my lower jaw night guard to keep in place the lower strip . A great suggestion by a previous reviewer . Again with the 30 minute procedure & again with what I would say is better results . My teeth do infact look & feel brighter & cleaner . The tissue whiteness test does NOT do any justice so far , but I'm happy with the results . Tomorrow's another day . Days 4 , 5 & 6 were pretty much the same results except the time of application changed . Enough with all of the step by step info , the results so far after 6 applications are that my teeth have experienced a definite & noticeable change in the shade or color . I wish I had a dental color chart & also had taken pictures of my experience to be able to chart the before & after results . Having been a dental lab tech 53 years ago I can still compare the results & say that my teeth are at least 4 shades whiter . I'm raising my review to 4 stars also reordering another box for future applications .

I bought these after hearing multiple social media influencers rave about them for months. Finally caved! I subscribed to these strips because it was cheaper. But I was a little lazy lol and didn’t even start trying them out until after I already had FOUR BOXES of them…ok so I was super lazy. I just don’t love the experience of using white strips so I put it off. But after I had 4 boxes I figured I better start using them. I was so certain they’d be great because these influencers rave so much! But there’s so much they don’t tell you. I have only used these, and different types of the Crest white strips in the past, so I only have the Crest to compare them to. First, sensitivity: this is the one area that I would say is purely a pro. These don’t make my teeth cold sensitive at all after use. If your teeth have a really hard time maaaaybe it would be worth all the cons to use these. Whitening: my teeth are getting whiter, 3 boxes in. It’s taking much much longer than the crest white strips took. I always brush my teeth before applying the strips and wear them for 30 min as directed - I use a timer. So I’m using them correctly but the whitening effect is sooooo slow. Not impressed at all. My teeth would get to a nice white after less than 1 box of crest strips. I’ve used 3 boxes of these already and still my teeth are not as white as they should be (and they weren’t horribly stained to begin with). Application: it’s weird I even have to mention this! With the crest strips you just put them on. With these, you dab your teeth super dry, carefully position them, try to put them on, but they flop and slide around, so you have to try to glue them down with pressure but be careful or they’ll slide…it’s annoying. They’re needlessly difficult to get to stick to your teeth. Plus - often during the whitening process the corners will come loose and be annoying sticking out and poking your tongue. The WORST PART: when you take them off. I was expecting a little residue because the strips I’ve used in the past left a little residue. With these basically all the gel stays behind stuck stubbornly on your teeth. Don’t spit in the sink - you will spit out chunks of gel and it feels so disgusting it’s nauseating. The gel thickly coats every tooth and if you have any crooked teeth it will be worse. What I do is use my wet toothbrush (which I don’t like doing since you’re not supposed to get your mouth wet after these strips but nothing else works) to scrub the gel off my teeth. I have to rinse my toothbrush several times because it gets totally gunked up with gel. Then I spit the remaining bits of gel out. It is extremely unpleasant. The first few strips I used, I thought something was wrong with my box but lucky for me I had other boxes, and none of them were old. but just in case, I tried the newest box. No, they’re all like this. All of the strips leave such a thick layer of goo on your teeth I can’t even imagine why the influencers rave over this product. To me, this is something you should use as a last resort lol if you can’t use anything else, ok try this. If you can handle sensitivity or have money for other means of whitening, avoid these!!!! They are so disgusting. I can’t believe people recommend them without even mentioning the mess of goo at the end and the slowwww whitening! These are so not worth the price. I still have some strips to use up, they were too expensive to throw away, but man do I regret buying them. Yuck!

review_title: A Smile Brighter Than My Future: Lumineux Teeth Whitening Strips Review
body_en: Attention, fellow coffee addicts, red wine enthusiasts, and anyone else who has ever looked in the mirror and thought, "Are my teeth supposed to be that color?" Have I got a tale for you! Enter Lumineux Teeth Whitening Strips, the little heroes in a box that promised to turn my smile from "library paste" to "Hollywood dazzle." Let's rewind. There I was, browsing Amazon with my usual morning cup of joe (cup number...let's not talk about it), when I stumbled upon Lumineux. "Clinically proven!" it boasted. "No sensitivity!" it declared. "Natural ingredients!" it purred. My stained teeth and I were intrigued. Could this be the answer to years of dental despair? Order placed, I awaited their arrival like a child on Christmas Eve. And lo, they came, these saviors of enamel. The strips themselves were so easy to apply, I thought I'd done it wrong. "Where's the catch?" I wondered. "Where's the pain? The tears? The existential dread?" But no, folks – just slap 'em on, wait a magic 30 minutes (perfect time to ponder life choices or scroll through dog memes), and voila! The deed was done. Now, I won't lie to you, dear readers. The first reveal was no miracle. "Patience," whispered the Lumineux box, possibly in my caffeine-induced hallucinations. And so, I persisted. Each day, a little strip, a little wait, a little more hope. It was around day five that I saw it – the transformation. My teeth, once the color of a well-loved antique, were becoming...what's the word? Bright. No, radiant. I was astounded. My mouth was aglow. I could signal ships at sea. Guide planes to safe landing. Illuminate dark alleyways. You get the picture. But the true test came at the family dinner. "What's different about you?" they pondered. "New hair? Lost weight? Finally got that tattoo removed?" Nope, just my Lumineux smile, blinding all who dared gaze upon it. In summary, these Lumineux Teeth Whitening Strips delivered more than just results – they delivered a new era of confidence, a beacon of light in a world of dental darkness. They're like little magic bands of joy, minus the usual terror of teeth sensitivity that comes with other whitening products. Five stars for the product, and another unofficial star for making me smile at my reflection instead of wondering if I've been unknowingly consuming chalk. Would I recommend them? In a heartbeat. Will I repurchase? Faster than you can say "pearly whites." Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some smiling to practice. My future's so bright, I gotta wear shades.

review_title: I hated soft toothbrushes until these
body_en: I’ve bought these several times over the last couple of years... usually in packs of four or more. At this point I know exactly what they’re like and I always come back to them to restock. I was always a medium bristle guy. ALWAYS. I used to hate the idea of soft toothbrushes because I assumed they would feel useless, like they’re just moving around without really cleaning anything. These changed my mind. They’re soft, but not weak, and that’s the whole difference. The bristles are the reason I like them so much. When I slow down and focus on one area, I can feel them going between the teeth, especially near the gumline and those really tight cracks between one tooth and the next. I don’t have gaps between my teeth, so I don’t mean actual spaces. I mean the tiny narrow places where you normally feel like only floss can reach. With these, I can push the bristles in gently and get that same kind of deep clean feeling. Honestly, they make me feel less guilty about never wanting to floss. I’m not pretending it’s the same thing, but the feeling is close enough that I trust this brush more than any regular medium toothbrush I used before. The brush itself feels right in the hand. The head size is normal, easy to move around, the grip is comfortable, and it feels well made without feeling bulky or flimsy. Saying a toothbrush is “easy to use” sounds a little ridiculous because it’s a toothbrush, not some complicated tool, but the proportions are good and nothing about it feels awkward. No strange taste either, which I appreciate. The colors are all nice too. None of them are too feminine or too masculine, so the whole pack is usable. Although I somehow always end up keeping the orange and red ones for my wife. They last well. I usually change mine after around six months, not because they stop working, but because I like the bristles to still look straight and fresh. Even near the end, they don’t really lose that floss-like feeling. I just change them once the tips start looking a little too spread out. I wouldn’t mind if they were cheaper, but I keep buying them anyway at the current price. To me they're worth it and the value is good when you buy them in a pack of 4 or more... Hands down these are the best toothbrushes I’ve used.

It’s crazy how good these are at leaving my teeth feeling clean and smooth. I was using an electric Sonicare toothbrush every night before bed, followed by flossing. When I flossed after Sonicare, I could usually still scrape a lot of food or whatever off my teeth using the floss. Now I do a routine where I use CloSys mouth rinse for 1 minute, followed by this toothbrush and then floss. My teeth feel so good afterward, and when I floss, almost nothing comes off my teeth except this one space where food like spinach always gets stuck! I’m a fan of this brush for life.

review_title: Durable, Compact, and Ideal for Work or Travel
body_en: I picked up this toothbrush as a dedicated travel and work option, and after using it for a few months, I’m very pleased with it. The packaging was solid, the materials feel durable, and the included storage case is excellent. Nothing about it feels cheap or fragile, which is more than I can say for many compact toothbrushes I’ve used in the past. In actual use, the toothbrush performs very well. The vibration is effective without being harsh, and the built-in timing interval is a nice touch that helps guide a thorough cleaning. It’s easy to use and does a good job overall. The only functional limitation I’ve noticed is that the short, straight brush head makes it a little difficult to clean my back molars. A longer neck or slight angle would help, but this is a minor issue and probably part of what keeps the toothbrush compact enough for travel. As a portable toothbrush, this one stands out. It’s lightweight, appropriately sized, and the storage case is one of its best features. The noise level is reasonable, and everything packs neatly away. After a few months of use at work it is still running on the original battery and the head is holding up well. Battery life and build quality are both impressive. Compared to other travel toothbrushes I’ve used, this is far superior. The build quality alone puts it ahead of most options, and the cleaning performance is solid for a compact device. I also feel that the price is appropriate for what you get. If you’re considering a toothbrush specifically for work, travel, camping, or general on-the-go use, this is a great overall choice. It does exactly what it should do, and it does it well. Pros & Cons Pros: • Durable, solid build quality • Excellent storage and travel case • Effective cleaning and comfortable vibration strength • Great battery life • Compact, lightweight, and easy to pack Cons: • Short, straight brush head makes back-tooth cleaning a little difficult • Would benefit from an adjustable or angled brush neck Who This Is For • Travelers, campers, or anyone needing a compact electric toothbrush • People wanting a sturdy, well-designed alternative to flimsy travel brushes • Anyone wanting a dependable work toothbrush for mid-day cleanings Who This May Not Work For • Someone needing deep-reach access to back molars • Anyone who prefers full-size electric toothbrush power levels Category Ratings Build Quality: ★★★★★ Cleaning Performance: ★★★★☆ Portability: ★★★★★ Battery Life: ★★★★★ Value for Price: ★★★★★ Overall Rating: ★★★★★ (5 out of 5) A well-built, reliable travel toothbrush that performs above expectations. A slight brush-head redesign would make it even better, but as it stands, it’s an excellent choice for travel or work use.

review_title: Easy to use. Attractive. Can stand in its holder right on the sink.
body_en: The dental hygienist I see recommended this brand years ago. She loves the timer aspect that prevents you from not stopping brushing too soon. It is easy to use. Is very attractive & comes in a tube that stands & holds the toothbrush. And when you travel you just insert it brush head forward so it protects it from getting dirty, etc. I've used this brandk form many years now.

Always a great toothbrush

Overall, I like this product. It’s slim, sleek, and fits well in my small travel go bag. I really like being able to stick it to the mirror so that it’s right there up off of the sink and you can drop the toothbrush right in so it can dry. I’m not 100% sure about the cleaning ability, but it’s not bad in that aspect by any means. It gets the job done. It is a very soft brush, though. Which is why I don’t use it for long-term, just short term trips. I think the value is good because you can use it multiple times versus my old habit of taking a brush from the dentist and just chucking it at the end. I’m glad I got it, and will probably look too get some replacement heads here in the future to keep it going.

Great toothbrush, it is slender in size which I find easy to hold in your hand and brush. The slender size will fit well in my travel makeup bag easily also - which is a bonus! Seems to be more effective than a previous electric toothbrush I was using at removing plaque from my teeth. The bristles are a little stiffer than I was using, but not too stiff as to make my mouth sore when using it! Would recommend!
I had one that lasted years. this last one lasted only 5 months and the motor quit. Great toothbrush IF it works.
Great toothbrush! I love the color if it. I have been using Quip Toothbrushes for over three years now, and love them..

I was in need of a new electric toothbrush, and as someone who has had braces for nearly 3 years (2nd round of braces as well), a water flosser is a helpful luxury. The toothbrush itself has good vibration, with different strength levels and modes, so I think it definitely gets the job done. The color is very pretty (I got pink), and it comes with 4 brush heads total. The water floss machine is very portable. It is easy to hold in your hand without being too bulky, and the water tank holds a sufficient amount. If you're still figuring out the water flossing technique like me, you may have to refill the tank once during use, but once I get the hang of it I'm sure I can stretch one tank for a single session. The water flosser comes with 4 heads total, one of them being a tongue scraper. Aside from the products and their attachments, they do not come with any sort of travel accessories. The toothbrush has a little cap that covers the end of it when there is no brush head attached, and the water flosser has space in the tank to attach 2 (i think?) heads to carry. Otherwise, there is no brush head covers that came with mine, nor is there a travel case or bag. This isn't an issue for me, as I can just buy a cheap travel case. The products themselves are great, and both the toothbrush and the water flosser come with charging cords. I haven't had any issues attaching or removing the accessories, and using the toothbrush and flosser is pretty easy and straightforward. All around, these products are pretty solid for such a good price and convenient combo!

I purchased this combo because I had never tried to water floss before and thought I would give it a try after reading reviews. It is a great value for your money. The two together you can’t purchase for this price in the store. Not in my area anyway. The battery last for days without charging. I have forgotten to charge mine for several days and it still worked. The toothbrush is noisy. I wish it was a little more quiet so I could use it when my husband is still asleep. I normally brush on the days he is off and sleeps in later than me on the weekends. The quality of the product is good. It reaches all areas and I like that it has a built in timer that makes it go off when you have brushed for long enough. The water flows is amazing on my gums and teeth. I love that I can choose my level of intensity. It does exactly what it was made to do. I am amazed at how much better my teeth and gums feel. I love the pink color. I even purchased my husband the black one. He loves these also.

Very efficient! Brush is very nice, comfortable I feel it cleans well, the water pik is good I feel it could be a little stronger but I love that they came together! Portable which is great and it does have several accessories. Charges quickly.

review_title: If you want a CLEAN mouth...

Good quality for toothbrush and waterpik. Very easy to use. I will say that for the toothbrush the bristles are rough so if you have sensitive gums possibly use a different head. Settings were easy to use.

review_title: Good value for a nice little electric toothbrush

review_title: Set 2 en 1 con cepillo e irrigador recargables por USB C.
body_en: I have been using this electric toothbrush and dental irrigator combo for several months and I recommend it to you not only because of the price but because it is not bad at all. It is quite practical that it is a 2-in-1 system because in a single device you have the electric brush for daily cleaning and the dental irrigator to clean between the teeth, something that is normally only achieved well with dental floss or separate devices. The irrigator has 3 cleaning modes and 6 intensity levels, which is very appreciated. If you have sensitive gums you can start with a low pressure and gradually increase it until you find the most comfortable level. In addition, the 300 ml water tank is quite practical because it allows you to do all the cleaning without having to refill it halfway through the process. The sonic electric toothbrush also works great; It has around 42,000 vibrations per minute, so it leaves your teeth with that deep clean feeling you normally get after a professional cleaning. It also includes interchangeable nozzles and heads, making it useful for different needs, such as sensitive gums or people with orthodontics. Another positive point is the USB rechargeable battery, which lasts a long time. With normal use it can last around 25 days in the irrigator and up to 35 days in the brush, so you don't have to constantly charge it. This use will depend on the use given per day, as well as the power or mode selected. Overall, it is a fairly complete device to improve daily oral hygiene at a really low price, especially if you want to add dental irrigation to your routine without purchasing several devices separately and with much higher prices. This product is made in China.

review_title: Cepillo eléctrico e irrigador COSLUS: todo en uno para una limpieza profunda
body_en: I have been using the COSLUS electric toothbrush with oral irrigator for several weeks and I can say that it has significantly improved my oral hygiene routine. The electric toothbrush has several cleaning modes, including one for sensitive gums, making it ideal for people with orthodontics or gum problems. The vibration of the head is gentle but effective, and the cleaning sensation is much better than that of a traditional manual toothbrush. The oral irrigator is, without a doubt, the strong point of this pack. It has six adjustable intensities, so the pressure of the water jet can be customized depending on the sensitivity of each user. The 300 ml tank is enough for a full session without needing to refill it and the interchangeable nozzles make it easy to clean between teeth. It is especially useful for removing food debris that normal brushing usually leaves behind. Its compact design and non-slip grip make it comfortable to use and easy to store in the bathroom or take on a trip. The rechargeable battery has good autonomy, although I would have liked the charging connection to be USB-C on both devices, since each currently requires a different cable. Additionally, the charging base does not have a protective rubber, so it should be kept dry to avoid damage. Overall, this kit offers excellent value for money and is highly recommended for those looking to improve their oral hygiene with a practical and effective product. Its strengths are its versatility, ease of use and visible results in deep cleaning. The only aspect to improve is the charging compatibility and the availability of replacement parts, but otherwise, it is a great investment for the oral health of the entire family.

The water flosser is great and features multiple modes. They both look great and feel great. The water flosser is great for getting in between my teeth. review_title: Simple, effective, and reliable sonic cleaning without the extra frills!
body_en: As an Amazon Vine Voice, I tested the PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush over a two-week period, using it for twice-daily brushing routines to evaluate its cleaning power, battery life, and overall usability. If you want to step up from a manual toothbrush without paying for expensive, feature-heavy models you'll never use, this stripped-down sonic brush is a compelling option. Here is my honest breakdown of how it performs: ⭐ Cleaning Performance & Power Sonic Technology: Delivering solid vibration action, it drives fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline. It leaves your mouth feeling remarkably fresh—way cleaner than any standard manual brush. Single-Mode Simplicity: It features just one cleaning speed and one button. While it lacks multiple intensity settings or fancy pulse cycles, it focuses entirely on doing the core job exceptionally well. Easy-Start Feature: If you are new to electric toothbrushes, it includes a built-in feature that gently ramps up the power gradually over your first 14 brushing sessions to prevent gum sensitivity. 🛠️ Design & Usability Slim & Lightweight: The handle has a sleek, ergonomic profile that feels comfortable and lightweight in the hand without taking up unnecessary counter space. Smart Timers: The integrated SmarTimer automatically shuts the brush off after the dentist-recommended 2 minutes, while the QuadPacer pulses every 30 seconds to signal when you should switch quadrants of your mouth. 🔋 Battery Life & Charging Dependable Endurance: The internal rechargeable battery easily lasts up to 2 weeks (around 14 days) on a single charge under normal use. Convenient Indicator: A subtle battery level LED indicator alerts you when it's time to drop it back on its USB charging base. 🛑 Minor Cons to Consider No Pressure Sensor: Because this is a budget-friendly model, it lacks a pressure sensor warning light. If you have a heavy hand, you'll need to mind how hard you press manually. Basic Accessories: The kit keeps things minimal with just the handle, one brush head, and a USB charging stand (wall adapter block not always included). The Verdict The PHILIPS Sonicare 1100 proves you don’t need to spend a fortune to get a dentist-clean mouth. It cuts out the complicated modes in favor of reliable timers, great battery life, and powerful sonic action. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a straightforward, high-value electric toothbrush!

If I'm being honest, the bristles are much slimmer than I expected and am used to, but after about a week of use, I got used to it. The vibration motors feels great and actually helpful, the grip on the brush feels good, and they've done a great job at leaving my teeth feeling crisp and shiny like I just left from the dentist.

review_title: Oral-B Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush, iO5 Win over Philips.
body_en: The Oral-B iO5 series toothbrush is an exceptional product, renowned for its durability and quality construction. The toothbrush’s plastic components are robust, ensuring longevity and reliability. The entire unit is designed to withstand rigorous use, embodying the latest advancements in dental technology. One of the standout features of the iO5 series is its Bluetooth connectivity. This innovative feature allows users to sync their toothbrush with their smartphone, enabling them to track their brushing habits and receive personalized recommendations. The toothbrush also includes a range of essential features, such as pressure sensors and timers, to ensure optimal oral hygiene. Notably, the iO5 series is manufactured in Germany, as indicated on the packaging and the toothbrush itself. This commitment to German craftsmanship sets it apart from other brands, such as Philips, which is known for producing inferior products made in Vietnam. In contrast, the iO5 series has proven to be a reliable and effective replacement for my previous Philips toothbrush, which required frequent replacements due to its poor quality. Even my dentist recommended the iO5 series, further solidifying its reputation as a superior dental product. MADE IN GERMANY 🇩🇪

I have been told by dentists for years that I should be using an electric toothbrush, but I have VERY sensitive teeth, and every time I used one it sent me through the roof! Well, a couple tooth cracks later and I decided to suck it up and try again. I bought this one because it has a lot of settings, including one for very sensitive teeth. Out of the box it was sleek and solid, and the display was easy to use and intuitive. It did take some getting used to, and I used it with warm water, but it did not hurt, which was thrilling for me! Now, several months later, I can say that I love this toothbrush and that it genuinely cleans my teeth really well! I am not one for pairing things with apps or my phone, so I can't comment on that side of the toothbrush, but it does have a pressure sensor that lights up red or green to let you know if you are bruising too hard or too lightly as you go. The battery lasts a long time, as do the heads, and it comes with a travel case as a bonus. Two thumbs up!

review_title: Works Great but App is Okay
body_en: I had the old style Oral-B before and was ready for a new toothbrush. The IO5 was on sale so I bought it. I didn't think I'd use the app at all but it turns out that the gamification of my oral hygiene is a positive for me. I brush longer and use the guided brushing to make sure I'm getting full coverage. The only thing is that the zone identification is sketchy. On almost every brushing, it indicates the wrong active area of my teeth. I've tried Oral-B's recommendations- stand straight, do each tooth one at a time, move to different segments, repeat on inside and bite surfaces- but it still misdetects zones. What that does is make me brush even longer, so not terrible, but better accuracy would be much better and, frankly, I expected much better. Occasional it totally glitches and I need to restart the app and the brush. I also thought the battery would lastonger but it's about the same as my OG Oral-B electric that was around $40. Note that I am probably brushing longer, so maybe the battery is a little better but I hoped for 3 weeks and I'm getting less than 2 between charges. I still like the brush, but just know the app guidance doesn't work as well as you'd think. I do like that it reminds you to floss, brush your tongue, and use a mouth rinse. It also gives you a score for each session and a running score, which I like even though I thought I'd never use that. In summary, it works well and my dentist noticed a difference and told me to keep it up. It is a bit expensive for an electric toothbrush, so I hope it lasts a long time.

I had the IO3 and that was really good but this one is even better. This one is so much stronger vibration wise. It also comes with an app with is really neat. review_title: Lasted 12 years before I had to buy it again! Superior clean without the hefty price.
body_en: After an incredible 12-year run with my first Oral-B Pro 1000, I finally bought it again! The battery on my original brush finally bit the dust, and toward the end, it would only stay charged enough to get me through 24 hours of teeth brushing (if I was lucky) before dying. However, I loved the performance so much over the last decade that replacing it with the exact same model was an absolute no-brainer. Here is why this brush is a classic: Hygienist Approved: My dental hygienist once told me that it really doesn't matter how fancy or expensive an electric toothbrush is—any solid electric toothbrush is far superior to a manual brush. This model gives you that elite, professional clean without making you pay for unnecessary, over-hyped tech features. The One Minor Con: If I have to name one downside, it is the noise. Even brand new out of the box, it does sound a bit like it might be powered by hamsters while it is working. But just because it doesn't sound whisper-quiet doesn't negate the fact that it is a remarkably solid, heavy-duty toothbrush. A Note on the Color: The color is fun, but the listing is a bit misleading. I thought I would be getting a mint green, but instead, it is definitely a powder blue. I much prefer green to blue, but eh, whatever—it still cleans my teeth perfectly! If you want a proven, durable electric toothbrush that will last you for years to come without draining your wallet, this is the one to get. Highly recommended!

Let me start this review by saying that when I was younger, much to my parent's dismay, I neglected to brush my teeth. I would brush them but not as often and as thoroughly as a child should. This was partly due to my very bad gag reflex and partly due to the fact that it felt painful (?). Anyway, I've had yellow teeth my whole life (I'm 29) because of it. I never got braces (thanks again gag reflex) but my parents tried everything to get me to have better oral hygiene and to have a more aesthetically pleasing smile. Now that I'm well into adulthood, my smile being so yellow, and also very crowded, was starting to bother me. I knew I had to give in and fix one or the other. (To be clear if you have crooked teeth don't feel like you have to change yourself just for society - after 29 years, I can say that I truly wanted to change the yellowness purely for myself). I've gotten healthier in almost all other aspects of my life. I decided to make the plunge and buy this in hopes it would help get my teeth cleaner and help reduce plaque buildup. Not just for aesthetics, but for actual oral hygiene. So, I've used it twice a day for 3 days so far and my brother commented on how "white" my teeth look yesterday evening. That felt very good to hear, not gonna lie. I think this toothbrush is amazing for the price. I love how tiny the head of the brush is. It fits into my small, overcrowded mouth perfectly. I was worried that it would take forever to brush my teeth since I wasn't doing the work, the toothbrush was. However, it takes about 2 minutes and 30 seconds or 3 minutes if you're extra thorough. It allots 30 seconds to each section of your mouth, it will do a variation in the vibration to let you know when the 30 seconds is up and to move to the next portion of your mouth. It doesn't automatically shut off after 3 minutes (that I know of) if you want to go back and do another section of your mouth, which is nice. As for the pressure sensor on the toothbrush, mine does not work. It doesn't indicate any color or anything. It just appears to be a normal electric toothbrush. I may have gotten a "bad" toothbrush since it's not working, but to be honest, I truly just wanted something that would do a deep clean and this toothbrush does that. However, all the other reviews mention the sensor working so if that's something you're looking for, I would still highly recommend this toothbrush. I think mine might just be a dud in that department. The charging took several hours to be full on the first day. I keep it on the charger to ensure that it is always fully charged. If you don't have your charger with you and you need to rely on it without it, I'm told the battery lasts up to a week. Which, is very impressive for a $50 toothbrush. Amazon says that it has Bluetooth connectivity but I do not see any indication of that on the boxes or in the manual. My parents bought me an electric toothbrush when I was little, but I was too young to appreciate it. Now that I'm older, I think this is a great option for any person of any age. I do recommend it!

I have used the Oral-B electric toothbrushes for many years. I’ve been told I have a small mouth and the small round head of this toothbrush is perfect for me. It makes every brushing like going to the hygienist—smooth clean teeth. It has a timer for a total of 2 minutes, with a change every 30 seconds to move you through the front and back of both sides of your mouth. I wouldn’t use any other toothbrush.

review_title: A great value that comes with power
body_en: This is the most powerful electric toothbrush I have ever used! I ordered this toothbrush to replace a manual one that I had. My dentist recommended an electric one so I picked this one up. This is amazing! My teeth have never felt so clean When you first get it, it will come with no charge, so make sure you charge it. In the box, it includes the toothbrush and a charger. You don’t get any extra heads so make sure that you order some. When you do use it though, you will love how clean your teeth get! My teeth have never felt so clean! I use it every day. It is waterproof, so you can take it in the shower, which is perfect for me since my mornings are rushed. It is enjoyable to use and to hold, it’s terrific! One thing I really enjoy about it is the two minute timer. It keeps me accountable to actually brush my teeth for a long enough time, and it doesn’t allow me to brush for a longer time than I have to. It pauses every thirty seconds, so you can brush each quadrant of your teeth for thirty seconds, so you can give one section of your teeth the attention it deserves. With the pros out of the way, I do want to talk about a few cons. There are way too many settings to use. I know that it’s nice to have many options to choose from so we can pick what we want, but you don’t need three different ways to brush your teeth. Most of the time I just click the on button and don’t bother with the other settings and turn it off when I’m done. The other settings aren’t even that different. You can see that in my included video The battery life is also not the best. Some people have reported getting a week or two’s worth of battery, but I’m finding I have to charge mine every five days, which isn’t a dealbreaker, but I travel a lot, so it’s not ideal. Speaking of not ideal, they use a proprietary charger which really makes this toothbrush not travel friendly. You need to take so many chargers with you for your phone and laptop. Those might have the same charger, like USB-C, but this doesn’t. So, you need to take this charger separately. Another thing is that you need to really keep the toothbrush, charger, and any surface it touches, clean and dry. Otherwise, wherever you put this, bacteria will start to build up. If you don’t clean your charger every other day, bacteria will start to build up and it’s gross. The included picture doesn’t do it justice, and that’s just on my sink. Despite my complaints, I really enjoy this toothbrush. It’s relatively inexpensive compared to other electric toothbrushes, it has lasted me a long time, and it’s powerful. I do recommend it!

review_title: Great electric toothbrush but head replacement gets pricey!
body_en: Great, lightweight electric toothbrush with several different replacement heads to choose from. Lower upfront cost to purchase the toothbrush than other brands or models within the Oral-B family. Recharges fast and is easy to take on trips too. Only issue is with the price of replacement heads - that is where they get you. Just do your research as the brush heads need replacing every few months and it adds up.

review_title: Don’t be frightened when your teeth feels clean for the first time!
body_en: Absolutely phenomenal. People weren’t lying when they said it feels like you just came from the dentist. I don’t know how it does it, but if you brush the same way you brush with a manual toothbrush, alongside the intense vibration, it feels like it removes 100% of plaque, especially the plaque that’s hard to get behind each tooth. Also, at first, the vibration may feel a little intense, but you’ll get used to it. But if it’s too strong, just press the button and it will go to a slower mode. I highly recommend the strongest mode for the most effectiveness. But hands down, this is the best toothbrush I’ve ever got in my life. I will say, because the brush is small, I usually apply the toothpaste on my finger and place it in my mouth manually, then brush. But that’s my personal preference. I just prefer more toothpaste. And it sits well on the charging pad. I honestly have no complaints.

I love this brush and wish I had gotten one years ago! After learning from my hygienist how to use it correctly, this brush made brushing so much easier than a regular toothbrush and I can feel that the cleaning is so much more thorough. Love it. Well worth the ~$50 cost.

review_title: This is a bit pricy over time but it works well
body_en: Love this. Power runs about 5 uses for me. Good buy, only thing worth noting is that the new heads are like 15$ a pop which is expensive in the long haul.

review_title: Great cleaning, versatile options for brush heads, charge lasts, but only 1 speed setting
body_en: One of my best purchases. I used to clean my teeth with a manual toothbrush, thinking that if I spent enough time and diligence, it would provide the same level of cleaning as an electric toothbrush. I was wrong. After my very first cleaning with this device, I felt a level of clean teeth only experienced when I leave the dentist's office after a cleaning. And it wasn't just a subjective feeling. When I returned for my 6 month cleaning the next time, there was barely any tartar or plaque build up - all had been removed by this toothbrush. I also noticed that my level of bad breath and tonsil rocks declined significantly. Turns out a manual cleaning is nowhere near as good as this machine. I have purchased this toothbrush for familty and friends, telling them it has changed my life. I wish I had this device as a child! The toothbrush comes with interchangebale heads, so that you can pick the one that works best for you - sensitive teeth, hard brush, whatever. Oral-B makes these products available, but you can also purchase no-name brands as well. It does create quite a bit of vibration in your head that I found a little scary at first. However, despite having sensitive teeth and gums, the toothbrush never harmed them. The toothbrush ahs a pressure sensor that stops once you put it too tightly against your teeth to prevent this. There is supposed to be 3 levels of speed for the brush. Mine doesn't seem to have them - has shown in the video. It's not that I don't know how to operate it - the toothbrush I purchased for my family (in white instead of pink) had those features, as advertized. In the end, I don't feel that having those 3 levels are important, except perhaps to get used to the sensation of vibration in the initial phases of use. The toothbrush comes with a plug and charger. It seems t o keep its charge for 4-5 days (I only use this toothbrush once a day for 4 min). Then the little light at the bottom of the toothbrush turns from green to red, alerting me that it is time to charge it (so I can usually travel without the toothbrush charge if it is for a trip that is less than a week). The charge itself happens very quickly - it seems to be charged within 20 min. I highly recommend this spinning toothbrush. It has changed my mouth's health!

review_title: Limpieza profunda y guiada, excelente cepillo
body_en: I have been using the Oral-B Pro 1000 CrossAction and I really like it. The cleaning is deeper than with a manual toothbrush: it helps remove plaque and care for the gums more efficiently. The built-in timer makes it easy to complete the recommended two minutes, guiding 30 seconds in each quadrant. In addition, the round head reaches difficult areas much more easily than a conventional brush.
You can feel the difference :)

I’ve been using the Quip toothbrush for a while now and overall I really like it. The design is super sleek and minimal and it feels lightweight and easy to use compared to bulkier electric toothbrushes. The built-in timer with the 30-second pulses actually helps me brush for the full two minutes, which I didn’t always do before. One thing I appreciate is how simple it is, there aren’t a bunch of confusing modes, it just does what it’s supposed to. It’s also really convenient for travel. That said, it’s definitely more gentle than other electric toothbrushes. If you’re used to a really powerful brush, this one might feel a little weak. But for everyday use, especially if you prefer something more lowkey, it gets the job done!

Battery is replaceable and so are h brush heads. This was a replacement for my first toothbrush, for some reason motor stop working after 3 plus years. But love how it works seems to be a very good value for the price.

review_title: Top notch - shop no further - this is the one
body_en: Love love LOVE this Quip! It’s lightweight, easy to keep clean, and best of all it has a timer so I consistently brush for a full 2 minutes. My dentist recommended a sonic toothbrush. So glad I read the reviews and tried this. Highly recommend and would buy again.

review_title: Quip used to rock; now it sucks
body_en: I’ve purchased a few Quip toothbrushes over the years and loved them. This one is terrible — like other reviewers here, I found that either the battery died quickly or the brush malfunctioned in a way that kept the little activation button from making contact with the battery properly. Either way, it’s almost impossible to get to the battery without breaking or misshaping the main part of the brush. It’s too late to return this through Amazon. I’m going to try to contact Quip about it directly but am not hopeful.

This is a great toothbrush, but after about 2 months of use, it started turning on itself. I would hear it vibrating in the bathroom cabinet. Couldn't get it to shut off until I took it apart and took the battery out.
Button is hard to press. I like the brush though but I don’t think I would pay so much for this again. Maybe if it had a charger.

I love the Quip toothbrush! I bought it to take on a trip to Europe because my regular electric toothbrush was too bulky. Wow was I surprised at how much cleaner my teeth were! I drink several cups of tea a day and I fight to keep the stains at bay. This toothbrush cleaned off all the stains by itself! I didn't have to do anything extra, no whitening strips, nothing. I just brushed my teeth with a whitening toothpaste like normal. It's slim and weighs a lot less than my regular electric toothbrush. The only downside is the timer. If you shut off the toothbrush to spit and then turn it on again, the timer starts over. It's really not a big deal as long as you know it's happening. The first time I used it I kept waiting for the final timer to go off and it just kept going. The next time I brushed, I didn't shut it off and the timer worked perfectly. FYI.
It works incredibly well it’s easy to use. The battery life is incredible it’s a great tooth brush for 20 dollars or however much it cost overall it’s a great fit for me.

This toothbrush is definitely different! I purchased them after watching a couple of YouTube videos of Dr. Ellie Phillips who highly recommended these brushes. They are gentle on the gums and I can tell that they are effectively removing food particles from between the teeth without the use of floss. I have always been a die hard fan of flossing because I believed that it was the only way to remove food debris from in between the teeth. However, after following Dr. Ellie Philips routine, my mind has changed. If you don't know who she is, she is a retired dentist who came up with a simple and effective program to help reverse gum disease, remove plaque and bacteria and help heal cavities among other things. Flossing can be kind of irritating to gums as I was having this problem. This toothbrush not only cleans the teeth better than ordinary toothbrushes but cleans below the gum line without causing any extra irritation. I noticed that my mouth is actually cleaner using this toothbrush and moving forward, I don't think that I will go back to regular toothbrushes. If you are dead set on flossing, I think that a water pik would be the safest choice which I may invest in the future but so far I don't think it will be necessary. I can't say enough good things about these brushes. Order them try them, If you don't like them you are only out of about 10 bucks. Not a deal breaker. I highly suggest you check out Dr. Ellies videos and then make an informed decision. Otherwise, I'm sold!!

review_title: I’m never buying a different brand again!
body_en: I saw these toothbrushes in a Buzzfeed article and got one for my boyfriend and me. The bristles are soft enough to not hurt but it truly does get between my teeth much better than any other brush I have used, even expensive electric ones. I have issues with bleeding gums, but this brush has helped stop that. I also have receding gums and this is gentle but effective! I feel like my teeth also look whiter now. I love that it has silver in the bristles to keep bacteria at bay. And the price cannot be beat!!! I do have a small mouth and while I can use the adult size, next time I may try the youth size. I would recommend these brushes to anyone wanting a dentist clean!!

I've been a Sonicare user for over fifteen years now, but my dentist said it was likely making my gum recession worse. It doesn't help that I'm heavy handed. I took the plunge on these manual brushes not expecting anything special but boy, was I in for a surprise. The bristles feel like a gentle massage on the gums, and they get in-between areas that the thick Sonicare bristles could not (I know, the sonic action is supposed to create cavitation that replaces the need for actual bristle contact, but still...) These toothbrushes feel so good, and my mouth somehow feels cleaner than it did with my electric toothbrush. I now look forward to brushing and have to remind myself to limit to twice per day, because in my situation brushing too much causes more gum issues. 10/10 highly recommended!

I love these toothbrushes. Of course, ideally, you should still floss. But I am very lazy and often I don’t. The tiered bristles on this brush are so good at getting into tiny crevices between teeth and around gums. I also usually in addition to just brushing with these toothbrushes, go through and kind of tap the longer bristles into the spaces in between my teeth. These toothbrushes are great because I think they clean just as effectively if not more effectively than expensive electric toothbrushes and if you don’t like the feeling of electric toothbrushes, these are such a good option. I’ve been using these toothbrushes for years and even though I’m not the best at taking care of my teeth, when I go in for my cleanings, the hygienist says she’s not seeing any built-up plaque around my teeth. So to me that feels like all the evidence I need. One note is that the bristles are natural I think, so they can look a bit dull or discolored, so just be prepared for that and don’t expect those bright white plastic brush hairs you’re used to

I’ve been happy with these toothbrushes overall. The bristles are soft enough that they don’t irritate sensitive gums, but they still leave my teeth feeling very clean after brushing. They seem to reach along the gumline better than some standard soft brushes I’ve used. The handle is comfortable to hold, and the brush head is a good size for getting to the back teeth. My only minor complaint is that I wish the bristles were a little firmer for an even deeper clean, but that’s a matter of personal preference. If you have sensitive teeth or gums and want a toothbrush that cleans well without being harsh, this is a solid choice.

This is a great toothbrush that has completely changed the way I brush my teeth. I’m used to bristles that are relatively hard and sometimes can cut my gums, but the bristles on this toothbrush are far from rough. They are extremely soft and make it easier to get that 40° angle without hurting yourself. The toothbrush is tasteless, and I am unsure if it has affected my teeth in terms of color, but it feels great in my mouth and is easy to travel around with as long as you put it in a proper container to ensure no bacteria gets on it. Compared to a non-electric toothbrush it may seem a bit heavy so I would take that into consideration if you’re someone who has a difficult time carrying anything heavier than a pen, but I find that the end of the toothbrush it’s thicker so it might be easier to grip onto compared to a regular toothbrush. These bristles aren’t bleached so do expect a yellowish tint and a high bristle count.

I've been using this toothbrush for 8 months. I thought it was doing a better job cleaning my teeth than any other toothbrushes (including electric) that I've used, because whenever I floss, there's nothing left on the floss. I've never had that happen prior to using this brush. But its performance was confirmed when I went to the dentist. After just simply brushing my teeth before my visit, I had the easiest check up of my life. The hygienist said "Your dental hygiene is excellent. I didn't have to scrape anything. No build up anywhere!" So, yeah, this brush is awesome and nothing else that I've come across can compare.

review_title: One of the best toothbrushes you can own!
body_en: I love my toothbrush and they are very durable and well worth the money. I received the item quickly and I would buy from this seller again. The bristles are soft and perfect design for the grip and the handle. I have taken my toothbrush with me on short trips because I love it so much! Thank you for making these! They are everything as described.

I don’t know what it is about these toothbrushes but they are the best I’ve ever used and worth the money. They clean the teeth well and seem to last well. Not too hard or too soft . I was so impressed that I ordered some for my adult son and he agrees.

I thought it was just hype - but it’s real! Saw this toothbrush on a TikTok and found my electric one was wayyyy too harsh on my receding gums and oh my goodness, I have never had such a good clean than with this brush! It’s so satisfying I literally look forward to cleaning my teeth

review_title: Perfect day and night tooth brushe
body_en: Works perfectly as day and night tooth brushes. Bristles are hard enough on the gums but not abrasive nor piercing.
This toothbrush is amazing. Leaves a clean feeling after brushing. Too bad that it's not available locally here in Singapore but delivery was quick. Overall satisfied with it!
This is different to the fine toothbrushes from other brands. Gets in between the teeth, firm but not harsh.

I hardly ever write reviews, for any product I order online. But this right here is an exception, happen to get this toothbrush, while scrolling through the deals section, I figured I could treat myself to a electric tooth brush, as I’ve been using just normal once’s for a while, I didn’t have any expectations before getting it, but the first time I used it, a lil eye opener on how powerful the vibration of the product was, after I was done brushing my teeth felt like it had an actual deep clean. Given how strong it was. I will say it does take some time to get use to, maybe just a few days as going from normal tooth brush to strong vibration tooth brush it may be slightly uncomfortable. Battery life excellent, it took so long to run out of battery life, durable, have dropped it many times. Indeed water proof. Nice features on it, many modes to use. Easy head replacements. I don’t have any complaints for it. It’s an excellent tooth brush, and not expensive.

These toothbrushes are amazing! I purchased one for each of us in the household, and we are also impressed with the settings and the efficacy of the product. It takes a minute to figure out the button to switch between settings, but once you get that down you’re good. My mouth feels so incredibly clean.

review_title: Super great product ! Well worth the money !

Works as it should teeth feels clean brush is smaller than what I’m used to but I actually like it way better great product takes not time to fully charge
Nice toothbrush but the rotation is hard in teeth when they are hit by the brush head.
Works great. I have only had to charge it once in several months.
Great tooth brush love all the different settings and the way you can charge it and it lasts for months!

A sleek and easy-to-use electric toothbrush. The oscillating brush head gives a thorough clean, and the handle feels comfortable and lightweight. I like the rechargeable design since there’s no need to keep replacing batteries, and the simple controls make it convenient for everyday use. My teeth feel noticeably clean after brushing, and the compact design is great for travel too.
I absolutely loved this toothbrush! Easiest transition ever, and makes every cent worth it. It’s been almost a month now, and the battery holds a charge like the day I got it.

I was so excited to get a toothbrush with a spinning head on it, since my dentist told me they are the best for my teeth. This toothbrush worked great at first! Perfect, actually. My problem however, is that I bought it in May, and now that it's September, it doesn't charge anymore. I never even got to use the extra brush head that came with it. It's dead now, so it's pretty useless to me. For the amount of money this toothbrush costs, I am highly disappointed. I do not recommend this toothbrush.

I loved my toothbrush worked just like I wanted it to for 2 weeks. Then it just quit. I have tried to get someone so I could get help. There is no way to contact any one. So I guess I am out of all of that money. I just wish w could get help

review_title: Love this tooth brush, just oozes in the back
body_en: Love this toothbrush! It makes my teeth feel super clean, even on the lightest setting which I prefer. This is my first electric toothbrush purchase, and I can’t believe what I’ve been missing. I wanted something gentle on my teeth and gums, and the lightest setting is perfect. The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because it leaks daily. I’m constantly wiping it down and cleaning out a small hole where gray gunk oozes through. It seems to come from the tip of the brush, I think the little holes inside connect and cause the leak. It’s strange, especially since I don’t use charcoal or gray toothpaste. Other than that, I really love it. It’s sleek, effective, gentle, not too loud, and the battery lasts about a month.

I liked this toothbrush, but about 1 year in it started to smell funny. Seems like there are holes in the head that allow toothpaste to get INTO the neck of the which then get into the piece of the body that attaches to the brush. I tried Soaking it in alcohol, leaving it out to dry fully, manually cleaning but nothing helps. Clearly it’s a huge design flaw and something I’ve never experienced before with an electric toothbrush. Going back to Panasonic, byeeeee!

I bought one of these for travel and loved it, so bought another for home use. I previously had an Oral B, which had a larger head and in my small mouth was awkward. The Quip has a smaller head and quieter operation...just right for men!
This has made a huge difference in my husband's tooth health amd routine!

review_title: Better than I expected for the price compared to more sophisticated models
body_en: My old battery operated toothbrush stopped working out of the blue! Was so happy to get this one the next day. What a difference! I have long been an advocate of Oral B and this did not disappoint. I literally unpacked it and put it to work. It came charged and the toothbrush heads are fantastic. My teeth felt immediately cleaner and happier after use. I really like the warning button if you are using too much pressure on the brush. This is a cheaper choice (as compared to the other more expensive iO options) but it will serve you well. I would definitely buy this again
Works great, cleans teeth, has 3 speeds, and has a timer for all sections of your mouth, great toothbrush, own 2 in different colors 😀

My product came used the toothbrush itself was all covered in dirt the whole body of the toothbrush and then there were 3 pieces of toilet paper bunched up in the box now this is serious here sending people who buy brand new merchandise stuff like this and it has actually been happening to me frequently I used to see reviews about it and thought maybe they weren't true but now I'm learning that this is actually happening so without a doubt I'm telling you to buy this toothbrush somewhere else!!!! We were upgrading from a spinbrush so this was expensive for us for the toothbrush and especially the replacement heads it's a nice upgrade charging it with a plug instead of batteries like before and having options for the speed on the toothbrush and also the timer for brushing your teeth for 2 minutes and it's nice you get 2 different toothbrush heads to see which you prefer for your own personal preferences but getting a used toothbrush just grosses me out and it's wrong I purchased a new one I was so excited about getting a better and more advanced toothbrush but so disappointed once I received it

Was skeptical if I'd like this any more than the cheaper Oral-B 1000, but it has exceeded expectations. It's quieter and gentler on the lowest setting. My only skepticism remaining is around the brush head, which is recessed in the middle. I am not sure on how thorough a job that shape does, as it feels like only the edges touch my teeth. However, I can replace with a different style head when replacement is due. Has good battery life so far. Would recommend, it is worth the money for this upgrade.

review_title: Newer heads than I was used to
body_en: Nice and quiet. I like having 3 speeds. I don’t need a timer, but I do want to get alerts if I use too much pressure, which it does.

review_title: A simple but highly effective electric toothbrush
body_en: This toothbrush functions excellently. I don't need anything fancier - it has three different speed/pressure modes and recharges on it's base. I have a bar covering my lower teeth that is hard to clean, but this brush and it's heads do it well. This is my first electric toothbrush and I will be sticking with it as long as I can. ONLY con is that grime buildup from the brushing process can build up in both the head and the stem of the brush unit. To keep them both clean, I remove the head, rinse both parts and tap them a few times on the counter to get the debris out. I let them both dry separately, and just reconnect it when I'm ready to use it again. It may seem tedious, but it keeps everything clean in the long run.

review_title: Big Performance Without the Big Price Tag: A Total Game Changer
body_en: I used to rely strictly on an Oral-B rotary toothbrush, but after picking up a cheap vibrating brush on a whim, I realized how much I preferred sonic vibration. Deciding it was time to step up to a proper rechargeable unit, I chose this one, and it has been an absolute game changer. In fact, I loved my first one so much that I ended up buying a couple more for family members. Real-World Details & Performance The feature that immediately stands out is the variety of oscillating patterns. Each setting delivers a distinctly different vibration feel, making it easy to switch up depending on what feels best for a deep clean. The shape of the brush head is exceptionally comfortable in the mouth, and the cleaning power easily outperforms my old Oral-B—I honestly don't see myself ever going back to a rotating head. While I haven't tried ultra-premium brands like Sonicare, I can't imagine they offer much more than what this unit delivers. Another massive plus is the value packed into the box: it comes with enough replacement heads to last a full year, making it effortless to swap in a fresh head every few months for that brand-new, fresh-from-the-dentist feeling. Pros & Cons Pros: Multiple Effective Modes: Distinct oscillating patterns that allow you to customize your clean. Superior Clean & Ergonomics: Head shape fits comfortably and cleans noticeably better than traditional rotary brushes. Outstanding Value: Includes a full year’s supply of replacement heads right out of the box. High Satisfaction: Fantastic overall performance that prompted me to buy additional units for family. Cons: Sonic Transition: If you are strictly used to rotating/rotary brush heads, the intense sonic vibration takes a couple of days to get used to. Final Verdict I highly recommend this toothbrush to anyone looking to upgrade to a high-performing sonic toothbrush without paying the inflated price tag of big-name brands. It delivers fantastic performance, incredible value, and a top-notch clean.

review_title: An absolute game-changer for kids with braces!
body_en: I originally purchased two of these electric toothbrushes for my kids after our orthodontist highly recommended switching from manual brushing to help keep their braces clean. Anyone with kids in braces knows exactly how difficult it is to get them to brush effectively around all those brackets and wires! These toothbrushes have been an absolute lifesaver. First off, my kids actually love using them. The brushing modes are incredibly effective at sweeping away food and plaque, but gentle enough that they don't irritate their gums. They find the handles easy to maneuver, and the built-in timer keeps them brushing for the right amount of time without me having to stand there and nag. It has taken the daily battle completely out of our morning and bedtime routines. The absolute best part, however, has been the results. At our last checkup, our dentist specifically went out of their way to comment on how incredibly clean their teeth are now. They noted a massive improvement in plaque removal around the orthodontic hardware compared to when we were using standard manual brushes. If you are a parent on the fence about upgrading to an electric toothbrush, especially if you are dealing with braces, this is 100% worth the investment. The quality is fantastic, the kids are happy, and the dentist is thrilled. Highly recommend!

I've been using this for a few months now. The brushes are a nice size and clean well, comparable to the much more expensive Sonicare I used for many years before it died. To get 8 brush heads, charging stand and this quality for this price (on sale for $8.99) is such a great deal. I had tried another brand for the same price before I found this one. The brush heads were too small and soft to clean well and it had no charging stand and limited features. I struggled with it for a year and a half before it died. I'm so happy to have found this one as a replacement. Highly recommend!

Looks great on the countertop. Is very durable. I have not used all of the settings yet, but the ones I have, I love & I look forward to using them all soon.

review_title: Makes my teeth feel as clean as coming from the dentist
body_en: So far, I am pleased with this electric toothbrush. I don’t think I’ve even explored the different modes yet (like the gum care mode), but I really just need it to perform its basic function of brushing my teeth. I haven’t updated my electric toothbrush in many years. I had an older model of the same brand, and it just seemed like the motor/batter had gotten weak and it wasn’t functioning that well anymore. I was definitely correct because this new Philips Sonicare packs much more of a punch compared to my old one. It was almost a little too much at first but I just needed a couple of days to adjust and now it’s great. I’ve noticed my teeth feel incredibly smooth all day long, like they do immediately after I go for a cleaning at the dentist. But the old one (which again was the same brand) was still going after almost a decade. So if I get that long out of it, I will be very happy.

review_title: Healthier Gums and a Cleaner Smile
body_en: I’ve been very pleased with this Philips Sonicare toothbrush. After using it consistently, I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my gum health. My gums no longer bleed when I brush, which has been a wonderful and encouraging change. The toothbrush leaves my teeth feeling much cleaner than a manual toothbrush, and I appreciate the built-in timer that helps me brush for the recommended amount of time. The different cleaning modes are easy to use, and the battery life has been excellent between charges. As a retired pharmacist, I understand how important good oral hygiene is to overall health. Investing in a quality electric toothbrush has been well worth it, and seeing healthier gums has been the biggest benefit for me. I would highly recommend the Philips Sonicare to anyone looking to improve their oral health, especially if they’re experiencing sensitive or bleeding gums. With regular use and good brushing habits, it has made a noticeable difference for me.

I can feel my teeth thanking me at night for getting a step up in motor for my electric toothbrush. It’s been like a month and my teeth look whiter and constantly feel cleaner. review_title: Fantastic clean, superb build quality, and great battery life
body_en: As an Amazon Vine Voice reviewer, I have tested my fair share of personal care devices, and the Philips Sonicare 5950 Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush immediately sets a high bar. Out of the box, you can tell this is a top tier, premium product with a lot of thought put into the engineering and design. The matte black finish looks sleek on the bathroom counter, but more importantly, the build quality feels incredibly solid. The handle has a nice weight to it, offering a comfortable, ergonomic grip that does not feel slippery when wet. The buttons have a satisfying click with zero play, and the brush heads snap on with a tight, precise fit. It feels durable and well sealed against water, which is essential for long term use. When it comes to performance, it leaves your teeth with that fresh, dentist clean feel every single time. The sonic vibration power is strong and consistent without feeling harsh on your gums, and the pressure sensor works like a charm to let you know if you are pressing too hard. Having the two brush heads included in the box is a great touch, making it ready for months of use right away. The battery life is equally impressive. A single full charge easily lasts for weeks of twice daily brushing, making it super convenient for travel without having to haul extra cords around. If you are looking for a high quality, reliable electric toothbrush that looks modern and delivers serious cleaning power, this one is worth every penny. Extremely well made and easily recommended.

Amazing. I have been using Sonicare toothbrushes for over 20 years. I decided it was time for an upgrade, but never knew they had so many versions. It is powerful, but soft on the gums, so my teeth feel like they're getting scrubbed, yet there is no irritation or pressure on the gums. It has different speeds, including one for gum health. Weird to be going on so much over a toothbrush, but what a difference. Looking forward to my next dental appointment for the real truth.

review_title: Better than Phillips Sonicare. App is actually useful and not just a gimmick.
body_en: So, I'm a long-time user of Sonicare, which means I've gone through a number of them that always tend to break right at warranty expiry. Though I usually find them on sale, they are not cheap, nor are the brushes, and for the price they are still so prone to breaking down and various issues. So, when my current one started to have an issue (turning on randomly on its own, startling all around), I started shopping for a replacement. This Oral B brush went on sale, so I decided to check it out - maybe return if it wasn't all that great in comparison. At first, I was a little confused, because I thought these brushes mainly worked by rotation, but they are both that and sonication. I don't know if the vibration speed matches to Sonicare, but it doesn't seem critical. One immediate thing I noticed was the light ring which instantly lets you know if you are pressing too hard or not enough. As somebody with gum issues, this is appreciated. Next thing, do set up and try out the app. I was skeptical, but it really does a good job of figuring out what part of your mouth you are brushing, apparently by some kind of bluetooth-based sonar and something in the brush that can tell if it's facing up or down. It's not to the level of knowing which tooth, but it maps the front and two sides of both the top and bottom of your mouth, which is still pretty detailed. Rather than just using some kind of timer, it tracks that you spend the proper amount of time in each of the 6 regions. Your coverage within each region is then up to you. Sure, there are some times when it is a bit off, but I find that that tends to happen if I turn my head. So if you keep your head still, it seems to work more accurately. Not too hard to do. Besides the main brush tracking, you can set specific goals, and it will add recommendations for other steps like tongue brushing and flossing. I started a program for plaque removal. So now, instead of brushing or not kind of mindlessly in the shower one a day, I have started brushing twice a day, with more intention, and it's even slightly fun. And so far, my teeth feel smoother and cleaner. I also get less gum bleed, perhaps due to avoiding pressing too hard. I think this is still a bit pricey at full price, but maybe in this case it could be worth it for the improvement in your teeth and gum health. On sale, I can definitely recommend. Will it last long term? We'll see.

review_title: Smart, Powerful, and Leaves Teeth Feeling Dentist-Clean
body_en: I’ve been using the Oral-B iO5 and it’s honestly a huge upgrade from a regular toothbrush. The cleaning power is excellent—my teeth feel noticeably smoother and cleaner after every use. The micro-vibrations combined with the round brush head really make a difference, removing more plaque than a manual brush. What I really like is the smart pressure sensor and guided brushing. It helps you avoid brushing too hard and improves your technique over time, which is great for gum health. It’s also very easy to use, with multiple modes depending on your needs (sensitive, whitening, daily clean, etc.), and the overall design feels premium and comfortable. Overall, this is a high-quality electric toothbrush that delivers a professional-level clean at home—definitely worth it if you want to upgrade your oral care routine.
