review_title: Fresh from the dentist clean, tiny design flaws.
body_en: The positive reviews concerning the distinctive clean feel even after the first use are all true. As a matter of fact, almost all positive reviews on this item are somewhat accurate. I would like to focus on the details that I searched for and couldn’t find on reviews both written or in video format. They may seem like “cons” but I must add that for me they were not deal breakers. Instead I’d like to think of them as constructive criticism, since they are details that I would like to see on later generations of this item. Cable management: It is difficult to tell the power source and cable situation from all the photos and videos online, which are edited for aesthetic purposes. I kind of knew what the set up would be from previous experiences with other electronic devices so I knew what to expect. However, for those who are expecting the same sleek, cable-free look from the photos online please take note that if your bathroom has power outlets above the sink area, like most homes in america, there will be a cable bunch up on your countertop. Even if the cable is wound up and tied together, it may still be an atrocious sight for that OCD gem in your home, who probably spends a lot of time at the sink. Power Adaptor: Once plugged in, the power adaptor sticks out over three and a quarter inches from the power outlet, yet another design flaw. With the amount of compact usb adaptors available this shouldn’t be difficult to correct since the company would only need to replace one part. Power adaptor plug: The placement of the power socket on the base station is a bit awkward and creates a distance of about two and a half inches from the wall or backsplash. I have similar electronics with the power socket located below the item, which makes for a neater appearance and freedom to push the item flush to the wall when necessary. Other small details that the shopper should be aware of is the size of the item and color of the brush handle. Please take a closer look and notice that the brush handle is two toned. I think it looks good but, anyone expecting it to be solid white will be thoroughly disappointed. Also, please double check the dimensions of this item and know that it is not a compact design. Definitely not for a countertop where space is at a premium. With all that being said…or typed; I would like to reiterate that all these may seem like “cons” but they really are small details that everyone should know to ensure that they are completely happy with their purchase upon receipt. So, In conclusion this item would be perfect if it was a bit more compact, and the cable/power adaptor issue was resolved. With the portable power core technology available now a days I don’t see why we shouldn’t expect a wireless base station that could hold a charge for a few days in the near future. If you made it this far, thanks for taking the time to read and I hope this helped out even just a lil bit. Bitty boppity, give me the zoppity!

review_title: Amazing - Your gums will thank you.
body_en: This is an amazing setup and actually the second one I’ve bought. The first lasted about 5 years before it started to get worn and dirty from regular use. This completely changed that routine—it does the job thoroughly and makes flossing easy and consistent. My gums have never been healthier since using it. Overall, it’s one of those products I wish I had started using sooner.

The water Pick, combined with the brushing action is both quick and easy to use and leaves a feeling that your mouth has been thoroughly cleaned. Definitely not a budget item. I had an old waterpik which had seen better days. I had a sonic toothbrush which made my teeth feel wonderful but gave me repetitive stress issues. I finally decided to spend the money on this combo unit and it really is better than the the sum of its parts. It finds all the little hidden bits of leaves and such that distress one's teeth while efficiently cleaning that all important gumline. That is, it does exactly what it's supposed to do. And there's no spitting! Bonus! So, only *mostly* love, because it's just a little too smart for its own good. The brush pulses to make four time divisions then turns off. The only way to have enough water to make it to the end is to have it overflow while filling. Filled up to what looks like the same point is not sufficient. I'm big on saving water, but just a tad more generosity in the tank would actually save water. The old hunch is necessary while doing the combination, or else water will run down one's forearm. I'm not sure if there could be any design solution to that, but it's the brushing part that takes that long. Those who can't hunch can use the brushing part and waterpik part separately. It was hard at first to set the toothbrush in the receptacle, but I learned that holding the hose coil in place, against the unit, it's much easier to seat the brush. The only really bad thing about this is the price--and I paid up not to have black. :)

review_title: Takes a bit to figure out and adjust to...
body_en: One thing to know is that although its advertised that you can brush and floss at the same time, the actual application of this concept leaves something to be desired. When you activate the floss and bruch together feature, the flossing rinses all the toothpaste from you mouth before it can be used. So, I brush, then floss. The deep clean is amazing and this has enough power. The brush is set for two minutes and the it will stop automatically. FLAW: if you pause it briefly while brushing, the two minutes restarts. Unlike my phillips sonic care, which you could pause and restart without resetting the two minute time limit. This comes with two heads, one normal size and one for travel, i found they work equally well until one literally broke off in my mouth. I ordered more from Amazon and they have lasted well, so maybe a fluke. Bottom line: This thing does what it does well, but one must be patient and brush first, then floor. Also, don't forget to fill the water reservoir with warm water prior to using flosser. The flosser is super powerful and will clean the heck out of your teeth. Which, as I think about it, is the entire purpose of this thing: clean teeth. This doesn't disappoint.

review_title: Great Customer Service & Tips on Reconnecting the Flosser
body_en: TLDR: If somehow the flosser doesn't respond to the toothbrush's signals and the radio and toothbrush resets don’t work, drain the toothbrush's battery completely by setting it idle for a week or so and reconnect the set to power. Make sure you place the toothbrush in the base before reconnecting the set to power. Waterpik offers great customer service and the device works great and does what it's supposed to do most of the time. ----------------------------------------- I bought one 2.5 years ago, and after less than 2 months of using it, the flosser stopped responding to the toothbrush's command. I don't know how it happened but I knew it was a housekeeper who unplugged the device as he had to clean the counter. After a few days of testing the flossing function and trying the troubleshooting techniques without success, I gave up and contacted Waterpik's customer service. They asked for anything, you know, that would allow them to honor the warranty. The process was a bit annoying (just a bit, and is absolutely nothing compared to arguing with insurance about coverage) but Waterpik in the end sent me another set for free which I'm still using today. Being the environmentally conscious and lazy person I am, I kept the first set because it'd be a chore to dispose of it properly, so I just put it into the original packaging and stored it in the vanity cabinet. Last year, I had to move to another state and while I was packing stuff up, I saw the set and decided to give it another try before completely throwing it away. And it xxxxing worked!!!!!! Now that I commute in between cities, I've placed one at the residence close to my workplace!!! Also I've been periodontitis free for the past 2 years! Thanks Waterpik!!

review_title: It was just meh, and then the flosser feature broke
body_en: Unfortunately, I don't recommend this product for the following reasons: 1) The button to turn on/off the water flosser is directly below the button to turn on/off the toothbrush. I can't count the number of times that I've inadvertently pressed the flosser button and water sprays everywhere. It's easy to press this button because of its location on the toothbrush, and also because the handle for the toothbrush is small in diameter and slippery when wet...and of course it's going to get wet...so it's tough to avoid pressing buttons while trying to hold onto it. I can disconnect the water flosser to avoid this problem, but that defeats the purpose imho and is a hassle. 2) I seem to spend an inordinate amount of time keeping this unit clean. The toothbrush and base have lots of crevices. 3) At this price, I expected a better product, especially from Waterpik. It’s just meh. Not great, not terrible. I can work around the above annoyances, but wish I hadn’t spent so much money on it. I gave it 3 stars because the water flosser does a good job, and the reservoir holds a sufficient amount of water compared to the "all-in-one" models, where the water reservoir is in the handle. If you have a dental implant, you need a water flosser. Once this toothbrush/flosser needs replacing, I'll look for a different design. Hopefully Waterpik will come up with something better. UPDATE: Not long after giving this product 3 stars and a "Meh" review, the flosser stopped working. Actually, it won't STOP working, and wants to run continuously when the unit is plugged in. Now all I have is an expensive electric toothbrush. It gets one star.

review_title: Mismatched items cost time and money!
body_en: I had one of these and loved it. I even rave about the product to my friends and bought one for Christmas as a gift for one of my best friends. The unit didn’t work, and after several attempts of investigating it once she turned it over to me, I found that the base unit and the toothbrush don’t match IDs, so the highly touted wireless connection didn’t work and would never work since they are tied to the unit’s ID. This careless mistake on the manufacturer’s side meant I was forced to take back the present and return it. I had to then personally repack it and bring it to the post office and pay $66.60 to ship it back. Amazon is only going to reimburse me for half of that, and only weeks from now. Terrible service on both Amazon’s part (I’ve always been able to get returns picked up but they don’t offer it anymore) as well as Waterpik for screwing up in the first place!

Think about it: It’s late, people want to get it done - brush, floss and do the mineral mouthwash. I also try to do the WaterPik at night, but all these oral hygiene steps do take time. Oral-B - please make a simple electric toothbrush with no lights or app syncing, and please offer value multi-packs of the Gentle Care and Specialised Tip replacement brushes. These particular brush heads are very good (softer bristles are as important as pressure). Users should replace the brushes regularly but they are not cheap. So make profit from the brush heads (like printers and toner) by encouraging frequent changing of brush heads. Volume packs (not just 2 heads per Pack) would be good because less shipping and packaging waste would be better for the environment.

12/15/23 Original Product Review (in case I return for updates). THE BASICS 12/13/23 Found the Bitvae R2 Rotating Electric Toothbrush in Pink on Amazon and Placed Order. 12/14/23 Received the product late this evening, securely packaged and undamaged. The pink hue is true to its image color, and I like it despite not being a "pink person." TLDR This morning, I brushed my teeth for the first time in two years without over- or under-brushing, sensitivity and pain-free, and without feeling like my teeth were shifting. THE FULL STORY Let me explain: In 2021, I got into a major cycling accident that changed a lot of my daily routine I took for granted more difficult. After going over my handlebars, I primarily landed on my mandible with my maxilla taking a hard blow, too. My chin bounced twice on the ground (only for my lower jaw to pop back) before my face (and the rest of me) slid on the concrete to a stop. My top row of teeth, well, the only way I know how to put it is that they immediately felt like they had slumped forward in my face (and they had). After a bit of dampened sound and ear-ringing, bright lights and loud, bothersome noises, not to mention the blood pouring from my nose, face, mouth, and wounds, I was treated (probably insufficiently) at the ER and headed to a local dentist. From the general feeling of skidding my lower teeth and lip on the pavement and having my head jolted enough that each front top tooth looked like someone had crushed ice in a blender and left it sitting in its container, I knew things were going to be bad. THE CONSEQUENCES Not only had the long and painful, but effective process of moving my jaw forward by an orthodontist been completely undermined, but all six top front teeth were, indeed, crushed. The palatine process of my maxilla (soft palate) had a thin, but long crack running back through it, and the other more superficial parts of my maxilla that surrounded my sinuses -- tiny fractures ran throughout. WHY OTHER TOOTHBRUSHES WEREN'T WORKING Since then, tons of anesthesia, twelve surgeries, lots of drilling, filing, and testing, irritating crown fitting, teeth shifting, nerve pain and cold sensitivity...things haven't been the same. Try as I might, what used to be a simple, quick everyday task had become frustrating. I've always believed I shouldn't let the little things get to me. But often, it's exactly the little things that get to you, because they're not just little things. They're habitual. They're routine. Across the span of your life, they're actually really big things. How you approach your health -- including your teeth -- is one of those things. I've tried extra soft and soft manual toothbrushes, different brands, returned to my original Colgate; I tried using the Burst toothbrush and a similar "sonic" variety that my husband uses; different toothpastes; mouthwashes; flossing methods and flossers; coconut oil pulling; everything I knew to do before and that could be done or that recently came out...whatever friends and family recommended. In two years, I've not once felt like my teeth were fully cleaned or, if picked, prodded, and scrubbed well, fully stable. THE BITVAE Nothing has worked like this toothbrush. Today, my teeth feel clean, but my gums aren't sensitive, swollen, or bleeding from my being excessive thoroughness and over-brushing. And I've only tried the "Clean" setting. The timer feature in the Bitvae was a smidge startling because, eager to try it, I overlooked the manual details and was unaware that there was one lol. Let's just say it's obvious. But, if you know to expect it, it's brief and distinct -- a slightly different buzz that cues you to move on and kinda' propels you to, which (having OCD tendencies) I appreciate. And while I wouldn't say the Bitvae is quiet, it's certainly no louder than any of the other battery-operated competitors I've tried. (Because of the accident's damage to my ears, it honestly sounded a little like a quiet light saber at times. Weird, nerdy Star Wars reference, I know, but I'm just calling it like I...heard it.) As un-irritated as my gums feel, they also feel well-massaged. The tissue looks and feels clean and bright, without feeling or showing any signs of inflammation or agitation. From the front of my crowns to the crevices behind my molars and all in between, my enamel is evenly brushed and fresh. The Bitvae's brush head was small enough to clean all around without knocking about or hitting other teeth. Meanwhile its grip, heavy in my hand, was sturdy to hold, but not burdensome in any way. It was very easy to maneuver. My breath smells and tastes better (un-tinged by the last of accidentally brushing something too hard and more so than if I tried "brushing gently"), if that makes sense. And the Bitvae, having come charged, remains charged, worked smoothly -- better than I anticipated. I rarely (IF EVER) give products a five-star rating. I'm a meticulous person who, in herself and the products she purchases, almost always finds room for improvement. But, I'm truly satisfied with this purchase, which cost me less than half of what a similar Oral B would (when the Oral B is on sale for 50%+ off) have. CONCLUSION Buy it. I don't like throwing away money, and I know all of this sounds dramatic, but an accident like the one I had is nothing short of that. Meanwhile, the Bitvae comes with a year's warranty, which is reassuring as a customer and as someone whose dental health has been affected for life. The return of a well-cared-for mouth with the ease I once had of "just brushing my teeth" pre-accident is amazing. To have brushing my teeth -- which had become a process in itself to grapple with every morning -- return to a brief, but effective routine is such a relief. I'm grateful for the bit of time I'll get back every day. I hope you'll take the opportunity to enjoy it, too!

We purchased one from them and less than 7 months later it stopped working. I reached out to Lenovo and was told they couldn't do anything about it. I sent a message to this seller through Amazon and they closed the message the next day with NO response. I've tried to call the customer service phone number that is listed here in their seller profile and NO answer or return phone call after I left a voice message. So much money WASTED! Amazon won't do anything because it is out of the warranty/return window.

I had an earlier Lenovo Desk Top and was not real happy with it, so I was Leary about their laptop. But, it turned out to be a well made machine, I’m happy and surprised at the QC. I did notice the cover was stiff to open, probably due to not having a latch. One purchaser said the hinges were terrible, I can see his point, they are stiff for a reason! Just open it gently and not try to fling it open, it’s just stiff to keep it closed. I would recommend this PC to any and all persons.

review_title: Nice laptop for Student or Home user
body_en: Nice light and thin with 16" screen, video performance is good. Reasonably fast processor, with 32 GB RAM so it handles typical productivity application tasks easily. 1TB SSD will most likely meet my needs for life of the laptop. I have attached a USB-C docking station to enable a few extra USB-A ports for use with devices such as audio input from Yamaha mixer board, WYRESTORM 4K Webcam. external KB and Mouse. This unit is used daily for extended length Google MEET calls. BTW, product description said no backlight KB but the unit I received does have this feature.
Great laptop for 60 percent off too 👏

review_title: You may need to do a clean reinstall of Windows 11
body_en: Make sure you download a copy of Windows 11 to a USB or DVD before giving up your old laptop or computer (if its still working.) When I got the laptop two days ago, I set it up and used it. Then signed off. When I signed back on later, the explorer.exe file showed as suspended and the start menu and task bar would not appear. After a couple of days of troubleshooting, I finally fixed it with a complete clean reinstall of Windows 11. It is definitely on the cheap side as far as the quality of the case. It is plastic and almost looks 3D printed, but I expected this for the price. Performance, so far, as been great for the price (after I got it fixed of course). Overall, I'm happy now that its fixed. Other than reinstalling windows, it's what I expected for the price I wanted to pay.
Fast performance!

Purchased for a charity management team member, set up bu myself and sent out for home working due to COVID-19. It comes with windows 10 home S mode which generally van only install software from the windows store. There is a free upgrade to full windows 10 that only takes minutes to perform. For family use s mode is more secure, but for a business machine the upgrade needs to be done unless you're only using office 365. Very pleased with the performance of this machine.

I bought this laptop because I needed something reasonably priced for everyday use, mostly checking emails, browsing the internet, and doing some basic office and school work. I wasn’t looking for a high-end computer, just something dependable that wouldn’t be a pain to use. It arrived well packaged with the laptop protected nicely inside the box. The build feels solid enough for the price, and the 15.6 inch screen is a good size without making the laptop feel overly bulky. Setup was pretty straightforward and Windows 11 was easy to get going. I’ve been using it at my kitchen table for browsing, documents, video calls and streaming, and it handles those tasks without any problems. The keyboard is comfortable and the webcam works fine for normal calls. The 4GB RAM can feel a little limited when I have lots of tabs open, but I like that both the RAM and SSD can be upgraded. I’d recommend it for students or anyone needing a basic everyday laptop.

review_title: Excellent laptop and easy to use
body_en: I have been looking for a laptop for just surfing the Internet and keeping track of emails. I didn't want to spend a fortune because I just need it for basic things. This works great for me. It came well packaged. I love the size of it, 15.6 inches. The screen is nice and clear and easy to read. It is a touchscreen and that is good because I am used to using my phone like that. The battery lasts a long time also. I am really impressed with it. It is a good value for the money.

This is a fast and lightweight laptop with the look and feel of a high end device. The keyboard is large and durable. It feels sturdy while typing! Love the 10-key on this laptop as well. The track pad is also large and very responsive. The boot up is lightening quick and the screen is nice, bright, and crisp! The facial recognition to log in is really a nice feature. Setting up all my apps took no time at all. This is well worth the money!

Over all the laptop works good. Got it for a extra laptop, where my daughter uses my other one. Easy to setup up. Runs smooth, doesn't lag when going different web pages. One down side is have to sign in, have a account with Microsoft. You have to download it.

review_title: This no-frills laptop is doing its job good.
body_en: This laptop replaced a 14-year-old laptop. This is a low-cost, no-frills laptop and not very powerful, but it will do the job I need it for. I have a very powerful computer at home. But if I am away from home, this laptop will work for me. The setup right out of the box was fast and painless. Very good Size for the cost. The Speed is good if you don't need to run very powerful stuff to run on it. I was running Non-modded Minecraft just fine on it. Sound Quality and Durability are decent for a no-frills laptop like this. I give it an 8 out of 10 for a low-cost laptop. Can use some more RAM memory and a bigger hard drive capacity. Note: this laptop cannot be updated hardware-wise at all; it is what it is.

review_title: Good Everyday Laptop for Work and General Use

The FHD display provides a nice viewing experience for browsing, streaming, working on documents, and handling general tasks. I also like the larger screen size because it gives you more room to work compared with a smaller laptop. The design is straightforward and makes it easy to use for school, work, or home activities. Overall, it is a convenient everyday computer for users who need a larger display and a portable setup without something overly complicated.

I’ve been using the AE86 15.6" Laptop for a few weeks now, and I’m genuinely impressed. The Intel Core m3-8100Y processor performs surprisingly well—much better than the older i3-5005U it’s compared to. Paired with 16GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD, it handles multitasking, office work, streaming, and light photo editing with ease. The Full HD display is crisp and vibrant, and the inclusion of HDMI and USB-C ports makes connectivity a breeze. I also appreciate the long-lasting battery life—it gets me through a full workday without needing a charge. Getting Windows 11 Pro and MS Office 2024 pre-installed is a huge bonus—ready to go right out of the box! If you’re looking for a reliable, affordable, and well-equipped laptop, this one is a fantastic choice. Stylish in gray, fast, and packed with features—highly recommended!

body_en: This laptop is perfect for schoolwork. It is fast, light and has a good performance for programs like Word, Excel and Zoom. Highly recommended for students. Good battery life. It is ideal for schooling at home, taking to classes or studying abroad. The keyboard is comfortable for writing for long periods and the 15.6” screen has good quality for reading and watching videos. Excellent investment for students looking for efficiency and portability. It works smoothly, the American Megatrends BIOS is stable and easy to use.

review_title: A lightning fast laptop! Very good deal!
body_en: Being a PC guy that knows his stuff, I am very pleased with this refurbished laptop. It works like new. They wiped the HD and fresh installed Windows 11. No bloatware! However, you will need to install an anti-virus program. I recommend Avast free. I have been using it for a good 15 years with zero malware or virus infections, and it is 100% free. SPEEDY! I am also an emulator master. This little laptop runs the most power hungry games in MAMEUI64 at FULL SPEED WITHOUT ANY FRAME SKIPPING! I was amazed. It really is an awesome laptop. I will likely buy another one of these to keep in case. Works great with USB hubs and the HDMI is 1080p and looks great. A+A+A+

I am very pleased with the condition and function of this lap top. The battery is nearly full strength and there is no visible damage or indication of wear. They put a skin on the outside, I assume to cover any marks or scratches, but this computer is in such good shape, I doubt there could have been much. My only complaint is some bloat wear added for "PC app store" that commandeers the computer at first, literally blocking you from doing almost anything else until you open an account, CC and all. I managed to finally get past it to settings where I could go in and delete that app. It is not the same as the Microsoft app store. Other than that, it is almost undistinguishable from a new laptop. UPDATE: I really liked this laptop, the size was perfect and it seemed to be working like new. A couple of months later, it just stopped working. I don't know what happened, one minute it was working fine, the next it was dead. Black screen. Nothing. I had assure, so I sent it in and they couldn't fix it. If I didn't have assure, I would have been out for the whole thing. I m so glad I back up everything on an external drive. I recommend you do that also, no matter what computer you have!
Everything was as described. I am very satisfied with the quality and functionality of this laptop as well as the delivery time the packaging was also very appropriate.

Minor wear around the corners, more than I'd like, but that's expected in used laptop. Works great though! Still has a long battery life, and still getting used of the Windows 11 Pro. No cracks at all, all the keys work, fast and nice screen. Very affordable. So I like it.

Battery life is about 3 hours or so. Somtimes the screen won’t come on unless you plug it in and it will still be at 50 percent battery. review_title: Dell Latitude - I was expecting better
body_en: I actually purchased 2 of these laptops, both advertised to be in excellent condition, which they were. I love the touch screen, size and weight of this laptop, but not so enchanted with the battery life, which on full charge only lasts a max of 2 hours or so. Both laptops have the 43Wh battery which I upgraded to 63Wh thinking my battery life would significantly improve, but that did not happen. That's okay though because I am only on about an hour a day anyway. However, why the 1 start rating is that both these laptops continually freeze up, which is terribly frustrating. And when they freeze, the only resolution is to power the off the laptop and re-boot. I don't like unreliable laptops and unfortunately I have found both of mine are exactly that. Sadly, for medical reasons, I did not start to use these laptops until after the return date expired, otherwise, they would have been returned. I have purchased other refurbished laptops from Amazon and they have all been excellent purchases. I guess I was due to run into a couple of lemons.

This computer was fine until it reached 50% battery, which happened in approximately 50 minutes. After that the battery drained very quickly, it hardly lasted 15 minutes on. I made the return at the beginning of February and it has not proceeded. Don't buy it, skip the whole process

review_title: Compact and Convenient for Basic Everyday Tasks
body_en: I use this Dell Latitude 3190 for basic everyday tasks, and it works well for what I need. The compact size makes it easy to carry, and the 2-in-1 design is convenient because I can use it as either a laptop or a tablet. The touchscreen is responsive, and it works well for browsing, emails, schoolwork, documents, and watching videos. The keyboard is comfortable for its size, and the laptop feels sturdy. It is not designed for heavy gaming or demanding programs, but for simple work and everyday use, it is a practical and affordable option.

review_title: Best laptop with touchscreen capabilities you could find for the price.
body_en: I bought this on a huge budget in need for something to use for classes, and I have to say this thing shocked me for it's price. It has a great battery life (although I can't quote how long exactly due to memory). Amazing tablet function with touch capability. Plenty of storage for daily class use. Very slim. Extremely durable. And while it's power cable is outdated a bit, it's also very durable. Very fast response for a small machine. I love it's foldable feature to make it a tablet that's not too bad to carry, you can even fold the screen at an angle to use the keyboard as a stand for the tablet function and the keys will automatically disable when folded past 90° (after making sure to update to the latest OS version). It's got good display and quality. One of the best laptops I've ever had. I wish more products were this thoughtful in longevity. I'm honestly amazed with this machine for the price especially. Couldn't be happier.

review_title: Dell Latitude 3190 11.6-inch 2-in-1 touchscreen laptop is compact
body_en: The Dell Latitude 3190 11.6-inch 2-in-1 touchscreen laptop is compact, versatile, and convenient for school, travel, or everyday tasks. Its convertible design lets you switch between laptop and tablet modes, making it a practical choice for browsing, streaming, note-taking, and light productivity.

Received laptop fairly quick and I love it. I'm not a tech savy person,so I'm not going to speak to all that,but let me say, this is the perfect size for someone who is planning on traveling overseas to use. review_title: Good Laptop At A Fair Price
body_en: For the price, this laptop gets a 5 star rating. Well, more like 4.5 but I couldn't give it that. It's a good sized laptop with a clear screen. It's pretty darn fast and it looks pretty sharp. Speakers are decent but not mind-blowing and for what it's worth, it has a camera, which is, again, passable, not mind-blowing. The keyboard on the one I got is more of a darker grey (it's advertised as ash grey, which I believe is a lighter color) but I actually like the darker keyboard better. Typing on the keyboard is pretty smooth too. It could use one or two more outlets on the sides though. You only get one USB Type-A port, one USB Type-C port and a headphone jack. Fine if you're more of a minimalist, but not ideal for multi-tasking work. Also, a little tip; When powering on, all you need to do is press the power button, NOT press and hold. I didn't realize that at first and thought initially that their was a problem. Just a piece of advice. Overall, it's a good laptop, at a fair price and should work well for the "Average Joe". I just got it, so the only question I have is, how long will it last? Hopefully it lasts me quite a while. But we'll see. I also got one of the recommended carrying cases for it, but that's another review for another time. Overall Rating: 4.5/5 stars.

review_title: Great! Love! Saved my business emergency
body_en: I bought this as an emergency overnight purchase when our business technology was compromised. I needed a fresh OS, that would run on a T-mobile hotspot, as soon as possible. This came overnight and was plug and play. This low priced Chromebook synced to my bookmarks and passwords through Chrome, and allowed many individual password protected passwords for separate already existing Chrome accounts. Paired with a cheap HP printer, a cheap wireless mouse, an already owned barcode reader, allowed my business back to production within 18 hours. Only two usb ports, but shifted seamlessly to another when connected. Not lightning fast, but for my need, that did not matter. I am beyond impressed.

The disassembly of the device is very very simple, remove the screws from the bottom of the case and the case pops off, might need a thin tool to pry the case off a bit (only con here) and you'll see the ram and the hard drive and the nvme along with the fans which make it easy for upgrades and cleaning. (I like to watch disassembly videos in case something happened, that way I can tear into it and hopefully fix the issue.) The ram is decent for 12 gigs, a 4 gig stick and an 8 gig stick, but I plan on upgrading the ram soon. Now after uninstalling a few things and setting windows to use less resources, I idle at about 18-19% which isn't bad at all, depends on what you do though. I do believe the manufacturer specifications have tested up to 16 gigs of 2666 on the board, however; there are cases with other omen laptops, where you can plop in 16 gigs in each dimm slot for a total of 32 gigs, wouldn't recommend it because it's not officially supported, but I will go ahead and try it (making sure i'm at the latest bios update from hp), and will provide an additional review/update. (I like to run a lot of things at once.) The processor is very nice, windows shows that i have 4 physical cpus and 8 logical processors, and I idle at 0% after turning the thing on (which mine booted into windows less than 3 seconds with the nvme 128 gig harddrive). I plan on upgrading the nvme from 128 gigs to 1 terabyte, might clone the drive or just grab a fresh install of windows 10 and slap it on a usb drive and fresh install, go from there. From what I read on the specification sheet for the dc0010nr, I think a cap of 512 Gigs nvme was officially tested and supported, but I'm going another 512 and see how the machine fairs. The 1 terabyte hard drive isn't slow at all, but I have nothing on it but a few games and some music, I constantly keep it defragged. The sound on the laptop is definitely an upgrade from my old hp g62 via software and hardware, but i use headphones into the 3.5mm jacks for mic and playback anyways. when it comes to gaming: Doom 2016 gives about 100 to 130fps on 1080p, ultra + open glide settings.... battlefield 1 on 1080p ultra gives about 45+ on mp and 60+ sp, drop it to high and it gives about 60+ but it depends on what map and what all is going on via gameplay. The heat on the laptop isn't bad, the machine will get warm and the fans will kick into high gear almost like a delay, but there is absolutely no throttling and when i'm finished with my gaming, the fans kick off to silent almost immediately. Also with the gpu, this is a verified gtx 1050 ti with 4096MB of vram in it. Final note: I think it's worth what I payed for: 799.99. If my desktop crashes and burns, it's a great replacement for it. It absolutely destroys solitaire and minesweeper along with other office products like excel spread-sheeting and you're in need for a couple of Pareto diagrams or 3 point beta distributions to resolve employee padding with P.M.O affairs making sure the stakeholders are happy. Alas I digress... I unboxed it, i pressed the power button and it immediately shot into windows and was ready to go. :)

review_title: Samsung Galaxy Chromebook Go — Affordable, Lightweight, and Built for Basic Computing
body_en: The Galaxy Chromebook Go is exactly what it appears to be: an affordable Chromebook designed for web-based work, education, and everyday tasks. It is not a performance machine, but for the right user it delivers a reliable and straightforward experience. The biggest strengths are portability and simplicity. The laptop is lightweight, easy to carry, and boots quickly. ChromeOS remains one of the easiest operating systems to maintain, making this a good choice for students, casual users, or anyone who primarily works in a browser. Battery life is another positive. In normal use, it easily gets through a day of web browsing, email, document editing, and video streaming without constantly searching for a charger. The 14-inch display provides a comfortable amount of screen space for schoolwork and everyday tasks. While the resolution and color quality won't compete with premium laptops, it is perfectly adequate for browsing, Google Docs, YouTube, and video calls. The integration with Android phones is convenient, particularly for users already invested in the Google ecosystem. File transfers, notifications, and cloud synchronization work smoothly. Performance is where expectations need to be realistic. The Intel Celeron processor and 4GB of RAM handle basic tasks well enough, but heavy multitasking can slow things down. Running numerous browser tabs, streaming video, and using multiple applications simultaneously will push the system to its limits. Storage is limited at 64GB, although ChromeOS relies heavily on cloud services, which helps offset the smaller local storage capacity. For users who primarily work online, this is less of a concern than it would be on a traditional Windows laptop. The build quality is respectable for the price point. It feels durable enough for student use, travel, and everyday carrying. The lightweight design makes it easy to toss into a backpack without much thought. Overall, the Galaxy Chromebook Go is a practical budget laptop that performs well within its intended role. If you need a device for web browsing, email, schoolwork, streaming, and cloud-based productivity, it offers good value. Just don't expect the speed, multitasking ability, or storage capacity of a higher-end laptop.

The Amazon Fire TV Soundbar offers a decent audio upgrade for those looking to improve their TV's built-in sound without breaking the bank. Dolby Audio, along with the convenience of Fire TV integration. However, it's important to have realistic expectations given its price point. What's Good: Easy Setup: Connecting the soundbar is a breeze, especially if you already have a Fire TV device. The setup process is guided and intuitive. Fire TV Integration: This is a major selling point. Seamlessly controlling the soundbar with your Fire TV remote is incredibly convenient. No juggling multiple remotes! Improved Sound over TV Speakers: The soundbar definitely provides a noticeable improvement in clarity and depth compared to most television speakers. Dialogue is clearer, and the overall soundstage is wider. Compact Size: The soundbar's slim profile fits nicely under most TVs without being intrusive. Affordable Price: This is a budget-friendly option for those wanting better sound without a huge investment. Bluetooth Connectivity: The ability to stream music wirelessly from your phone or other Bluetooth devices is a welcome addition. What's Not So Good: Limited Bass: Being a 2.0 system, the bass response is somewhat lacking. While it adds some low-end presence, it won't satisfy those looking for deep, rumbling bass for action movies or music. Consider a subwoofer if bass is a priority. Virtual Surround Sound: While DTS Virtual:X and Dolby Audio are present, the simulated surround sound effect is subtle. Don't expect a truly immersive experience. It provides a slightly wider soundstage, but it's not a replacement for a dedicated surround sound system. Sound Quality Could Be Better: While better than TV speakers, the overall sound quality is adequate, not exceptional. The mid-range can sometimes sound a bit muddy. Limited Connectivity: The soundbar primarily focuses on Fire TV integration. While it has Bluetooth, it lacks other input options like HDMI ARC, which could limit its versatility. Overall: The Amazon Fire TV Soundbar is a good entry-level soundbar for those primarily focused on improving the audio from their Fire TV and who are on a budget. The seamless Fire TV integration and improved dialogue clarity are its strongest points. However, if you're a serious audiophile or crave powerful bass, you'll likely need to spend more for a higher-end system. This soundbar is best suited for casual viewers who want a simple and affordable upgrade to their TV's built-in speakers.

In fact, I couldn't even switch them off normally. Even with nothing connected, I switch them off and still get sound pushed through. I kept trying to fix it. What I had to do was: 1) Settings 2) HDMI-CEC control 3) Switch One Touch Play off 4) Turn off Soundbar 5) Set Volume to 0 6) Turn Soundbar back on That seem to let the soundbar function independently, get rid of the echoing, and get everything to work as described. The downside, the volume will only go up and down at 2 intervals despite what I set it to internally. And, there is no easy way to switch between the TV and sound bar for audio without screwing up the good result I got after working all day on it. Also, make sure you plug into your first HDMI port/Arc port. I had my gaming console set up and didn't realize my intital issue of no sound was the fact that I needed to swap the ports. Frankly, being an Amazon soundbar with and Amazon TV that specifically has a set up for it. I would say the functionality kind of sucks because it it should just work, like it says it should, by following the instructions without having to search up and down for way to keep both audios from playing. Like, the setting say the internal speakers were off despite being a lie and that setting effected nothing. It made it more difficult them it needed to get it to work somewhat normally. I would prefer to set it so volume interval is 1 but I guess to make this usable I am stuck at 2 everytime. And, I better hope that nothing changes and messes it up again in a update to the TV. The sound itself is a improvement, and there is a marked difference between regular and surround sound. It sort of like watching TV versus going to a theater. It terms of the way it fills the room and hits your ear. I can't say that the movie, music, dialogue settings seem to different to me. The size is okay. It just tall enough to not block my screen. The length is just about the size of my dresser. Depth is about 3.5 inches so as long as you have another room in front or to push back your TV, you will be fine. Overall, it is nice but I am not sure if I am total happy I bought it considering it was almost $90 for what I would categorize as works okay. I feel like for that price, and the fact I specifically bought Amazon for the fact I thought it would better with fire tv, that I am not blown away. Happy for now, but not impressed.

Lastly, and most bothersome, whenever there is a power blip, I have to perform what is called an HDMI handshake. I have to unplug the HDMI cable from both the tv and the speaker, turn everything off, wait 30 seconds, and then reconnect and turn the volume extremely high before it kicks back in. I love being able to ask for the weather, set timers and reminders, play music, and get answers without having to pick up my phone. Setup gave me a little trouble at first, but once I got it connected to Wi-Fi, everything worked perfectly. The Alexa app makes it easy to customize and add features, too. It’s a great little device for the price, and I’m very pleased with it. Definitely

I absolutely love my Echo Dot! The setup was quick and easy, and Alexa responds very fast to my commands. The sound quality is excellent for such a compact speaker—clear, loud, and perfect for music. I use it for alarms, reminders, weather updates, music, and controlling my smart devices at home. It has made my daily routine so much easier and more convenient. The design is also modern and looks great anywhere in the house. I’m extremely happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend it! 5 stars!

We have two Amazon Alexas in our house, and somehow they’ve both ended up living in my 5-year-old’s room! 😂 He is absolutely obsessed with them. As an only child, he loves to role-play with Alexa, and it’s been wonderful for encouraging his imagination, expanding his vocabulary, reinforcing good manners, and giving him someone besides Mom to talk to throughout the day. Every parent knows the constant “Hey Mom!” moments, so hearing “Hey Alexa!” every now and then gives me a chance to get a few things done around the house. I was able to snag this Echo in Used – Like New condition for more than half off the regular price, and I jumped on it as soon as I saw it. I’m so glad I did! I also purchased the wireless battery base, and now my son carries Alexa around the house like a little friend, making sure it’s included in all of his adventures! Even after buying the battery base, I still spent about what I would have paid for a brand-new Echo Dot, so I feel like I got an incredible deal. The condition truly lived up to the “Like New” description. It arrived in excellent shape with no signs of wear at all. While it didn’t come in the original retail box, it was packaged securely in an Amazon box and worked perfectly right out of the package. My only minor complaint, and this is just me being picky, is that the power cord is white even though I ordered the black Echo. Since we’re using the wireless battery base, it doesn’t affect us right now, but it might bother me a little if I ever decide to plug it directly into the wall. Even so, for the price I paid, it’s a very small issue. I’m a frequent shopper of Amazon’s Used – Like New products because I’ve consistently had great experiences, and this purchase was no exception. If you’re considering buying one in Like New condition, I definitely recommend it!

I’m really happy with the Amazon Echo Dot. It’s compact but surprisingly useful, and the sound quality is good for its size. Setup was quick and easy, and Alexa responds well to commands. I love being able to use it for music, timers, reminders, and controlling compatible smart devices. Overall, it’s a convenient little smart speaker and a great addition to my home.

review_title: Alexa hears me clearly and responds quickly. Great sound, easy to use, and I’m very happy with it!
body_en: I’m very happy with my Amazon Echo Dot. The sound is clear and surprisingly powerful for such a small speaker. Alexa responds quickly and makes it easy to play music, set alarms and reminders, check the weather, and more. It was also very easy to set up. The design is nice and fits perfectly in any room. I definitely recommend it!

review_title: Multi-Music Player mystery solved, how to select more than one echo if you cannot
body_en: Alexa Echo Speakers Multi-room Music issues I found a solution to not being able to get more than one speaker to work at a time, paired, or set up a “Multi-Room Music” in the Alexa app. This solution also fixed my inability to get Apple enabled devices connected into HomeKit, or even Google Nest Hubs to set up, period. Quick answer: Deselect “Enable Wireless Isolation” when activating your 2.4 Wi-Fi broadcast on your router. I also took all speakers off guest wifi. But I’ll try to put them back to see if that is necessary now. Back story: Months of issues with HomeKit, (only weeks with Echo Multi-Room Music), I gave up trying and decided to try Alexa and Google to replace my Apple smart home efforts. I spent way too much time. After the fix, I’ll live a blended tech life. I’ll give a quick answer, followed by my backstory: Last week I was at my wits end in utter frustration over three major roadblocks. I acquiesced and decided to try Alexa because I couldn’t get almost any of my Apple HomeKit enabled devices into HomeKit, except for new Apple products. I knew it had to be something small I was missing. Alexa was sooooo easy and quick to connect to everything, before I figured out the fix. (I dislike the echo show advertising, their echo speakers are better.) While they seemed a breeze to connect everything, for some reason I couldn’t get more than one echo speaker to work at a time. I was continually blocked from setting up Multi-Room Music or even connect a pair to play together. Hundreds of tries. I deleted, reset, rebooted, spent over 4 hours with Comcast yesterday (thankfully a Boston native who did not put me on hold every minute like certain countries) getting my internet working again. I had rebooted my modem and router so many times, my computer got molasses slow and I feared I went too far In interest I also decided to try a few Google nest hub speakers. Black Friday had great sales on all this stuff. Trying to set up googles hub 7 was impossible. It wouldn’t stay connected to the internet for more than a split second before “Something went wrong” message. Probably over 70 tries. (Google is better than Echo Show. Apple HomePod mini sounds crisper and better than Amazon echo 4 and mini 5’s. But Alexa is way friendlier to interact with verbally, and price point, well...) Frustration. Thursday, I broke down and bought my first Apple Homepod Mini to see if I can get that working and see if it works better than the Apple TV 4k Ethernet connection. The HomePod mini gave me a hint how to solve all these l connection and internet blocks. The HomePod mini kept telling me that I don’t have “peer-to-peer connection” allowed on my network. Now, I’m a little techy, but it took three days (ehem, months) to finally take a chance on a for granted setting I always enable on my netgear router. It’s the blasted first Wireless page when enabling a wifi broadcast. I had to deselect “Enable Wireless Isolation.” That was it. It solved every issue I have come across with smart home tech for the last 4 months, ..year. For the months that I could not solve these problems, Amazons Multi-Player Music issue made me dig deeper. I did not find anyone suggesting this particular router setting, so I thought I’d share with ppl. Tonight, I finally am able to simultaneously play music on all of my Echo speakers, connect my HomeKit enabled and Google nest hubs. I’m not sure what this will do for my/your internet security. But I’m going with it for now. And I’ll try to put all devices back onto guest Wi-Fi. I’ll never really leave Apple, but after interacting with other smart speakers, it’s probably not going to be my main go to for speaker or answers to questions. Or I’ll just get too creeped out by Google and Amazon invasiveness and acquiesce with Apple instead. Echo Dot 5 (this is such a sprite, great speaker!) Echo 4 are my favorite for Amazon Echo Echo Studio seems the least smart, most deaf, quiet, combative, difficult to interact with, of the three speakers. Hopefully the Multi-Room music fix will improve my experience with it Echo Show 8 Meh. Far too much and annoying advertising of non-solicited or wanted advertisements. Least user friendly screen to work with. It sits unplugged for the most part. I mostly got this for a friend who visits who wants a YouTube fireplace playing on the tv. SIDE NOTE on other Smart Home Amazon (online, or physical store) products, related to this topic: I have been pleased with Smartbot plugs, switches and app, the Levoit 600s air purifiers and app (app goes by VeSync), and Lutron Caséta Light Switches and Dimmers, and hub. Lutron has the most stable and reliable app out there. I was fine running their apps separately. They are very nice, better than the big 3 apps. Well, back to listening to music throughout my house instead of one or two rooms. Joy!

review_title: Amazing for controlling different smart lights brands
body_en: I bought the Echo Dot mainly to control my smart lights, and it has been amazing. I have both Govee and Kasa lights set up, and now I can simply ask Alexa to turn them on or off without having to open multiple apps on my phone. The setup process was quick and straightforward, and Alexa recognized all of my devices easily. I’ve also created routines so my lights automatically turn on and off at certain times, which has made my daily routine much more convenient. The sound quality is surprisingly good for such a small device, but the biggest benefit for me is the smart home integration. If you have smart lights or other smart devices, the Echo Dot is definitely worth it and makes everything feel much more seamless.

review_title: How easy and convenient Alexa is to use every day.
body_en: I’m really happy with my Alexa! It’s easy to set up and very convenient to use. I love being able to play music, set reminders, ask questions, check the weather, and control different things with just my voice. The sound quality is great for its size, and it has become a very useful part of my daily routine. Definitely recommend it!

review_title: Great Quality Speaker at an Amazing Price
body_en: I am extremely impressed with this Bluetooth speaker! The sound quality is much better than I expected for the price — clear audio, great volume, and strong bass without any distortion. The build quality feels premium, and it has a sleek design that makes it perfect for home, travel, or outdoor use. The Bluetooth connection is quick and reliable, and the battery life has been excellent. It’s easy to use, portable, and delivers the performance of a much more expensive speaker. This is a great value purchase and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a high-quality Bluetooth speaker without spending a fortune!

review_title: Great sound in a compact speaker!
body_en: I was pleasantly surprised by the sound quality of this speaker. It’s compact and easy to take anywhere, but it gets plenty loud without sounding distorted. Bluetooth connected quickly and stayed connected without any issues. The battery life has been great, and it’s perfect for listening to music around the house, outside, or on the go. The build quality feels solid, and it’s an excellent value for the price. I would definitely recommend it!

This is a powerful speaker, despite its small size. It connects easily to other wireless devices. The battery lasts a long time on one charge. You sound is clear and rich. We have used this speaker for approximately a year, and we highly recommend it.

Functions well. Speaker is loud enough, though sound is ok. It does not have good sound balance. Pretty much zero on the bass profile. High-Mids, and highs good enough. Connection via bluetooth works perfect. Unit appears well built. But, for the money it performs very well. Just don't think you are getting a JBL comparable product at 1/5 the price because you aren't.

review_title: Excellent Sound for the Price – Perfect Travel and Beach Speaker
body_en: I bought this speaker after comparing several options and I’m really happy with the purchase. For around $24, I honestly don’t think you can ask for much more. The biggest surprise was the sound quality. It’s much louder than I expected for such a compact speaker and had no problem competing with beach noise, nearby conversations, and other people playing music. The audio stayed clear even at higher volumes, making it perfect for the beach, the pool, or outdoor gatherings. Another feature I really appreciated was the waterproof design. The rubber cover that protects the charging port gives extra peace of mind around sand and splashing water, which is exactly where I used it the most. It’s a small detail that makes a big difference for outdoor use. The speaker is also very lightweight and easy to pack. It fit perfectly in my beach bag without taking up much space, so it’s a great travel companion for vacations, camping, or weekends by the water. Pairing with my phone was quick and easy, the controls are straightforward, and the battery lasted long enough that I never had to worry about it during the day. The optional light effects are a fun bonus, especially for evening gatherings, and you can turn them off if you want to save battery. Overall, this is one of those products that delivers more than you expect for the price. It combines good sound quality, portability, durability, and useful features into a very affordable package. I would definitely buy it again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable Bluetooth speaker without spending a lot of money. Excellent value and highly recommended!

review_title: Expecting disappointment and I was wrong! Highly recommend!
body_en: I was expecting disappointment, but was pleasantly surprised! I got is super cheap with on a deal, and was expecting it to feel and sound cheap. I like it! Not high end sound, but I put it next to me so I can hear the TV better, while the rest of the house is asleep. Bass is surprising. Holding it, it feels solid and not cheaply made at all. I'm thinking of getting a second, and they will sync up.

review_title: Functionality, quality for price in general. Must Buy For Any Outdoorzy Ones! ROCK IT, BABY!
body_en: Excellent for price, durability, ease of functions, sound quality!

So at the coupon price of $16 this little speaker is a great value. I use it with hook and loop tape to attach to cart wilst golfing. The bass is a low level output at all volumes, however sound from unit can get quite loud. The light only fades from color to color (not synced to music) and can be turned off for longer battery life. It does come with a quick start up guide, charging cable and a small lanyard to hang/wear with. A thought, if having trouble with paring or a speaker freeze, long press power button for 8 seconds to reset. With all that said, I totally would recommend it for the value, and no worries if it gets damaged from misuse. Get it at a discount/coupon price.

I received it today and since the time it arrived I have been putting it on the charger because I thought the battery was empty and until now it has been 5 hours and every time I start playing music it turns off. I think that those who wrote comments belong to the seller.
Very excellent, great bass sound
Good sound and good battery life. It would be desirable if you could choose whether the lights turn on or not....
Ease of connection and long battery life. Sound is loud and clear.

OMG!! I love this portable blue tooth speaker for my laptop. The sound is great! I love the pretty pink speaker. The size is perfect. Let me mention the different colors of lights that change colors on top. I'm so excited to be able to hear what is going on on my laptop. Great value for the $. The battery life is awesome. Connected right away and the functionality was no joke. The volume is on point. I'm glad I finally made this purchase. I highly recommend.

Great product! It’s really loud, even at half volume! You can even feel the base and see it because of the pulse feature. It’s small enough to fit in your hand so it’s great for traveling with. It connected to my phone right away, no issues. The battery life lasts hours! Definitely worth the cost!

review_title: Cute, loud and super functional speaker!
body_en: My favourite speaker ever!! I love the pink. It always works super well for me and is great for parties because it can be really loud. I also love being able to super easily adjust volume and pausing it from the speaker without getting my phone out. Its battery lasts me probably a month even while using for hours every weekend and it stays connected to my Bluetooth until I turn it off. Overall an amazing speaker for a great price!

The Portable Bluetooth Speaker is perfect for the beach, camping, or any outdoor adventure. It delivers surprisingly clear sound with strong bass for its size, and the Bluetooth connection is quick and reliable. The battery lasts for hours, and the compact, portable design makes it easy to take anywhere. Great value for a fun and durable outdoor speaker!

I can't comment on the long term reliability or various other factors but I just got this. I fired it up and it paired very simply and can be LOUD and is very clear. Would absolutely buy again. I hope it does last a long time.

Small but so POWERFUL! Has great sound and easy to use! Hooks right up to my phone and was able to control it through that. Has small suction type under the speaker and it was able to stick to the table and not worry about it falling over. Had it since the beginning of the summer and have not had to charge it as of yet! Great loud sound as well! If you really wanted it loud, you can increase volume on the speaker and then on the phone as well!!

review_title: Yes, it gives room filling VOLUME!
body_en: For those of you who might have the same question as I had before purchasing this: How is the max volume? Is it loud enough? YES! YES! It will easily fill a 10 FT by 10 FT room. And sound is clear and bass is good for its size! Back in 2008-2009, I used the Soundmatters foxL that was like $250. Since then, these little portable speakers evolved, price went down, but performance went up. I don’t have much need for portable speaker these days so last one I used was JBL Flip5. And JBL really shines on Bass. I can tell you that perhaps clarity of this PulseSound is on par or even better than JBL. However, the Bass is below JBL Flip5. But here is the catch, this PulseSound costs way less than JBL. I am very satisfied with this product and highly recommend it.
Great little speaker for the price and size. Very easy to use. Very good sound quality. Easy functionality, compact to go anywhere. Compatibility was easy to connect.

review_title: Ultimate Outdoor Powerhouse – Incredible Bass and Battery Life!
body_en: I am absolutely blown away by the Soundcore Boom 2. If you are looking for the perfect outdoor speaker, this is it. ​Sound Quality & Bass: The sound profile is incredibly crisp, but the star of the show is the "BassUp" feature. For a speaker this size, the bass hits remarkably deep without distorting the mids or highs. It easily fills a large backyard or noisy beach area. ​Design & Portability: The built-in handle makes it super easy to grab and go. It feels rugged, well-built, and durable enough to handle drops or outdoor elements. The synced LED lights on the side are a fun touch for evening hangouts. ​Battery Life & Waterproofing: The battery life is phenomenal—it easily lasts through a full weekend trip on a single charge. Plus, the IPX7 waterproof rating gives me total peace of mind by the pool. It even floats if it accidentally drops in the water! ​App Integration: I highly recommend downloading the Soundcore app. The customizable EQ lets you fine-tune the sound exactly to your liking, which elevates the experience even further. ​Bottom Line: Anker has outdone themselves. It offers premium, booming sound at a fraction of the price of its competitors. Highly recommended!

review_title: Good sound with deep bass, lightweight and many more awesome features
body_en: The Anker Soundcore Boom 2 is a serious contender in the portable speaker game. It’s super well-built with premium materials and packs a punch with loud, crisp sound and surprisingly deep bass. Bluetooth pairing is seamless and instant, and despite all that power, it’s remarkably lightweight and easy to carry around. Since it’s waterproof, you can take it anywhere without stressing whether you're by the pool, beach or at a party with friends. Plus, the battery life holds up for hours even with the extra bass button cranked, and the Soundcore app is a huge bonus in my opinion, letting you tune your audio with a customizable EQ, tweak the LED light show, and keep the speaker running smoothly with firmware updates. Love it and recommended to y'all.

review_title: It’s not Bose..but it’s REALLY close.
body_en: This portable bluetooth speaker is AMAZING!! It fit in my carryon backpack and was perfect for a trip to the beach! So easy to use and it a a cool LED light show on each end of the speaker. Held a charge for my whole vacation! Plenty of powerful bass and strong mids and highs! I want to get another one as you can link tgem up in party mode!! Its not Bose, but it’s REALLY close!!

Makes hanging in the backyard so much more fun. Bass definitely hits rights and the way it pairs with my galaxy s25 ultra is lovely. A match made in heaven. Its easy the operate, if you can't figure it out return it and buy some paper cups and strings. Batteries last long and the build quality is a1.

Wow! I just ordered this for $85 and I’m blown away. This sounds better than any of the smaller Bose speakers I’ve had over the years. It has plenty of base and I can’t imagine most people ever needing anything louder. I think it looks nice, and the lights are sort of cool, although I don’t imagine I’ll use them much. The fact it’s fairly small and waterproof only adds to the value. I also just saw you can pair two speakers together to get stereo sound with separate right and left channels! Most people may not care about this but for me having portable stereo sound would be amazing. l just ordered a second one and I’ll update after I try it. No matter what happens, this is a steal at $85 and probably still a bargain at regular price.

Bought this as audio and some lights for my golf cart. Its pretty nice. Not as loud as I wanted, but thats just me. Its plenty loud though. Bass boost works well. Lights are cool. Battery is definitely good. Sat outside overnight in a light rain and it wasnt an issue. Well built.

I work as a grill cook, which means I’m in a very noisy environment. So I need a speaker that is very loud. And I can say this speaker gets very loud for its size, but is never harsh on the ears, like some other speakers which leave an almost ringing in your ears after a high note. And it does not distort at max volume which is a plus for me. I used to have a 50w Rave Neo from soundcore, until recently when I sold it to a coworker who was in need of a good speaker. I had it for nearly 5 years. When I had it, I was constantly getting compliments on how impressive that speaker sounded. So I decided to buy another speaker from Anker since it’s quality I can trust. Comparing to the 50w Rave Neo, both with bass boost, and boom 2 out of box sound profile. The boom 2 gets louder than the rave Neo, however gets a little “muddier” at high volumes, while the rave Neo keeps a fuller sound. Probably due to the fact the boom 2 is missing a full range driver, and only has tweeters and a racetrack “subwoofer”. However does not matter in my use case. The battery life seems the same, after 3 hours of use at high volumes with bass on, I only used 40% of the battery on the boom 2, while I also used 40% of the rave Neo. Portability goes to the Boom 2. It is only the length of a ruler, height of 3/4 of a ruler, and is fairly slim. so it fits on any standard sized table easily, it also weighs less than half what the rave Neo weighs. The rave Neo felt like a workout carrying it work, while the boom 2 is easily carried by one finger. I also give appearances to the boom 2. The metal grill on the boom 2 feels very rugged and is much superior to the metal grill on the rave Neo. Both plastics feel the same as well, however it does seem the boom 2 is more vulnerable to scuffs and marks as I already have a scuff on the boom 2 with only 3 hours of use, while I have never gotten a scuff on the rave Neo. The LIGHTSHOW. The boom 2 is amazing to watch as it lights up and moves the radiators to the music. Very nice touch since I never really enjoyed the lights on the rave Neo. The rave Neo was also impressive, but the diffusion on the boom 2 looks very premium. Charging. Both charge with an input of usb type c. However, with the rave Neo, you had to use a usb type A charging block, which was super annoying because I have been trying to get away from usb type a, and micro usb. Type c charging blocks and cords are worlds superior. And the boom 2 can charge from any type c charging block. Sound. The boom 2 is loud. It is not audiophile quality. But if you plan on sticking it in the corner of the room or on the outside of a basketball court, you might not feel or hear every instrument or every vocal chord in a singers throat, but I guarantee you will be satisfied with the volume of music you are receiving from this speaker, which does sound very pleasant at least, which is what this speaker is meant to do. Get loud, so you can listen to music while you are doing other activities. I highly recommend higher end soundcore speakers, can’t go wrong.

review_title: Big sound from a small box
body_en: I’m very happy with the volume and fullness of the sound coming from this little box. I bought this for outside on the patio and around the pool. I had been using a Bose Flex, which was great for indoor near-field listening, but a little weak for outside. This Boom 2 gets plenty loud enough to reach the pool half way across the yard at a comfortable listening level, and it can easily get loud enough to annoy the neighbors. Music is full and clear - the bass won’t rattle the furniture, which I never expected from a box this size, but there’s plenty of it for casual listening and small outdoor gatherings, for which this guy is perfect. Bluetooth connection to my iPhone is flawless; once it’s paired, you just need to turn it on and it automatically connects. The Soundcore app is easy enough to use if you need it, which I usually don’t. I just turn it on and start the music on my phone, and the party is on. USB-C charging is convenient, because almost every gadget I have uses it now, so there are plenty of charging points around the house.

Incredible, the sound is terrible, much better than Sony srx, very pretty, very easy to use, the GSM recharge function as well. To see in the long term if it is reliable... Perfect packaging... I love it, incredible value for money

review_title: Ben çok düşündüm siz fazla düşünmeyin !..
body_en: It is very difficult to find a product in this price range and with this sound quality. As someone who uses Motion +, this is revolutionary. What can I say about paying more than necessary for well-known brands when this device is available? It is impossible to increase the sound above 50% in a home environment!..
It gives a very satisfactory sound. Reasonable price compared to its equivalents

review_title: Un son monstrueu pour un petit gabarit !
body_en: The materials are robust, very simple and refined design pleasant to look at. For the size, the sound is really excellent (true stereo): very present bass, but never too excessive, giving depth to the sound and a nice roundness. The mids are very pleasant, the voices are very well reproduced and natural. Power is important: certainly, we are far from true 80w, but there is a lot of volume. Can be used without problem even outdoors, in large spaces, as well as at home to listen to music at low volume, enjoying a pleasant and round sound. The battery lasts a very long time, especially when you turn off the lights, a nice gadget but not very useful. Overall: excellent product, so much so that I ordered a second one, by pairing the two speakers we achieve a maximum power of 160 w for a maximum value of 200€ (2 times 99€) very profitable. Excellent for watching a movie on a tablet. Versatile speaker that is suitable for all uses and all spaces. Way above the same range JBL brand, lighter, cheaper and better sound. Two small negative points (but really because I'm annoying) there is no possibility of plugging in a USB key, micro SD card or jack socket, too bad and no notch to put a strap. You can purchase it and you will not be disappointed.

Good base. Good price. Good bluetooth speaker. 10/10. If your on a budget a must have while on sale. I bought 2 for stereo mode while watching 120 inch projector at my room. Like watching movies in cinema cuz of boom base

review_title: A real powerhouse of a speaker.
body_en: I originally got this speaker to play in the shower. I have since moved to playing it in my garage, outside when doing yard work, and in my car when I want to connect to my songs without having to connect to my car audio. It is very loud, the battery last for yours, and it is very easy to carry around. I love this thing. Pros - Sound Quality – is excellent. It is a lot loader than I thought it would be. Can play in your car and it matches the best sound system I have ever heard in a car. Sound is crisp with voice, thumping with bass, treble, tones, and other variables. The lights are neat, but I got if and kept it for the sound output. - Quality – nicely built. Heavy material which adds to the bass. I use it in the shower, so I know condensation is not an issue. Have not taken it in water, you will have to let me know how that goes. - Value for the money – you get a lot of sound for your buck. If all speakers this size plays like this, then you can only get the same, not better. - Connectivity – connected easily to my phone on the first attempt. Now I only have to turn it on and it connects every time. - Portability – Love the cord that comes with it. I am able to hang it in the shower or on a hook in the garage. I also take it outside in the yard and dust and bugs don’t affect it. - Battery life – the battery last a very, very, very, very...did I mention “very” long time? Well it does! I also like that it lets you know when the battery is going low. - Reliability – has been working perfectly since I got it. Never had an issue with it turning on or connecting. - Volume – it is very loud. Cons - None

I have one I got from someone else. Have been using it for nearly three years. The other day it was turning itself off every few songs even when plugged in like it was powering down and the lights quit working. I looked it up to see if buying a new one was an option. I can’t believe these are only $30. From what I got out of the other one, and how it sounds, I figured it’d be $70-80 for a new one. New purple one came today. Highly recommend at this price point for sure. Always connects right to my phone, always had a long battery life unplugged, great sound for the size, and versatile due to compactness and alleged waterproofing. I dropped it prolly a hundred times, threw it at the wall once or twice. Lasted me three years and wasn’t brand new when I got it. I rarely leave reviews… this one I had to. If you have read this far, I recommend using the eq button on the speaker as well as an eq on whatever app you’re playing music through. No a 30 dollar speaker isn’t going to play standard eq well. You have to cut mids out a few decibels to get clear bass and highs. Simple way to make this speaker sound great instead of good.

It’s small, easy to carry, has an amazing long-lasting battery, and GREAT sound! I lost my first one at the beach and had to get another one, and honestly, it was a great investment. I take it to the beach, the park, and even use it in my room when I don’t want to bother anyone in the house with super-loud music from the living room. 😂 The functionality is great, and the fact that there are no cables needed is definitely a plus. It’s convenient, portable, and looks good too, just as mentioned. Definitely a great little speaker and worth the investment!

review_title: Bought it twice because apparently it’s that good
body_en: I originally picked up this BolaButty Bluetooth speaker for my wife to use at work during in house meetings so she could easily connect and play audio. The installation was basically nonexistent, just pair it and go, which made setup super quick. For its size, this thing puts out some serious power. The sound quality is surprisingly strong and clear, easily filling a room without sounding tinny. It handled presentations really well and made everything more professional. The controls are simple and easy to use, which is great when you don’t want to fumble around mid meeting. Overall functionality is exactly what you’d want from a portable speaker, reliable and straightforward. Now here’s the part that says it all. Someone liked it so much they decided to permanently “borrow” it from her desk. So I ended up buying a second one. That alone should tell you everything you need to know. Definitely worth the money and apparently worth guarding closely too.

Based on the reviews I opted to pick up a pair of these speakers. The comparison JBLs are over $100 each...so took the gamble. I am very impressed with the pair, for the size the have great sound, rival the competition absolutely. I bought them for camping trip but had to test them out before obviously. Easy to pair them to play together. I cant speak on the 30 hr battery yet but for the price these are great, have good volume and pretty good bass too, and they light up.
