But for my office, I want something that I can get up and just make a cup of coffee and go back to my desk and not to have sit there and do everything you do with an espresso machine This has been a life changer. I no longer have to go to Starbucks every day and get that cup of coffee I want. I get a cup of coffee that I want to taste that I want and the strength that I want I will even allow my husband to use it because he can’t mess it up So this product has been a really good product so far I’ve had it for over a month and it still runs really good and I’m still very happy with it If it ever breaks down, I’ll just get a new one. I do think it’s the one I will keep. I will keep my espresso machines too because I like making special cups of coffee the other way for my friends when they come over

First of all the actual box arrived opened (unsealed , inside other box), Milk container was missing!! This meant to be a brand new, sealed unit, so ended up returning it back, waste of time & efforts! Busted a fired later to found he just got the same exact machine, even same color (luckily no missing parts) so we ended up putting in good test, but truly ended up packing his and return it as well :). NOW, As for the machine itself, if you like coffee taste, this is not yours, brewing group and dosing size in grams is VERY shy for adequate coffee taste/aroma/crema, Off course, with less grinding time, small puck size, you end up with browny WATER not a cup of coffee. I personally/eventually went with De'Longhi Magnifica Plus, and YES! It is the earth and heaven difference.

TIP of the DAY: Use coffee filters #2 is the coffee grounds catch basin for easy cleanup. Intuitive -Even the least savvy tech person can work it since the icons and buttons are clearly marked. Convenient- Makes all types of coffee and the milk frother can be easily detached for cold storage between usage. Quality - built sturdy and well designed. The coffee grounds have a catch bin and easy to clean.

review_title: As good or better than the (more expensive) competition!
body_en: I love my automatic coffee maker! I drink too much coffee now! It’s just too easy. The only way it could be better would be if it would clean itself! And actually it does! All I have to do is take care of the grounds.

This machine is a joy to use and makes great coffee from freshly ground beans. Guests love helping themselves; custom programs are a plus for fussy and varied family favorites. Had an issue about six months in, customer service was great and arranged to come pick up the system for repair.

I bought this machine to replace my old worn out Philips 5500 series I bought in from William Sonoma in 2021 because I absolutely love this coffee machine as it does everything I need from regular coffee to espresso perfect. And yes, they do wear out and in the 5 years I had it I replaced the grinder along with the coffee chute from the grinder to the coffee press and that’s it. With that reliability I was more than willing to purchase another one and would recommend it to anyone looking for a high quality coffee machine. Now, here is why my review is on negative side. The new machines top cover for the beans was not in the box and the coffee chute door for the pre ground beans was cracked and broken. To remedy the problem, I just used the old machines cover and just going to deal with the broken chute door instead of going through the hassle of returning the whole thing. The photos I have attached show the top & chute door/flap of the older machine I used as well as the broken shoot flap/door from the new machine I received. Sad that paying a premium price for something doesn’t mean your get a premium product

review_title: Easy to use, easy to clean, good coffee
body_en: A pleasure to operate. However, The machine grinds less coffee per shot than we are used to, so we have had to change to a darker roast bean and we do double shots to get good flavor. It took a few days to get it all right. Loving the easy variety of drinks.
Bruyant

review_title: Con descuentos, GENIAL por donde lo veas.
body_en: I didn't think a coffee maker could change my routine so much, but the Philips S5500 LatteGo did it. Preparing coffee with fresh beans is as simple as pressing a button. In seconds you have a perfect espresso with crema and you enjoy it without worrying about cleaning anything right away. That comfort is what hooked me the most. -Coffee with fresh grain and consistent flavor -Quick and uncomplicated preparation -Easy to clean LatteGo system -Elegant design that looks great in the kitchen -Great savings when buying it on sale The only detail that I think could be improved is the water tank: it falls short if you drink several cups a day. It's not a serious problem, but it is something you notice in everyday use. Between the taste, the convenience and the price I got with discounts, I can say without a doubt that it was a great purchase. The small tank is a detail, but it doesn't overshadow the overall experience.

The line has quite a few problems with extraction quality. Of course, this machine will not give the same quality as an espresso machine, but for its price you expect a quality product that works first time. If I wanted to spend an hour and a half fine-tuning the grinder, I would have bought a semi-automatic. In the end. My particular machine came without a good seal during extraction and therefore the result was more like sock water than coffee. I had such a bad experience that I rejected the exchange. Don't buy even by mistake.

review_title: Bien pero falto un pequeño tubo
body_en: The coffee maker works very well and is really easy to use, but according to the description of what it was supposed to bring, it was missing a small tube to periodically (once a month) grease the part that prepares the coffee. It is a special food grade grease that can be purchased separately ($500.00 Mexican pesos).

review_title: realy nice chair for the price
body_en: I am not a gamer, but I do like a good chair I can sit in for hours when writing code. This chair really surprised me. I purchased it thinking it would be okay and that it was not very expensive. Just something to get me by for now. I am happy to say I do not need to worry about finding a permanent solution because this is a great chair. I am a big guy, and even though I wish it had more than just the two adjustments "Up-Down, and Reclining," I am very happy with it. It is sturdy and easy to assemble, and comfortable. It has a removable cover, leaving a mesh back that stays cool when sitting for long periods of time.

Bought this for my son. He plays games and makes videos about it. Now that i got him this he doesnt leave the chair but to eat and sleep. Im sure if he could take it to school he would. It is very comfortable i must admit. The wheels roll nicely and it reclines to always be in a comfortable position for your posture. Easy to assemble. I highly recommend. I will be ordering one for myself one of these days.
Good quality and comfortable

review_title: Love it, supports my 270 lbs mass
body_en: I like it personally. Im a 6'4" man around 270 lbs and never even made a concerning sound and I've had this for half a year so far. Quick to set up and simple instructions to follow. Only gave a 4 star because it doesn't necessarily go back far enough to feel like im laying down but thats just me nip picking. Also 5 star is always sus reviews

Got this for my son he loves it very Nice and easy to put together, He sits in it for long periods of time with no complaints very comfortable, but he is very tall the legs rest is a nice touch his legs are too long. the material is very nice looks more expensive than it was got it on sale which makes it an even better purchase. waiting on another sale to purchase another for my other son who saw it and now wants one. I was impressed with the way it was packaged.
Easy to assemble. Sits comfortably. Only had it for a few weeks, but it’s a very good chair so far. Great for gaming and has good lumbar support.
I bought this for my grandson and he loves it. He says it very confortable. It also looks very sturdy and the quality looks ok.
Quick assemble. Extremely comfortable

beautiful chair, fairly easy assembly, well explained. the cushions can be removed so you can even change them, the only problem is the solidity of the chair, to see over time. the back of the chair has no foam so you can feel the straps a little and the seat is very thin, given the photos I really thought it would have been more solid, very thick and more comfortable but no, too bad.
Good chair used for several months, still in good condition, too bad the lambar cushion does not stay in place
Pretty good for now. I will give the additional star after a year, if I see that the materials and structures are perfectly maintained.

Briefly on my own behalf: The DPD driver simply claimed that I wasn't there and delivered the package to a shop. Annoying, worse than that, I'm a stroke patient! So I had to pick up the bulky package on foot because the DPD driver was too lazy to deliver it to the door (1st floor). The seller responded really nicely and gave me a discount for my inconvenience. A very friendly contact and the service is also outstanding! Now about the gaming chair: Setting up and assembling the chair was really easy, and you only need the only tool provided. There is a QR CODE that provides a setup video, practical, but it works very well without it. After about half an hour the gaming chair was set up and could be used. The chair is really comfortable, ideal for my back, which is very sensitive. The lumbar pillow in particular supports the back optimally during longer gaming sessions, for me it's truck rides in the simulator area. I use a steering wheel with pedals, so I have high demands on a gaming chair. The neck pillow can also be moved variably, so the neck is well supported! This chair offers an incredible amount of customization options and settings, which is exactly what I was looking for! I am 1.74cm tall and the dimensions of the chair are optimal for me. The leg rest also suits me very well; it might not fit well for taller people. You might want to consider this before purchasing! The gaming chair has a medium level of hardness, you don't sink into it, but it is always comfortable even after long periods of use. The highlight is of course the removable back, so you don't get stuck in the summer! Then the back area is airy and the heat can circulate. I'm happy to forego a massage function because the designer has achieved a significant improvement in comfort here. My gaming computer generates a lot of heat, the hot summers do the rest and you're literally stuck in standard gaming chairs. Thanks to the mesh fabric in the backrest, the fan can now distribute the air, a great thing in my opinion. This way you can always keep a cool head while gaming and you can add a massage pillow for €10 if necessary. The chair is also suitable as a TV armchair; it can be folded back wonderfully. Extremely comfortable with the leg rest! It is also possible to take a short nap without needing to see a chiropractor straight away. The wheels move smoothly and I haven't noticed any unpleasant noises from the chair in general. The seams are very neatly processed and the gaming chair looks aesthetically high-quality, like a sports seat in a car. The side support is similar, the armrests are wide and comfortably padded! Conclusion: For me personally, an all-round successful product of high quality and at a reasonable price. The removable back cover is a great idea and extremely practical for the hot summers! In my opinion, the comfort of the gaming chair is very high, the aesthetics are not neglected either, great design paired with clean workmanship! I haven't been able to identify any weak points yet and I can't rate durability yet. The service is good, if I need similar gaming accessories again, the seller will definitely be my first point of contact! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ absolutely deserved and I am happy to recommend this product.

An excellent replacement for my old computer chair. Easy to assemble using either the instructions that came with it, or the online video. Nice looking chair and very comfortable to sit on, especially with the footrest, lumbar support pillow and the neck/head pillow. It’s quite lightweight for a chair of this sort of thing, so you need to be careful when you sit down on it as it moves fast.

review_title: Love it so far! Short & tiny people approved!
body_en: Just got this today, but my first impression is that it’s exactly what I needed! Is this a gaming chair? Yes. Did I buy it to use in my work office at 41yrs old? Also yes. My nephew got this over xmas and when he showed it to me, he made me try it. It was love at first sit. I’m pretty small, 4’11 and 95lbs, so all of my work chairs are very uncomfortable for me. My feet never touch the floor, the chairs didn’t recline and my head was too short to have it hit the actual headrest. After I saw my nephews, I knew I had to get this. It’s everything I need. My feet hit the floor, it has a pillow that sits under my neck, back support and even the foot rest. I love that it reclines as well and impressed with how well it came together. I’m very excited to bring to work and finally be comfortable! Price: I got this on sale for 109$. It’s normally 129$ but 20$ shipping. I wish it would stay at 99$ all around since the shipping isn’t free. It was a super heavy package though so I get it. Style: I got all black so it blends in at work and it’s as pictured. I wish the logo wasn’t so big and bright for those who don’t use this as a gaming chair but I may use a black sharpie & color it to make this more discreet. Size: If you are on the shorter side, this is a great chair. Great for kids obviously and tinier adults. Not sure this is a heavy duty chair for the regular sized adult so keep in mind. Delivery: said it would take a week but came next day which was impressive and I was very happy with that. Arrives in great condition. Setup: the directions are so so. My husband put this together and it took wayyyyy longer than it should have because some of the directions were mislabeled. Screws numbers were added that weren’t needed for this chair and some of the images were so tiny you couldn’t see much. For some reason we had the biggest issue with the footrest. We had to do it like 3xs b/c we couldn’t tell from the image how it actually sat. Got it done none the less and worth the struggle. Bottom line: worth the buy and seems good quality for the price but I’ll see how it hold up when I bring it to the office for actual use.

review_title: Sturdy, very cute, easy to put together!
body_en: I didn't expect much for how much it cost. I thought it would be okay, but knew I couldn't afford a super fancy chair, so didn't my hopes up. It's actually a fantastic chair! I'll start with the TINIEST gripe. It was filthy. GROSS. I had to get a magic eraser to get the grime off of it, grease and stuff from the factory. But it's a gorgeous pink and white chair, feels so sturdy and comfortable. Great support for your back, and that's even without the lumbar pillow that comes with it. I will say, the instructions were clearly written by ChatGPT. Awful. But the pictures were just fine, so it was actually easy to put together, haha. So don't fret if you read it and it's confusing. The diagrams are accurate and easy to read. It also didn't take long at all to put together. OH! I personally didn't want rollers, as I have a pup and didn't want to squish toes. So I bought office chair gliders to replace the wheels (which are beautiful, sadly, would've loved to use them) and they fit just fine! So if you're like me and wanted to change them, they're compatible. But the wheels are super cute. :) Honestly so pleased with this chair. I am very happy with it, and look forward to using it while I work and draw and game for a long time to come.

Packaged very professionally, Easy instructions to follow, and most importantly super comfortable for whatever your needs are, Gaming, working, editing, etc. Highly recommend this chair fit my set up great, looks fantastic, very adjustable and definitely a bang for your buck chair. It feels very stable as well definitely not falling over or going to fall apart!

review_title: DO NOT BUY - ITS NOT AS IT IS ADVERTISED.
body_en: We purchased this chair because it is advertised to be a gaming chair for an adult up to 400 pounds. Weighing in at 235, we figured it would be comfortable to use. IT IS HORRIBLE! Very uncomfortable. Looks pretty but it is made for a teenager, not an adult. DO NOT BUY IT! THE RETURN POLICY IS A JOKE! They want you to return it in its original packaging with no tags removed or it be used - or they can charge you up to 100% of the cost. I guess you have to decide before assembly if it will fit or be comfortable. I should have ordered a workable crystal ball. You have to buy a big box to ship it back in and you have to pay shipping. Do you know what it costs to ship something this size? We would wind up owing money instead of getting a refund. DO NOT BUY THIS FOR AN ADULT. IT IS HORRIBLE. --- There, now I am happy. I may not get my money back, but I hope this will save others from buying this falsely advertised item.
Great chair! I weigh 270 lbs and this thing is holding up. The arms come loose and the foot stool is way too short and flimsy to be effective.

review_title: Good quality chair for the price!
body_en: This chair is extremely comfortable and was super easy to setup. The footrest is amazing and maximizes the comfort. The chair seems super sturdy and the material is very comfortable. Highly recommend for those looking for a good office chair
This might be a decent chair, but it is nowhere near worth $200 if I didn’t wanna go through the hassle of having to disassemble everything for the return I would

review_title: Just okay. Wouldnt buy again, but not upset with it
body_en: Its an alright chair. It is fairly comfy and the material feels nice. The assembly wasnt too complicated but the instructions were extremely hard to follow (the instructions showed very tiny pictures that were hard to see, and the written instructions only said to fasten the screws down, no actual worded instructions on how to assemble it). The locking mechanism for the leaning is different from any chair and kinda awkward to use because it goes so far down that you have to reallllyyy lean sideways to unlock it and re-lock it, which makes it awkward to lean back or forward to adjust it. The footrest is garbage because it goes straight out but not far enough, making it so your feet dont actually rest on it but rather your lower calves do (or if you do out your feet on it youll be in an awkward squat position) and its held with extremely thin aluminum rods run through plastic screwed into the bottom which means the footrest has give and feels like itll bend or break easily from putting any substancial weight on it. I also had a shipping delay of 5 days after it was supposed to take over a week anyways, which was an inconvenience. Its not necessarily a bad chair, especially if youre a shorter persom who can use the footrest comfortably. But if the footrest was a big reasom for you to buy the chair (like it was for me), look elsewhere or get a chair without one because this one is definitely not worth it. Its an alright chair fir

review_title: Sedia molto comoda e con rapporto qualità - prezzo molto buono
body_en: I purchased this gaming chair with an excellent discount, it is very comfortable and I have no problems using it for hours, the price-quality ratio is truly excellent, highly recommended!!
The chair is of good quality, I would only improve the fastening of the lumbar and cervical supports, since they do not stay in place and come off.

The chair is comfortable, I had to remove the lumbar support, I am tall at 184cm and I need the entire bench, the neck support I had to put higher up because of my height, easy to assemble, if this description is of value to anyone, greetings to all, I would buy it again.
Perfekt

This is an amazing and comfortable product that is perfect for any office or gaming work at home in your room, it has an extendable leg rest that was so convenient for me and a neck padding that kept my neck adjusted. I couldn’t recommend this product any more

I’m really happy with this gaming chair. It was easy to assemble, feels sturdy, and is very comfortable to sit in for long periods. The cushioning is supportive, and the adjustable height and reclining features are very convenient.

review_title: Easy setup and exactly what you want it to be
body_en: Very easy setup and quite comfortable! Only took about an hour to get it up, instructions were pretty clear and they even offer to send an electric drill if needed. Used it to play for about 5 hours this weekend and it felt perfect without strain!

review_title: Excellent Chair for Gaming and Office Use
body_en: "Very satisfied with this chair. It was easy to assemble, the instructions were clear, and all the parts fit perfectly. The chair feels sturdy and comfortable, even after sitting for several hours. The cushioning is soft, the back support is excellent, and the adjustable features help me find the perfect position. It looks great and feels like a high-quality product for the price. I would definitely recommend this chair to anyone looking for a comfortable and reliable gaming or office chair."

"Really happy with this gaming chair so far. It was easy to put together, feels solid, and is surprisingly comfortable for the price. I've spent hours gaming and sitting at my desk without feeling uncomfortable or needing to constantly adjust my position. The chair looks great, has a nice reclining feature, and provides good back support. One of the biggest reasons I chose it was because it was affordable, and honestly, it feels like a much more expensive chair than it actually is. If you're looking for a comfortable gaming chair that won't break the bank, I'd definitely recommend giving this one a try."

I bought two chairs for family members who are gamers. They put them together easily. The quality is very nice and they absolutely loved them. These were gifts and I would recommend these if you have young teens, teenagers or adults that are gamers or use a computer a lot.

I bought this chair for my son, and he love it. He's a gamer and needed a better chair. He said it's comfortable. I actually caught him sleeping in the chair a couple of times since I received it. I love the appearance and color and the quality is nice. He is 355 pounds and it holds him well. Pretty cool chair to have. I would recommend buying it.

review_title: Better Than Expected – Comfortable, Sturdy, and Easy to Assemble!
body_en: This GTPLAYER e-sports chair really exceeded my expectations! The installation process is very simple. It takes about twenty to thirty minutes to install according to the instructions. The accessories are complete and there are no missing parts. The chair is very comfortable to sit on. The biggest highlight is the Pocket Spring cushion. The armrest is linked with the backrest, and the arm is also supported when lying down to rest, and it is very comfortable to pull out the footrest for a lunch break. The overall workmanship is solid, the chair is very stable, the wheels slide smoothly, and there is no abnormal sound. At this price, it is really cost-effective, which is more comfortable than many more expensive e-sports chairs. I am still very satisfied after using it for a few days. review_title: Those legs are ANNOYING to assemble, but otherwise decent chair
body_en: The hardest part about putting this thing together is the legs. It says "slap on floor" or something to get the screw holes to line up. THEY WON'T! What you really need to do is get it as close as possible to lining up, then put the bolt in at an angle but DO NOT SCREW IT IN! Put the tool into the bolt and then use the two to press inwards and kinda pry back the leg piece until the bolt stands upright like it should. THEN screw it in! A screwdriver won't work because it tends to slide right back out if you aren't holding it in place when you start to screw in the bolt. So when you remove the screwdriver to put the bolt in, you'll lose the alignment anyway. And you need the tool (included with it) in the bolt to be able to apply enough pressure while at an angle to "catch" the screw hole before pulling it into line. HEAD. ACHE. Aside from that, here's my assessment of the chair's use compared to about 4 or 5 others that I've used in my lifetime: The assembly is easy and straightforward after you get those leg screw holes lined up. The arms seem to be shorter in length and height than some other chairs I've had. But that's a good thing for me because when the seat is at the correct height, the arms of other chairs were rubbing against the underside of my *GLASS* top desk. Occasionally that little bit of give in the chair when I get up or descent when I sit down would snap the arms against the glass of my desk, and it always sounded like I would break it. Thankfully, I didn't. Also, I love the fabric covering! I ordered this specifically for that one reason. The one I'm about to throw out now has the typical vinyl covering and as it aged, it cracked, especially on the arm rests, and my arms were getting torn up by it! While this cloth will also wear over time (especially being microfiber), it shouldn't create sharp vinyl pieces to scratch up my arms, so that's a plus! The back of the chair has a really thick dense foam that isn't quite conforming to my spine just yet. It's going to take some wearing in to really feel comfy. My worry is that once it breaks down enough to wear in, the foam may deteriorate very quickly afterwards. That's something to watch for in the future though. The arms may have a lighter foam, or maybe the foam just conforms better to sharper points, like elbows. But they seem to have more give to them, for which ever reason. The back also doesn't lean back as far as some gaming chairs I have had. That could be bad for me as I sometimes get *very random* vertigo and need to lie flat for a few minutes until it goes away. With this chair, I'll probably have to stumble to a couch or bed to lie down if it happens. The seat itself is not too long or short either. I've had some that were short enough I felt like I would fall off the front of the chair. And others that were so long that when I saw back, my knees were ON the seat of the chair. This one is, thankfully, right in between. The foot rest isn't anything special nor bad, but it "attaches" in the slides with a bolt on the back of one side. That will make it easy to remove when it's time to buy another chair. With the exception of the gas lift, most of this will be easy to take apart to fit inside of a large trash collection container when it's time for that. (Yes, I've gone through enough chairs for that to be a concern now!) I never use the lumbar supports, so I can't give any information on that.

I will definitely be a repeat customer of this company!

review_title: For less than $90 this chair is a steal. Takes around 30 minutes by yourself to assemble.
body_en: (Note - I was going to buy another one for daughter, it went up to $159.99 in 2-3 days! Might still get it but this chair is awesome especially for sale price from few days ago) For less than $100 this chair is awesome. I’ve seen reviews stating it took an hour or even longer to assemble…no. I am not a handyman whatsoever and it took me about 30 minutes to completely assemble. Maybe 45 minutes unboxing and separating pieces to make sure I had everything. Easiest chair I have ever put together. Instructions are clear and very simple. As for the chair overall; it is not a $500 gaming chair with top of the line materials. If you pay >$90 for a gaming chair (this chair) do not expect it to withstand years of abuse. If you are careful around it, it should last plenty of time. If you game 10 hours a day and constantly adjust the seat roughly, it will probably last a couple years. For my 11 year old it is perfect. He isn’t allowed to game 10 hours a day so it should last longer than 2 years. If it lasts 2 years I will have gotten more than enough value for what I paid. I’m 6ft tall and overweight and it is comfortable for me. My son sat in it and he loves it. My 17 year old daughter sat in it and now she wants one. Why not! Reclining ability is good. It does not lay down completely flat but more than enough. Foot rest is simple and not bad if you are not 6.5ft or taller. The chair has a very comfortable firmness and isn’t too firm either. It fits my 5ft and change 11 year old and my 5.5ft 17 year old. And my heavy 6ft never mind how old. For the price, this chair is a great buy.

review_title: Looks Great, But Comfort and Build Quality Are Just Average
body_en: I’ve been using this chair for a little while now, and I have mixed feelings about it. First, the design is definitely one of its strongest points. It looks great, especially if you’re going for a gaming or modern office setup. It has a clean, sporty look, and from a distance it honestly looks more expensive than it is. That said, once you get up close, the overall build quality isn’t quite as impressive. The finishes could definitely be better. There are a few small details that make it feel a bit cheaper than I expected, and the materials don’t really give off a premium feel. It’s not terrible by any means, but you can tell where some corners were cut. As for comfort, I’d give it about a 7/10. It’s perfectly usable for everyday work or gaming sessions, but it’s not one of those chairs you immediately sink into and never want to leave. After a few hours, I definitely notice that it’s more of a budget chair than an ergonomic one. Overall, I think it’s a fair value for the money. If you’re expecting premium quality or all-day comfort, you may be a little disappointed. But if you’re shopping in this price range and mainly want something that looks good and gets the job done, it’s a reasonable choice. Just keep your expectations realistic.

review_title: Cute and durable Vanity Chair that my teenager loves!
body_en: This chair is absolutely stunning to look at and looks beautiful in my daughter’s room, and I believe this vanity chair would work in any type of room. The color of this chair is neutral, and that is why I think that this chair will look cute with any color scheme. The chair itself is a beautiful creamy white color, and the base around the wheels is white with black wheels. The instructions included were very easy to follow, and I was able to put this chair together in less than 30 minutes all by myself. Each part of the chair was packaged separately and easy to assemble. You can easily locate each piece and follow along with the instructions. The instructions included have pictures of each section, and that made putting this chair together very simple. This product included all of the tools needed to complete the chair and also includes spare parts if you need them later. The chair also comes with a plush pillow that looks very cute when not in use. The included pillow is full and plush and very firm. When my daughter or I are using the chair, we remove the pillow because it’s not as comfortable with a firm pillow behind our back. The chair feels soft to the touch, and the fabric seems to be high quality and strong enough to withstand use for extended periods of time. The chair moves up and down and can be adjusted in height according to your needs. You can sit on the chair and grab the handle underneath, and it moves up and down smoothly without any issues. The chair can spin around all the way, and it’s not loose. It stays in place when I sit in the chair, and it doesn’t wobble or move without me moving my feet to have the seat of the chair in the position I like. The seat of the chair is firm and comfortable for sitting comfortably while putting on my makeup. I love that this vanity chair has a wide back to it because it makes me feel safe when I lean back, and I don’t have to worry about falling out of the chair. It also is nice to have a wide back on the chair to lean back on and relax. The value of this vanity chair is worth the investment right now because of the quality of the materials and how well made this product is. I do think that this chair will last a long time and retain its shape and firmness because it is meant to be used occasionally each week for short periods of time. I do believe that each part of the chair was made with high-quality materials and exceptional craftsmanship.

review_title: I think I have too much badonka in my donk for this chair

I love the scalloped look to this thing, but even with the throw pillow out of the way it rather feels like I'm sliding forward out of the chair. I wanted this to replace the chair I've been using at my vanity because the metal backing keeps coming loose and it's not on wheels. I had hoped this petal vanity chair would fill the bill. I've been losing weight, so perhaps it will become a non-issue. The one thing I will address that IS an issue with the chair is you play merry hell trying to reach for the lift level. Somehow, with how it's attached, it is both too close in to the center of the chair, and somehow too far back when you're actually sitting in the chair. We have another chair from FIDOM that is a shop/garage chair without such a problem, and we really like that chair. That said, much like the shop/garage chair, it was super easy to put together and rolls quite readily across the floor, whether flat floor or carpeting. If you aren't suffering from big bootyitis I would say this chair is worth the asking price. Just try to limit how often you need to adjust the height, since it'll be a bit of a pain to do so.

body_en: I’m really pleased with this chair. It arrived very well packaged, and everything was secure and nicely organized. The quality stood out to me right away. I actually own another chair from this same brand, and this one has the same well-made feel, so based on my experience, they seem to be consistent about using quality materials. I’m using this as a vanity chair for doing my makeup, and it’s perfect for that. The petal-shaped back gives it such a pretty, feminine look without being over the top, and the white color works beautifully in a vanity or bedroom area. The seat has a nice amount of cushioning and feels comfortable and supportive. I also like that it swivels, has wheels, and the height can be adjusted. Those features make it much more practical than a traditional stationary vanity chair, especially when I’m moving around and reaching for different makeup products. Overall, this is a beautiful combination of style, comfort, and functionality. Having another chair from this brand with the same level of quality makes me feel even better about this one. It looks elegant at my vanity and feels like a piece I’ll be able to enjoy for a long time.

This is a nice chair and is priced decently. I'll start off with my biggest gripe- that awkward, dangling pump. It literally looks like the manual aneroid sphygmomanometer (blood pressure cuff) that dangled on a doctor's office wall, except it is dangling off of your office chair. It's an eye sore, it looks misplaced, and my toddler won't stop squeezing it. You can definitely feel the lumbar support puff up when you pump it which is nice and all, but it's just a silly design and they could have at least made the pump more discreet or figured out a way to store it without it literally just dangling around. I have half a mind to just cut mine off and forego the lumbar pump because it looks just that ridiculous. Our office space is in a visible area of our home and the pump is just so silly looking. The rest of the chair is very nice- very clean looking aesthetic, comfortable and adjustable. This doesn't have all the bells and whistles that some other pricier office chairs have, but it looks clean and gives enough support for working and sitting. I just honestly thought the pump would be able to be hidden instead of dangling like a child and cat toy.

review_title: So Cute and Exactly What I Was Looking For! 💕🌸
body_en: Okay, I’m honestly in LOVE with this chair! This is exactly what I have been looking for to use at my vanity. I wanted something cute and feminine that didn’t look like a boring office chair, and this one is absolutely perfect. The petal-shaped design is sooo cute, and I love how it looks sitting at my vanity. It’s also surprisingly comfortable, especially with the extra-thick cushion. I can sit here getting ready without feeling like I’m sitting on a hard, flat chair. The wheels roll smoothly, the height is adjustable, and being armless makes it really easy to tuck right up under my vanity when I’m not using it. It also swivels, which makes moving around while I’m getting ready super easy. I really don’t have anything bad to say about this one. It’s cute, comfortable, practical, and fits my space perfectly. I’ve been looking for a vanity chair like this for a while, and I’m so happy I finally found one I actually LOVE! 💗

This vanity chair has such an elegant look and is a beautiful addition to my room. It is soft, well-made, and even comes with a cute little pillow for added comfort. I really like the supportive back design, and the chair is comfortable to sit in while getting ready. The height is adjustable, so you can easily raise or lower it to fit your vanity. The height works perfectly with mine. It also has wheels on the base, and they roll smoothly, making it easy to move around even while sitting in the chair. Assembly was incredibly easy. I put it together completely by myself in about 10 minutes, and all of the tools I needed were included. I didn’t need any extra screwdrivers, a hammer, or anything else. The chair has a weight capacity of up to 300 pounds and feels sturdy and well constructed. I love the elegant design, the comfort, and how nicely it fits with my vanity. I’m super excited to have this chair in my room!

This chair was easy to assemble, with clear instructions and all the necessary parts included. Once assembled, it feels sturdy and supportive. The wide, well-padded seat and high back make it comfortable for longer periods, while the adjustable armrests, footrest, reclining back, and inflatable lumbar support provide several ways to customize it. I agree with other reviewers that the rocking function is fairly stiff, even after adjusting the tension. The hand pump for the lumbar support also hangs down and can get close to the wheels unless it is secured out of the way. These are inconvenient design details, but they do not take away from the chair’s overall comfort. The heavy-duty base and substantial construction seem durable enough for regular use. At $259.99, this is an investment, but the size, comfort, adjustability, and supportive design help justify the price. Overall, it is a comfortable, well-built chair with only a couple of minor issues.

review_title: Thick padding and quality construction at a good price
body_en: I love this chair. The padding is thick and provides excellent support, even during long periods of use. Assembly was quick and straightforward, taking very little time. I especially enjoy the reclining feature with leg support—it’s perfect for leaning back and watching videos comfortably. At this price point, I’m genuinely impressed and have no complaints

This is not the chair you are looking for. I have been using this chair for under half a year and it is falling apart. The chair legs are modular, made of plastic, and not durable. I am over 50 lbs under the weight limit and it is awful. The chair has bent and the legs do not hold it. Never buy this.

This chair exceeded my expectations. It was easy to put together, feels incredibly sturdy, and is very comfortable even after hours of gaming or working. The footrest and lumbar support are great features, and the cushioning is soft without losing support.
Amazing chair. I use it every day and has is very comfortable especially with the foot rest. The installation for the chair was super easy and simple.

review_title: Great chair if you’re “Big and Tall” for an 8 year old
body_en: Got this chair to replace an old one. When I got it out of the box it was missing pieces right off the rip. Once I got the parts and put it together, it is a very nice and sturdy chair. It’s easy to assemble and the instructions are good. My chief complaint, the chairs marketing says big and tall multiple times and this chair is hilariously small. If you’re considering buying this for a moderately sized teenager, go ahead. It’ll make a great chair. If the gamer to be using the chair weighs 170+lbs, find another chair. I’m extremely disappointed in the flagrant false advertising on this listing. Buyer beware.
Already falling apart, squeaking around, not even a year old, parts are staring to feel loose.

I was honestly pretty happy with this chair for the price. It's comfortable, looks good, and doesn't feel cheap once it's all put together. If you're on a budget and don't want to spend a fortune on a gaming chair, this is a pretty solid option. The only real downside is the instruction manual. It definitely needs more work. Most of the steps just expect you to figure things out by looking at the pictures, and some of them aren't very clear. A little more written explanation would have made putting it together a lot less frustrating. Overall, though, I think it's worth the money. Once it's assembled, it's a comfortable chair and does exactly what I expected. I'd recommend it if you're looking for a decent budget gaming chair—just be patient during the assembly process.

Bought this gaming chair for my husband since he’s a gamer, and let’s just say he’s not sharing it with anyone in the house 😂 It was a great price and is obviously very comfortable since he practically lives in it now. Definitely a good purchase!

review_title: Great product for a great price
body_en: A user-friendly product with excellent quality, suitable for everyone to use together, and the delivery speed is very fast

review_title: Don't throw out the box, you'll need it
body_en: I ordered the Nouhaus Strato ergonomic office chair to replace the one I've had for 6 years. The seat was beginning to feel uncomfortable and it was getting squeaky when I got up from it. To start with the cons- although the directions seemed to be clear to follow, it's only images and no words. I've got bad eyesight and couldn't make heads or tails of what direction things went. I assembled and disassembled the chair about 3 times before I got it correct. I also destroyed all the packaging before I began which was a HUGE mistake. The instructions recommend using the box to help with assembly and it would have made it much, much easier had I known ahead of time. So if you're reading this take note! My last cons are with the chair itself. First, I am prone to sciatic pain and after one 8 hour work day in the chair, I could feel a flare up coming on. Fortunately, it's the weekend so I am not sitting anymore. I'm going to add some cushioning to it to see if that helps. The arm rests tilt in and out for comfort which I like but they move so easily if you bear any weight on them and push in or out. I do this alot so I'm going to have to adjust how I sit and reposition to limit this happening. OK for the pro's... the chair glides easily across the floor. The base has adjustable height like most but it feels very sturdy like it won't start to slowly lower as you sit. You all know what I'm referring to. The back also allows for reclining. When locked upright it helps with posture and didn't hurt my upper back. On reclining, you can lock in how far back it goes and it's very, very comfortable. So much so I could take a nap in it during breaks. The mesh seat feels supportive and well made. I'm hoping it holds up as long as my last one. The size of the seat is adequate too. As a larger person, I don't feel like I'm stuck in the chair but have room to breathe. Overall, office chairs are a necessity for many. If you're looking for comfort and something that should last a while, this is a good option albeit a little pricey. I think it's well made and compatible to the prices you pay for other chairs.

review_title: Exceptional Ergonomic Chair for Work, Gaming, and Every Day Use
body_en: I purchased the Nouhaus Strato Ergonomic Office Chair after spending countless hours at my desk each day, and it has been one of the best office chair investments I've made. From the moment I assembled it, I could tell it was designed with comfort, adjustability, and long-term support in mind. The ergonomic features are outstanding. The adjustable headrest, height-adjustable backrest, and dynamic lumbar support work together to provide excellent posture support throughout the day. I especially appreciate how easy it is to customize the chair to fit my body. The 3D armrests allow adjustments in multiple directions, making it easy to find a comfortable position whether I'm typing, attending meetings, gaming, or simply relaxing between tasks. The breathable mesh design is another major advantage. Unlike traditional padded chairs that can become warm after several hours, the mesh back promotes airflow and keeps me comfortable even during long work sessions. The high-back design provides full upper-body support, helping reduce neck, shoulder, and back fatigue. I was also impressed by the chair's build quality. It feels sturdy, durable, and well-engineered. The rolling casters glide smoothly, and the reclining mechanism operates effortlessly while still feeling secure and stable. Whether I'm sitting upright for focused work or leaning back during breaks, the chair remains comfortable and supportive. Assembly was straightforward, with clear instructions and well-packaged components. Once assembled, the chair had a premium look and feel that immediately elevated the appearance of my workspace. The sleek black design fits perfectly in both professional office environments and home gaming setups. One small drawback is that all of the adjustable features may require a little time to fine-tune initially. However, once everything is adjusted properly, the level of comfort is well worth the effort. Additionally, the premium design may come at a higher price point than basic office chairs, but the ergonomic benefits and build quality justify the investment. Overall, the Nouhaus Strato Ergonomic Office Chair delivers exceptional comfort, support, and customization. The breathable mesh construction, adjustable headrest and backrest, 3D armrests, and dynamic ergonomic support make it an excellent choice for professionals, students, gamers, and anyone who spends significant time at a desk. I highly recommend this chair to anyone looking for a premium seating experience that promotes comfort and productivity throughout the day.

review_title: Nice chair, easy to put together, nice style, limited arm movement priced quite high at 370
body_en: Quick important tip: DO NOT TOSS THE BOX WHEN YOU UNPACK IT! The directions explain to prop the pieces onto the outer box to build the chair and it was a GENIUS idea! Pay attention to the sticker on the seat that says FRONT of chair and aim the arms that way. Also the metal back piece needs to aim so the overhang part is at the back of the seat so the back piece can attach to it. I sometimes sit a work for 4-5 hours straight w/o a break so I need a good chair. The chair that I had was an expensive chair from a good brand, but, the seat cushion just didn’t give me the support and comfort that I was looking for and need. I also really wanted a white chair to go with my white office furniture. This chair hit all of the marks. This was a heavy box so be prepared to maybe have some help getting it in the house. I did it ok by myself, but my awesome Amazon driver left it on my top stop for me. This was very straight forward to put together, but I am also ok with putting things together in general. I do not think there will be many issues putting this together with one person. The directions are a little clunky. The chair is comfortbale and supportive. I did 3 hours straight of deep focus work and I was very comfortable. I also really like the color of grey and white. I was looking at $1100 Henry miller chairs because I really need a good chair- I’m glad I went with this chair- it’s good quality. It’s priced a bit high at $370. This would be a great buy at $100-150, maybe on prime day or Black Friday. This does not have the bells and whistles that a $200 and up chair would, let alone a $300 and up chair. Important points: The arms can be lowered and raised only-they cannot swing out or up which is disappointing esp in this price point. The back support is great, but the sliding mechanism to adjust the back is very standard and not elegant at all. You have to shimmy it up awkwardly while you sit in it. Anyone with difficulty twisting their upper body will not like this The only true adjustability of this chair is the seat height. Up and down with a standard up and down lever….. This is not worth more than 100-150$. If you can grab on prime day and want a firm back support, this could be a good option for you.

review_title: Assembly stinks but chair is amazing
body_en: My son and I put this chair together for his new desk in his room and it is extremely comfortable. It hits quite a few ergonomics points with height adjustments, slight back adjustments, and the neck adjustments as well as a sort of firmness area for your back. Hard to explain without sitting in it. The mesh feels strong but you won't want to have any Sharps near it because I think it would ruin the chair pretty quick. I will say the assembly was tough because some of the screws didn't line up easily and some of the screw holes were not threaded properly on the chair we got. We had to kind of force the screws into the threading before they would catch like there was maybe some Burrs or something in the way. But once we got it going it went in easily. Very happy with the end product! Nouhaus makes amazing chairs and this is not our first.

I really wanted to like this chair, but it just isn’t a good fit for me, especially at this price point. One feature some people may appreciate is how adjustable the armrests are, but I found them more frustrating than helpful. They move around every time I shift in my seat, which quickly became annoying. I’ll probably end up removing them altogether. The wheels were another disappointment. They didn’t roll well, and I ended up replacing them with a different set, which added extra cost and hassle. On the positive side, the chair was fairly easy to assemble, and the instructions were straightforward. Unfortunately, ease of assembly wasn’t enough to make up for the overall experience. For the amount this chair costs, I expected better comfort and quality. I wouldn’t purchase it again.

I recently grabbed this Nouhaus Strato Ergonomic Chair because since I mostly work from home, I spend a lot of time in the same chair for work and gaming. The first thing I looked at was the build quality. The construction looks and feels both premium and sturdy at the same time. Installation was a snap following the detailed step by step instructions. All the materials feel durable enough to last for years and the stitching feels flawless without any loose threads found. One of the strengths of this chair is just how customizable the chair really is. The height-adjustable backrest and headrest allowed me to fine-tune the fit to match my posture perfectly, providing excellent support throughout the entire day. The ergonomic design of this chair promotes proper sitting posture and significantly reduced the fatigue and stiffness I previously experienced after hours at my desk. The lumbar support feels well-positioned and supportive without being overly firm. I found the adjustment mechanisms to be smooth, which makes it easy to find my ideal seating position for my body. I find the seat cushion is comfortable without feeling too soft, offering me the right balance of support and comfort. The back mesh design and materials promote air circulation to prevent unnecessary back sweat and the feeling that you are "sticking to the chair". The caster wheels feel rugged and glide easily across a low nap carpet. I have probably sat in this chair close to 30 hours so far and I have zero regrets picking it up. I haven't experienced any discomfort or body fatigue while using this chair. Overall, this Nouhaus Strato chair combines comfort, adjustability, and premium build quality into a stylish office chair that I would highly recommend to anyone working from home or in an office.

review_title: Comfortable Ergonomic Chair That Provides Excellent All-Day Support
body_en: This ergonomic office chair is thoughtfully designed for people who spend long hours at a desk. With multiple adjustment options and full-back support, it offers the flexibility needed to stay comfortable throughout the workday. One of the standout features is the height-adjustable backrest. Rather than relying on a fixed lumbar cushion, the back adjusts to better follow the natural curve of your spine, providing support across a wider range of sitting positions. The reclining backrest is another highlight. Multiple recline angles make it easy to switch between focused work, reading, or taking a quick break without sacrificing support. Combined with the adjustable headrest, it helps reduce strain on the neck and shoulders during extended use. I also appreciate the 3D armrests. Being able to adjust their height, depth, and angle makes it much easier to find a comfortable position whether you're typing, using a mouse, or simply relaxing between tasks. The breathable mesh back promotes good airflow, helping keep you cool during long work sessions, while the cushioned seat provides comfortable support without feeling overly soft or sinking over time. The sturdy base and smooth-rolling casters give the chair a stable feel while allowing easy movement around the workspace. Its clean, modern appearance also fits nicely into both home offices and professional environments. Assembly is straightforward, and the wide adjustment range makes it suitable for a variety of users and desk setups. Overall, this is a well-designed ergonomic chair that combines excellent adjustability, breathable comfort, and reliable support. It's a great investment for anyone looking to improve posture and stay comfortable during long hours of work, studying, or gaming.

I’m extremely happy with this gaming chair! The quality exceeded my expectations. It was easy to assemble, and all the parts fit perfectly. The chair is very sturdy, comfortable, and provides excellent support for my back and neck. The adjustable armrests, reclining function, and footrest make it perfect for both work and gaming. The built-in speakers are a nice bonus and sound surprisingly good. The off-white color looks elegant and matches my office perfectly. After using it for several days, I can honestly say it’s one of the best chairs I’ve purchased. Great value for the price, highly recommended!

This is by far the best budget gaming chair ever. We'll its not really budget necuase it has benefits that 600+ dollar chairs dont. We have a cat and so we he jumps on it, it creates pretty visible scratches so a plus would be to make the fabric a bit thicker. But otherwise its great and comfy. The pillows provide great support. Although it doesn't lift up very high . But maybe thats cause I have a tall desk. Assembly was easy and straightforward. It's very flexible with hwo you can have it displayed. The speakers really submerge you into your game or music. Overall great product that needs tiny tweaks.

This is my third gaming chair in the past few years and is my favorite of the three. It looks fantastic and sleek in my office space. I was drawn to the creme color and couldn't be happier with it in person. In fact, it matches even better than I anticipated. I have a smokey grey desk and shelf system which it fits well with and also looks good with my hard wood floor. Before I jump to more pros, I will point out the cons first that caused me to knock a star off of my review. The condition was not perfect. The flange was cracked as you can see from the picture and on one side of the seat there was a little dimple and the other side kind of wrinkled, but very minimal and not a deal breaker. The cracked flange is not a big deal because they usually end up cracking anyways and it doesn't have any effect on the mechanics of the chair. Now onto some more pros. *Comfortable! It is a good size, big enough for a big 245ln 6'0" guy like myself but somehow manages to stay slim in your space as well. *High Quality material - even when I was putting it together it was evident that every piece was solid and good quality. This contributes to the comfortability of the chair. *Easy to set up - if you have put any chair together in the past it does nothing unique to complicate it, but I found the tools to be well built and organized. *Footrest - much better than the last chair that I bought. The last one tended to swivel to the left when I tried to kick my feet up. This one feels much more stable so far. *Speaker system - I saved the best for last. I am pleasantly surprised at the quality of the blue tooth speakers. It wasn't difficult to set up, but you do have to download the app to initiate it. I like to listen to YouTube or podcasts while I am playing certain games, such as Microsoft Flight Simulator or City Skylines. I love how I have the sound of the game in front of me, while having the sound of my videos behind me. It balances the sound between the two sources very well so that they do not conflict with each other too much. I would usually have to turn my game down in order to hear my podcasts. I haven't figured out if I can pair with my PC though. I don't think that I can. I have only had it for a couple of days, so longevity is still a question. But it was well packaged with clear instructions and the packet is actually quite sleek.

Really happy with this chair. It feels solid, looks good, and was simple to put together. Everything works the way it should. The lumbar pillow was included, but it didn’t have the strap the instructions showed for adjusting it up and down. The headrest pillow and strap were and included and work perfectly. It rolls around easily, the height adjustment works fine, and the recline is smooth. The footrest turned out better than I expected—nice and sturdy, and it doesn’t make the chair tip over as I was thinking it might. The size is just right for adults. I wanted a big-and-tall chair, and this one fits perfectly—roomy, supportive, and comfortable. On top of that, the price was affordable, and the quality is excellent, which makes it feel like a great value.

This product offers a remarkable balance of affordability, stability, and quality. Its adaptability is noteworthy, and it demonstrates exceptional durability. Additionally, its size is standard and well-suited for its intended purpose.

review_title: Clear Instruction for assembly/ quality materials, blue tooth speakers.just buy it!
body_en: China is producing very high quality, low price, modern esthetic design household furniture. This is an example. This year i have assembled seven outdoor acacia wood chairs, three tables all from china. Very high quality materials, fastenings and clear instructions. Assembly may take an hour or two, but easily accomplished. Chair is fully adjustable for height and back support.

There were plenty of reviews before mine that reported the same issues that this chair we got has. It came in with stains already on it, that formed splatter patterns once assembled. Some looked like black ink on the arm of the chair. Some looked like droplets of dried blood splattered on the left side along the seat and the back. God, I hope it’s not! I sanitized the chair, but none of the stains even lightened no matter what I tried. Even with careful, meticulous assembly, the left side and arm are drooping lower to the front of the chair. The chair looks even from the back. You might as well toss out the footrest. It was a nice idea, just not a sturdy one. The color of the chair is darker and drabber than depicted here. Other than those issues, my son is happy with the chair, and can use it for hours at a time doing homework and also gaming. Hindsight, I should have gotten a black chair so that any and all stains would not be so visible, but I probably would not have spent any more for a different chair because a gaming chair isn’t a real necessity, and it’s not going to be loved like a Lazy Boy anyway. Unless you are considering this for your husband or 40 yr old son, consider that a (hopefully NEW) chair like this will probably last as long as this phase that it is wanted for.

I recently upgraded my gaming setup with the GTPLAYER Leather Gaming Chair in Ivory, and it has transformed my gaming experience in more ways than one. This chair is the epitome of comfort and style, offering a gaming throne that exceeds expectations. First and foremost, the design of the GTPLAYER chair is sleek and modern. The ivory leather upholstery adds a touch of sophistication to my gaming room, making it not only a functional piece of furniture but also an aesthetic centerpiece. The attention to detail in the stitching and overall construction exudes quality craftsmanship. Comfort is paramount during long gaming sessions, and this chair delivers on all fronts. The ergonomic design provides excellent lumbar support and ensures a natural sitting posture, reducing fatigue even during extended gameplay. The adjustable armrests and reclining feature add a customizable touch, allowing me to find the perfect position for both work and play. The GTPLAYER chair's build quality is outstanding. The sturdy metal frame and high-quality leather upholstery not only make it durable but also easy to clean and maintain. The smooth-rolling casters ensure easy mobility, and the 360-degree swivel feature adds a layer of convenience when navigating around my gaming station. One standout feature is the built-in footrest. This thoughtful addition takes comfort to the next level, allowing me to kick back and relax during breaks or when watching movies. It's a game-changer for those moments when you just want to recline and enjoy some downtime. Assembly was a breeze, with clear instructions and all the necessary tools provided. Within no time, I had my GTPLAYER chair ready to elevate my gaming and work setup. In conclusion, the GTPLAYER Leather Gaming Chair in Ivory is a masterpiece that seamlessly combines comfort, style, and functionality. It has become the focal point of my gaming space, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone in search of a premium gaming chair. GTPLAYER has truly set the bar high with this one – an investment that pays off in unparalleled comfort and a touch of gaming luxury
EXCELENTE PRODUCTO.
Excellent purchase, arrived in excellent condition and on time. Easy to assemble, and with clear instructions. The chair is quite comfortable for long work sessions

It took a couple of days to arrive, but it is understandable due to the customs procedure. It arrived well packaged. It is easy to assemble, the instructions are easy to follow. The parts came complete and even came with extra parts for spare parts. The only detail is that one of the speakers was a little banged up, but it works fine. I bought it because I was looking for a chair suitable for people of short stature like me; I am 156 cm tall, the cushion fit perfectly on my neck to rest my head, but my feet don't completely reach the floor, if the seat could be lowered 2 cm more it would have been perfect. It is comfortable to work for hours and with the reclined seat and footrest you can rest well. I am satisfied with the purchase, good price-quality ratio
Todo excelente
NO ES DEL TAMAÑO QUE APARECE EN LA FOTO

review_title: Great Chair at a Great Price
body_en: Amazing gaming chair. Firm seat, which I like. Highly adjustable back. You can literally lie down in it lol. Has a pull-out footrest too. Not noisy or squeaky or anything like that. Seems pretty durable and highly stable. I have never felt it would tip over at all. I use it for gaming and doing college homework, so I'm in it for hours on end lol. Super easy to put together; instructions were easy to understand. Great chair for a great price. Dang good deal! I can highly recommend this gaming chair.

I really like the feel of the cloth vs leather chairs, leather ones tent to crack over time and our cat would leave scratch marks. It was easy to put together. Customer service is great. My teen son is on the heavy side so when he broke off one of the legs I contacted customer service for a replacement part and had one sent out with in a week. Then my son broke the backrest. I had worries that they would not cover it since they already sent a replacement part in the past but customer service was so nice and understanding and sent a replacement backrest with in a few days. I would definitely purchase this chair again. Out of the 5 name brand gaming chairs my son has gone through this is by far the best one of with great quality, comfort and stability.

This chair is a replacement for another gaming chair I had for a number of years that had the fake leather on it and tore off over time, so I decided to get one with a cloth cover instead. I'm happy with the quality of the chair and it looks like it will hold up well over time. It also looks really good. One thing to be aware of is that the chair seat is very firm. If you want a chair that is softer, this is probably not the best option for you. It is still comfortable and I'd still recommend it for anyone who doesn't mind a more firm seat. Another thing to be aware of is that the width of the back between the raised sides is rather narrow. If you have broad shoulders or are a bigger person, you may not be able to lean back comfortably in the chair. The chair can be put together pretty easily by one person and the only issue I had was the picture for attaching the seat back to the seat... the bar that attaches is shown in the picture backwards from what it is supposed to be. If you watch the video that they provide, it's clear how to attach it, but if you're following the instruction images, it may be confusing. The reclining lever is the type that you can push or pull and let go while adjusting the back rather than the spring ones where you have to hold it while adjusting the back. Either option is fine, but I find this style to be slightly more convenient.

review_title: Decent chair at a decent price
body_en: Like other reviews say theres something wrong with the armrests where something sharp stabs u, other then that its a perfectly fine chair and really comfortable. Looks really good and pretty durable id say

I love this chair. Super comfy and the leg rest is great. It's not the strongest leg rest, but I mean, don't lean on it like a savage. If you sit on the chair like a normal human, it works fantastically. The chair is quiet and doesn't make any crazy noises. It is simple to use and the adjust how you want the chair. I even fell asleep in it while studying.

Probably the best economy chair on the market. I needed a second chair for guests and didn't want to spend for another SL chair. This one is surprising well made for the price. Pros: Metal frame. Definitely better than cheaper plastic options. Solid build. Easy assembly. I was able to put it together by myself in about 35 minutes. Material. Reminds me a bit of car seat material. Decently soft and seems fine for prolonged sitting. Cons. Leg rest is really short. Basically useless and I'm only 5'8, BUT it's a standard size and can be replaced with an alternative. Lumbar pillow is not attached. Also kind useless. Arm rests. Not adjustable. But they do move with the recline. Overall, I got it for $100 and worth every penny.

review_title: like sitting on a rock with a thing quilt.
body_en: I am going to be giving this a low score. the assembly was ok, but the seat itself is barely comfortable, and while the back of the seat has a good angling to it, the seat itself is bare bones, and just straight, so when you to go incline the back you start to slide off of the seat. unless you are sitting upright the entire time this is probably one of the worst seats you could buy. I don't care to do the return and will likely just gift it to a nephew or something.

review_title: Great Chair to have for gaming
body_en: Great product with large size, fabric surface and easy to adjust. It only took me half an hour to assemble it by myself. Good looking color and comfortable

review_title: Nöjd med produkten, men problem med frakten.
body_en: My son is happy with the product and the material. However, there were major concerns with shipping. Received a similar replacement item but it also disappeared. With the help of the support, the package arrived, after more than a month.
Easy to assemble. Very comfortable and sturdy. Well worth the price.

WOW... this chair is more than I expected.. compared to the old Obus Forme Office chair from 20 years ago.. this is a dream to sit in with more padding, more space on the seat and better arm rests, all for a quarter of the price paid for the old chair... It was easy to put together and it even arrived 4 days earlier than it said.. so big Bonus it was here before new Years game night. The foot rest is a little chintzy, attachment is suspect if there was a lot of weight ever applied to it... but who uses the foot rest much anyway.. For a TALL person, my man is 6'1" this fits well..

Really beautiful and well made. The materials seem excellent, very comfortable and seems very resistant. Less than half an hour of assembly, clear instructions. Praise goes to the sellers, it arrived with a defective armrest but after contacting them they responded immediately by sending me a new one in a very short time. Everything perfect
nice chair, only connecting cushions could be better, otherwise satisfied

I’m not sure what more you can ask for out of a chair at this price. Easy to assemble, looks pretty good, easy to operate, cushion, lumbar, and neck support are all really good and better than I was expecting. I love the foot rest and the ability to set the exact recline with ease. I’m 5’10” 170 lbs and this chair is very comfortable and foot rest is perfect. For larger people this chair may not be perfect, but it would likely get the job done. If you want something that looks fancy, this isn’t your chair. It looks nice and it’s sturdy, but not fancy. All parts are heavy black plastic. Are there better chairs out there. Yep. Do they cost 3x to 10x more? Yep. I’d say you get 90% of the chair for half the price of name brand “budget” gaming chair options. I’d be surprised if anyone who bought this chair didn’t rate it 8 out of 10 or higher.

This chair is a lot nicer than I had anticipated after reading some reviews. It was packed extremely well and the directions and assembly was super simple! They pack all the hardware in an easy access package that's labeled for every step in the assembly process. They also give you the tool, an Allen wrench, that works on each bolt and screw. The chair is well designed and comfortable. The seat is firm and thick! Don't get me wrong, it's not hard by no means. It has great cushion. It's just well built. Should last for years. It's sturdy! It's not a cheap chair. I bought the textile version at an incredible price and that's great marketing because after putting this baby together, I'd have no hesitations about buying another in the faux leather because I now know the quality is really they from this manufacturer. Highly recommend.

review_title: Absolutely worth it! A great deal!
body_en: This chair has been a fantastic purchase! I thought I would have to get a super expensive chair to get the comfort and support I wanted but this one was very reasonably priced and I got it on sale too. It's extremely versatile and very comfortable even for all day gaming. The lumbar pillow is the perfect firmness. The seat width is such a breath of fresh air. I can change how I'm sitting regularly and comfortably with plenty of room. All of its movement is smooth, i.e hinges, support column, wheels. My favourite feature so far is locking the recline in the exact angle I want with a quick push of a lever. It was easy to put together (though it took a bit of hand strength for some spots, like the last screws on the sides, so it may not be very easy for anyone with dexterity concerns.) It's almost completely noise-free and what noises it does make are quiet. The fabric is holding up well so far (2 months at the time of review). As a seamstress, I had concerns since the faux suede types usually aren't, but it's doing well. And the temperature regulates great. No overheating or sweating. The only thing struggling occasionally are the zippers on the neck and lumbar pillows. Sometimes they slip open since the fabric is so tight over the inserts, but they can be closed again and the zippers aren't technically broken yet. The footrest is a nice addition but doesn't extend far enough out to fully stretch my legs out. An extender that collapses into the main bars for the footrest would be needed since the bars are exactly the depth of the seat when put away. It they were longer they would stick out the back underneath the seat. All-in-all, a fantastic purchase that my weary body is appreciating when I'm at my computer. I'll try to remember to update this on the durability in a few months!

This is actually a pretty solid chair. Was easy to put together, I’d say it took me about 35-40ish mins to put it together. I like the color, was a bit lighter than I expected tho. The material is very soft and comfortable, I like how it feels and everything. The seat padding is pretty firm, but not uncomfortable, could be a tad softer tho. I might need to break it in more. It reclines well and the leg/foot rest is solid and sturdy. The neck rest pillow works well, but I do wish the lumbar pillow was a tad thicker and actually strapped to the chair. My only gripe is the left arm rest wiggles a bit, that’s it. Over all happy with my purchase, would get again in a different color just to have or would give one as a gift.

Really happy with this gaming chair. The lumbar and neck support are fantastic—I can sit for hours working and gaming without my back aching. The build quality feels very solid and sturdy. I also really like the fabric; it’s soft, breathable, and much more comfortable than leather/PU leather, especially for long sessions. Definitely recommend it!

review_title: Very Comfy and Holding Up Great
body_en: I ordered this chair on August 6th, and after a little over two weeks of regular use, I absolutely love it. It is much more comfortable than my previous chair, which I had been using for years, and I can sit in it for long periods without feeling uncomfortable. I also haven't noticed any degradation in the cushioning, materials, or overall comfort so far, which is a great sign. The only downside I had was the assembly. There wasn't really a clear manual included with the chair, so figuring out exactly how everything was supposed to go together was a little confusing. I had to rely on YouTube videos to figure out some of the assembly, and finding a useful video was a bit of a hassle. Once I figured everything out though, the chair went together fine. Overall, I am very happy with the chair. It has been a major comfort upgrade from my previous chair and after a little over two weeks of use, it still feels just as good as when I first put it together.

review_title: Bad, bad, and also not good.
body_en: This chair looks great. I bought it because it had pocket spring construction and the seat wasn't your typical "chunk of foam on a piece of plywood"...and it was red. I hate it. It creaks and wobbles every time you move in it. It took me a solid hour to get one of the arm rest bolts threaded, then the next day, the arm fell off. It's back on, but I have no faith that it will not say goodbye again. The fabric is so slippery that after you sit in it for 15 or 20 minutes, you start to slide forward, out of the chair. Microfiber. Yuck. Warning: Do *not* try to lean back when the chair is in the upright position or you'll end up sitting on the floor (after the seat scrapes your back on the way down.) The headrest is in the right position and is quite comfortable. The lumbar cushion is uncomfortable and, if you do give it a try, it helps in pushing you out of the chair. Sitting on it doesn't help. If you decide to recline, make sure you have a friend there to take a video...so you can post it in the 'funny videos' area of YouTube. It reclines, but the spring isn't adjustable and has so little tension on it that you may end up somewhere you don't want to be. (e.g., the floor) I don't know who this chair was made for but it certainly wasn't me. Maybe it was you. I'm not a gamer. I just wanted a decent (and fairly comfortable) chair for my desk. Maybe if I was a 16 year old gamer I'd be ecstatic. But I'm not. While I'm at it, how does that tubby guy in the picture get his hugeness on that seat and cross his legs? I'm probably half his size and fairly flexible and I can't do that. I tried. Didn't work. I can easily get one leg up on the foot rest though - two if you cross them. Finally, on top of all of this, the pneumatic cylinder seems to lose air on a random basis. As much as I thought I would like this chair I do not. In fact, as much as I hate to say it, this is probably one of the worst chairs that has ever been introduced to my rear end...and back...and arms. I have been in old, wooden office chairs devoid of all padding and/or adjustment that were more comfortable. Even though it says "FREE RETURNS", I would return this chair in a heartbeat - except that I'd have to disassemble it and get it back in the box in a satisfactory manner. You should buy this chair, but only if you want a nice-looking, fabric covered chair that you will never enjoy sitting in. For me, it's just money wasted.

I didn’t think this chair would be as comfortable as it is. I’ve bought a few gaming chairs this year looking for a good one under $200 and this was the one! Nice feel and super easy to put together! Love it and bought the light purple one as well 😌

review_title: Sehr guter Stuhl (Lest mein Fazit durch)
body_en: Super comfortable, but you have to get used to the chair for a week to find it comfortable. This is because of the pillows. At the beginning you think “how uncomfortable are the cushions”, but your body first has to get used to the new sitting position and then you just say “BABA!”. The gaming chair offers a lot of little extras, e.g. the adjustable backrests or the front footrest, which can be extended. ASSEMBLY: The whole thing took me almost an hour, but you have to keep in mind that I had never assembled any chair before and was a bit shocked by the instructions at first, but it turned out that the instructions were easy to understand. You can compare it with an Ikea assembly plan.
