CONCLUSION: My conclusion is that I can definitely recommend this chair because it offers many extras and is comfortable (once you get used to the shape of a gaming chair). Nevertheless, the price of this chair is of course a lot of money, but I would say it's worth it, because you'll definitely keep this chair for a few years and the company is world-famous for its good gaming chairs.

its a very good very comfortable chair in + the fabric and very good quality very comfortable for long gaming sessions another + the chair and high very easy to assemble all the tools its in sight nothing to complain about very good chair very happy for the price it doesn't get any better.

First of all, a 10 for delivery, it arrived 1 week earlier than initially expected. The quality of the materials is very high, the touch and precision of the pieces stands out. Assembly is very simple, following the instructions without a doubt (I recommend an electric screwdriver to tighten the screws or it is very tedious to keep turning the wrench). The operation, the comfort, the fact that it has everything (Bluetooth, speakers, the adjustable armrests (also rotating a little) and the footrest makes it great for intense computer sessions, whether for work, leisure or gaming. It is even comfortable for taking a nap if you want. The only drawback, and I hope that the seller or manufacturer resolves this doubt, is that the left speaker does not sound. I understand that these speakers are for an immersive experience and therefore do not have much volume, since It sounds very faint. But the left speaker doesn't sound to me. Looking at the Bluetooth receiver, it seems that each speaker should have a separate jack cable, and I only found one, and before opening the case (which involves disassembling it) I want to make sure that there must be a cable, and that it will be inside the case because it has slipped through the exit hole.
Very good product, robust and comfortable. Easy to assemble, just with the key it comes with. We'll see how it ages.
Superb armchair that exudes quality. Assembly in 15 minutes and without tools other than the one provided. Stable and very comfortable
The back support on this chair is so great that you won’t want to get off of it. It’s got great stability. The instructions were so clear and easy to follow. Seems pretty durable.

We bought this chair for our 13-year-old son to use at his desk. On unboxing day, he was able to assemble it with minimal help, which was a nice bonus. The chair was true to the advertised color and overall build. My thoughts: In general, I find most gaming chairs to be on the rigid side, and this one is no exception. It doesn’t offer as much support for the back and neck as I’d prefer, even with the included pillow accessories. Compared to other chairs I’ve owned—like my previous Secretlab, which was much heavier and more substantial—this one feels lighter and a bit less sturdy. That said, the material is soft to the touch. I can’t fully speak to how breathable it is yet. Overall, it seems like a decent option for someone looking for a budget-friendly chair while saving up for a higher-end model. Longevity will really depend on how it holds up over time. My son’s thoughts: (I’ll update with more detail later.) He enjoys the added features, especially the leg rest, reclining function, and the included cooling mat. He finds it comfortable and has no issue sitting in it for extended periods. With summer coming up, we’ll see how well it stays cool in hotter conditions. I’ll update this review over time with how it holds up to regular use.

My son purchased this for his gaming set up after we remodeled his bedroom and he loves it! It’s great quality for the money. It’s comfortable to sit in for hours apparently because he never leaves his room now and assembly was very easy.
Purchased this chair for the gamer in my life. Easy to put together, loves the massage feature of the lumbar pillow, loves the feel of the material, and it didn't break the bank.

I really wanted to love this chair. I love the fabric and the design of the chair; it’s very sturdy and honestly a good quality chair. However I will state that this chair tends to make my back hurt, and I’ve never had any issues with back problems till I started to sit in this chair. I love the footrest and the fact you can tilt and adjust the seat in different positions, but I’m just not comfortable and find discomfort while I’m sitting in this chair. Chair sits pretty firm, and I was using a very old office chair before hand and was just looking to purchase something for my desk. It wasn’t difficult to put together and fits well in my desk area, I just wouldn’t recommend this chair to people who are sitting frequently, because I could see where it could cause back issues. For the price point the quality is good, but for the price point I had expected more for the comfort aspect, and there are more affordable comfortable chairs than what this chair can offer you.

Pretty decent chair. Assembly was easy, it looks even better than in the pictures, the adjustability is nuts and the wheels roll incredibly well. It’s a little on the small side if you like to sit like an absolute goblin while you game, like me. The padding could be thicker, but it’s not causing me any problems at all; it’s still quite comfortable.

The chair was was purchased for Overnight delivery, was showing it was out for delivery, then got changed to next day. Finally received the chair, missing instructions as well as a leg arm. It had all wheels but no arm for the wheel to go into. Went out and bought another chair because I wasn’t going to wait any longer. Chair went straight to the dumpster. Do not buy this chair. You can tell it wasn’t going to last long anyways, very poor build quality. This is not a $180 dollar chair, this is maybe $80. If there is a sale and it dips below $100, Maybe worth it. Do not make the same mistake and buy at $160+,based on convenience or next day delivery. Wait a couple of days and invest in a better brand.

I recently got this gaming chair and I’m really impressed with the quality. The build feels solid — from the sturdy frame to the comfortable padding. I also like how adjustable it is — the armrests, recline, and height adjustments make it easy to find a comfortable setup.

Fine chair, comfortable while it lasts. Foot rest hardware is cheap plastic, snapped after about 6 months just from regular use. If you plan to never use the footrest, it's cheaper than an office chair. Otherwise, keep looking.

A good size chair (I was expecting it to be very rough), comfortable. It is very easy to assemble, only the instructions only come in English, but with the images you can guide yourself very well. It comes with everything you need to assemble it. I decided not to assemble it with the armrests due to space issues. Shipping was good and all the parts came very well packaged, there was no strange smell or anything like that. It also comes with a few extras, which are a cooling gel pad and a massager in the lumbar support. The chair's microfiber fabric cleans easily and is very soft to the touch. The wheels are not noisy at all and slide smoothly. Likewise, the chair is completely silent and does not squeak. The backrest is fully adjustable and has an option to lock it to the angle you want so it stays that way. The footrest is equally comfortable and adjustable to taste. I am very satisfied with my purchase, a great option at an excellent price.
Well, the materials may not be the best but if they look good, now it is time to pass to see their durability.

review_title: Es bonito, es tela transpirable y fácil de armar
body_en: Very nice, and easy to assemble, although the instructions are in English, it is very easy to understand the instructions, we need to try it to see how good it is in lumbar support

review_title: A Stylish Office Chair That Feels Comfortable All Day
body_en: I wanted an office chair that looked more like furniture than a typical office chair, and this one immediately caught my attention. The faux leather has a clean, modern appearance that fits perfectly with my home office. After using it daily, I found that it’s not just attractive but also very comfortable. The seat provides good support during long work sessions, and the adjustable headrest makes a noticeable difference whenever I lean back to relax. I also appreciate how easy the faux leather is to wipe clean. The chair rolls smoothly, feels stable, and the reclining function adds a nice option for taking short breaks between meetings. Overall, it combines style and comfort in a way that works very well for everyday office use.

This is one of the most comfortable office chairs I have used. It was very easy to assemble. This chair is extremely comfortable and easy to adjust. The base is heavy metal which makes the chair very sturdy and very stable. The mesh back and headrest allow air circulation but still provides firm support enhanced by the adjustable lumbar support. The arms, footrest, and seat are padded fabric creating a soft comfortable seat. The seat and footrest are made of thick high density foam that provides a soft seat with noticeable support. I do not expect the foam in this seat to break down even with long hours of continual use. I like the fact that it has a 300 pound capacity so I don't have to worry about who may sit in my chair. It swivels and rolls very smooth without any catches. The best part of this chair is the ability to recline and change position to rest periodically. The adjustments are easy to use and work well. They are placed at just the right place to easily reach them. This is a very well made, comfortable office chair at a very reasonable price point.

review_title: Such an upgrade from my previous office chair!
body_en: This is such a nice office chair and a huge upgrade from what I was using before! My other office chair was literally falling apart so I was super excited about this chair. My husband helped me put it together but it didn’t take long. It feels really sturdy and well made and is comfortable even when sitting in it for longer periods. I really like the mesh back because it doesn’t feel hot, and the lumbar support and headrest are both really nice and help with back pain! The seat has a good amount of cushion without feeling too soft. It rolls smoothly and feels stable when moving around. It looks really nice in my office space and feels much more expensive than a basic office chair and I’m really happy with it!

review_title: Looks Nice, but Lacks Lumbar Support
body_en: The chair looks nice and the seat is fairly comfortable for regular use. I like the adjustable headrest and height, and the wheels roll smoothly. My main issue is that there really isn’t much support for the lower back. After sitting for a longer period, I definitely notice the lack of lumbar support

review_title: Comfortable and Easy to Keep Looking New
body_en: One reason I chose this chair was the faux leather upholstery because I wanted something that would be easy to maintain. After several weeks of use, it’s still looking great and only takes a quick wipe to remove dust or small spills. The seat feels supportive without being overly firm, and the backrest gives good support throughout the workday. The adjustable headrest was another pleasant surprise because it helps support my neck whenever I take a short break from the computer. The chair also feels sturdy while moving around the office, and the overall construction inspires confidence. Overall, this has been a practical and comfortable chair that also adds a more refined look to my workspace.

review_title: Armrests flip up, chair tucks under the desk
body_en: The armrests get more use than anything else on this chair. They flip up when I want the chair tucked under my desk. They also slide forward and swivel in toward the keyboard while I type. The mesh back runs cool. There's a switch that frees the back to rock, and a tension dial that sets how much push it takes to lean into it. I keep it locked while I'm working. The seat cushion is deep and I'm not feeling the base through it. Shifting my weight around hasn't set off any creaking from the base. The lumbar block slides high on the backrest, but it only moves up and down and doesn't push in or out toward my back.

review_title: Comfortable Chair With Lots of Adjustable Features
body_en: I received this product through the Amazon Vine program for my unbiased opinion. This office chair is comfortable and has a lot of features that make it nice for working at a desk for longer periods of time. I especially like the high back, adjustable lumbar support, and headrest. The mesh back allows for good airflow and doesn’t feel hot or stuffy. The reclining feature is a nice bonus when you want to lean back and take a break, and the pull-out footrest makes it even more comfortable. There are plenty of adjustments available, so you can customize the chair to your preferred sitting position. Overall, it’s a comfortable and versatile chair that works well for a home office, computer desk, or gaming setup.

review_title: Comfortable for Long Workdays and Relaxing Breaks
body_en: I spend most of my workday at a computer, so I wanted an office chair that could keep me comfortable while also giving me a place to relax during breaks. After using this chair for a while, I think it strikes a nice balance between productivity and comfort. The adjustable lumbar support was one of the first things I noticed. It was easy to position it where my lower back needed support, and it made sitting for several hours much more comfortable than my old chair. The mesh back also allows good airflow, so I don’t feel overheated even during long afternoons. One feature I didn’t realize I would use as often as I do is the retractable footrest. Pulling it out and reclining the back makes it easy to take a quick break without leaving my desk. The reclining function feels smooth, and the chair stays stable while leaning back. Assembly was straightforward, and everything fit together without any issues. The materials feel solid, the seat cushion has enough support without being overly firm, and the chair rolls quietly across my floor. Overall, this has been a comfortable upgrade for my home office. It works well for both focused work and short relaxation breaks, making long workdays much easier.

I’m really happy with this office chair. It feels sturdy and comfortable, and the mesh design keeps it breathable even when sitting for long periods. The lumbar support and adjustable headrest provide great support for my back and neck, and I especially like the adjustable armrests. The footrest is a nice bonus when I want to lean back and relax. It was fairly easy to assemble, and everything feels solid and well made. Overall, it’s a comfortable and practical chair for working from home or everyday use. Definitely worth the price!
It is a fairly complete office chair, the high mesh backrest promotes ventilation, the lumbar support helps maintain correct posture and is very comfortable.

For a $300 chair, I expected it to be put together with a degree of functionality. Only a month after owning it, the lower back support piece was already falling off the chair due to the bolt falling out, which is a part assembled in the factory. However, customer service is amazing, and got me a refund for the trouble. I'll need to fix the chair, but I'll be able to buy the supplies to fix it! Everything else besides that Lower Back support is great, too. It might come in kinda janky, but the support team is great.

review_title: Adjustable arm rests are no bueno!
body_en: Nice chair all and all… I really like the lumbar, the recline and foot rests.. But the swivel arms are absolutely miserable! There needs to be a way to lock them in place. Just by resting my arms on them while seated they don’t want to stay put, heaven forbid I try to use them to get in and out of the chair. I’d wind up on the floor. I’m a big guy, (6’-5” 300lbs.) and the chair has no problem reclining and not tipping which is a huge plus. If it wasn’t for the stupid arms, I’d love it.

review_title: Comfortable chair but arms not stable
body_en: Comfortable chair but arms not stable

This 3D headrest is height-adjustable—I raised it 2cm and pushed it forward a little, and it fits the curve of my neck perfectly. It stays snug even when I lean back. I napped on it for 20 minutes during lunch break, and my neck didn’t slump at all. Finally, no stiff neck after napping!

review_title: Easy to Assemble and Very Comfortable
body_en: The chair was easy to put together and feels great to use. It’s comfortable, supportive, and works perfectly for my home office. Very happy with it!

I have been using this chair for several days, and I really love it. It is very comfortable and provides excellent back support, allowing me to sit for several hours without discomfort. I purchased a used chair at a great price, but it looks like new. I am very satisfied with this purchase.

A very good chair, comfortable, it does take a little to assemble, but it has clear instructions, the materials feel resistant, the lumbar support is great and the armrests are on another level when turning, there is no position in the chair in which it does not fit well

Bought this chair for my daughter and she loves it. I was skeptical about whether it would be good because it was so much cheaper than the fancy ones, but my daughter says it is very supportive for her back even after hours of summer gaming. It has been about 7 months and no complaints with this chair so far. We purchased all black. It's nice looking, was easy to put together. The height adjusts so you don't have to worry about what size desk you have. I did have to call customer service once and i got 2 beeps and then the line disconnected. I thought- well that stinks...but they called me back. They were super pleasant and easy to deal with. I'm thinking of getting the smaller tralt chair for myself. I wouldn't hesitate to buy from them again

review_title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent ergonomic and very comfortable chair
body_en: I bought this TRALT chair to work several hours a day at the computer, and it has exceeded my expectations. The mesh back allows for good ventilation, preventing my back from getting too hot, and the lumbar support provides excellent support throughout the day. The adjustable headrest helps maintain a comfortable neck posture, while the fold-down armrests are very practical when I need to save space. The chair feels sturdy and stable, even with extended use. The seat is wide, padded, and comfortable, and the casters glide smoothly. Assembly was also easy thanks to the included instructions. Overall, it's an excellent option for its value. I recommend it for those who work from home, study, or spend many hours sitting at a desk. 👍🏻💺✨

* Comfortable for long sitting sessions – Many reviewers say the mesh back and thick seat cushion remain comfortable during 6–10 hour workdays. * Easy assembly – putting it together in about 20–30 minutes using the included tools. * Good lumbar support – The ergonomic back design is frequently mentioned as helping reduce lower-back fatigue. * Excellent value for the price – Buyers often compare it favorably with chairs costing significantly more. * Sturdy construction – Users appreciate the metal base, smooth-rolling casters, and solid feel, especially considering the budget price. * Breathable mesh back – Helps keep users cooler than fully padded chairs during extended use. * Adjustability – The height adjustment, recline, and armrests are commonly cited as making it easier to find a comfortable position.

review_title: Chair is for little people, but it’s still nice
body_en: I guess I misread the size this chair is intended for (description says 54”-62” - but I saw it as 5 foot 4 to 6 foot 2 because of the 300 lbs weight limit) - I mean, I guess that’s really my fault.. but seriously, WHO IS 300lbs and 4 foot 6? So needless to say the lumbar support is in the totally wrong place for me being 6 ft - but I’m sure it’s well placed if you’re a petite person for which it was intended. Anyway, I’m keeping it because it works for my daughter that is 5’ 6” (she says it’s “super comfy”) and the chair design looks really sharp and modern (we got the Gray on White frame). The reason I’m not giving it 5 stars is because there’s no way the seat cushion can handle 300lbs, I’m only 210 and my butt fell asleep after 2 hours of sitting in it.. also, the arms flex so much using them to get up out of the seat I’m afraid they will snap under my weight (again, I’m not even close to the 300lb weight limit it’s intended for). While the lumbar adjustment goes in and out towards or away from your back, it’s good to note that it does NOT adjust up or down. Props to the mfr for keeping the parts to a minimal and reusing the same screw sizes for most of the build, that was helpful so I didn’t have to worry if I was using the correct screw lengths or washers.. they also include a really nice T Allen wrench instead of the standard L style (which is a super nice touch) - so all this kept the assembly simple and I was done in less than 20 minutes. Putting my misunderstanding to the side, the reason this gets dinged a star is due to the seat having weak arms, thinner than expected seat padding, and the inability to adjust the lumbar support up/down.. other than that it’s actually a good solid and stylish chair for somebody in the 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 foot, sub 200lb demographic.

review_title: Very Comfortable and Supportive Office Chair
body_en: I’m really impressed with this TRALT ergonomic office chair. It has a comfortable, supportive design that makes a big difference when sitting at a desk for several hours. The lumbar support is one of my favorite features because it provides good support for the lower back without feeling too stiff. The chair is also very adjustable. I like being able to adjust the seat height, headrest, backrest, and armrests to find a comfortable position. The flip-up armrests are especially convenient when I need more space around my desk. The breathable mesh seat and back are another great feature. They help keep the chair comfortable during longer work or study sessions, and the cushioning provides a nice balance between softness and support. The reclining function is also great when I want to lean back and relax for a few minutes. The wheels roll smoothly, and the 360-degree swivel makes it easy to move around my workspace. The chair feels sturdy and well made, and I really like the overall modern look. Assembly was straightforward and the instructions were easy to follow. Once assembled, the chair felt stable and solid. Overall, this is a great ergonomic chair for working from home, studying, gaming, or simply spending a lot of time at a desk. It offers a lot of adjustable features and comfort for the price. I’m very happy with it and would definitely recommend it.

I really liked this chair. It's comfortable and feels quite sturdy and stable. The lumbar support is very helpful, especially when I spend a lot of time sitting. I also like that the armrests can be flipped up when I need more space. The mesh back allows for good airflow, and the design looks modern. Assembly was easy following the instructions. Overall, I think it's a good chair for the price, and I'm happy with my purchase.

review_title: Decent chair but not for us taller people
body_en: I really wanted to like this chair but, while there are things I do like about it, there are too many things I find fault with. For context, I am 73 years old, am 6’3” and weigh in around 265lbs. My last chair was designed for big and tall people and it fit me to a tee. I worked from home for two years during the apocalypse and that chair was super comfortable and I could spend over 8 hours a day in it with no problems. Unfortunately the faux leather wore off so I needed a replacement. I retired a couple of years ago and now only spend a few hours a week in front of the computer so I really don’t need anything too fancy or expensive. After researching a bunch of chairs, I settled on the Tralt Mesh Back Ergonomic Computer / Gamer Chair. I’ve never had a mesh chair before so I expected it to feel a lot different from my old all faux leather chair and it does feel a lot different but it’s what I expected. The good: 1. Price. For $130.00, I think this is a pretty good deal. 2. Assembly. Fairly quick. It took me about 30 minutes to unbox and assemble but I took my time so you could probably do it in 15-20 minutes easy. All parts lined up correctly and all bolts screwed in without any problems. 3. Weight. This chair is at least 50% lighter than my old chair so carrying it fully assembled upstairs was easy for me. 4. Appearance. Very nice. 5. Adjustments. Raising and lowering the chair is smooth and easy. Control lever and hydraulic piston work well. Tilting mechanism is also smooth and easy. The not so good. 1. IMO, this chair is NOT for anyone over 6’ if you are going to spend any time in it. The Amazon description says this will fit people who are 5’2” - 6’4”. Nope. The measurements shown in the description PHOTOS says 5’3” - 6’2”. Also nope. The front of the seat cushion hits my legs about half way up the thigh. It should hit closer to the knees. This makes me feel like I’m sitting on the edge of the chair. If the seat cushion was 24” in depth instead of 19-1/2” this would solve that problem. Also, if the lumbar support was positioned correctly, it might fit and feel better as well. 2. Lumbar support. As other reviewers have stated, the lumbar is too low and hits your tailbone, not the lumbar area of your back. This setup might be acceptable for someone shorter but for anyone 6’ or taller this is a problem. The lumbar is adjustable but it’s kind of a moot point in my case. 3. Arm rests. They are adjustable and slide forward but for taller people, even if fully adjusted forward, the arm rests still sit too far back and are not comfortable. 4. Stability. When I sit in the chair it doesn’t feel super solid. I don’t know how to explain it but I feel like I am going to tilt off to the side. It’s just a weird feeling. The chair doesn’t actually tip side to side but it’s just this odd feeling I get when I sit and even when rolling forward. 5. Weight capacity. The description says the chair has a weight capacity of 330lbs. This is probably true but, after using the chair for a while, I wonder about the longevity of the chair for someone heavier like me. Look, as I said earlier, for the price this is a good deal. I only use the chair once or twice a week so decided to keep it as returning it was more of a problem than I wanted to deal with. If the seat cushion was 3-4” longer, it would fit my legs much better and I would be a lot happier. My advise: if you are big and tall like me, pass on this chair. Spend a little more money and get something that fits you.

review_title: Great option for a great price
body_en: I REALLY like this chair. Originally it arrived without wheels but quick contact with the sellers customer service and they sent me wheels right away. Customer service was friendly and easy to work with. Sometimes you never know and I was pleasantly surprised. I love that the arms of the chair can flip up so I can choose to use them if I feel like it. I typically don’t use chair arms and have to remove them, but having the option is even better. The seat area is very large, which I like since I’m someone who usually has a leg up on my chair and I still have plenty of space for my booty. I’m short (5’3”) and this chair works well for me. I prefer to rest my feet on the tops of the wheels & chair legs since I’m used to not touching the floor. Just the same, the height adjustment is helpful if I didn’t prefer to float a little higher off the ground. The seat is nicely padded and comfortable. It’s lasted perfectly for the last 7 months. It’s lighter in color and could stain easily if you’re not careful with your morning coffee. I’m very happy with my purchase.

I simply loved it, super comfortable and you can see that it will last, I bought another one for a much lower price right here on Amazon and it is not even close to comfort and robustness. It's worth the investment, as I need to sit for an average of 8 hours or more, so quality makes a difference
The truth is that it is very comfortable!
Best chair I've had in my life, no more back pain, the support works very well for me. Super comfortable the seat is big it’s great
In general, I found it very comfortable, and it was very easy to assemble. The only detail is that I felt it a little fragile, it doesn't feel as solid as others I've had.
The product is different from the pictures and description, but good

Comfy chair, the assembly was honestly fairly easy. I looked up a YouTube vid but I probably could have figured it out after an hour. With the video it was maybe 15 minutes. Quality is very good, a big upgrade from my previous Walmart chair. I do a lot of gaming and it honestly has helped a ton.
Had it for about a month now. Amazing chair, especially for the price soft and a solid structure highly recommend! I didn’t get any instructions with it, but it was pretty easy to put together

review_title: Good chair, comfortable for work day use, a little creaky.
body_en: I've had the chair for 7 months, and it is a good pick overall with no buyer's remorse. I am 6'2 and 180lbs and sit in the chair for ~7 hours a day. The support is okay, as they are just adjustable lumbar/neck pillows and nothing rigid. I have a 30" waist, and I would say a 34" or 36" is around the max to fit within the seat bolster. The arms do not adjust out, only up and down, which is not an issue for me. If you are larger, that is something to consider. The recline feature works hilariously well as you can recline nearly flat and not fall over. The leather is still in great shape with hardly any creasing and no damage or wear to the material. It's comfortable to sit in for the whole day. The chair was very simple to assemble in ~5 minutes and comes together like every standard office chair with 4 bolts for the base, and 6 for each arm. This chair has started to creak which can't be helped. I would give it a 3.5-4 rating due to this alone. The creak comes from the pressed steel pin the chair tilts on at the top of the post, so it can't be tightened or adjusted in any way. It is a little obnoxious, but my only real issue with the chair. To compare, I have a $1,500 Humanscale Freedom Task Chair with Headrest at home, and I feel no real difference in the chair's comfort or overall quality. The Humanscale does have better built-in ergonomic adjustments like the arms, seat pan depth, and lumbar position versus the Corsair, which only includes a couple pillows for lumbar and neck support. The Humanscale is really underwhelming for the price, very loud with the smallest movements, and not that comfortable. Do not feel compelled to spend more expecting better quality. Overall, I would probably purchase the Corsair TC500 Luxe for a little more next time for more adjustability, and the built in lumbar system.

review_title: Looks good in pictures and description. Return before 30 day window ends.
body_en: Looks good in pictures but shows it flaws quickly. I love the Corsair brand and took a chance on this chair because it looks great. Some issues I found include: lumbar cushion is too large and impractical/uncomfortable; unusable. Head cushion is fine, but taller people will have to slouch for it to fit your neck and cause lower back pain; remove it and there is no neck support at all. back cushion material is very thin and will quickly give way to the lumbar frame, which is not comfortable at all. The entire chair mechanism and controls are cheap quality. Even in the locked position the chair still rocks back and forth to a small degree. You are constantly flexing your muscles just to stay in one because of the sway. The bolt holes are flimsy and even when tightened beyond capacity, the entire chair still rocks and flexes. No stability at all. Arm rests are completely fixed in place and can only go up and down. Arm rest surface is hard and uncomfortable. Arm rests stay in place when leaning back causing your arms to completely come off the arm rest or having to stretch both arms just to stay on the armrest, another huge inconvenience and ergonomic issue. Seat cushion is just thin as the back support. Thin cheap poly stuffing across metal frames. Get ready for serious lower back issues. Unless you are a small child, this chair is not for you. Now I know why they only give you 30 days to return the item. The chair shows its issues after that window closes.

review_title: Glad I bought it…Well not for long
body_en: I was hesitant to buy this chair. Every review I read was an emotional rollercoaster. One minute it’s great, one minute it’s trash, I wasn’t sure what to believe. I decided to just commit to it and order since I’ve always wanted this chair, and it matches my Corsair peripherals. I ordered it Monday, it came Wednesday, which is pretty awesome. Everything was well packaged. Branded bags, a lot of protection surrounding the products, I was impressed. It does NOT come with physical instructions, but you can just find them online. Super straight forward install which took me a solid half an hour at most. Now, the final verdict. First sit down and I was really impressed. The bottom cushion is honestly nice, and the two back pillows work well and fit my body like a glove. I’ve already used this for a consecutive couple of hours and I’m happier than I was in my other chair. I was rocking a Respawn 110 Pro, which is very large and plush but is very cheap feeling in comparison. For those looking to get this chair, every single one of the complaints I’ve seen did NOT fit my experience. Whether it be the parts, the bolts, the cushion, whatever. But I do understand where some of these may come from. Let me advise that this chair is absolutely perfect for me. Im 5’11 and 145 so I’m not your average bodybuilder. It still has some room but just be mindful of that since it does seem like it’s meant for the “smaller” peeps. Besides that, everything feels great and is premium. It left me surprised, and I will continue to not trust reviews and just get the dang thing myself. Glad I made the decision. EDIT: LMAO I sold it less than a year later because it started hurting to sit for long periods of time. The chair formed to my seating position but it never felt soft/comfortable enough. Sadly my 5 star didn’t last that long. Recently got a GT Player suede chair for half the price and it’s 10 times better. It’s ight you live and you learn. Just get an ergonomic chair if you want comfort
We love these chairs. We have three of them now. They have been durable and comfortable

review_title: A comfortable chair with a great lumbar support.
body_en: The chair came well-packaged and intact. Assembly was fairly easy and straightforward using the assembly instructions on the Corsair website accessed via the QR code printed on the inside of the box lid. The chair appears to be well built and has been comfortable so far. Given the price of comparable chairs, I would say that this one is worth the $229 that I paid for it. As for durability, only time will tell.
This chair is one of the best for its price and it is very comfortable, it is definitely worth it and it took me 20 minutes to assemble.

I was dilemma on whether to get the leather version or fabric version. In the end i picked leather beaucse its much easier to clean and maintenance. No doubt i made one of the best choice. The leeather is luxurious feeling and very much comfortable. I do face shipping issue from 3rd party seller but it was resolved in a weeks time. Abit frustrating but I do believe sometimes mistakes are inevitable.
The chair soon started to creak and the foam in the seat is very thin, so you quickly sit on the wood. After 6 months of use, the covering (skin) begins to wear and chafe.

The Corsair TC100 is a highly recommended chair! The workmanship is neat and you can tell that attention was paid to quality. For the price it is absolutely unbeatable – functional, comfortable and without unnecessary bells and whistles. The ergonomic design in particular ensures a high level of seating comfort, even when sitting for longer periods. If you're looking for an inexpensive yet reliable chair, you can't go wrong here. Clear recommendation!

Such a disappointment. I waited 2 weeks for this chair, Amazon used a 3rd party courier company. When I saw the eta after ordering the chair assuming it was being shipped from the US. Nope 2 week delivery time from Melbourne to Canberra. I was so hyped to put this thing together. Missing instructions was annoying, but not the end of the world as it was easy to figure out. Such a let down sitting on this thing for the first time. It’s very firm and in no way comfortable. There is a lever to that locks the chair from leaning back and the opposite direction lets it free. The lock setting still rocks the chair back a few inches before locking. The free setting is useless, you have to push yourself back for it to work and then just snaps back to resting position. I own many Corsair products, and i find them all high quality, well made. 10 minutes I gave this chair before requesting a refund.

review_title: Ideal para Oficina o Gaming EXCELENTE opción.
body_en: It was worth the investment, very comfortable, cute and easy to assemble, it does not come with instructions.

review_title: Rock solid, whisper quiet, and a lifesaver for office naps!
body_en: I’m really impressed with this chair. Assembly was a breeze because the instructions were clear, and I had it put together in no time. Right out of the box, you can tell the hardware has some serious weight to it since nothing feels cheap or flimsy. Once assembled, it feels super sturdy with great weight support. Best of all, there’s zero creaking or squeaking when you shift around or lean back. The pull-out footrest is the real game-changer, though. Being able to kick back and take a quick nap in the office is insanely comfortable. Totally worth it!

My son ordered this chair for his desk and gaming. He loves it and said it was very easy to assemble. It's a nice slim size so if you're cramped for space you'll love it. It's solid and looks to be durable. The foot rest is brilliant and I may get one myself for my work desk. I am in a chair all day for work and I've been having a lot of hip pain. The reclining back and foot rest do wonders for tight hip flexors and circulation.

I’m very happy with this gaming chair. It was fairly easy to put together and feels sturdy once assembled. The seat is comfortable, the back support is good, and I like the extra neck and lumbar cushions. The black and white design also looks really nice and clean in person. The chair feels spacious and comfortable even when sitting for a longer period of time. The armrests and reclining feature are useful, and it rolls smoothly. For the price, I think the quality is very good. Overall, a great gaming/office chair and I’m happy with the purchase.

review_title: Very nice chair for the price
body_en: Pretty comfortable chair. Seems sturdy and looks good. Seat width is just enough for me, I'm 5'10" 200 lbs, a heavier person might find it too narrow, but the height and seat back are more than tall enough. Covered in good vinyl that could almost pass for real leather, well cushioned. Vibrating lumbar pillow feels pretty good, USB powered, cord about 4' long which you can detach when not using it. Armrests adjust easily, it reclines nicely, though footrest is a bit short, hits me about mid-calf, and not real stout. Everything fit together easily, the packing was kind of scrambled but all the parts were there. I'm satisfied with the purchase

This slim and efficient computer chair is exactly what I needed. Feels great and keeps you focused at your desk like a good gamer chair should. The lay back feature is almost good enough to take a nap in, seriously I almost fell asleep! When locked in at the normal height it gets work done better than those bigger CEO chairs, by far better. The only drawback is you can't really rock back on it. Instead you can go back and lock that in but once locked you lose the rocking feature. Not a huge drawback but my old chair rocked and I kinda liked that feature. I love the colors and the little extra lumbar supports it comes with. Overall a very solid chair and built to last. It also fits next to my computer better than my last chair so I have to give it high parise for that. You really can't go wrong at this price, my last chair cost 3x more and it didn't last more than a few years before the seat wear down to nothing, this chair is built to last longer I can already tell.

review_title: Like sitting on a cloud plus a footrest and massage
body_en: Okay, I’m officially obsessed with this Dowinx chair. First off, it looks super clean in white. But looks aside, this thing is COMFY. The seat is nice and padded, and the lumbar support actually has a little massage function—perfect for when your back starts yelling at you after hour three of gaming or work. The footrest is a game changer. Pull it out, lean back, and you’re basically in nap mode. I’m around 220 lbs and it feels rock solid—supposedly holds up to 330, so no worries there. The armrests move up and down and link with the recline, which feels way fancier than it sounds. Assembly took maybe 30 minutes. My only tiny gripe? White shows dirt, but that’s on me. For long gaming sessions or Zoom marathons, this chair delivers. Worth every penny.

review_title: Needs different seat cushion and better footrest
body_en: Headrest, massager lumbar support, adjustable armrests and recline are nice. Padding is quite firm. Not built for the thicc thighed though, sides of the seat dig into my thighs, have to use a pillow or extra cushion to elevate myself high enough above the seat in order to feel comfortable. Footrest is mediocre especially for my long legs as I have to rest my calves against it or sit cross legged as it does not conform well to my legs. 3 out of 5, it's a decent chair that needs a couple of changes/improvements

Easy assembly, great looking chair! Haven't tried the usb massager yet but my computer is right next to it and I have usb's on the desk or could use a portable charger if I needed/wanted. I really like the 2D-linkage armrests, keeps my elbow at a comfortable level at the computer! I weigh roughly around 200lbs the chair is comfy but isn't as wide as some, perhaps breaking it in will help. Overall I'm happy with my purchase and my old chair was starting to show a lot of wear and tear. Recommended.
Very comfortable and easy to assemble. It looks good and the material is of very good quality

review_title: LOVE THIS CHAIR FOR MY OFFICE.
body_en: Love this chair super easy to put together and super comfortable. Highly recommend this chair. No noises seems very stable and durable as well. Stability does not seem to be an issue as well.
Very happy with the chair. Easy to put together, very comfortable. and great price.

review_title: Decent Chair, arm cushions will go flat
body_en: I've had this chair for almost a year now. The cushion in the arms is gone :| just from normal use. it makes a lot of creaking noises and doesn't feel "stable". When you sit in it, it will wobble a little as you shift it's not solid. I'm assuming it's due to how you put it together as it is in lots of pieces. Otherwise, still works, still holds my butt secure while gaming. really wish the air cushions didn't die though :( My only disappointment
Easy to assemble. Very comfortable. Well worth the price.

This has been pretty much exactly what I hoped. Solid, comfortable, functional. I saw a few comments mentioning it doesn't recline at all, but that isn't the case--you can lean back and it has some give (though yes, it doesn't have a built-in recline thing). The up seat height adjuster works well. Arm handles aren't adjustable in height but that hasn't been an issue for me. To be frank I find myself getting kind of sweaty on the rear end when sitting, but I think any chair that isn't some kind of mesh material on the bottom would give me the same issue. So I don't have any complaints. It's not gonna change your life but for the price, I'm plenty happy with it and will probably use it for however many years until it breaks. Took under an hour to set up and was intuitive as long as you refer to the instructions.

(Few months of constant use) Actually a great chair, especially for the price. Comfortable, good for sitting for long periods, good posture & looks nice as well. Cons: Can see the cushion flattening out sooner rather than later (maybe) but I like this chair so much I’ll prob just buy another when it wears out.

Was really frustrating to put together when trying to assemble the arm rest to the chair after having already assembled the seat and back rest together, which is what it says to do in instructions before even attaching armrest to seat. Furthermore the plastic circles that are supposed to cover the areas where we use the hex screws, keep falling off. And don’t stay in place.

Solid but not made to be abused. One of the most shocking things when receiving this product is its packaging. You think you bought something cheap when the reality is that everything is optimized so that you receive the best possible product for the price you paid. This chair is not fragile at all. Most of the construction is made of metal and plastic of good material, in addition to having an ingenious design to adjust the screws to have the best assembly with difficulty ratio. The screws are positioned in such a way that, although simple, it guarantees pressure and sustainability higher than what you would expect for this price range. Of course, this is not made to be assembled quickly and with great force. It requires patience and "craft" when inserting the screws on the legs, the back of the chair and especially the arms. I give it a 7/10 for difficulty assembling which, although it is simple, requires you to pay attention. Would you recommend this product to the most "demanding" ones? The answer is complex, but in my experience. Yes, if you want to treat your chair with due care so as not to shake yourself too much or have bad postures that the same instructions tell you to avoid for optimal use of the chair. A no, if what you are looking for is an ergonomic chair that can withstand the roughest of rough use. In short, great chair, packaging that is a bit scary but it is a satisfying experience in the end. Highly recommended if you are in a financial pinch or if it is your first desk chair.
Very satisfied decent chair overall
This chair is comfy and suits a child perfectly as a gaming chair. Easy to assemble and an affordable price.
Good quality for the price
A beautiful chair, better than expected. It seems solid and stable, was relatively easy to assemble and looks really good.

review_title: An amazing chair at a reasonable price.
body_en: I got this chair for about $118 back in January of this year. I held off on writing a review because, I really wanted to get to use the chair to understand its inner workings. To start with, the chair is made out of a breathable material and provides back support that can be adjusted for more or less firmness. Additionally, there is an adjustable head support as well and the armrests can be adjusted either side ways or slid forward. Putting this chair together was incredibly easy. In fact, this was the easiest instructions for a piece of furniture I put together in a while. The chair is reasonably sized and stable and I feel like it has been incredibly durable so far.

review_title: High-End Quality Without the High-End Price Tag
body_en: This is an impressively high-quality chair at a very competitive price point. While there are a few minor details that could be improved, the overall craftsmanship and thoughtful design make it a standout choice for a home office. One of the most impressive aspects was the packaging. The box was meticulously taped on all sides, preventing any dust or particles from entering; a level of care I wish was standard for all furniture companies. Inside, rather than using messy styrofoam that breaks apart and litters the floor, the company used neat bubble-style wraps for each part. This attention to detail ensured that even though the chair is heavy, every piece arrived clean and in perfect condition. The build quality is excellent, starting with the solid metal base that gives the chair a reassuring heaviness and stability. Assembly was relatively straightforward for someone used to DIY projects, though a second person might be helpful if you aren't familiar with fixing things. The headrest is particularly noteworthy; unlike more expensive chairs I’ve owned where the headrest constantly slips, this one is very sturdy. The lumbar support is also highly effective, allowing you to adjust both the height and the support strength. The 3D armrests are another highlight, moving back and forth, twisting, and flipping up 90 degrees so you can either use them for support or move them out of the way to push the chair fully under the desk. The seat cushion is equally impressive, with 3.14-inch thick foam that feels deep and resilient, giving me confidence that it won't flatten out or lose its shape with regular use. There are a few areas where the product could be refined. The armrests are made from a PU-padded material, which I find to be a negative as it is prone to friction damage over time; I would have preferred a simple high-quality plastic or a full mesh/cloth finish. Additionally, the assembly gloves included were far too small for an average adult. I also have a suggestion for the company regarding the extra hardware provided: since these chairs often come with spare screws or tools, it would be a fantastic and unique innovation to build a small, dedicated compartment into the frame of the chair to store these extra materials. I haven't seen this feature on other chairs, but it would be a very pragmatic way to ensure the spare parts aren't lost over the years. Despite these small points, this remains a five-star quality chair in my opinion.

review_title: A review after a year of owning this chair
body_en: It’s been over a year since I bought this and have decided to write my review. My experience with this chair during this time- since I bought it and up till now is overall good experience. It’s not the greatest chair out there available on the market, but especially for the price and usability, I would say it was worth it. A few Pros worth mentioning: • adjustability • comfortable cushion • lightweight and easy to move around A few cons worth mentioning: • No reclining- just a “rocking back and fourth” which you have to twist below the seat to adjust the sensitivity- which I find very tedious, tiring, and long. • Headrest is honestly not the best and kind of protrudes your head forward a bit- although adjustable, still not as comfortable as I would like. • Cushion will eventually wear out- BUT not too much and still lowkey comfortable, but I started to felt the need to change my sitting position more overtime. As stated before the chair is decent- especially for the price. For me personally, I love that the seat encourages you to sit up straight and nicely, but naturally, it does get “tiring” after a bit of time. Even then, not sitting the way it intended to- is ironically the most comfortable way to sit on it. The seat does not get too hot which is also nice. If the chair had actual reclining, this chair would be perfect. Also, the chair has some decent height adjustability aswell. The building process was easy and didn’t take that long to do. Overall, if you needed something that was comfortable enough, cheap, and reclining is not a need, I would recommend this chair.

review_title: 45 minutes assembly -- piece of cake. Nice chair.
body_en: Before I finally landed on this chair I read about a million articles with buying advice for ergonomic desk chairs, looked for second hand expensive chairs, read so many Amazon reviews. Obviously you can spend a whole lot of money on an ergonomic desk chair (even used ones), but I really didn't want to. I just bought this today, so the jury is out on long term wear, ,but I can say that the components feel solid, assembly was easy, it is *very* comfortable so far, and -- even more to the point -- VERY adjustable in so many different ways that physical therapists etc recommended in the articles I read. I am 5 foot 5; in order to put the chair at the right ergonomic height for my particular desk and keyboard, I need a footrest so my feet aren't dangling. But that would be the case with any chair in my setup. The headrest is great, the arms are soft and comfortable, the back support piece is perfect, and everything can be adjusted as you sit in it. Rollers are quiet and stable on laminate floor. The box was a good size and heavy enough (~32 lbs) to be awkward for an unfit middle aged lady to wrangle down apartment steps; however, the Amazon driver brought it straight to my door. The chair was carefully packed. Whoever wrote the assembly instructions (which are in English and Spanish) for this chair is some kind of technical writing genius -- I have never seen clearer or more easy-to-follow instructions. From slicing open the tape on the box to finished chair was 45 minutes for me. All you need for assembly is included -- also fabric gloves (for protecting your manicure? I guess?) and extra bolts and washers. Super buy. If I'd known I could get such an affordable and massive upgrade from my previous garbage chair I would have done it long ago. Great value for the money. I rarely write reviews but all the reviews I read helped me make a great decision, so here ya go.

review_title: Highly Recommend! quality purchase for the price!
body_en: I am very happy with this purchase! The quality exceeded my expectations, especially for the price. Everything arrived well-packaged, was easy to set up, and worked exactly as described. The materials feel durable, and it's clear that attention was given to the overall design and build quality. I've been using it regularly, and it has performed flawlessly without any issues. If you're looking for a reliable product that offers great value for the money, I would definitely recommend this one. I would happily purchase it again and wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to family and friends. Overall, this has been an excellent purchase, and I'm very satisfied!

I was so excited to finally get a new chair for my desk at home. When it arrived, the delivery driver even walked it down the hall to my apartment for me. Once I brought it inside, I saw that the box was kind of badly taped up, but I didn't think much of it at first. Once I opened it, the items inside were haphazardly wrapped in plastic and bubble wrap, but again, it's a cheap chair from Amazon, so not too worried yet. Then I pulled out the little plastic envelope with the toolkit and gloves and that's when I realized that this was not a new chair. The gloves were dirty and had clearly been used before and the toolkit was open in several places. Ugh! All of the pieces were included and I didn't see any obvious damage on any of the parts. Plus, the thought of trying to send it back was too much, so I decided to move forward. The first step was attaching the legs which went fine. Then I needed to insert the wheels. Four of the wheels snapped in very easily. The 5th wheel, however, would not budge. I tried it several times and on different legs and it wouldn't move. I noticed the other wheels have a little groove on them and the stubborn one does not. It looks like someone might have tried to create a groove, but gave up. Needless to say, I was disappointed and frustrated. I reached out to Amazon through their chat feature. (I should note hear that the person I dealt with was extremely kind and efficient). After explaining the issue (and pointing out that the chair was an obvious prior return), I was offered the chance to return the item. I didn't really want to do that; I just wanted the wheel I needed. I was then offered a refund of $19.45 and provided a link to purchase new wheels which would cost $11.99 (before taxes and shipping). I explained that wasn't sufficient since after repurchasing the wheels, my actual refund would be about $7.00! I was then sent a new link for wheels that cost $7.99; offered a refund of $25.94; and told I could come back to request a refund for the wheels I after they were delivered. I decided to go with that option instead. I won't get the new wheels until tomorrow, but I went ahead and assembled the rest of the chair. There were no other problems with the assembly. I did it solo, so it took me about 45 minutes and it was pretty easy. I really like the chair itself. It looks nice and works well. I like the ability to recline a little and to flip the armrests up. The seat is nice and wide and I appreciate having a headrest. I'm still annoyed that I was sent a repackaged returned item, but I appreciate the customer service i received from Amazon to resolve the issue.

Oh man, finally put mine together (8 months after buying it!) WELL worth the price. Between work and studying for bar exam, I'm at my computer 10-12-14 hours a day. And I'm a heavy guy - 270-280. This thing is nice. Ample seat, good padding, feels like sitting on air. Easy and fast to put together - just 7 steps. I love the ability to raise the arms so I can play guitar in it. The mesh is so much better than feaux leather in the Texas heat. And I like the ability to adjust the lumbar, because my lumbar isn't in an S shape. Finally, yes, the frame is plastic, but it feels sturdy! It's hard plastic and lots of it.

review_title: Basic office chair at a decent price. Easy to assemble.
body_en: It's a decent chair at a decent price. It decently comfortable. Good lumbar support. Easy to assemble. The wheels are just nothing special wheels. So if you are using it on any type of carpet. Maybe upgrade to skate wheels. It uses a most common wheel peg. So replacing them is as easy if popping them out and popping in a better style.
The clamps could be a little more comfortable and lined in fabric instead of plastic. The rest is very good.
