While it is a little higher on the purchase price it is definitely worth it. The water bottle is very easy to use and clean. It requires very little maintenance. The 1 gallon capacity has ensured he doesn't run out of water during practice or games. The insulated water bottle keeps the water cold long after he's finished with practice regardless of the 100°F plus, temperature days. The material it is made out of has proven to be very tough and durable while still remaining light weight. It also comes with some very handy accessories such as a heavy duty custom sewn hand carrying strap, straws and straw/water spout cleaning brushes. Just to mention a few. It also comes in several different custom color options. I was forced to purchase the Raymylo 128oz insulated water bottle to quickly replace the first water bottle I purchased (Underarmour) for my son which suddenly and without warning started to profusely leak between the cap and bottle after only a few uses. The RAYMYLO Water bottle I purchased has resulted in an unexpected upgrade that has turned out to be the best replacement I could have asked for. It has proven time and time again that regardless of what activity it's being used in conjunction with, temperature altitude and environment it's subjected to, or position it's stored in it will continue to provide an extremely durable, reliable, leak proof light weight water bottle that keeps its liquid contents cool for long periods of time. I highly recommend it and I will only be purchasing the RAYMYLO brand water bottles in the future!

I’ve accumulated quite a few water bottles over the years, but this RAYMYLO 20 oz insulated bottle has become one of my daily favorites. I’ve been using it regularly, and it has held up extremely well. The powder-coated exterior is durable and still looks great even after several accidental drops. I also really like that it comes with both a comfortable handheld strap and a shoulder strap, making it easy to carry whether I’m running errands, hiking, or just on the go. It keeps my drinks cold for hours, doesn’t leak, and the overall build quality feels solid. If you’re looking for a well-made insulated bottle that’s built for everyday use, I highly recommend this one.

review_title: Easy to clean, versatile water bottle
body_en: These are great bottles at a great price! I usually use a much more expensive water bottle, but needed a backup so I gave this a shot. I'm so glad I did! They don't leak, they look great, they keep my drinks super cold, they seem durable, and they aren't too overpriced so if something happens to it I won't feel like I lost an expensive EDC item, I can just buy another and keep it moving. I love that they have the outside cover and paracord handle too, what a nice touch! They are fairly easy to clean as well, which is one of the most important features for me.

review_title: Great for school! Keeps water cold, doesn’t leak, and is very durable.
body_en: I am very satisfied with this water bottle. I bought it mainly for my daughter to use in her daily life, and it has been an excellent purchase. It keeps water cold for many hours, does not leak, and is very durable for everyday use. In addition, it is easy to clean and has a perfect size to take it anywhere, since it comes with its case and can also be comfortably carried with its strap. The quality is excellent, and I would definitely buy it again. I highly recommend it for both children and adults.

Great water bottle, keeps my water nice and cold, the ice lasts all day. I love the extra's it comes with, a carrying case so I can use the long strap when walking for longer periods or the short strap for carrying short distances. It has 2 different lids for drinking, if you need to hydrate quickly you can use the pouring lid or one with the straw. I prefer drinking with a straw however I do not like the rectangle shape of this lid, that is the only thing I don't like about this water bottle. It also does not fit in my cup holder however it hasn't leaked when it has fallen over in the seat.

My absolute favorite purchase from Amazon this water bottle is amazing and is true to the description. It stays cold for hours even when left in the car in the sun (on accident) it also comes with either the straw or the drinking cap as well as brush to clean both the bottle and straws. Another thing I like about it is the clip and the paracord handle it makes it very easy to carry around. It is Leak-proof but you have to make sure it’s sealed on tightly I learned the hard way lol. Besides that it’s honestly a really solid bottle for the price I’ve had it a few months and use it everyday only thing that I don’t like is the fact it doesn’t fit in a cup holder but what can you expect for that size.

This water bottle is so amazing! It retains ice even in hot weather, which, as I work outside in 100F+ weather, is perfect! The lid has two options, though I prefer the straw option for ease of drinking. The color is a deep black, which I appreciate. The bottle is sturdy, surviving drops and rolls. I did have to add some extra stitching on the cover, as the full weight of the bottle puts strain on the stitching, but overall- an amazing bottle!
Since then we have been drinking more. Suitable for sports and everyday life. Completely satisfied.

review_title: Más de 24hrs confirmadas con hielo intacto 👌🏼
body_en: Quality, durability, hardness, practical and all sizes.

Great product. Well insulated. Price is good. Strap and carrying case are great and surprisingly comfortable when adjusted. I bought this in the summer of 2024. The carrying case broke in the summer two years later, but the bottle is still in good condition. I would recommend this for adventures outdoors but expect the straps themselves to be fair to the price. Invest a little more if you want the straps to be more comfortable and durable to carry long distances. The option between a straw and chug cap is brilliant, though keep in mind that the bottle’s large size can make it hard to suck from. I think I got the biggest size at the time because I only wanted to have to fill it up once a day. Turns out that it sometimes can go multiple days without refilling but it is awkward to carry because of its size, so I personally would only usey particular size bottle for hikes with multiple people or long trips in heat (safaris, etc). That being said, I am still using this every day partially filled for work until I get another small bottle. My only suggestion to the manufacturer would be to offer a model with a higher quality strap (fake leather or something of the sort) that will do better in harsh environments.
good product delivered on time to see now in time if the product holds up
Perfect size water bottle! My husband said it’s his favorite water bottle. It keeps the temperature cold, has a choice of lids, and fits in the cup holder nicely.
Keeps my water cool all day long. When I go to the gym, I leave it on my sweltering car, when I get out, my water is cold. I like that it can fit in my cup holder and has different lids.
I am pleasantly surprised with this bottle. It keeps ice as long as yetis do and are half the price. The different lids that come with the bottle provide great versatility. Highly recommend.

I got the 40 oz model. If I could give 10 stars I would. I had been looking for a larger container (I need to drink a lot of water per day) that kept water cold. I also needed it to be spill proof and fit in all my vehicle cup holders. This water bottle works perfectly for me. If there are any imperfections about this bottle I haven't found them yet.
A very nice bottle. Just a little big for me. I like all the extras though.
It was exactly what I was looking for, and it preforms perfectly.

The person, who asked me to buy this for them, is in love with it's functionality! She does straight 32-48 hour shifts as a security at times, and brings her own food to work. The ability to keep beverages cold for that long is a necessity, and what amazes her the most is the ability to add water to current ice, that also converts to literal ice. If this isn't mind-blowing, I don't know what is!

review_title: Great Fit for Tesla Cup Holder
body_en: I like the fact that it fits in my Tesla cup holder. I had a hard time finding something to hold a lot of liquid but slim enough for my Tesla cup holder. I love the 40oz capacity yet slim enough for it to fit in my cup holder. I like the handle on the lids to carry as well. Great purchase. I’m not sure if it’s dishwasher safe or not but I put it in anyways.

My husband and I bought these over two years ago and still using it today. They are a great size - if I drink one through the day - I feel I got a good amount of water. Also, when pregnant - I need ice cold water and this keeps the water nice and cold the whole time. It’s easy to clean and the handle makes it easy to carry with you. I haven’t used the travel bag but been keeping it in hopes I might one day. Highly recommend.

review_title: Good for size but struggles to keep things cold
body_en: This water bottle is excellent for the amount of water it can hold, but it's not so great at controlling water temperature. Also, the strap to carry it broke after one month of use, which makes lugging the big fella around a little less convenient. Still, it's not a bad choice if you need a big water bottle.

Really happy with this water bottle. It’s a great size for everyday use, fits nicely in my car cup holder, and the 2-in-1 lid is convenient depending on how I want to drink. The insulation works well and keeps water cold for hours, and I haven’t had any issues with leaking. It also feels sturdy without being overly heavy. Overall, a well-designed bottle at a very reasonable price. Would definitely recommend.

review_title: Excellent Insulated Bottle — Durable, Cold All Day, and Great Value
body_en: I’ve been really impressed with this POWCAN insulated water bottle. It keeps my drinks cold for hours, even in Florida heat, and the insulation works exactly as advertised. The build quality feels solid, the lid seals tightly, and the bottle is easy to carry around. I also like that it doesn’t sweat or leak, which makes it perfect for work, the gym, and travel. Overall, it’s a reliable, well‑made bottle that performs better than many more expensive brands. Highly recommended.

Incredible water bottle. Keeps my drink cold! Maintains ice for many hours. I've even finished the bottle, added new water and finished that, with ice still remaining! I love the color, too! The straw allows you to just about finish the entire contents of your drink. Instinctively, I always open the spout to finish the bottle off, but there is really not even a sip left. You can't go wrong with this bottle and the price was the cherry on top.

I needed a water bottle and knew I wanted something that wasn't part of the current fad of other cups and bottles. This specific one had great reviews and was the exact size I was looking for. It is great. Keeps my water cold, does not leak. I love the color. It has dual options on the lid to drink from and is super durable. I will definitely purchase again!.

review_title: Good bottle, does keep things pretty cold for a long time
body_en: This water bottle does a good job of keeping things cold, although I do wish it was bigger, but that’s not an issue with the bottle (I thought 40 oz would last me longer than I thought it does). The only thing I don’t really like is the straw because it’s kind of hard to clean and it’s chunky and hard to pull out, but these are pretty minor issues. It does the trick as an insulated water bottle, it’s nice that the lid has two options for drinking out of, it’s easy to carry around and does fit into a purse, and it keeps water cold pretty well. I’ve left ice in the bottle overnight and while the cubes were smaller, they were still frozen in the morning. Overall I wouldn’t recommend this product as I don’t know if it’s any better than any other option out there, but it is a good value for the price, and I wouldn’t say you shouldn’t buy it either.

I absolutely love how cold this bottle keeps water. Ice last for at least 12 hours in this amazing water bottle. I love the handle on the bottle I've been able to vlip it on my backpack while camping. This water bottle comes with a drink spout and a straw which has been helpful while riding my bike. It's light weight and very sturdy. Its true to color. The size is perfect for my bike I'm going to buy a bigger size just to have on hand.

It does what it's supposed to do, and it does it well. Keeps cold drinks cold, and the twist-open cap and flip-up straw are both excellent. No leaks, no flaws. Manufacturer sells replacement parts, so this will stay usable and fresh for years. This wasn't my first Powcan bottle, and it won't be my last.

Love it. For a cyclist, having a durable/reliable water bottle is imperative. This one checks all the boxes in that respect. Holds plenty for a moderate to long ride, is easy to fill/empty and is still pretty compact. Fits in my holder perfectly as well. Not to mention you can just use it as an all day drink container too. I even fill it at night and leave it on my nightstand for easy access during resting hours. Even stays cold all night too! That's another thing, it insulates PERFECTLY. I live in Nevada, we get 115+ degree days in the summer. So water staying cold in that kind of heat is also imperative. Which it does in this one, for long durations as well. I imagine it will do the opposite for those in cold weather needing to keep liquids warm, as well. Overall, very satisifed with the price and product. 5/5

Really good water bottle, resistant and with more possibilities for drinking. Personally, I chose it above all for the straw, I find it very convenient to use especially in the car. Maintains temperatures very well. The "handle" for carrying it is resistant and comfortable. It's a bit heavy, the only flaw is that when it's completely full, if it's turned upside down or moved too much it tends to leak a few drops.
Very good quality!
I bought it for a gift and the person loves it! It keeps heat for a long time and the package arrived in perfect condition.
Very nice and functional, although I don't drink cold water, it has been left under the sun and it doesn't heat up even a little. Excellent purchase.
Holds the temperature for a long time. Big and very beautiful.

I purchased this bottle just to try out in the summer of 2023. It is now the summer of 2026 and I still use it multiple times a week (only because I now have multiple Owalas and I have just ordered my third Owala FreeSip). I have used so many cups—Stanleys, Yetis, Hydrojugs, Hydroflask, etc—and the Owala is still my favorite. Here’s my favorite things about it: LEAKPROOF! This is the biggest one. I can throw it my bag and trust that everything will stay dry. THE SPOUT! Hands down the best spout I’ve ever used. I love that I can sip through the straw but then close the lid and keep my straw clean and not have any spills if it tips over. And then it also gives me the option to absolutely inhale water if I’m about to shrivel up from dehydration. I think this alone is why I now own three in different sizes. STAYS COLD! The 32 ounce holds ice for quite a while. It varies depending on how often I refill it but if I’m not constantly refilling it, it will hold ice for about 24 hours. THE SIZES! I love the size options. My original one was a 32 ounce and is a great middle ground for me. It holds enough water that I’m not refilling it every hour but it’s not huge. It’s great for work and this bottle will be going to live at my job. I just ordered the 40 ounce for home because I want a little more volume when I’m outside gardening but I can’t say much about the 40 ounce size yet. I also have a 16 ounce (kids size) that I use when I leave the house. It fits in a lot of my bags and it’s leakproof so I always have cold water with me. It’s perfect especially since I’m on medication that causes dehydration if I’m not careful. DISHWASHER SAFE! This one is self explanatory. It’s amazing and I love it. There are a few cons though. The first one is that the 32 ounce doesn’t fit in my cup holder. Not a huge deal since it’s leakproof—I just keep it on the passenger seat. But Owala does have cup holder friendly options now if that’s something you want. The bottle also does dent and scratch fairly easily. I dropped it getting out my car one day and it’s a little beat up now. Kind ugly, but it’s still my fave. It’s kinda disappointing because I have Yetis and Stanleys that have been through far worse and still look new. Just be mindful of that and baby it a little. Still 100% worth it though. Long story short, it’s a great bottle that will keep your water cold and everything else dry. As someone who has used this bottle regularly for years, I highly recommend!

I freaking love this thing. I'm not a trend person, I go for function. And when my STB SIL got my fiancé a shiney new Stanley I decided it was time to replace my beat up Rtic with the mismatch lid and straw. I may not follow trends, but I didn't want my fiancé's cup to put mine to absolute shame! First off, can we all agree that the marshmallow is gorgeous? THIS cup is spectacular. Strange to say that about a water bottle, I know. But since I never jumped on that train, I didn't know what I had been missing out on. Let me tell you what! The most important things to me is taking care of my service dog. She keeps me safe so her care is paramount to me. This enables me to pour my water into her bowl on the fly, without having to open my bottle past what I would do to drink from it. Quick and easy. That right there was the selling point for me. But as it turns out, there was even more benefit than that. I don't chug my water but if I did, the chug hole does works fine. The straw portion is ready to sip from, and it doesn't stick up tall like other water bottle straws. It's JUST tall enough to get the job done. No worry of toppling over because the straw got knocked over by the cat. (Because that happens.) The "handle", which is generally the locking feature unless you're using it as a handle, is well placed and comfortable for my sized hands. Not to small and not clunky and large. STB SIL likes to talk about how great the Stanley handle is, which I don't really get. I like that this doesn't have a handle. I have one to carry it if I need it, and not if I don't. The seal is completely water tight. I occasionally put a drink mix in it and shake vigorously. No leaks whatsoever. In fact... It fits in a car cup holder upside down. That's how I transport it in the car. It doesn't fit butt down, so I put it top down. I've been known to do this with various bottles, so I tried it with this one and it fits ok. It's not ideal but it's better than nothing. Try it in yours! Since it's completely leak proof there's are no worries about spilling. (Just be careful when you remove it that it doesn't unlatch.) Another bonus of the covered straw is that germs don't get in the straw. Perfect because people in public often don't cover their sneezes. Ugh. And the coolest part? Lipstick messes are concealed with a flip of the lid! Easy peasy! I have noticed that the inside of the straw stains a little, which was disappointing. I don't like that I look at it and it looks dirty when it isn't. But I guess I shouldn't have used drink enhancers then. Also, my top color is very light. Other colors might not show that. Another thing that want fun was that when it fell, it dented! Oh no! So beware of that. It keeps my water super cold and I don't go anywhere without it. I love it so much that I'm thinking of getting another so I don't have to limit myself by style! Definitely worth the price since I use it constantly, every day. This one is so chill and Zen... The next one shall be colorful and crazy! One for every mood! I simply can't say enough about this darn water bottle... Does that mean I'm on trend now? Who knows! I just love my Owalla! I'm definitely a fan!

Owala water bottles for the win! These are hands-down our favorite water bottles. We have tried just about every popular brand out there—Yeti, Stanley, Hydro Flask, and others—and the Owala is the one that everyone in our family consistently reaches for. I absolutely love the versatility of the lid. You can use the built-in straw when you want to sip, or easily flip it open and drink straight from the opening. Having both options in one bottle is incredibly convenient, especially when you're on the go. The color combinations are also so fun! There are so many options to choose from, and the colors and designs make the bottles feel a little more personal and fun to use. Durability is another huge selling point. These bottles get used constantly and have been dropped and knocked around, yet they hold up extremely well. They seem much less prone to denting than some of the other brands we've tried, which is especially important when they're being used by kids. And, of course, they keep drinks really cold! We can fill them with ice and water, and they stay cold for hours. The lid also seals extremely well—we have never had an issue with them leaking in a bag. After trying so many different water bottles, Owala is definitely the winner for our family. They're durable, versatile, attractive, keep drinks cold, and don't leak. I honestly can't think of another water bottle brand we've liked as much!

As my first Owala I am so pleased with this water bottle. Keeps ice and water cold for hours, doesn’t leak, and love that you can use straw or spout. Great quality and liked the price. Only complaint is that it doesn’t fit in the car cup holders

review_title: Meet Your Hydration Goals with the BEST Water Bottle!
body_en: I am absolutely thrilled with my Owala FreeSip stainless steel water bottle as it has quickly become my absolute favorite for every day use, and it is easily the best insulated bottle I have ever owned. The best part for me is the built- in straw. It allows me to sipupright or I can drink from the widemouth opening. The push button lock lid locks securely so I can toss it in my tote bag without worrying about any spills. The stainless steel keeps the water ice cold all day even if I leave it in my hot car! It has a convenient carry loop. It can be filled with large ice cubes, and it’s easy to clean. You will love it!!!

We love this Owala! The 16 oz size is perfect for kids—big enough to hold plenty of water without being too heavy or bulky for them to carry around. The FreeSip design is probably my favorite part because they can sip through the straw or tilt it back to drink normally. It doesn’t leak all over the place, keeps water cold for a long time, and the covered spout stays cleaner than an exposed straw. The Read My Lips color is super cute, too. It’s held up really well to everyday kid use, which says a lot. Definitely worth the 5 stars!

I got this Owala for my son and really like it so far! My favorite feature is that you can drink from either the built-in straw or use the chug opening. It gives him both options without having to switch out lids or pieces, which is really convenient. The bottle itself feels sturdy and good quality, and the lid closes securely and has a handle that makes it easy to carry. The colors are also really fun and vibrant. My only concern is the coating on the outside. It feels like it may be somewhat easy to scratch, especially since this is going to be used by a kid and tossed into bags, taken to school, etc. We’ll see how it holds up over time! Overall, though, I’m really happy with it. I’ll update my review once I find out how sturdy it is.

Water stays cold all day like the others, and it never leaks. The only downside is that it doesn't fit in my car or chair cupholders by just a fraction. I kind of suspected that might be the case going in, so it doesn't bother me too much. At games I just have to set it on the ground instead of my sports chair. It just won't be my everyday bottle - I will continue to use the 24 oz for the car since it fits perfectly in the cupholder. But Owala still gets 5 starts for the great design, easy to carry, and staying cold all day.

The next one shall be colorful and crazy! One for every mood! I simply can't say enough about this darn water bottle... Does that mean I'm on trend now? Who knows! I just love my Owalla! I'm definitely a fan!

Owala water bottles for the win! These are hands-down our favorite water bottles. We have tried just about every popular brand out there—Yeti, Stanley, Hydro Flask, and others—and the Owala is the one that everyone in our family consistently reaches for. I absolutely love the versatility of the lid. You can use the built-in straw when you want to sip, or easily flip it open and drink straight from the opening. Having both options in one bottle is incredibly convenient, especially when you're on the go. The color combinations are also so fun! There are so many options to choose from, and the colors and designs make the bottles feel a little more personal and fun to use. Durability is another huge selling point. These bottles get used constantly and have been dropped and knocked around, yet they hold up extremely well. They seem much less prone to denting than some of the other brands we've tried, which is especially important when they're being used by kids. And, of course, they keep drinks really cold! We can fill them with ice and water, and they stay cold for hours. The lid also seals extremely well—we have never had an issue with them leaking in a bag. After trying so many different water bottles, Owala is definitely the winner for our family. They're durable, versatile, attractive, keep drinks cold, and don't leak. I honestly can't think of another water bottle brand we've liked as much!

As my first Owala I am so pleased with this water bottle. Keeps ice and water cold for hours, doesn’t leak, and love that you can use straw or spout. Great quality and liked the price. Only complaint is that it doesn’t fit in the car cup holders

review_title: Meet Your Hydration Goals with the BEST Water Bottle!
body_en: I am absolutely thrilled with my Owala FreeSip stainless steel water bottle as it has quickly become my absolute favorite for every day use, and it is easily the best insulated bottle I have ever owned. The best part for me is the built- in straw. It allows me to sipupright or I can drink from the widemouth opening. The push button lock lid locks securely so I can toss it in my tote bag without worrying about any spills. The stainless steel keeps the water ice cold all day even if I leave it in my hot car! It has a convenient carry loop. It can be filled with large ice cubes, and it’s easy to clean. You will love it!!!

We love this Owala! The 16 oz size is perfect for kids—big enough to hold plenty of water without being too heavy or bulky for them to carry around. The FreeSip design is probably my favorite part because they can sip through the straw or tilt it back to drink normally. It doesn’t leak all over the place, keeps water cold for a long time, and the covered spout stays cleaner than an exposed straw. The Read My Lips color is super cute, too. It’s held up really well to everyday kid use, which says a lot. Definitely worth the 5 stars!

I got this Owala for my son and really like it so far! My favorite feature is that you can drink from either the built-in straw or use the chug opening. It gives him both options without having to switch out lids or pieces, which is really convenient. The bottle itself feels sturdy and good quality, and the lid closes securely and has a handle that makes it easy to carry. The colors are also really fun and vibrant. My only concern is the coating on the outside. It feels like it may be somewhat easy to scratch, especially since this is going to be used by a kid and tossed into bags, taken to school, etc. We’ll see how it holds up over time! Overall, though, I’m really happy with it. I’ll update my review once I find out how sturdy it is.

review_title: Love Owala; does not leak and easy to carry. Stays cold!
body_en: Love Owala bottles and I have several of the 24 oz. I decided to get a larger size (32 oz.) this time to take to sporting events to hold more water. Water stays cold all day like the others, and it never leaks. The only downside is that it doesn't fit in my car or chair cupholders by just a fraction. I kind of suspected that might be the case going in, so it doesn't bother me too much. At games I just have to set it on the ground instead of my sports chair. It just won't be my everyday bottle - I will continue to use the 24 oz for the car since it fits perfectly in the cupholder. But Owala still gets 5 starts for the great design, easy to carry, and staying cold all day.

review_title: Produto perfeito, mas a entrega deixa muito a desejar.
body_en: Let's go, firstly, I LOVED the bottle, I was super excited for it to arrive and I don't regret buying it at all. It keeps the water cold for a LONG time (if you're like me and are curious to know exactly when, a great example was that I put water in it WITHOUT ICE at 4 pm and the next day at 8 am when I woke up it was still cold as if it had just come out of the water filter, remembering that my filter has ice water). Her straw is amazing and super practical, but I also recommend buying one of those little brushes to clean. Furthermore, she is very beautiful and big. I bought the 945ml one and it's perfect for me, as it has a handle and the outer material of the bottle is not slippery to the touch. Now talking about the negative points, the only negative point I have to mention here about this bottle is the delivery. I saw a lot of people complaining about the delay in delivery and it actually happened to me too, the shipping time is HUGE, I believe it's because of the number of people who buy this bottle, so it took a LONG time for them to ship, approximately a month. Anyway, the product is perfect, but they made a big mistake in the way they sent it, and it's not even because of the delay, but because of the damage caused to the products, since more people here had the same problem.
Very good, doesn't leak, keeps the temperature.

Really nice and holds so much water and keeps it cold for a really long time. The quality is worth it for the price.

A little expensive compared to average, but worth it! It keeps the temperature very well, but above all the possibility of drinking by suction thanks to the straw makes it easier to use even while driving! The colors are fantastic!

review_title: I recommend and absolutely love the free sip SWAY
body_en: I am obsessed with w/ the sway, I bought Daybreak/ Fig, they are gorgeous, the bottle design is sleek as well highly functional. It is matte vs shiny the bottle isn’t slippery in hand, & there are different sizes to choose from. It fits into my cupholders, it also fits into my couch cupholders, & have the 30 oz. I will be buying more for me as well for gifts as EVERYONE deserves to fall in love w/ this water bottle! Oh, I have not talked about the lid functionality and I left the best for last because I never thought I would love love love the sip straw part as much as I do the chug part is very good as well. They’re right kind of like right next to each other, but you can definitely tell the straw area versus the chug area. I don’t usually use a chug type mouthpiece , but I did try it out because well it’s there and it’s very nice as well. With other brands, you either have a straw straight up you have a straw you have to flip up and this is more practice. The sealing is awesome, I tested ice in the bottle and I put it in @ noon 8/21/26 & it’s 653am 8/22/26 and my water is cold with a lot of ice. I wanted to test it out because I know there’s some mixed reviews. I myself do not use ice in my drinks. I just use cold water so the ice retention for me is really not huge on whether I buy a bottle or not.. and let’s face it if you put water and ice into any water bottle you’re gonna have some weight, but I don’t think it’s that heavy and I have arthritis and some other issues. I love the handle on the sway. I don’t usually like cups that have the side handle. I just find those to be bulky, but I love the handle on the sway because even though I have small hands, sometimes I have to carry it versus putting it into my bag because I have a lot of things as being a teacher if you know you know. So I’m an advocate for cleaning your entire bottle and when I say entire bottle I mean take the little part and I don’t like 1 million gazillion pieces and I’m one that’s very thorough. I don’t just take a little brush through it. I take the seals off I take my watch a video first on it on TikTok and then because sometimes I don’t know how to clean the bottle lid and then of course I repeat that and I find this one to be extremely easy to clean even the piece that sits in the lid. I don’t know depend on the color you get mine is gray. I will just pop that out, clean it with the brush clean it however let it dry then put it all back together so you don’t get any type of mold because any water bottle you have you’re gonna have mold if you don’t clean your bottle and again I love this bottle and I did purchase it with my own money as I have no deal with them at all I’m not even vine reviewer( I wish).

I love this water bottle for many reasons. It checks off all of my requirements! My list was particular and I didn’t think I’d find exactly what I wanted. The body is stainless steel and is quite sturdy, it keeps my water cold for about 24 hours and the 30 oz. size is perfect. It’s neither too big nor too small. It fits in my car’s cup holder, has a convenient carry handle, features a lock and unlock switch, has a dual spout with a straw and also a regular spout to drink out of, the mouthpiece is covered by a pop up lid that opens at the press of a button and protects the mouth area from dirt and germs. Last but not least is the pretty color. I bought the Out of the Blue color. Durable, sturdy, leakproof, easy to clean. The lid, straw and gaskets are dishwasher safe. The bottle itself should be hand washed so the finish doesn’t get ruined in a dishwasher. One point to consider is that this bottle is for cold liquids only, not for use with hot beverages. It’s by far the best water bottle I’ve had because it has so many great features. Since it’s easy to carry around by the handle, I am finding myself taking it wherever I go in the house and I’m actually drinking more water because of it! Try it and you’ll fall in love with it just like I did!

Solid water bottle!!!. Not a water bottle person nor I do I really review anything but I like this is it a lot. Buy it. It’s worth it. Cool colors. The cherry one I got has a candy paint sparkle. simple ergonomic design. So far spill proof. Fits in cup holder and yea. Don’t get a Stanley get this instead.

I didn't get into the Stanley craze-I've had too many accidental spills with the whole cup & straw set up. So when my kids started insisting I get an Owala, I was skeptical. But then I saw the TikTok of that one guy using his Owala as a weapon to fight off the men who attempted to break into his house, and not only did he stop them, his Owala survived with just a dent (and a broken handle, if memory serves me right)! Then Owala does the of the best PR stunt/customer appreciation ever, and not only sends that man a safe, but filled that safe with several Owala bottles! I admire a company that can back their products up; but I will support a business who listens and recognizes their customers too! So I started looking for one; I got to thinking as a woman who often does her errands alone, "you know, I can always use it for defense and I can't be accused of carrying a weapon, because technically it's a water bottle." When Owala came out with this Amazon exclusive color, I knew it was kismet! I put it on my cart, but before I checked out, my kid saw what I was doing and she stopped me. She said, "lady, I already bought that for you. It's coming next week." LOL I guess she got tired of telling me to get one, and just grabbed it for me, knowing that burgundy is one of my favorite colors! I've had it for 5 months now. It's a little dinged up on the bottom-nothing too bad. I just dropped it one or two times (maybe more). I love that the mouthpiece is covered up and can be locked so 1)it will always be clean; and 2)it won't accidentally spill if it tips over, or you know, you accidentally drop it. It keeps me accountable-I fill that 40 oz 2-3 times a day to make sure I stay hydrated. I love that it's insulated so I can keep my drink cold or hot-depending on what I fill it with. I love that it's easy to clean-there are no nook & crannies that can't be cleaned or reached! I just love it. Period.

Love, love. Love this Owalla water bottle! It’s big enough to supply my needs and the body has flat side., just a tiny indented surface that makes it much easier to hold. I enjoy the sipping it allows so the beverage doesn’t come in an uncontrollable flow. With that you get a face wash ! But the open top allows for larger portions faster on days you’re really hot. I like the style of the bottle and the colors to choose from are so varied and stylish. In using this bottle it performs beautifully in keeping my beverage cold, even on the beach. I highly recommend this item👍‼️

I've been really happy with this bottle. The 30 oz size feels like the perfect middle ground—big enough that I'm not constantly refilling it, but not so big that it becomes a pain to carry around. It also fits in a standard cup holder, which was a must for me. It's surprisingly lightweight, and the bucket handle makes it really easy to grab and go. The only downside I've noticed is that ice doesn't last quite as long as some other insulated bottles because the lid isn't fully insulated. That said, it's not a dealbreaker for my use. It still keeps my water plenty cold throughout the day, and the convenience and design more than make up for it. I got the Dreamy Fields color and it looks even better in person. Overall, definitely recommend.
Very versatile, keeps water icy cold all day. Has a built in straw, great colors offered and the lid also has a lock feature. No worry about spills!

I’ve been using this Owala water bottle for a couple of months now, and it’s quickly become one of my favorites. I love the color, and the large handle makes it really easy to carry around throughout the day. One of my favorite features is the option to either sip directly from the spout or use the built-in straw. It’s nice having both options depending on what I’m doing. The only downside I’ve found is that the sip area can be a little tricky to clean thoroughly because of the design. It’s not a dealbreaker, but it does take a little extra attention when washing. Other than that, I’ve been extremely happy with it. I’ve run it through the dishwasher several times, and it still looks brand new. The finish has held up beautifully with no noticeable wear. Overall, it’s a well-made, durable water bottle that I’d definitely recommend.

The Owala FreeSip Tumbler in Light Roasted exceeded my expectations. The color is stunning: a beautifully understated light beige with a subtle milk tea undertone. review_title: HONESTLY THE ONLY WATER BOTTLE YOU'LL EVER NEED!! BEST EVER!!! SON USES IT FOR SCHOOL EVERYDAY!!
body_en: I waited to write this review. My 8 year old son needed a daily water bottle for school & I found this on a really great deal in Sept 2025. I loved that It had a strap for him to carry, especially if we had trips! It is now March 2026 & I am BEYOND impressed with this thing! First off, it came with 2 straps- one hand strap & another for his shoulder! He has currently been into sipping through a straw, but used to prefer pouring... This one comes with BOTH types types you can change by screwing that choice lid on! It had 2 straws (I had never had to replace yet- and he brings it everyday)!! It comes with 2 brushes to clean and 1 for the straw. I have washed it so many times- it's easy! it's still exactly the same now as it was! One of the best things I like about it is how cold it keeps his drink (it like dense metal but also not really heavy) but ALSO- HUGE- the fact that somehow it doesn't seem to create any mild easier like others I've had, even if its kept out. (Once he accidentally left It at school during a week vacation and there was no signs of mold in there- I don't know how! That would have never happened with our old ones!) It slides very easily into a pouch that is the "carry pouch". I have his name tag attached to the clip on it. We have gotten so many compliments on it & asked where it came from. I bought another water bottle so I could interchange them during washes- but honestly, I've rarely ever done that bc this is my son's favorite water bottle & this will be the only one you'll ever need!

I really love this half gallon bottle. I love the color as it is my favorite so of course I was immediately drawn to it. Very good ratings as well. Compared to my other one I had through someone else it leaked if tipped over or even leaning from day one and this one doesn’t leak at all. It keeps my water cold even without ice. It’s easy to use and doesn’t feel as heavy as my old one used too. I love the lid options as I prefer the spout. I like that I can easily grab it either by the hard handle or the rope strap. All around wonderful product.

I kept running out of water at work with my Owala so I was looking for a larger size water bottle without breaking the bank. I found this 87oz water bottle for a great price. My first impression was that it could be cumbersome to carry around, but that quickly changed. It’s so easy to carry with the braided strap (that also has a compass, nice touch!!). I really like all the extras (the slim pockets, carabiner, two style of lids, longer strap to carry, and all the washing tools). It was a bit difficult to slip the fabric off the bottle at first and the fabric has a slight smell to it, but I expect that to dissipate. I think this is a great option to help fulfill your daily water needs!

This is an amazing tumbler! I usually do not have to put ice in after 24 hours unless I add room temperature water to the cup. It is leakproof! I've not experienced a leak, so that is another 5 Star! I gifted it to myself in February 2026 as my New Year's Gift! The capacity is amazing! I love that I can drive over 12 hours with enough water from the start to the finish of my drive! The handle options and the carrying case? GENIUS! I absolutely love them, those are "FIVE STARS". I used the shoulder carrying option on my last cruise! Everyone wanted one for themselves! I gave it a 4 star because there is a "gassy, galvanized taste" that I still taste. I initially thought it was because the tumbler was new but I have owned it for over 6 months now and I do use it everyday. I understand it's a "oral galvanism or a lipid-oxidation sensory reaction", this might be different for me than someone else. The next reason for not giving a solid 5 star! Of the two Lid options, I prefer using the straw lid! Since I take the tumbler everywhere I go, I would prefer if the "mouthpiece, sip, or straw tip" was covered. If they upgrade Lid Options to a "Callapsable Cover Straw Lid", I would purchase the lid! In fact I came back to see if they upgraded, not to leave a review. I hope this was helpful to someone.

Love these - I have two. My grandson wants whatever I’m drinking. Not that the size isn’t enough to share… It keeps beverages cold with ice overnight and into the next day - ice is still there. Love the sturdy handle and places to carry things like cellphone and wallet. Love that I can clip it onto another item. Or use the smaller hook for car keys. LOVE LOVE LOVE THESE!

Love this water bottle! It holds about a half gallon, keeps water cold all day. It is insulated, has both a handle made of para-cord and 2 different tops! It never leaked on my 35 days of camping. Yes, I would order again. You won't be disappointed!

review_title: Its looks cool and stays cool!
body_en: Keeps water cool and has a large opening which let me fit ice cubes and other things like cucumber in easily. The large size is perfect to take to heavily active jobs like construction as well as to the gym. Its also super easy to clean and has no issues in the dishwasher.

I love my bottle! The colour and quality is amazing! Seems easy to clean as well. The problem? I'm missing the straws, which is kind of a dealbreaker since I only drink from that type of mouth, the other one is useless to me. It also didn't come with the straw or bottle cleaners, that bothers me less since I have some already. I'd really like to not return this and somehow just get the missing items (Mostly the straws.) --- Review of actual product: Gosh darn is this thing HEAVY! I wasn't expecting it. But the quantity lasts me 12 hours just fine. I'm considering the extra weight an excuse to get a workout for my arms, haha, but if you have any type of disability, you might want to consider a smaller size. My stronger and taller friend uses their gifted bottle just fine, they also say they really like it. This one (128oz) doesn't fit in my backpack, which is a shame, but oh well. It can also be a struggle to fill it all the way, depending on what you get your water from. I can do it to the top, my friend can only get 8/10ths unless he wants to use a separate cup to scoop the rest of the water in. The colour is beautiful, the clips and bands seem sturdy, I got a stain on the sleeve, and it washed out with just a dab of water. The mouth is wide enough to pour ice in, and it keeps the same temperature forever! --- Edit: The seller contacted me quickly and helped me find a solution, they were very concise and answered all of my questions. I will say, there seems to be a problem with quality control, I think sometimes bottles get sent back, and they can miss any damages/missing items because of that. I bought another bottle and this one had a black smudge on the sleeve I couldn't wash out, it's not a dealbreaker for me, but so far 2 of the 3 bottles had some error. The only reason I'm keeping it at five stars despite that is because of their customer service being 10/10 and the quality of the product being the same.

review_title: Keeps water cold for long periods.

review_title: Beautiful, Practical, and Worth Every Penn
body_en: I’ve been using this Owala bottle for a while now, and I’m really happy with it. It keeps my water cold for hours, even on hot days. The FreeSip lid is super convenient because I can either sip through the built-in straw or drink normally. It’s easy to clean, doesn’t leak, and the Disney Princess design is subtle but really cute. The quality feels excellent, and I would definitely buy another one. Highly recommend!

Normally I'm not the type of person to follow trends or fall for the "hype" of popular products like the Stanleys and Hydroflashs because usually they end up being useless. HOWEVER-! These are definitely worth it. Whether I'm working a 9hr shift, driving during a hot day or just sleeping overnight it stays cold the entire time. It doesn't leak. It's not super heavy. The material is nice as well, and doesn't make a lot of noise or fall over and start leaking. I also love all of the color options, I went with the Tangled version and aside from the fact that I think the stickers could've been a bit bigger it's super cute! Highly recommend, especially considering the price. It seems expensive but knowing you won't have to constantly replace it makes it worth it. As well as being relatively affordable for younger peeps like myself who need a nice one for work!

I bought this Owala bottle for my kindergarten daughter, and she absolutely loves it! I originally wanted a smaller size, but the Disney Princess collaboration was only available in this size. Even though it’s a little bigger, it has worked out great. She was so excited to take it to school because she loves the Disney Princess design. It keeps her water cold all day, doesn’t leak, and the flip-top straw is easy for her to use on her own. The quality is excellent, and I’d definitely recommend it to other parents looking for a durable school water bottle.

The Wicked Pink Owala insulated water bottle is absolutely beautiful! The design is full of thoughtful details inspired by the movie and Glinda the Good Witch, making it a must-have for Wicked fans. It’s lightweight, comfortable to carry, and does an excellent job of keeping drinks cold for hours. I also love that it’s dishwasher-safe, making cleanup quick and easy. Stylish, functional, and well-made—this bottle is a great addition to any collection.
My daughter loves it! Spill proof, keeps the water cool for the entire day, easy to use and clean and the colors are lovely

Love these water bottles. Love the option of the flow or the built-in straw, which makes it very versatile. Very durable I have dropped mine several times and it takes the hit though the paint does scrape off, which is to be expected. The design is amazing the Star Wars decor color perfect for the Star Wars lover.

I had been hearing positive things about Owala water bottles for years, so when I needed a new water bottle for an upcoming work trip, I figured it was time. The fact that Beauty and the Beast is my favorite movie made this particular model a no brainer. I absolutely understand the hype, your water stays cold all day, the lid is secure, I love the option to sip from a stray or chug. This particular size was perfect for me, easily fits in my diaper bag and my car cup holder, and is large enough to hold a decent percentage of my daily water needs. After this purchase, I ended up buying two more for myself and one for my husband. The only negative feedback I have on this particular line (the Disney Princess, and likely any other bottle that has stickers) is that the stickers simply didn’t last. After one hand wash all the colors faded, so the slight up charge between a regular Owala and the Disney Princess version was kind of a waste, but I did add my own stickers and they’ve been just fine. That’s the only reason why I docked a star.

I love my Owala water bottle! I love that it is leak proof, the water stays so cold. I tested against a Simple Modern one and not only did it stay colder, the temperature of the water was colder. I loved the versatility of being able to sip or use the straw. I had a problem with the ones with the straw, every time I was down to the bottom, I had to open the cap to drink the rest. The handle makes it easy to grab in the morning on my way out to work. I’m buy Owala from now on! The princess series is my favorite. The cup easily fits in my cup holder. It may be pricier than some, but well worth the cost.

review_title: La combinación perfecta entre funcionalidad y diseño para fans de Star Wars
body_en: The Owala Star Wars FreeSip is easily one of the best reusable bottles I've ever owned. From the first moment it stands out for its design: the Star Wars-inspired details are incredibly well done and make it look much more special than a common bottle. Whether you're a casual fan or a collector, it's definitely an eye-catcher. But the best thing is that not only does it look amazing, it also works great. The FreeSip system is probably the most convenient thing I've ever tried in a water bottle. Being able to choose between drinking with an integrated straw or drinking directly by tilting the bottle seems simple, but in daily use it makes a lot of difference. It is practical for the gym, office, car or simply to bring it all day. The build quality is also excellent. It feels sturdy, well-sealed, and made with premium materials. The lid closes perfectly and so far I haven't had any leaks, even carrying it in a backpack. Another impressive point is the thermal insulation. It keeps the water cold for many hours, even on hot days. It really delivers what it promises and ensures that you always have cold drinks available. Plus, the size and grip are very comfortable. It doesn't feel bulky and the integrated handle makes it very easy to transport it. They are small details that end up making a big difference in everyday life. Something that I really liked is that it manages to perfectly balance the collectible with the functional. Many times thematic products sacrifice quality for design, but here both things are very well taken care of.
Very good product and very pretty. In person they look incredible and are original. I recommend it. ❤️

review_title: A surprisingly complete 40 oz bottle kit with tons of carrying options
body_en: This is an impressively complete water bottle set. Everything coordinates in a black/deep green color scheme that looks great and works equally well for men, women or kids. More importantly, the accessories aren’t just filler—they actually make a 40 oz bottle much easier to carry and use. The black and green paracord handle is especially helpful when the bottle is completely full. My 9-year-old plans to use this for school, and he was comfortable holding it by the paracord handle even with 40 oz of water inside. (I didn’t tell him about the whistle in case he decides to demonstrate it in class.) The paracord handle attaches to a rubber ring that slips over the neck of the bottle. One thing to know is that you can’t remove just the paracord portion—the entire ring and attached hardware need to come off for washing, which is fairly easy to do. If you decide not to use it, you’ll also lose the attached compass and safety whistle. Fortunately, both included lids have their own built-in handles, so the bottle is still easy to carry without it. The locking chug cap comes preinstalled, and there’s also a straw cap with two straws. You get a straw brush, bottle brush, shoulder strap and neoprene bottle sleeve as well. The sleeve is a particularly nice addition because it cushions the bottom so you don’t get the loud metal clang when setting the bottle down, eliminating the need for a separate silicone boot. It also adds two storage pockets: a mesh pocket in front and a surprisingly roomy zippered pocket in back. The adjustable shoulder strap gives you several carrying options. For reference, I’m 5’6”. At its shortest setting, the top of the bottle sits about two inches below my armpit. Fully extended and worn crossbody, the top sits around my hip. Worn over one shoulder at the longer setting, it hangs a few inches below my hip bone. Between the two lids, paracord handle, shoulder strap, protective storage sleeve, cleaning tools, whistle, compass and carabiner, there’s a lot packed into this kit. If you’re looking for a versatile 40 oz bottle that feels durable and gives you plenty of ways to carry and customize it, this is an excellent option.

review_title: A Super Over the Top Metal Water Bottle That Is Rugged & Robust & Built for Any Adventure!
body_en: This is probably the most comprehensive water bottle kit I've ever used! It comes with 2 different lids with 2 straws, multiple brush cleaner tools, a sleeve with a zippable phone pouch, and a heavy-duty paracord handle to top it all off. The robust feeling of the total package is incredible, as the metal on the bottle is thick but also very heavy, especially when filled with water, so bear that in mind. Talking about the weight, it comes with a drinking lid with 2 straws, one being connected to the lid and the other as a replacement, which is great for drinking from the bottle without having to lift it off the table or surface its on, and this is my preferred choice of using the bottle, as the other lid forces you to have to lift the whole bottle upside down to drink from it, which is a bit cumbersome because of the weight. However, that particular lid comes with a lock, which will keep the bottle from opening. Still, even though that lid has a lock and the other one technically doesn't, they both don't leak, which is awesome, so the lock is kinda pointless. As long as the lids are tightened appropriately, you won't have any problems. The paracord handle is super tough and will give you confidence when you're holding it, as I don't think it will break prematurely. It even comes with a little compass attached to it, which is a nice feature. The only downside I can think of when it comes to the product is the price itself. I'm not saying it's not worth the asking price, but you have to ask yourself if you need such a heavy-duty water bottle to begin with, because it's probably unnecessary in most situations unless you are going hiking or camping, and even then, do you really want to lug around a 64 ounce of container of water? It would probably be better to carry around a much lighter bottle of water for most situations, or at least you could carry 4 plastic bottles of 16 ounces of water, but then you might also be trying to stay away from plastics, which is understandable. All in all, if you think a 64 oz metal water bottle is overkill, it might be worth considering something else, but if you want something that might last a lifetime, this might be it!

review_title: I just wanted to drink water, but now I look like I’m about to summit Mount Everest to get groceries
body_en: Look, all I wanted was a standard, reliable water bottle to keep me hydrated so I could stop drinking three cups of coffee before noon. What arrived on my doorstep from WONSYGO is not just a bottle—it is a full-blown, survivalist tactical hydration ecosystem that makes me look like I’m preparing for a 40-mile trek through the wilderness every time I walk into the kitchen. Let’s talk about the Survival Paracord Handle. This thing is braided like military-grade climbing rope and features a built-in safety ring. It looks so intense that I half-expect it to deploy a miniature life raft if I pull on it too hard. Carrying this bottle by the paracord gives you an immediate, unwarranted surge of rugged confidence. I was walking out to grab the morning mail, holding my bottle by the strap, and I genuinely felt like I was leading a search-and-rescue team through uncharted terrain. If an emergency ever strikes, I’m fairly certain I could unravel the handle, tie down a tent, build a shelter, and still have ice-cold water left over. The Insulated Carry Bag with Shoulder Strap takes the tactical aesthetic to a whole new level. When you slide the bottle into the sleeve, clip on the strap, and throw it over your shoulder, you are no longer just a person with a drink; you are carrying high-tech field artillery. It protects the matte black finish from dings when you inevitably drop it on a gravel path or the gym floor, and the strap leaves your hands totally free. The Leak-Proof Seal is an absolute champion. I threw this 32-ounce cylinder into the passenger seat of my car, hit a speed bump, and watched it roll into the footwell upside down. Zero leaks. Not a single drop. It’s tight as a submarine hatch. They even include a Bottle Brush and Straw Brush, which is a massive relief because trying to clean a deep 32 oz container with a standard kitchen sponge is like trying to wash a vase with a tennis ball. If you want a heavy-duty, zero-leak water bottle that treats daily hydration like a high-stakes outdoor expedition, this complete kit is an absolute powerhouse.

review_title: Perfect to get my daily water intake!
body_en: This is so much more than just a 64-ounce water bottle. It comes with one of the most comprehensive accessory sets I’ve seen included with a bottle. You get multiple options for carrying it, including a woven handle/strap, a protective sleeve, plus cleaning accessories including a full-size bottle brush and a smaller brush for getting into narrow areas. I really appreciate being able to thoroughly clean everything without having to purchase additional accessories. I tested the temperature retention before reviewing it, and it genuinely kept my water cold for 24 hours. I have even had ice remain beyond that. Since I only enjoy drinking water when it’s really cold, this is a huge plus for me. There is also no strange or metallic taste from the food-grade stainless steel. I’m planning to use this as part of my health journey because the 64-ounce capacity makes keeping track of my water incredibly simple. My goal is one full bottle each day, so rather than constantly measuring or tracking individual glasses, I know exactly where I stand based on what’s left in the bottle. The black finish looks great and goes with everything. The carrying strap is especially useful when I’m taking it somewhere like a concert, festival, camping trip, or other outdoor activity. Obviously, 64 ounces of water has some weight to it when completely full, but that’s something I expect with a bottle this large. Durability has also impressed me. I’ve already dropped it, and it didn’t dent or noticeably scratch. Everything feels sturdy and well made, and this seems like something I’ll be using for a long time rather than replacing after a few months. The price may initially seem a little high for a water bottle, but considering the large capacity, excellent insulation, durable construction, and extensive set of included accessories, I think the value is there. It’s exceptionally good at keeping my water ice cold, feels built to last, and includes pretty much everything I could want with a large insulated bottle.

review_title: I’d give this 10 stars if I could - an amazing water bottle!
body_en: We’ve all got lots of water bottles, but until you have one like this, you are NOT ready for the beach/picnic/camping trip. It’s got huge volume, so does 2 people a good long day out and about, and it really does keep things cool thanks to the insulation AND the neoprene case. That case also has a zippered pocket on the side which can hold a regular iPhone and some ID - super useful! Lids? Two. Two!!! One pop top (lockable via a click-lock to avoid accidental opening) and one flip-up straw sort, with a spare straw and all of the cleaning tools to keep it pristine. They really thought this one all the way through. Handles and straps? Plenty! The shoulder strap is great for heavily loaded outings, while the paracord and plastic handles are perfect for passing around or just moving the bottle. For the sorts who appreciate such things, it has a small compass on the paracord handle, which does really work. It also has a whistle built into the fastener for that handle, so if you were ever to be stuck in a ravine and need Lassie, or a Mountie etc to come and help, you’re in luck. It’s the sort of thing you can imagine Bear Grylls has clipped to his backpack. I’ll be buying another - for camping trips, beach days, or just long road trips, this is the ultimate water canteen. You could also use it for soup, coffee (a LOT of coffee) or anything else you might want to keep in large quantities and hot or cold. I can even see using it for premixed cocktails for big picnics! You want one, believe me - it’s already replaced two of our smaller water bottles, and is going to be getting plenty of use in this household.

review_title: Reliable 64 oz Water Bottle with Great Insulation and Handy Accessories
body_en: I’ve been using this 64 oz water bottle for a few weeks now during hiking, camping, and daily activities, and I’m very pleased with its performance. The multi-layer vacuum insulation technology is impressive — it keeps my drinks icy cold for a full 24 hours and hot beverages warm for up to 12 hours. Whether it’s a cold summer hike or a chilly morning coffee, the bottle maintains the temperature perfectly throughout my adventures. The bottle is made from food-grade 304 stainless steel, which feels sturdy and durable without any metallic aftertaste, a problem I’ve encountered with other bottles. The wide-mouth lid with a thick silicone seal ensures it’s completely leak-proof; I’ve tossed it upside down in my backpack multiple times with no spills or drips at all. This leak-proof feature gives me peace of mind when carrying it in bags alongside my electronics and other gear. Another standout aspect is the all-in-one accessory kit that comes with the bottle. The durable paracord handle is not only stylish but also practical for easy carrying and hanging on backpacks or trekking poles. The neoprene sleeve provides excellent grip and protection, preventing scratches and helping to keep my hands comfortable with hot drinks. Cleaning is a breeze thanks to the included long-handled bottle brush for deep cleaning the interior and a slim straw brush for any narrow gaps. The wide-mouth opening makes it simple to add ice cubes or fruit slices, and cleaning is straightforward. The bottle’s size is perfect for staying hydrated throughout long outdoor activities or even busy workdays. It’s a versatile water bottle that suits gym workouts, road trips, office commutes, and more. Overall, this water bottle offers excellent insulation, reliable leak-proof design, and thoughtful accessories that add real value. It’s well-built and designed with outdoor enthusiasts in mind. I’m very satisfied with my purchase and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable and convenient hydration solution.

This is a high‑capacity, well‑made thermos that comes with a great selection of straws, cleaning brushes, and multiple grip, strap, and handle options. It’s versatile enough for hiking, camping, or daily use, and it delivers impressive heat and cold retention. The temperature performance is excellent. Thanks to its multi‑layer vacuum insulation and food‑grade 304 stainless steel interior, it keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours. Whether you’re carrying hot coffee on a winter trail or ice water on a summer hike, it maintains the temperature reliably throughout the day. Build quality is solid. The stainless steel is BPA‑free, non‑toxic, and doesn’t leave any metallic aftertaste. The wide‑mouth lid uses a thick silicone sealing ring, making the bottle 100% leak‑proof — you can toss it in a backpack or gym bag without worrying about spills. The included accessories add a lot of value. You get: A durable paracord woven handle for easy carrying or hanging A thick neoprene sleeve for protection and better grip A long‑handle bottle brush for deep cleaning A slim straw brush for cleaning tight gaps It’s essentially an all‑in‑one hydration kit. The wide-mouth opening makes it easy to add ice, fruit slices, or clean the interior thoroughly. The braided handle works well for hand‑carrying or attaching to trekking poles or backpacks, making it ideal for hands‑free outdoor travel. Overall, this is a well-designed, durable, and highly functional thermos with excellent temperature retention and a thoughtful set of accessories — a great choice for hikers, commuters, and anyone who wants reliable hydration on the go.

review_title: Durable but not very practical or comfortable.
body_en: I received the 32oz bottle and it has all the gadgets imaginable, it looks very durable, the cleaning brush set was a very appreciated addition. Having two types of lids is great idea. That said, this bottle is very large and I personally cannot hold it in one hand, and I have medium large hands for a woman, it does not fit in the cupholder in the car, which is pretty much expected, the spouts are not very comfortable, neither the straw nor the flip lid, it is pretty heavy for hiking. Probably good for camping. Not sure about the beach because of the black color, but it would probably work ok. I would recommend making a little skinnier and modify the spouts to be more comfortable and bigger flow.

review_title: Great insulated bottle — and I love using it for warm water too! 💧🔥
body_en: I really like this insulated water bottle! Of course, it does a great job of keeping drinks cold or hot, but I've actually been using mine for something a little different: warm water beside my bed overnight. I love having warm water first thing in the morning, so I've been filling the bottle with boiled water at night and taking it upstairs with me. By the time I wake up in the morning, the water is still pleasantly warm rather than having completely cooled down overnight. It's not so hot that I can't drink it, which is exactly what I wanted. The insulation is therefore working really well for my particular use, and I can see this being equally useful for keeping cold drinks chilled during the day, especially when hiking, camping, travelling or spending time outdoors. 🏕️🥾 I also like all the practical accessories that come with it. The paracord handle makes it easy to carry, and having both a bottle brush and straw brush included is a thoughtful touch because cleaning reusable bottles properly is so much easier when you have the right tools. The neoprene sleeve is another nice addition for handling and protection, while the leak-proof design gives me peace of mind when carrying it around. Overall, this is a very versatile insulated bottle that has become part of my nighttime routine in a way I didn't initially expect. I love that it keeps my water at a comfortable temperature for hours, and the included accessories make it feel like a complete set rather than just a bottle. 💧😊

review_title: Excellent Bottle Set — The Carrying Sleeve Makes It Even Better
body_en: This is a really impressive 32 oz water bottle set, especially considering how many useful accessories are included. The bottle itself feels substantial and well made, and the matte black finish gives it a clean, sleek look. One of the best features for me is the neoprene carrying sleeve. A 32 oz bottle can get cumbersome to carry around by hand, so being able to put it in the sleeve and use the adjustable shoulder strap makes a huge difference. The front zippered pocket is large enough to hold small essentials like a phone, cards, or keys, while the mesh pocket provides additional quick-access storage. It makes this especially convenient for walks, hiking, sightseeing, kids' activities, or travel when I don't necessarily want to carry a separate bag. The bottle also comes with a paracord handle and carabiner, giving you several different ways to carry it. I like that the paracord handle isn't just decorative—it provides a substantial grip and adds to the outdoorsy design. Another thing I appreciate is how complete the accessory package is. It includes extra straws along with a bottle brush and straw-cleaning brush, so you don't immediately have to purchase separate cleaning accessories. There also appears to be an additional lid, which gives you another drinking option depending on your preference. The 32 oz capacity is a good size for staying hydrated without having to refill constantly. It is definitely larger than a typical everyday bottle, but the carrying sleeve helps compensate for that. Overall, this feels like much more than just a basic water bottle. It's a thoughtfully put-together kit with accessories that I would actually use rather than extras that will immediately end up in a drawer.

review_title: Impressive water bottle with premium features.
body_en: I received the WONSYGO 24 oz Water Bottle with Paracord Handle through the Amazon Vine review program. I think this is the most impressive water bottle I've owned—and that's saying something, considering how many my family of four has gone through over the years. There's a lot about this bottle that gives it a premium feel from the moment you take it out of the box. The cover is impressive, and it comes with useful accessories, including different straps. The paracord handle is particularly well done. It looks great and is easy to grip. There's even a small analog compass attached, which is a neat extra that adds to the bottle's outdoorsy appeal. It makes this feel like the perfect water bottle to take along when you're hiking on the trails. The pouch is actually useful. It has a zippered compartment and a mesh pocket where you could keep cash, coins, or an earbud case. Another really nice touch is the included shoulder strap. That's especially useful with a larger water bottle like this that when filled has some weight to it, particularly when you're carrying it for hours. A second lid style is also included, along with cleaning tools and extra straws. I love this water bottle, although I already know that the second my younger son sees it, he's going to claim it for himself. He's a water bottle connoisseur and very picky about what he likes, but this one checks all the boxes I know are important to him.

I really like this water bottle! The 24 oz size is a nice middle ground — big enough to actually hold a decent amount of water without feeling huge or bulky to carry around. The black colour is simple and goes with everything. I especially like that it comes with two different lids, so you can choose how you want to drink from it. One lid has a regular drinking opening, while the other comes with a straw. I love having the option depending on what I’m doing, and it makes the bottle feel much more versatile. The paracord handle is probably my favourite feature because it makes the bottle so easy to grab and carry, especially when I’m out walking, travelling, or already have my hands full. The neoprene sleeve is also a nice touch. It gives the bottle some extra protection and makes it more comfortable to hold, while also helping with condensation from cold drinks. I also really appreciate that it comes with both a bottle brush and a straw brush. Those little cleaning accessories are actually useful and save you from having to buy them separately. Overall, it feels like a thoughtfully put-together water bottle rather than just a basic bottle. I love having the two lid options, and the handle, sleeve, and cleaning brushes make it especially convenient for travel, hiking, or everyday use. Really happy with it!

The nice thing about the Wonsygo water bottle is all the accessories that come with it: two different styles of lids (a lockable flip spout and a straw lid with a straw); a neoprene sleeve; a paracord handle with a compass and wash brushes. Unfortunately, while I received the bottle brush, there was no straw brush included in what I received. The bottle itself is very good quality. I left ice in it overnight, and in the morning, most of my ice was still intact with only a little bit having melted into water. I will be using this when I go on beach holidays, so the ability to keep my drinks cold is extremely important. Also important, since the colour of the bottle is black, is the neoprene sleeve. I've learned the hard way that some water bottles made with metal are too hot to handle once they've sat out in the sun! Now the neoprene sleeve and paracord handle, I won't have to worry about burning my hands! Overall quality seems very good. 24oz is a decent amount - enough to hold a lot of ice to keep drinks cold. My preference is the spout rather than the straw lid, but it's great to have the option. Considering some of the brand name bottles are over $50 for just the jug itself, there's a lot of value with this one with all the accessories. Hopefully the missing straw brush was just a packing error.

review_title: The best water bottle I've had in years
body_en: Overview: The 40oz Insulated Water Bottle has quickly become an essential companion on my daily adventures. Whether I’m out hiking, hitting the gym, or just working at my desk, this bottle ensures that my drink remains icy cold throughout the day. Like all products, it does have its strengths and a few areas for improvement, but overall, it’s a fantastic investment for anyone who values hydration in their day-to-day. Pros: Durable Finish: One of my primary concerns with water bottles is how well they hold up to daily wear and tear. I’ve had my fair share of bottles that chip or scratch easily, but this one has proven its mettle. Its finish is robust and has successfully resisted the occasional bump or drop. So, for the clumsy folks out there (like me), this bottle might be your new best friend. Efficient Insulation: The insulation game on this bottle is top-notch. Even in the blazing summer heat, after leaving this bottle in my car for hours, I return to find my water as cold as when I first poured it in. That's a game-changer, especially for those of us living in warmer climates or who simply love their beverages ice-cold. Rugged Straw: For those who prefer sipping through a straw, this feature is a standout. The straw is durable, ensuring that it doesn't get squashed or dented easily. Plus, it allows for easy drinking, especially during activities where you don't want to pause or tilt your head back. Versatile Top Design: Flexibility in design is always a win in my book. The interchangeable top, allowing for either open drinking or through a straw, gives users the option to switch according to their preference or activity. A casual day at the beach? Go for open drinking. On a run? The straw might be your best bet. Cons: Slippery When Wet: My only real gripe with this bottle is its tendency to become somewhat slippery when wet. Given the durable finish, it's a bit ironic that it can become a challenge to grip if there’s condensation or if you spill a bit while refilling. It’s not a deal-breaker, but something to be wary of, especially if you’re out and about and your hands are sweaty or it’s raining. Final Thoughts: Despite its minor shortcomings, the 40oz Insulated Water Bottle is an exceptional product. Its insulation capabilities alone make it worth the investment. However, coupled with its rugged design and versatile drinking options, it's hard to resist. If the manufacturer were to address the grip issue in future designs, it would undoubtedly earn a full 5-star rating from me. Would I recommend it? Absolutely. Just be cautious when handling it with wet hands!

Currently have had this water bottle for about a month, pretty good so far! I like the alternating caps. Was worried at first because I didn’t see a handle but it’s attached to one of the lids so it’s good. Insulation is alright, does keep my water cold for at least 4 hrs.
Quality product. Keeps beverages cold ans slim design fits perfectly in backpack pocket.
Great value, perfect size with handles.

This is my new favorite water bottle! It has great ice and water retention as I am able to keep any drink in it and it will stay to its temperature for long periods of time. The size of the water bottle is great, and it is what I need to get my daily water intake. The durability is questionable as after walking a couple of times and accidentally bumping into walls, the paint started to wear off. At certain parts, I can see black spots or even the grey metal under the paint.
