Keeps my drinks cold and is easy to clean.

review_title: The right size at the right price
body_en: We purchased these when my son was starting high school, because it was time to get rid of all of the battered 16 ounce water bottles and moved to something that was a little bit bigger and better suited for a teenager. These are a great size – not too big to carry in a backpack, but not too small, either. The color is as represented, a nice deep red. We appreciate that they come with both a straw cap and the screw cap depending on your preference (although I can't be alone in saying that the water bottle cabinet is the new Tupperware drawer – a disaster area of lids and straws!). We got a sheet of school stickers so that my son Could personalize the bottles. The one drawback that we found was that the stickers did not stay on through a dishwasher cycle. It is not clear to me whether that is a sticker issue or a water bottle issue, but it was easily solved by hand washing the bottles. All in all, the price and size were right for these. They come in a ton of colors too! I'm considering buying another set in blue. Highly recommend!

I bought these so I can fill them and take them on road trips, picnics etc instead of buying cases of plastic non refillable water bottles. Great quality, they do not leak with either of the lids on them. Also, they are insulated so the water will stay cold without coolers and ice. Will probably get a second set for weekend camping trips. Highly recommend!
Keeps water hot or cold till the next day!

review_title: Prefect for the project I was working on
body_en: They are just like they described them and the prefect size. I will be ordering them again.

These water bottles are great at keeping drinks cold. I got this for my office at work and I can put ice and water in it and come back over 24 hours later ans there is still ice in the water bottle. Also love that it has the two lid options to switch it up.

I bought this for my daughter for school, she’s 8. It is big and heavy when full but It holds a lot and with ice , it’s still very cold by the end of the school day. I fill it around 7am , still very cold (sometimes still has ice depending on how much I put in) by 3pm. Does leak if on its side , unfortunately we ruined a library book finding that out. It serves its purpose though. We needed a good size bottle that will keep her drink cold without making me poor haha. We used bottle stickers I purchased separately and she had fun decorating her bottle . I hand wash only .

I bought this waterbottle as a gift for my dad who works all day and comes home late. I wanted a bottle that was big (64oz), could withstand falls, and had different cap options to switch out when they get dirty. This bottle checks all the boxes and is super inexpensive ($19) compared to name brands. It came neatly packaged in a box with bubble wrap. I received the waterbottle assembled with the straw cap and the handle, two additional caps ( a screw on and one with a spout), two plastic straws with a cleaning brush, and a carabiner. It did come with the tiniest paint scuff at the top but nothing that would be a deal breaker. Since my dad prefers the spout cap, I tested to see if it would leak and not a single drop spilled. It retains cold temperatures perfectly well. Though I have not tested an entire day (24 hours) as the lable describes, if you add cold water from the fridge with a couple of ice cubes, you will have no problem staying fresh in a hot summer day. The bottle overall feels very durable and I really appreciate the rope handle that it comes with since it makes carrying the bottle a lot easier and is more secure than the plastic handle from the cap. I included a video of how to attach the rope handle in case yours does not come pre-assembled or if you'd like to remove it for washing. The only downside is the difficulty with having to remove the seals from the caps. I spent several minutes trying to remove the deeply wedged plastic seals inside the caps and finally succeeded using a fork and a butter knife, but this issue is common with mostly all insulated water bottles so its no different from name brands. If you are looking for the perfect water bottle, you have found it.

review_title: Great Size and Easy to Carry
body_en: I really like the 64 oz size because I don't have to constantly refill it throughout the day. Even though it's a large bottle, the handle makes it much easier to carry around, and the overall build feels sturdy. The insulated design does a good job keeping drinks cold for a long time, which is exactly what I wanted from a bottle this size. I also like having the different lid/drinking options depending on how I'm using it. Overall, it's a practical bottle for work, the gym, or just making sure you're drinking enough water during the day. So far, I'm very happy with it.

This is an excellent water bottle! The 40 oz size is perfect for staying hydrated throughout the day without constantly needing refills, and the insulation keeps my water cold for hours. I also love that it comes with three different lid options, so you can switch depending on how you like to drink. The included straw cleaner is a thoughtful bonus and makes it easy to keep everything clean. The bottle feels strong, sturdy, and very well made, and the handle makes it easy to carry around. Overall, it's a high-quality water bottle with great accessories included. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a durable, insulated bottle that offers plenty of versatility.

This is a good water bottle that fits in my car cup holders. I like the option of lids and noticed that they are also interchangeable with my other wide mouth water bottles which is a nice bonus. This says hand wash but I've put it through my dishwasher without any issues. This bottle also keeps my water cool all day without ice, we'll until I need to refill it because I drink at least 3 bottles a day. Minus 1 star because the flip top drinking lid cracked and fell apart on my daughter's water bottle. She said she didn't do anything to cause it. Her bottle also has a few dents. Evidently junior high is not water bottle friendly.

review_title: Excellent insulation and plenty of capacity
body_en: This has quickly become my new everyday water bottle. One of the main reasons I bought it was because of the larger 50 oz capacity, which is a big upgrade over many other popular bottles that only hold around 32 oz. The paracord handle is a surprisingly nice addition and makes it much easier to carry around. There is also a small compass attached to it, although I wouldn't count on it for navigation—it seems to be more decorative than functional, which honestly gave me a laugh. The bottle itself feels very durable and has held up well so far. It also does an excellent job keeping drinks cold throughout the day, even when left sitting in the sun for extended periods. Despite its larger size, I still find it portable enough for everyday use, and the overall appearance is clean and well-designed. Overall, if you're looking for a larger insulated water bottle that keeps drinks cold all day and is easy to carry, I would definitely recommend this one.

I’m really happy with this water bottle! It’s a great size and holds plenty of water to keep my son hydrated throughout his football practices, especially on those hot summer days. I love that it comes with multiple lids, so there’s no need to purchase them separately. The water stays nice and cold and it’s easy for him to carry. Definitely a great bottle for an active kid!

review_title: Keeps water cold and day! Ice doesn’t melt.
body_en: Best jug ever. My husband loves it. Ice doesn’t melt throughout all day and he works in the construction field and with this heat that means ALOT. Buy it! It’s so worth it. (:

review_title: Good after a year of use.
body_en: This canteen has been perfect for me the last year. Lightweight. Holds its cool and multiple sips. Takes a mean beating and barely any dents and easy to clean. Highly recommend this to anyone that’s a water drinker or wants to keep liquid cool on a hot day.

review_title: My favorite bottle, very durable and easy to take care of and easy to take on the go
body_en: Mayim Swift-Sip Insulated Water Bottle 26 oz, Leakproof One-Hand Open Lid, Patented Easy-Sip Spout, Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel, Locking Carry Handle, Fits Cup Holder, BPA Free (Deep Ocean) is an excellent choice for on-the-go hydration, work, or even nighttime use on the nightstand. While many people consider drink holders as mere containers, this one stands out as a top-notch option. Firstly, its BPA-free design ensures that your water remains clean and free from harmful chemicals. Secondly, the locking mechanism prevents spills and messes, providing peace of mind when tossing it into a bag or placing it on a seat. This feature is particularly useful when accidentally knocking the cup off the table, as the closed lids prevent waking up to a messy morning. Additionally, this bottle maintains the temperature of your drink, keeping it colder for longer or hotter for longer, depending on its contents. The 26 oz capacity is a significant advantage for me, as staying hydrated can be challenging. This bottle offers ample space to add ice or real fruit to a 17 fl oz bottle of sugar-free flavored water, making it a versatile option. It’s also an excellent choice for making iced coffee and keeping it cold, even with ice inside, without any condensation. Another notable feature is the straw attached to the inside of the bottle, eliminating the need to tilt it to drink. The straw allows for a direct and effortless sip, with no leakage. Additionally, the cap prevents bugs from entering the drink, ensuring a clean and enjoyable experience. The convenient carrying handle is another key feature. My hands are often full of various items, especially when relaxing on the patio. This cup, with its ingenious handle, makes it easier to carry out with all my belongings. It’s surprisingly lightweight, even when filled with fluid, allowing me to hang it on one finger. Such a great 26 oz dark blue bottle. Definitely built to last you years. I like how it can even go in the dishwasher with no fuss. Making it easier on me, one less thing to wash by hand is always a plus. This definitely a great investment for me and for anyone. Such an all around great investment that will provide you with clean stored drinks with no chemicals and it helps me want to drink more. I absolutely love this Mayim Swift-Sip Insulated Water Bottle 26 oz, Leakproof One-Hand Open Lid, Patented Easy-Sip Spout, Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel, Locking Carry Handle, Fits Cup Holder, BPA Free (Deep Ocean) bottle. I highly recommend this one. Such a great price for what you get from it. This would make an amazing gift to. The holidays are coming up soon and this is a gift that will keep being used and they’ll remember you by. This is my favorite bottle to use when I relax out back in my rocking chair enjoying nature. Keeps me cool on them hot southern temperatures. Still be keeping me warm on the cold southern temps by the fire. I could easily give this 10 stars, as it’s that great of a bottle.

I’ve been really happy with how well this keeps drinks cold. I put ice water in it at night and by the next morning the water is still freezing cold, usually with some small pieces of ice still floating around. It also fits in my car cup holder without any issue, which is always something I check with bigger bottles. The lid took me a minute to understand, but I actually like the way it works. The carry loop folds over the top and kind of acts as an extra layer of security over the button that opens the lid. Once you flip the loop up to carry it, that button is exposed, but there’s enough resistance that I haven’t had it accidentally pop open on me. Cleaning it is pretty straightforward too. The inside straw comes out and is easy enough to clean with one of those little narrow straw-cleaning brushes, although one is not included. I also like that the drinking spout is hard plastic instead of a soft rubbery material. Those softer mouthpieces always seem harder to keep clean over time. I would clarify the “leakproof” part a little. When everything is closed and locked, I haven’t had an issue. If the lid is open and the bottle tips sideways, though, liquid can come through the mouthpiece if the water line is below the small vent hole above the drinking spout. So I wouldn’t consider it spillproof while you’re actively drinking from it (like you’d expect from a kids sippy cup). My only real design complaint is the outside of the bottle is completely hard and smooth. There is a narrow softer band near the top that gives you something to grip, but I would have loved to see that same material farther down the bottle. Especially with a larger bottle, a little extra grip around the middle would make it easier to grab one-handed. Other than that, it’s been easy to use, keeps drinks extremely cold, and the lid design is pretty thoughtful.

review_title: Fantastic, durable stainless steel bottle with an excellent leakproof lid
body_en: Overall Verdict: The Mayim Swift-Sip Insulated Water Bottle is a highly durable, well-insulated, and cleverly designed bottle that is incredibly comfortable to hold and completely leakproof. My Experience & First Impressions: When I first saw this bottle online, I mistakenly assumed it would be entirely made of plastic. I was incredibly pleased to realize upon arrival that it is actually made of high-quality stainless steel, just as the description states. It has a beautiful deep blue color, and the brand logo is subtle and not an eyesore at all. I only use this bottle for cold drinks, and it keeps my water refreshing throughout the day. It also fits perfectly into my vehicle's medium-sized cup holders, making it a great travel companion. Design & Performance: Ergonomic Grip: The bottle is designed to be slightly narrower in the middle. This subtle contour makes it very comfortable to grip, handle, and drink from, even on the go. Smart Lid & Spout: The locking cap stays airtight and completely leakproof when closed, and flips completely out of the way when open. The large, patented easy-sip spout allows for excellent water flow and eliminates the need for a frustrating straw. Easy Maintenance: Cleanup is quick and simple. I easily wash it by hand using just mild dish soap and warm water. Pros: Premium vacuum-insulated stainless steel construction. Ergonomic center contour provides a secure, comfortable grip. Airtight, leakproof locking cap that clears your face when open. Wide spout allows for easy drinking without a straw. Fits standard car cup holders seamlessly. Cons: None to note—it outperformed my initial expectations. Final Thoughts: If you want a stylish, comfortable, and reliable water bottle that won't leak in your car or bag, this is a fantastic choice. The solid stainless steel build and straw-free design make it a great daily buy.

review_title: Better travel cup for life on the road
body_en: I spend a lot of time on the road, so an insulated cup is something I can actually put to use rather than another drink container that ends up sitting in a cabinet. I wanted something I could take with me in the truck and use for coffee or another drink without dealing with an open cup while traveling. The Swift-Sip style caught my attention because convenience matters when you're taking a drink with you instead of sitting at a kitchen table. I want a travel cup that is straightforward to open, drink from, and close without turning the lid into a project every time. I also like the taller, relatively narrow design. Space around a driver's seat can fill up quickly with everything you need during a workday, so I generally prefer drinkware that doesn't take up unnecessary room. The dark blue exterior looks clean and understated, which I prefer for something that's going to get used regularly rather than saved for special occasions. It also feels appropriate for the truck, office, commuting, or just carrying around the house. I don't make claims about how many hours a cup will maintain a particular temperature unless I've actually timed it under controlled conditions. What matters more to me is whether it is convenient enough that I'll continue reaching for it. For commuters, drivers, or anyone who routinely carries a drink from place to place, this is the type of insulated cup that fits naturally into a daily routine.

review_title: Hands Down My Favorite Water Bottle
body_en: Hands down, this is my favorite water bottle I have ever owned. It arrived in the exact Deep Ocean color shown in the listing, and the overall design is sleek and very comfortable to hold. I especially like the shape because it is slightly tapered toward the bottom, which allows it to fit smaller cup holders. The indented sides also make it much easier for me to grip with smaller hands. It came with a straw, which I personally don’t like using, so I removed it and use the bottle as a traditional tilt and sip instead. It works perfectly that way. The seal on this bottle is excellent. I have tested it in all kinds of situations where I would normally expect a water bottle to leak, and I haven’t had a single leak. The locking mechanism really seems to do its job and keeps the lid securely closed. Between the comfortable design, cup holder friendly shape, and completely leakproof seal, I absolutely love this water bottle.

review_title: Keeps drinks cold all day, opens one-handed with no leaks, and you get both a spout and a straw
body_en: This bottle comes with me everywhere, around the house, in the car, out running errands, and on walks or to the gym, and it holds up across all of it. Cold retention is the headline. Drinks stay cold all day, not a few hours, so what I fill it with in the morning is still cold in the afternoon without me thinking about it. The one-hand open lid is more convenient than I expected. I can flip it open while I'm carrying something else or driving, without setting anything down or unscrewing a cap. There's been no leaking at all, which matters since it rides in a bag on walks and gets knocked around in the car. Nothing seeps out around the lid or the spout. The sip spout flows well, giving a good stream without gulping or dribbling. It also includes a straw, so you can go either way depending on what you prefer that day. Having both options rather than being locked into one is a nice touch. The shape of the bottle feels nice in hand, with a contour that sits comfortably rather than feeling like gripping a straight tube. The carry handle makes it easy to grab and haul around too, especially when it's full and 26 ounces has some weight to it. The colors are super cute as well. The soft lavender is a pretty muted shade rather than anything harsh. One thing to know: it doesn't fit in the cup holder in my Mini Cooper. Smaller cars with tighter holders may have the same issue, so measure yours if that's how you plan to carry it. In my case it rides in the passenger seat or a bag instead, which works fine for me. Cold all day, no leaks, and versatile in how you drink from it. Really happy with this one, five stars!

review_title: Perfect as a school water bottle! Easy to open!
body_en: I really like this cup for my daughter to take to school. The pink, purple and mint colors are cute without feeling too babyish, and the 26 ounce size gives her plenty of water for the day! We haven’t had any issues with leaking either when the cap is on right and sealed properly. The lid is also really easy for her to use and I like that it has a lock so the spout isn’t just popping open in her backpack. You lift the purple top to unlock it and then press the blue/mint part of the cap to open the drinking spout. It’s simple enough for her to do on her own, which is an important factor in considering it for a school water bottle. My favorite thing about this bottle, though, is that the whole cup is dishwasher safe. I can just toss it in the dishwasher every evening instead of having another water bottle with a bunch of pieces I have to hand wash. It’s stainless steel and vacuum insulated, too, so it feels like a nice sturdy cup that should hold up well to being taken back and forth to school every day. This is definitely a good school cup for us, and my daughter loves the colors of it!

review_title: Easy to Drink From and Convenient to Carry
body_en: I’ve been using the Mayim Swift Sip, and it’s turned out to be a really solid everyday bottle. The first thing I noticed was how easy it is to drink from. The flow feels smooth and natural, so you’re not tugging at the spout or working for a sip. It’s especially nice when you’re on the move or trying to hydrate quickly. The one‑hand open lid has been genuinely useful. You press the button and it pops open right away, and the locking handle actually does its job. I’ve tossed it into my bag several times and haven’t had a single leak. The insulation also performs well. Cold water stays cold throughout the day, and hot drinks stay warm long enough to enjoy them. The size works well for daily use, and it fits into cup holders without any fuss. The bottle feels sturdy without being heavy, and the overall design is simple and practical. Overall, it’s a well‑made bottle that’s easy to carry and easy to use. Smooth sipping, no leaks, and dependable temperature control. It’s become one of my go‑to bottles for staying hydrated.

review_title: I recommend and absolutely love the free sip SWAY
body_en: I am obsessed with w/ the sway, I bought Daybreak/ Fig, they are gorgeous, the bottle design is sleek as well highly functional. It is matte vs shiny the bottle isn’t slippery in hand, & there are different sizes to choose from. It fits into my cupholders, it also fits into my couch cupholders, & have the 30 oz. I will be buying more for me as well for gifts as EVERYONE deserves to fall in love w/ this water bottle! I love this water bottle for many reasons. It checks off all of my requirements! My list was particular and I didn’t think I’d find exactly what I wanted. The body is stainless steel and is quite sturdy, it keeps my water cold for about 24 hours and the 30 oz. size is perfect. It’s neither too big nor too small. It fits in my car’s cup holder, has a convenient carry handle, features a lock and unlock switch, has a dual spout with a straw and also a regular spout to drink out of, the mouthpiece is covered by a pop up lid that opens at the press of a button and protects the mouth area from dirt and germs. Last but not least is the pretty color. I bought the Out of the Blue color. Durable, sturdy, leakproof, easy to clean. The lid, straw and gaskets are dishwasher safe. The bottle itself should be hand washed so the finish doesn’t get ruined in a dishwasher. One point to consider is that this bottle is for cold liquids only, not for use with hot beverages. It’s by far the best water bottle I’ve had because it has so many great features. Since it’s easy to carry around by the handle, I am finding myself taking it wherever I go in the house and I’m actually drinking more water because of it! Try it and you’ll fall in love with it just like I did!

Solid water bottle!!!. Not a water bottle person nor I do I really review anything but I like this is it a lot. Buy it. It’s worth it. Cool colors. The cherry one I got has a candy paint sparkle. simple ergonomic design. So far spill proof. Fits in cup holder and yea. Don’t get a Stanley get this instead.

I didn't get into the Stanley craze-I've had too many accidental spills with the whole cup & straw set up. So when my kids started insisting I get an Owala, I was skeptical. But then I saw the TikTok of that one guy using his Owala as a weapon to fight off the men who attempted to break into his house, and not only did he stop them, his Owala survived with just a dent (and a broken handle, if memory serves me right)! Then Owala does the of the best PR stunt/customer appreciation ever, and not only sends that man a safe, but filled that safe with several Owala bottles! I admire a company that can back their products up; but I will support a business who listens and recognizes their customers too! So I started looking for one; I got to thinking as a woman who often does her errands alone, "you know, I can always use it for defense and I can't be accused of carrying a weapon, because technically it's a water bottle." When Owala came out with this Amazon exclusive color, I knew it was kismet! I put it on my cart, but before I checked out, my kid saw what I was doing and she stopped me. She said, "lady, I already bought that for you. It's coming next week." LOL I guess she got tired of telling me to get one, and just grabbed it for me, knowing that burgundy is one of my favorite colors! I've had it for 5 months now. It's a little dinged up on the bottom-nothing too bad. I just dropped it one or two times (maybe more). I love that the mouthpiece is covered up and can be locked so 1)it will always be clean; and 2)it won't accidentally spill if it tips over, or you know, you accidentally drop it. It keeps me accountable-I fill that 40 oz 2-3 times a day to make sure I stay hydrated. I love that it's insulated so I can keep my drink cold or hot-depending on what I fill it with. I love that it's easy to clean-there are no nook & crannies that can't be cleaned or reached! I just love it. Period.

Love, love. Love this Owalla water bottle! It’s big enough to supply my needs and the body has flat side., just a tiny indented surface that makes it much easier to hold. I enjoy the sipping it allows so the beverage doesn’t come in an uncontrollable flow. With that you get a face wash ! But the open top allows for larger portions faster on days you’re really hot. I like the style of the bottle and the colors to choose from are so varied and stylish. In using this bottle it performs beautifully in keeping my beverage cold, even on the beach. I highly recommend this item👍‼️

I've been really happy with this bottle. The 30 oz size feels like the perfect middle ground—big enough that I'm not constantly refilling it, but not so big that it becomes a pain to carry around. It also fits in a standard cup holder, which was a must for me. It's surprisingly lightweight, and the bucket handle makes it really easy to grab and go. The only downside I've noticed is that ice doesn't last quite as long as some other insulated bottles because the lid isn't fully insulated. That said, it's not a dealbreaker for my use. It still keeps my water plenty cold throughout the day, and the convenience and design more than make up for it. I got the Dreamy Fields color and it looks even better in person. Overall, definitely recommend.
Very versatile, keeps water icy cold all day. Has a built in straw, great colors offered and the lid also has a lock feature. No worry about spills!

I’ve been using this Owala water bottle for a couple of months now, and it’s quickly become one of my favorites. I love the color, and the large handle makes it really easy to carry around throughout the day. One of my favorite features is the option to either sip directly from the spout or use the built-in straw. It’s nice having both options depending on what I’m doing. The only downside I’ve found is that the sip area can be a little tricky to clean thoroughly because of the design. It’s not a dealbreaker, but it does take a little extra attention when washing. Other than that, I’ve been extremely happy with it. I’ve run it through the dishwasher several times, and it still looks brand new. The finish has held up beautifully with no noticeable wear. Overall, it’s a well-made, durable water bottle that I’d definitely recommend.

The Owala FreeSip Tumbler in Light Roasted exceeded my expectations. The color is stunning: a beautifully understated light beige with a subtle milk tea undertone. It feels warm, muted, and elegant, making it look far more refined than most tumblers out there. Its minimalist design looks clean and polished, whether on a desk or in a car cup holder. The carry handle is easy to use without compromising the lid’s locking function, making it secure and convenient for travel. Cleaning is straightforward thanks to the wide-mouth opening, which also makes it easy to add ice. If you’re looking for a tumbler that combines visual appeal with everyday practicality, this one is an excellent choice.
Chugga chugga sip sip tech cannot be beaten. Colours are lovely, doesn’t spill. Good investment
Great quality! owala is truly the best. love the color.

Aesthetic and functional! This Owala thermos is perfect, large capacity, keeps the liquid cold for many hours, its handle allows you to easily carry it anywhere and the best thing is its anti-spill system is completely safe!! I would buy it again.

I purchased this bottle just to try out in the summer of 2023. It is now the summer of 2026 and I still use it multiple times a week (only because I now have multiple Owalas and I have just ordered my third Owala FreeSip). I have used so many cups—Stanleys, Yetis, Hydrojugs, Hydroflask, etc—and the Owala is still my favorite. Here’s my favorite things about it: LEAKPROOF! This is the biggest one. I can throw it my bag and trust that everything will stay dry. THE SPOUT! Hands down the best spout I’ve ever used. I love that I can sip through the straw but then close the lid and keep my straw clean and not have any spills if it tips over. And then it also gives me the option to absolutely inhale water if I’m about to shrivel up from dehydration. I think this alone is why I now own three in different sizes. STAYS COLD! The 32 ounce holds ice for quite a while. It varies depending on how often I refill it but if I’m not constantly refilling it, it will hold ice for about 24 hours. THE SIZES! I love the size options. My original one was a 32 ounce and is a great middle ground for me. It holds enough water that I’m not refilling it every hour but it’s not huge. It’s great for work and this bottle will be going to live at my job. I just ordered the 40 ounce for home because I want a little more volume when I’m outside gardening but I can’t say much about the 40 ounce size yet. I also have a 16 ounce (kids size) that I use when I leave the house. It fits in a lot of my bags and it’s leakproof so I always have cold water with me. It’s perfect especially since I’m on medication that causes dehydration if I’m not careful. DISHWASHER SAFE! This one is self explanatory. It’s amazing and I love it. There are a few cons though. The first one is that the 32 ounce doesn’t fit in my cup holder. Not a huge deal since it’s leakproof—I just keep it on the passenger seat. But Owala does have cup holder friendly options now if that’s something you want. The bottle also does dent and scratch fairly easily. I dropped it getting out my car one day and it’s a little beat up now. Kind ugly, but it’s still my fave. It’s kinda disappointing because I have Yetis and Stanleys that have been through far worse and still look new. Just be mindful of that and baby it a little. Still 100% worth it though. Long story short, it’s a great bottle that will keep your water cold and everything else dry. As someone who has used this bottle regularly for years, I highly recommend!

I freaking love this thing. I'm not a trend person, I go for function. And when my STB SIL got my fiancé a shiney new Stanley I decided it was time to replace my beat up Rtic with the mismatch lid and straw. I may not follow trends, but I didn't want my fiancé's cup to put mine to absolute shame! First off, can we all agree that the marshmallow is gorgeous? THIS cup is spectacular. Strange to say that about a water bottle, I know. But since I never jumped on that train, I didn't know what I had been missing out on. Let me tell you what! The most important things to me is taking care of my service dog. She keeps me safe so her care is paramount to me. This enables me to pour my water into her bowl on the fly, without having to open my bottle past what I would do to drink from it. Quick and easy. That right there was the selling point for me. But as it turns out, there was even more benefit than that. I don't chug my water but if I did, the chug hole does works fine. The straw portion is ready to sip from, and it doesn't stick up tall like other water bottle straws. It's JUST tall enough to get the job done. No worry of toppling over because the straw got knocked over by the cat. (Because that happens.) The "handle", which is generally the locking feature unless you're using it as a handle, is well placed and comfortable for my sized hands. Not to small and not clunky and large. STB SIL likes to talk about how great the Stanley handle is, which I don't really get. I like that this doesn't have a handle. I have one to carry it if I need it, and not if I don't. The seal is completely water tight. I occasionally put a drink mix in it and shake vigorously. No leaks whatsoever. In fact... It fits in a car cup holder upside down. That's how I transport it in the car. It doesn't fit butt down, so I put it top down. I've been known to do this with various bottles, so I tried it with this one and it fits ok. It's not ideal but it's better than nothing. Try it in yours! Since it's completely leak proof there's are no worries about spilling. (Just be careful when you remove it that it doesn't unlatch.) Another bonus of the covered straw is that germs don't get in the straw. Perfect because people in public often don't cover their sneezes. Ugh. And the coolest part? Lipstick messes are concealed with a flip of the lid! Easy peasy! I have noticed that the inside of the straw stains a little, which was disappointing. I don't like that I look at it and it looks dirty when it isn't. But I guess I shouldn't have used drink enhancers then. Also, my top color is very light. Other colors might not show that. Another thing that want fun was that when it fell, it dented! Oh no! So beware of that. It keeps my water super cold and I don't go anywhere without it. I love it so much that I'm thinking of getting another so I don't have to limit myself by style! Definitely worth the price since I use it constantly, every day. This one is so chill and Zen... The next one shall be colorful and crazy! One for every mood! I simply can't say enough about this darn water bottle... Does that mean I'm on trend now? Who knows! I just love my Owalla! I'm definitely a fan!

Owala water bottles for the win! These are hands-down our favorite water bottles. We have tried just about every popular brand out there—Yeti, Stanley, Hydro Flask, and others—and the Owala is the one that everyone in our family consistently reaches for. I absolutely love the versatility of the lid. You can use the built-in straw when you want to sip, or easily flip it open and drink straight from the opening. Having both options in one bottle is incredibly convenient, especially when you're on the go. The color combinations are also so fun! There are so many options to choose from, and the colors and designs make the bottles feel a little more personal and fun to use. Durability is another huge selling point. These bottles get used constantly and have been dropped and knocked around, yet they hold up extremely well. They seem much less prone to denting than some of the other brands we've tried, which is especially important when they're being used by kids. And, of course, they keep drinks really cold! We can fill them with ice and water, and they stay cold for hours. The lid also seals extremely well—we have never had an issue with them leaking in a bag. After trying so many different water bottles, Owala is definitely the winner for our family. They're durable, versatile, attractive, keep drinks cold, and don't leak. I honestly can't think of another water bottle brand we've liked as much!

As my first Owala I am so pleased with this water bottle. Keeps ice and water cold for hours, doesn’t leak, and love that you can use straw or spout. Great quality and liked the price. Only complaint is that it doesn’t fit in the car cup holders

review_title: Meet Your Hydration Goals with the BEST Water Bottle!
body_en: I am absolutely thrilled with my Owala FreeSip stainless steel water bottle as it has quickly become my absolute favorite for every day use, and it is easily the best insulated bottle I have ever owned. The best part for me is the built- in straw. It allows me to sipupright or I can drink from the widemouth opening. The push button lock lid locks securely so I can toss it in my tote bag without worrying about any spills. The stainless steel keeps the water ice cold all day even if I leave it in my hot car! It has a convenient carry loop. It can be filled with large ice cubes, and it’s easy to clean. You will love it!!!

We love this Owala! The 16 oz size is perfect for kids—big enough to hold plenty of water without being too heavy or bulky for them to carry around. The FreeSip design is probably my favorite part because they can sip through the straw or tilt it back to drink normally. It doesn’t leak all over the place, keeps water cold for a long time, and the covered spout stays cleaner than an exposed straw. The Read My Lips color is super cute, too. It’s held up really well to everyday kid use, which says a lot. Definitely worth the 5 stars!

I got this Owala for my son and really like it so far! My favorite feature is that you can drink from either the built-in straw or use the chug opening. It gives him both options without having to switch out lids or pieces, which is really convenient. The bottle itself feels sturdy and good quality, and the lid closes securely and has a handle that makes it easy to carry. The colors are also really fun and vibrant. My only concern is the coating on the outside. It feels like it may be somewhat easy to scratch, especially since this is going to be used by a kid and tossed into bags, taken to school, etc. We’ll see how it holds up over time! Overall, though, I’m really happy with it. I’ll update my review once I find out how sturdy it is.

review_title: Love Owala; does not leak and easy to carry. Stays cold!
body_en: Love Owala bottles and I have several of the 24 oz. I decided to get a larger size (32 oz.) this time to take to sporting events to hold more water. Water stays cold all day like the others, and it never leaks. The only downside is that it doesn't fit in my car or chair cupholders by just a fraction. I kind of suspected that might be the case going in, so it doesn't bother me too much. At games I just have to set it on the ground instead of my sports chair. It just won't be my everyday bottle - I will continue to use the 24 oz for the car since it fits perfectly in the cupholder. But Owala still gets 5 starts for the great design, easy to carry, and staying cold all day.

review_title: Produto perfeito, mas a entrega deixa muito a desejar.
body_en: Let's go, firstly, I LOVED the bottle, I was super excited for it to arrive and I don't regret buying it at all. It keeps the water cold for a LONG time (if you're like me and are curious to know exactly when, a great example was that I put water in it WITHOUT ICE at 4 pm and the next day at 8 am when I woke up it was still cold as if it had just come out of the water filter, remembering that my filter has ice water). Her straw is amazing and super practical, but I also recommend buying one of those little brushes to clean. Furthermore, she is very beautiful and big. I bought the 945ml one and it's perfect for me, as it has a handle and the outer material of the bottle is not slippery to the touch. Now talking about the negative points, the only negative point I have to mention here about this bottle is the delivery. I saw a lot of people complaining about the delay in delivery and it actually happened to me too, the shipping time is HUGE, I believe it's because of the number of people who buy this bottle, so it took a LONG time for them to ship, approximately a month. The delivery itself after shipping took a week +/-, so I believe it is really a stock thing. The problem is that the bottle should come in a cardboard box, lined inside and everything. But in fact it came in a bag with nothing on it, just the bottle, wrapped in a small package with a DUBIOUS layer of bubble wrap. I even believe that this was the reason for the scratch in the photo (it's small, very small, and it's on the bottom, it's practically not even noticeable, especially after I buy that silicone mold to put on the bottle). Anyway, the product is perfect, but they made a big mistake in the way they sent it, and it's not even because of the delay, but because of the damage caused to the products, since more people here had the same problem.
Very good, doesn't leak, keeps the temperature.
Did not include the green ”cover” as shown. Other than that, I adore this bottle!
Really nice and holds so much water and keeps it cold for a really long time. The quality is worth it for the price.

A little expensive compared to average, but worth it! It keeps the temperature very well, but above all the possibility of drinking by suction thanks to the straw makes it easier to use even while driving! The colors are fantastic!

Nalgene bottles just work. The Nalgene bottle is perfect for those who enjoy outdoors activities. As funny as it is to say it "just works" when it's as simple as a bottle, it absolutely does. For starters the material. Not only is it BPA-free, the Tritan material is perfect for a drinking bottle. It's extremely rugged, in fact Nalgene has gained a reputation for how long their bottles last. It also doesn't leave much of a taste! A lot of my experience with plastic bottles is that you can taste the plastic, the problem persists with metal as well. Nalgene bottles have a fairly neutral taste. It's also very resistant to trapping odors and tastes. My problem with alternatives is that if you hold coffee in them for a long time, then your water tastes like coffee even after a clean. 1L is a perfect amount of water to hold in my opinion. It's enough to be usable, but not overkill to where it's not a functional bottle. It's great for day to day use as well, I find myself finishing a Nalgene just fine. The size is great in this aspect, it doesn't waste space with insulation. I find a lot of metal bottles and other plastic bottles can only ever hold 500ml and some change because of their shape. The leak proof seal just works. A lot of bottles are finicky, if you screw the cap from an angle it still leaks. I've tried to do it from an angle but it always screws on properly, I've never had a problem with it spilling. Overall the Nalgene is the perfect bottle. It's a good middle ground of everything while having its strengths in durability, build quality, and price.

Love this bottle. Cute color, hardy and stands up to drops and dings perfectly. Fits 32oz and then some which is perfect if you’re trying to drink more water in the day. No leaks, easy to clean and easy to clip to a bag or just carry around. Highly recommend.

review_title: Simple bottle that’s actually easy to use and clean
body_en: I really like the simplicity of this water bottle! No straws, no complicated lids, no weird tiny parts that are impossible to clean, this is just a simple water bottle that you’ll actually end up using every day. I got it in the color “cotton,” and it’s honestly such a nice neutral shade, knd of a soft beige that looks way more expensive than it is. The wide mouth is one of my favorite features because it makes cleaning super easy and also makes it easy to add ice. I also really like the ounce/milliliters markings on the side of the bottle, it became surprisingly helpful to me for keeping track of how much water I’m actually drinking throughout the day. This is actually my second Nalgene bottle, I bought this one to replace my older one because plastic bottles should be replaced once in a while, especially after heavy everyday use. My previous one lasted a long time though, which says a lot. The only downside is that because there’s no straw and the opening is pretty wide, drinking from it while walking or moving around can be a little awkward unless you’re careful. Overall, really happy with it. Simple, durable, lightweight, and super practical, which honestly matters more to me than trendy designs ;)

review_title: No o-rings needed; dependable; won’t leak
body_en: The best and most dependable water bottles out there. No need for janky o-rings. The build tolerances are so tight that you just twist the lid snug and it won’t leak. Great color and the wide mouth is easy to clean. Only drawback? When you put cold stuff in it, the condensation will get on stuff.

This is the perfect water bottle for those who want to get their daily water intake. It has the measurements and a wide mouth opening that makes cleaning easy. No straws to wash just the bottle and attached lid. Nalgene products are also very durable and affordable.

review_title: Verified Purchase ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Classic Nalgene Durability, Clear View, and Better for the Planet!
body_en: I have been using Nalgene bottles for years, but this Sustain 32 oz. Wide Mouth Water Bottle in the clear finish is my new absolute favorite. I love being able to see exactly how much water I have left at a glance, and it makes measuring out hydration mixes or tracking my daily intake incredibly easy.The biggest selling point for me is the new Sustain material. It is made from 50% recycled plastic, but it retains the legendary toughness you expect from the brand. I have already dropped this bottle onto solid concrete while getting out of my truck, and it didn't crack, shatter, or leak a single drop—just a tiny, barely noticeable scuff. The classic wide mouth is fantastic because it easily accommodates large ice cubes, fits perfectly with most backpacking water filters, and makes cleaning out the bottle manually an absolute breeze. The leak-proof loop top is rock solid, and it attaches perfectly to a carabiner for clipping onto a backpack or gym bag. There are absolutely no weird plastic tastes or odors right out of the box, either. If you want a dependable, indestructible, and eco-friendly water bottle for hiking, camping, or everyday use, this clear Nalgene is an absolute classic that will last for years.
Good water bottle for the price, love the colors. No issues with leaking but wish it fit in a cup holder

review_title: Simple design, but built like a tank
body_en: I've used a lot of water bottles over the years, and the Nalgene 32 oz Wide Mouth is still one of the best. Super durable, lightweight, and completely leak proof. I've dropped it multiple times and it barely shows any wear. The wide mouth makes it easy to clean and perfect for adding ice cubes. Great for the gym, hiking, work, and everyday use. Simple design, but built like a tank.

Over the years, I've had about four of these in different colours. The only reason I've ever replaced them is because I appear to lose a water bottle every 2.5 years! Really nice vibrant colours that don't fade or chip like an anodised bottle would + it's dishwasher safe with no noticeable degradation to quality. The quality on Nalgene has always been exceptional and lasted many many hiking trips + every survives every day life. 1L is the perfect size for me. While some may say ~£20 is steep, I have had no problem ordering another without a second thought on price the instant I realise I've lost one.
Excellent water bottle, the wide opening allows you to easily wash the inside.
As good as any Nalgene, durable and I love the colour. Perfect for adventures.

review_title: 水筒といえばナルゲン
body_en: I have been using Nalgene bottles for a long time. There are so many colors to choose from, and they are all so fashionable that you will have a hard time choosing. I can see how much water I drink in a day, which is very helpful.
Lovely colour, great bottle

I got this 16oz bottle for myself because I've stated using the celsius packets rather than drinking the cans. I wanted something reusable because I have a water dispenser at home and didn't want to have to keep buying cases of water when I have perfectly fine water already. Anywho, this works out perfectly for my packets! The bottle keeps my drink cold for the length of time needed. It has a nifty tab on it that locks the lid, though I don't really use that, but would be useful for the kiddos. It also has a sturdy handle on it, which is amazing! It does have a bumper around the bottom, protecting the bottom corners of the bottle from scratches, etc. The bottle is insanely easy to clean! I've noticed several people complain about mold growing in the rubber pieces on the lid and around the rubber ring. These are insanely easy to remove and place back in. Yes, water will get trapped under these pieces, but simply remove them while it's drying and pop them back in when you're ready and it will totally avoid the mold issue. Oh, and it's also a plus that this bottle doesn't leak, also perfect for the kiddos for school, etc. All in all, I'm pleased with the bottle!

This water bottle is the perfect size for our 6 year old. With this bottle, you don't have to worry about keeping straws clean or worse yet, losing them. The bottle is easy to clean. It seals well so there is no leaking and it keeps water cool for hours. The lid is easy for children to open and close. Highly recommend this water bottle.

review_title: Perfect Size and Durable Water Bottle for Kids
body_en: This Thermos Funtainer water bottle has been a great choice for my child. The 16 oz size is perfect for a first grader—not too big or heavy, but still holds enough water. The bottle feels sturdy and well-made, which is important for kids who are constantly dropping or tossing things into their backpacks. The spout is easy for my child to use, and the neon pink color is fun and easy to spot. Overall, this is a reliable kids’ water bottle that has held up well. It is a great size, durable, and works well for everyday school use.

I bought the Thermos Funtainer for my kids and it’s been a great purchase. They use it every day for school, and it holds up really well to being dropped and tossed around. It actually keeps drinks cold for hours, even through the whole school day. The size is perfect for little hands, and it’s easy for them to open and use on their own. Best part—no leaks in their backpacks so far. That alone makes it worth it. Super happy with this and will probably buy more.

This is a good quality cup, bright colors, handle with a grip and a lock on the mouthpiece. There is no straw, but it has good drink ability through the mouthpiece. Very good at heat and cold insulation. My son loves this cup for his school. I would highly recommend.

review_title: Might be THE water bottle for us
body_en: I think we may have found THE water bottle. My 3 and 5 yr old love this chug spout and it holds a good amount of water for them. It's easy to clean, you can pop off the silicone parts and wash easily. The lock feature is great. So far the button works well to open the lid. Has a nice tactile feel to lock and open. Not sure about the longevity of the bottle which is why I gave 4 stars but the silicone bottom helped to prevent a dent from a fall. Fits in the kids car seat cup holder. Nice carry handle. Can leak if your silicone parts are not installed properly. Keeps water cold. Nice color options and I got them on sale.

I've gotten similar cups at my local store that broke within 24 hours. This one lasts. My 2.5 year old can drink from it. My five year old loves it. I was looking for something with a wider opening. Needed a cup he could fill up by himself without worrying about taking the lid off. Most of the sip nozzles have two parts. If one of them breaks, the cup no longer closes. This cup works better for us. The design has stayed intact and we've had zero leaks.

review_title: Great water bottle for kids to bring to school. Love the no straw feature!
body_en: I purchased two of these for 8 and 10 year olds and they've been going to school with them daily for about a month now. We've been using Thermos Funtainers for most of their lives so are very familiar with the version including a straw... I am so glad to be done with those as these open spout water bottles are not only much easier to clean, but my kids are drinking more water (yay!) because it flows a little faster. Not so fast that we've even come close to any accidents though. I'm sure it won't stay perfect forever, but the kiddos aren't exactly careful and these cups are still free of dings and scratches, so they still look brand new for now. This wasn't the case a month into last school year when the kids had different, (not Thermos brand), water bottles that did not have the plastic piece protecting the bottom. Those bottles did the job but to be frank, they just started looking crap because they were (too easily) all beat up in no time. No leaking! These cups get tossed around with the kiddos' bookbags and are brought out to the field for P.E. and tossed on the ground and still.. no leaking. There was one day that a tiny bit seeped out but that seems to be a user error since it hasn't happened again. Anyhow, these big kid Funtainers are just about perfect for us... Dad, teen, and I have been using Yeti for several years but I will admit, I'm not perfectly happy with mine. Thermos has been doing it longer so I think I'll make the switch myself.
A high-quality product. It keeps cold for 12 hours. It does not leak water. It is easy to clean. There are multiple colors and shapes that satisfy all tastes.
Good quality and very practical

It is of very good quality, very beautiful and the materials feel premium. If it keeps the temperature very well and it is a size like the one my son needs, it is small and its capacity is enough for the time he is at school.
Beautiful bottle, with excellent value for money in the promotion

It's a great bottle.

review_title: Premium Build, Outstanding Insulation, and Truly Leakproof
body_en: This insulated water bottle excels where it matters most. Insulation: The double-wall vacuum insulation is outstanding. Water stays cold for hours, and ice is often still present at the end of the day. If cold retention is a priority for you, this bottle delivers. Leakproof Design: I have to call this out specifically because I love it. The secure-sealing lid and cap system is truly leakproof — toss it in a bag, clip it to a backpack, lay it on its side — no leaks. Period. For anyone who's dealt with water bottles that claim to be leakproof but aren't, this one actually means it. Build Quality: The stainless steel construction feels premium and durable — built for rugged outdoor use without feeling cheap or flimsy. The powder-coated exterior provides good grip and durability, while the silicone base adds stability, impact protection, and prevents slipping on surfaces. The rubberized lid and silicone components improve overall grip and usability. No metallic or plastic taste. Design and Functionality: The versatile lid design allows either a full opening for filling or a smaller opening for drinking — a practical touch for daily use. The comfortable carry loop and strap make transportation easy, whether you're on a long hike or walking between meetings. It clips easily to a backpack or gear for outdoor use and fits well in backpack pockets. Easy to clean, easy to fill, and the gift-worthy packaging makes it a great option for gifting as well. A few things to keep in mind: Size and Weight: At 32oz, this is a large bottle designed for all-day hydration, camping, travel, and outdoor activities. It's slightly heavier than some comparable bottles and can feel cumbersome for casual everyday carry. If you're looking for a compact, lightweight daily bottle, this may be more than you need. Cup Holders: The 32oz size may not fit standard vehicle cup holders. I've used an enlarged cup holder adapter for years to accommodate larger bottles, so this wasn't an issue for me — but it's worth considering. Interior Threading: The threading around the drinking opening can be prone to collecting debris and developing odor over time, especially if you're mixing in additives like electrolyte powders. Regular thorough cleaning of the threads is recommended to keep things fresh. This is a premium, rugged, well-designed insulated bottle that prioritizes durability, insulation, and capacity. It's an excellent value compared to more expensive competing brands, and it delivers on every claim. Highly recommend for anyone who takes their hydration seriously.

review_title: Big, well made bottle that's great for camping
body_en: The Nordikra insulated stainless steel water bottle deserves 5 stars because of its high quality construction. But be aware that this is a big, heavy duty bottle. I personally find it too large and heavy to comfortably carry on a walk or hike. It doesn't fit in my car cupholders, and it wouldn't be practical on a bike due to its weight. This bottle is more like an old school thermos bottle that has been upgraded and strengthened, minus the fragile glass liner. The bottle holds a generous 32 ounces of liquid. It keeps a drink cold for hours. However, it did not, for me, live up to its claim of keeping liquid hot for 24+ hours. In my test, it was closer to 12 hours. Still, that's pretty good. Here is what I like best about the bottle-- This is a very good looking water bottle. It comes in an attractive box that would be perfect for gift-giving. The powder coated exterior is impressive, looks great, and feels very durable. The silicone base and cap are very practical and I like the colorful contrast against the black body. The lid is easy to twist off. You can easily drink from the bottle or pour from it. The bottle is also easy to clean. Although I don't care to carry this bottle around, it was perfect to keep drinking water fresh and cold at our campsite. The 32 ounce size is convenient, and the bottle takes up less space than the plastic thermal jugs we had been using. Plus, we had no trouble with drips or leaks. The bottle also comes with a 5 year limited warranty. The Nordikra bottle is a welcome addition to our camping gear.

review_title: Nice bottle! Buy it I suppose!!
body_en: It’s a bottle, so there’s not a ton to dissect, but this Nordikra feels solid in hand. The textured coating gives a secure grip that doesn’t slip, and the metal seems thicker than what I’ve used before, which makes it feel tough enough for hiking or the gym. I didn’t notice any setup steps... just filled it and went. The finish looks premium and hasn’t scratched yet, so the build quality checks out so far. Ice stayed in for a full day, which is handy for keeping water cold during long outings. It’s easy to clean since it goes in the dishwasher, and there’s no metallic or plastic taste, which I appreciate. The leak proof claim holds up in my bag, and knowing it’s BPA free adds peace of mind. It’s basic but reliable for travel or camping, though I haven’t tested extreme conditions. I gave it five stars because it does what it should, and the five year warranty gives confidence. Buying it funds a tree through the National Forest Foundation, which is a nice touch for sustainability. There aren’t real downsides yet, just the simplicity of the design. For a reusable bottle, it’s a straightforward pick that matches the description without surprises.

This beautifully designed, solidly built water bottle features two separate openings—one for drinking and a larger one for filling or adding ice. Both caps are wrapped in textured silicone, providing a secure, non-slip grip even with wet hands. It also includes a sturdy, flexible carry loop that is comfortable to hold and makes the bottle easy to transport. The base is protected by a silicone cover that provides a stable, non-slip surface while helping guard against minor bumps and scratches. This is not a lightweight bottle. Filled with its full 32-ounce capacity, it weighs approximately 3.25 pounds, making it better suited for those who prioritize durability over minimal weight. I found its cold retention to be more impressive than its heat retention. In my testing, I filled the bottle with 58°F water, and after 12 hours the temperature had risen to only 68°F. I then repeated the test using 190°F water, which cooled to 140°F after 12 hours. While it does not retain heat as effectively as it retains cold, the performance is more than adequate for my needs since I primarily use it for cold beverages. Overall, this is an excellent water bottle for everything from gym workouts to long hikes. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a durable, well-built insulated water bottle.

This Nordikra 32 oz insulated stainless steel water bottle is a well-made, durable bottle with several thoughtful design features. The 32 oz capacity is great for camping, sports, outdoor activities, or any situation where you need plenty of water on hand. My son initially wanted to use it as his school water bottle, but I found it a little too large for that purpose, especially if you’re relying on a standard backpack pocket. It’s also fairly wide, so I don’t expect it to fit most standard vehicle cup holders. The protective features are a nice touch, particularly the reinforced base and the easy-grip handles, which make the bottle more comfortable to carry. I also like the open-spout design because it’s easy to drink from directly or pour water into another container. Most importantly, it does a good job of keeping water cold for an extended period. Overall, I’m impressed with the quality and construction. The price is in line with what I’d expect for a quality insulated stainless steel bottle, and while these bottles can be an investment, this one feels well made enough to justify the cost.

review_title: Very well insulated and premium construction
body_en: This is a very well insulated and heavy duty, rugged water bottle. Throw in a few ice cubes and water stays nice and cold throughout the work day. Extra large size makes it easy to keep up with my hydration. Not that I ever want aim to impress anyone with how my water bottle looks, this does sport a very attractive and sharp design with the red rubbery bottom sleeve. That provides nice traction so you can rest it on angled surfaces, rocks, etc, without it sliding off. Also adds a nice degree of durability. The clip-like design of the cap holder allows me to easily attach it to my backpack. Both caps (large and small) seal perfectly and have zero leakage. Being extra large, it is more difficult to hold if you have smaller hands. Also won't fit in a lot of car drink holders, so keep that in mind. Stainless steel interior has no bad after taste and is much safer than plastic bottles. Given its size and how well insulated it is, at $35 I consider it a great value compared to some of the more expensive brands. One last thing to mention, it comes packaged in a very nice rounded box that is perfect for giving as a gift.

This insulated water bottle is a lifesaver! I took it out on a scorching 90+ degree day, and it held a substantial amount of water. I filled it halfway with ice and the rest with water, and it kept my water icy cold throughout the entire day. I spent the entire day outdoors in the sun, and by the time we got home, there was still ice floating inside. The bottom portion of the bottle has a silicone protector that provides a great grip on the ground. It doesn’t make it easy to slip, especially on uneven surfaces. The bottle is easy to screw on top and doesn’t leak water. It’s also incredibly convenient to carry. If you have a larger metal clip attached to a lanyard, you can clip the bottle onto it as well. I ended up just carrying it around my fingers while hiking to the river, and the handle didn’t break or pull apart on me. This is a great bottle to take outdoors or on the go. Quality made!

review_title: Real review of a not-free product
body_en: This is NOT a “Vine Customer Review of Free Product”. This is a real review by a guy who paid $45 of my hard earned dollars for a water bottle. I’m not a Ridge fanboy - this is the first Ridge product I’ve owned. PROS: **It fits in the water bottle pocket of every bag I own, every bag my wife owns, and our kids backpacks. It’s not a girth monster. **It fits in the cupholders of our Nissan Maxima, Toyota Highlander, and my (pride and joy) Cub Cadet lawn tractor. Praise the Lord. **It’s slim and easy to hold - 24oz capacity is plenty. Reusable water bottles are reusable? If you drink all the water, you can just refill it. I don’t need a half gallon on me at all times - I'm not training for a triathlon. **It doesn’t leak. Has good silicone gaskets that work well, and has a safety lock for the accident prone among you. **Has nice style & colorways, so it’s easy to identify if it gets lost in a sea of everyone else’s emotional-support water bottles. **Has an ice catcher. I didn’t know this was something I needed, but apparently it is, and I support it. **No straw. Has a great spout that makes chugging water easy when serious hydration is required. This is how water should be consumed by adults: efficiently, aggressively, and with purpose. CONS: **you don’t have one yet. Get your life together and buy one. If your reading Amazon reviews you’re obviously interested, just do it. If you don’t like it, return it.
Great water bottle, ergonomic design, really like to cap that prevents ice from falling through the mouthpiece; highly recommended

I really like this water bottle, although I will be the first to admit that I've typically liked most Ridge products I've tried. I've put it at 4 stars, however, as it's not all perfect and there are definitely a couple pieces you will want to be aware of before purchasing. On the plus side - it's well built. I wouldn't say any more so than any other major brand name water bottle I've used in the past, but also no less so. It very much holds it's own and feels like it fits in well with the overall quality of the wider "premium" water bottle market. I also really, REALLY love the inclusion of the integrated strainer - if you use this for water with ice cubes like I do then it's an absolutely genius addition! On the "things to be aware of" note - while it is undoubtedly well built, it may or may not be worth the full ~$45 asking price to you. That is to say that there are definitely water bottles out there that feel every single bit as premium for not much more than ~half the price. It's also relatively small. This doesn't bother me, as my desk job keeps me close to the water cooler and it's never a bad thing to have an excuse to get up and move around...but it would drive my wife absolutely crazy. So definitely don't buy this if a smaller water bottle isn't your cup of tea. As long as neither of those "cons" scares you off, then you will likely enjoy this water bottle just as much as I have been and it's worth checking out!

review_title: A great water bottle if you like ice!
body_en: Great water bottle. It keeps ice a long time and the ice strainer is perfect. So far the durability seems to be very good.

This is a well-styled insulated double wall bottle weighing in just under 15 oz that fits great in car cup holders with a locking push button lid. It’s well-designed, comfortable to hold, and easy to drink from but lacking in capacity at 24 oz compared with the similarly cup holder friendly Owala Sway which is 30-40 oz. Like many insulated bottles it might be top rack dishwasher safe if it fits but handwashing is recommended. The lid has the stand out feature of the ice catcher which good for preventing splashing or ice falling out, but hard to remove plus another thing to clean. It doesn’t have any other notable features like a silicone bottom for grip/silence or ceramic interior to keep it from negatively flavoring your beverage in my RTIC. If value was notably better with a coupon or on sale then I would rate this 4 stars. I also don’t see any replacement accessories third party or otherwise for sale on Amazon which is another strike against this bottle. If you really like the style, give it a try.

I ordered the black and orange colorway which is one of my favorite color combos, so right off the bat I liked it a lot. It is a very nice water bottle. I have owned and used many different water vessels from starbucks to tal to miir, to stanley to yeti & others i've received as christmas gifts. I think most double walled water bottles are going to provide what you are looking for and it is hard for me to say any one of them including this one are superior to another if they do what I personally want them to do and that is to hold a diet coke or water or coffee and keep the diet coke & or water cold and if i happen to be having a warm beverage that day, (my coffee), I want it to stay hot. Ridge is in the top for quality and the price reflects that. I think it is pricey for what it is but it would make a very nice gift and as you can see the box and branding and presentation are exceptional. I would be proud to have it sent to a friend "sight unseen" from Amazon without me personally wrapping it. It is a quality piece of workmanship. I like the dispenser top/cap. The weight is in the medium range and i like that it isn't too heavy to lug around like some of mine are. I have wrist and elbow joint issues and it can be hard to carry and hold some of these bottles when they are full. I am excited to further test the Ridge. These are my thoughts/experience w/this item @ the time of review. review_title: Expensive, but a great water bottle
body_en: Our family is on the constant search for a great water bottle; we use them all the time in the car, at sporting activities, in the gym, etc. I don’t think our requirements are significantly different from others, mostly in this order: no leaks, easy to drink from without the water running down your shirt, easy to clean, good cold retention, fits in cup holder, a handle. This ‘Ridge Water Bottle 24 ounce Double-Walled” meets all those requirements very well. It doesn’t leak in any position, even if you shake it. The top opening is just the right size, with the opening not set so far back (toward the middle of the cup) that you get dripping. It’s easy to clean with no nooks and crannies (since we just use it for water, we generally use a kitchen brush for all of it, and now and then put the top in the dishwasher). It holds water cold even in a hot car (and it fits in all our cup holders). It has a sturdy handle. It’s the first bottle we’ve had with an ‘ice catcher,’ and while I can honestly say I’ve never considered this to be an issue, it certainly does help keep the water flow steady if you put a lot of ice in. I don’t quite see how it works as a ‘mixer for powder and supplements’ as described, although I guess if you dumped in some lumpy powder it might help. The only downside is the price, at double what you pay for other good quality water bottles. If you’ve been disappointed in others it might be worth it even at this price. I’m rating it based on the product quality and not the price.

review_title: Good looking bottle, like the ice catcher
body_en: Stainless steel double-walled bottles are becoming a dime a dozen. I am not familiar with this brand, but I do like the bottle. Looks sharp, handle is good, like the ice catcher idea inside. There is no straw option for sucking water out of the bottle, you will need to tip it and drink like an adult! The lid does have a clear plastic window, allowing you to see inside when it's open, which could be a handy feature. There is also a sliding lock to keep it from opening unexpectedly. The size is good, it's not a super tall bottle, which is nice for fitting on shelves. It is also listed as dishwasher safe, both bottle and lid. Overall, it's a good bottle with some extra features. I did not try denting it for this review, so not sure how dent resistant it is. I am also not familiar with this brand, so my main thought is, is it worth the premium price? It might be- but definitely a better value if it happens to go on sale. The main drawback is if people like to use straws integrated with a mouthpiece to drink, this bottle does not have that option, you will need to look elsewhere.

review_title: Great deal at 16.99, but definitely worth more!!
body_en: Oh. My. Goodness. This is the BEST deal! This bottle comes with an extra straw AND a brush for washing them PLUS the entire bottle and top are dishwasher safe! The little card inside also says you can contact them if you want another straw, also! It holds a ton, keeps it cold forever (24 hours!) and has a great grip strip right at the perfect spot so it won't slip out of your hand. Also comes with a handle on top. I expected to be pleased, but I'm REALLY pleased. I'm about to buy another in another color so I can have an extra just because. Do yourself a favor and buy this. Trust me you will NOT be sorry.

It is a great product for the price, excelent quality ,, is leak proof an I have teste no just for leak ..this pruduct is a tank, the liquid stay cold ,I do not used for hot but you can put food with no problem and on top ,looks very nice.You can put one of those very expensive and no one will see the difference .I’m not influencer or getting pay. If you are going to buy , buy more than one, because really is multi purpose..
Top notch quality- great color - keeps drink cold all day long. Exactly as described. Perfectly priced.
Cute bottle! Ice last good time.

I didn't think I'd like this as much as I do. It keeps water cold for at least 24 hours. I add 2 big ice cubes to it, add filtered water and shut the lid. Works great and I'm drinking more water so win win. I also really like the textured grip ring. The one thing I'll mention is that while it fit the cup holders in my 2010 Sonata, it doesn't fit the cup holders in my Toyota Cross. The bottle only goes so far into the cup holder (enough to keep it stable). It seems leak proof but I don't really keep it on its side so haven't tested that.
