This thing keeps ice for 24 hrs for real I have left it in a hot car and still has ice. I had gotten one from Walmart that wouldn't keep ice for two hours. Pleased with this and it fits in car cup holders.
Cute and stays well insulated
We needed a clear water bottle for my kids school this year and this was perfect!

I love it! It’s super cute! The lock feature works well and the rubber tip is nice. It obviously doesn’t keep things cold for as long. Compared to an insulated water bottle. But it does the job and I love being able to see my ice and water, (weird I know).
Good quality. Made of Plastic so doesnt keep drink too cold
Great purchase! Doesn't look and is perfect for school.

review_title: Lid for drinking out of the open top is difficult
body_en: I got this bottle because I prefer to drink water out of the top, rather than through a straw, and I was excited about a pop-up lid for that purpose. Overall, the quality of the materials is good - the lid, bottle and handle all seem to be durable. The bottle is versatile because it gives the option of drinking out of a straw, or out of the lid. The straw opening is a soft plastic and the pop-up lid function works fine for the straw opening. However, the pop-up lid for drinking out of the top could be better - it takes a lot of force to open & close it. So it's definitely not a one-handed operation. The unusually shaped opening also feels a little strange to drink out of. The straw lid is easy to open and close with the push button, so I leave the straw out and drink through the straw opening most of the time. The bottle fits in my car cup holder. I wish it had a more simple push button opening for drinking out of the lid, like the straw function does. So I can't really recommend this for someone who wants a pop-up lid to drink out of. But if you prefer drinking through the straw, this bottle would work great.

Good colors, sturdy construction. However, even when locked, the top has popped open and spilled water everywhere. In addition, water has leaked up through the straw so that when the top was open, water squirted out.
Love how this resembles the Ello stainless steel water bottle. It’s still does the exact same thing as a normal Ello pop and fill. It’s just clear. Perfect for my job.

review_title: Pretty. Stiff button. Glue dot packaging sucks.
body_en: I wanted these for the lid to make refills easier for my fourth grader, so was pleased to find them in clear plastic which is all of a sudden required by the school. These fit in the side pocket of her book bag perfectly. We love that the straw and lid come in colors- which are all neutral and pretty, and the mouth piece is a comfortable silicone. The lid itself feels stiff and hurts the thumbs to open a bit. We found using two thumbs and pushing closer to the top of the button (instead of the middle) makes it a little easier to release the top cover to drink from the spout. I was worried about a review that said the plastic was thin- but when you squeeze the bottle the material does not budge like a cheaper plastic would, so it’s durable enough for us. What I feel really frustrated about is the packaging. They put a few stickers on it which were easy to take off. It was the glue dot they used for the label that ruined it. What should have been a 2 second removal has turned into 10-20+minutes per bottle of soaking in Goo Be Gone and gently scrubbing in hopes of not scratching up the plastic. Even then I can’t seem to get it all off, so on a brand new bottle we haven’t even used yet we are left with that frosted/sticky spot where the glue dot was. Maybe there is a fancy hack for this? But it should not be this hard. Will update when she uses it for school next week.

review_title: really impressed with this water bottle
body_en: I've been really impressed with this water bottle. The insulation is outstanding—it easily keeps my water ice cold for a full day, and I've even had ice left after 24 hours. The 64 oz size is perfect because I'm not constantly refilling it throughout the day. The build quality feels premium. It's durable, the powder-coated finish provides a good grip, and it doesn't sweat. I also really like that it comes with both a straw lid and a spout lid, so I can switch depending on whether I'm at work, traveling, or at the gym. The paracord handle is a nice touch and makes it much easier to carry than I expected. Most importantly, it doesn't leak. I've tossed it in my truck, carried it around the house, and traveled with it without any issues. If I had one suggestion, it would be to make it fit more vehicle cup holders, but that's a tradeoff with any half-gallon bottle. Overall, this is one of the best insulated water bottles I've owned. If you're looking for something that keeps water cold for a long time and helps you stay hydrated throughout the day, I highly recommend it.

This insulated water bottle is great! I specifically purchased it for my son to use during his Youth football practice/games. It has proven to be an excellent purchase. While it is a little higher on the purchase price it is definitely worth it. The water bottle is very easy to use and clean. It requires very little maintenance. The 1 gallon capacity has ensured he doesn't run out of water during practice or games. The insulated water bottle keeps the water cold long after he's finished with practice regardless of the 100°F plus, temperature days. The material it is made out of has proven to be very tough and durable while still remaining light weight. It also comes with some very handy accessories such as a heavy duty custom sewn hand carrying strap, straws and straw/water spout cleaning brushes. Just to mention a few. It also comes in several different custom color options. I was forced to purchase the Raymylo 128oz insulated water bottle to quickly replace the first water bottle I purchased (Underarmour) for my son which suddenly and without warning started to profusely leak between the cap and bottle after only a few uses. The RAYMYLO Water bottle I purchased has resulted in an unexpected upgrade that has turned out to be the best replacement I could have asked for. It has proven time and time again that regardless of what activity it's being used in conjunction with, temperature altitude and environment it's subjected to, or position it's stored in it will continue to provide an extremely durable, reliable, leak proof light weight water bottle that keeps its liquid contents cool for long periods of time. I highly recommend it and I will only be purchasing the RAYMYLO brand water bottles in the future!

I’ve accumulated quite a few water bottles over the years, but this RAYMYLO 20 oz insulated bottle has become one of my daily favorites. I’ve been using it regularly, and it has held up extremely well. The powder-coated exterior is durable and still looks great even after several accidental drops. I also really like that it comes with both a comfortable handheld strap and a shoulder strap, making it easy to carry whether I’m running errands, hiking, or just on the go. It keeps my drinks cold for hours, doesn’t leak, and the overall build quality feels solid. If you’re looking for a well-made insulated bottle that’s built for everyday use, I highly recommend this one.

review_title: Easy to clean, versatile water bottle
body_en: These are great bottles at a great price! I usually use a much more expensive water bottle, but needed a backup so I gave this a shot. I'm so glad I did! They don't leak, they look great, they keep my drinks super cold, they seem durable, and they aren't too overpriced so if something happens to it I won't feel like I lost an expensive EDC item, I can just buy another and keep it moving. I love that they have the outside cover and paracord handle too, what a nice touch! They are fairly easy to clean as well, which is one of the most important features for me.

review_title: Great for school! Keeps water cold, doesn’t leak, and is very durable.
body_en: I am very satisfied with this water bottle. I bought it mainly for my daughter to use in her daily life, and it has been an excellent purchase. It keeps water cold for many hours, does not leak, and is very durable for everyday use. In addition, it is easy to clean and has a perfect size to take it anywhere, since it comes with its case and can also be comfortably carried with its strap. The quality is excellent, and I would definitely buy it again. I highly recommend it for both children and adults.

Great water bottle, keeps my water nice and cold, the ice lasts all day. I love the extra's it comes with, a carrying case so I can use the long strap when walking for longer periods or the short strap for carrying short distances. It has 2 different lids for drinking, if you need to hydrate quickly you can use the pouring lid or one with the straw. I prefer drinking with a straw however I do not like the rectangle shape of this lid, that is the only thing I don't like about this water bottle. It also does not fit in my cup holder however it hasn't leaked when it has fallen over in the seat.

My absolute favorite purchase from Amazon this water bottle is amazing and is true to the description. It stays cold for hours even when left in the car in the sun (on accident) it also comes with either the straw or the drinking cap as well as brush to clean both the bottle and straws. Another thing I like about it is the clip and the paracord handle it makes it very easy to carry around. It is Leak-proof but you have to make sure it’s sealed on tightly I learned the hard way lol. Besides that it’s honestly a really solid bottle for the price I’ve had it a few months and use it everyday only thing that I don’t like is the fact it doesn’t fit in a cup holder but what can you expect for that size.

This water bottle is so amazing! It retains ice even in hot weather, which, as I work outside in 100F+ weather, is perfect! The lid has two options, though I prefer the straw option for ease of drinking. The color is a deep black, which I appreciate. The bottle is sturdy, surviving drops and rolls. I did have to add some extra stitching on the cover, as the full weight of the bottle puts strain on the stitching, but overall- an amazing bottle!
Since then we have been drinking more. Suitable for sports and everyday life. Completely satisfied.

body_en: Quality, durability, hardness, practical and all sizes.

Great product. Well insulated. Price is good. Strap and carrying case are great and surprisingly comfortable when adjusted. I bought this in the summer of 2024. The carrying case broke in the summer two years later, but the bottle is still in good condition. I would recommend this for adventures outdoors but expect the straps themselves to be fair to the price. Invest a little more if you want the straps to be more comfortable and durable to carry long distances. The option between a straw and chug cap is brilliant, though keep in mind that the bottle’s large size can make it hard to suck from. I think I got the biggest size at the time because I only wanted to have to fill it up once a day. Turns out that it sometimes can go multiple days without refilling but it is awkward to carry because of its size, so I personally would only usey particular size bottle for hikes with multiple people or long trips in heat (safaris, etc). That being said, I am still using this every day partially filled for work until I get another small bottle. My only suggestion to the manufacturer would be to offer a model with a higher quality strap (fake leather or something of the sort) that will do better in harsh environments.
good product delivered on time to see now in time if the product holds up

review_title: Beautiful color, comfortable handle, and keeps drinks cold!
body_en: I’ve been using this tumbler every day, and I’m really happy with it. The soft pink color is even prettier in person, and the matte finish gives it a premium feel. The handle is comfortable to hold, and it fits in my car’s cup holder, which is a huge plus. It keeps my water cold for hours, and I love the large capacity because I don’t have to refill it constantly throughout the day. The lid feels sturdy, it’s easy to clean, and I haven’t experienced any leaking during normal use. Overall, it’s practical, stylish, and well made. I would definitely purchase another one in a different color.

review_title: ​A gorgeous and highly functional tumbler that everyone in the family loves.
body_en: Design: Beautiful brown leopard tumbler that makes a fantastic birthday gift. ​Performance: Truly leak-proof and effectively keeps drinks both hot and cold. ​Convenience: Fits perfectly in standard cup holders. ​Overall Value: Highly recommended—so impressive that it inspired an additional purchase for myself!

I love this travel mug. I use it all the time for my water. It keeps it cold. It doesn't leak as long as you have the straw part is flipped down completely. It is easy to assemble. Dishwasher safe. The lid can be put on so you can use either right or left hand. This size is great for me. Will probably be buying another one. The straw is great. It comes off and can be put in the dishwasher. The color holds up in the dishwasher. It is portable and stable when sitting it down.

review_title: HydroJug is the best for me!!!
body_en: Good Morning I’m just wanted to reach out to everyone on my new HydroJug. This cup is amazing keeps my ice and water or any drink cold for such a long time. I play tennis in the hottest of times here in Arizona and can even leave in car overnight and the next day still ice and cold water. Also like the fact it fits in my car cup holder. Also if it falls over in your car it WILL not spill. The lid is so easy to twist on and off and great it has great straw that is is easy to keep clean. This won’t be my last.
does not leak, does not dent easily, stays cold for a long time. worth the price 👍

I purchased this as a birthday gift for a friend, and instead of just wrapping it, I filled it with flowers for a fun surprise. She absolutely loved it! It made for such a cute and practical gift that she could continue using long after her birthday. One of the reasons I chose this tumbler is because it's so well-designed for everyday use. The lid and straw help prevent spills, making it perfect for people who take their drinks everywhere they go. Whether it's in the car, at work, or running errands, you don't have to constantly worry about it tipping over and making a mess. The cream color is beautiful, the handle makes it easy to carry, and it feels like a high-quality tumbler. If you're looking for a thoughtful gift, or just a great tumbler for yourself, I'd definitely recommend this one!

review_title: If you're in the market for travel mug, get this one.
body_en: Better than the rest? I'm not sure, but I'm so glad I bought this one. I maintains temperature, is totally leak proof when the straw is down, is super easy to clean (I've just been washing it by hand, but rumor has it it's dishwasher safe), there's no funny taste when drinking from it, it doesn't smell (I'm sensitive to that), and almost everyone who's seen me with it has asked where I got it (aka it's pretty). It's giant, but it's not heavy, and it does actually fit in the cup holder of my car. I like that it closes in such a way that it works whether you want to hold it with your left or right hand (never would have thought of this but now that I have... it matters). It's somehow managed to make me drink way more water and I'm completely stoked about everything related to this travel mug. I can't think of a single reason why you shouldn't get one too.

I love my new HydroJug Traveler 40oz. I drink so much fluid. This holds hot fluid for at least 6 hours or more. It is very solid even with its thinner bottom that works perfect in my car cup holder. I mostly use hot, but I have also used cold. It is a wonderful mug. I was concerned when it fell off my trunk lid today, but it didn't even make a mark. I am VERY happy with my new purchase. No leaking whatsoever. I feel clean about the straw. Everything is good!
This water bottle is great, the best I've had and I've tried every brand. Never leaks, so nice to be able to put it in your bag without worrying if it leaks or not
Received a white colored tumbler, I had ordered a pink colored tumbler. Straw is just a simple straw not an attached straw as shown in the photo. Do not buy it. Waste of money. It's not leakproof.
I liked that the ice lasts 24 hours and meets expectations regarding spills and leaks.
Simply great, the best thermo mug I have ever had in my life. I immediately ordered a larger one and will stay with this brand permanently, simply the best cups😍🙏🏼
This thermos is a 100, the color is spectacular, you don't spill anything! And the drink stays quite cool!

This is a really good water bottle. Fits in the drink holder in my truck and keeps my water cold for what seems forever. I left it out yesterday and overnight and it still had ice. Now I’m in South Louisiana and the ambient temperature yesterday was 97, 102 on the thermometer under the patio. So still having ice this morning was pretty impressive. And it looks good also; I got the yellow/orange. I like the handle and secured screw cap. My wife has a bottle that was 3 times the price and mine is just as good! Many colors available. Feel comfortable ordering this bottle; it’s very good!

I like this thing. It keeps my water cold and, when closed, it stays shut. I'm an idiot sometimes and forget to screw the cap back on before putting it in my bag. That's not an issue with the bottle, though. I'm very happy with it. The 32 oz size is pretty much perfect for what I want out of it. It's big enough to hold a lot of water without needing constant refilling, and it's small enough to keep in my backpack. So, it's easy to lug around. I really like the dual color of it as well. Many people have similar water bottles at my job, but mine is immediately detectable due to the unique color scheme. I've also dropped the sucker a few times. It has left a few tiny scratches, but no dents or dings, so I'm confident in its durability.

Exactly what I was looking for. It fits perfectly into my cup holder in the car. It holds a good amount of water. It doesn’t condensate with ice. It’s the perfect pink color. It doesn’t spill when it’s closed fully. I love it!
Keeps water very cold. Wish the opening was just a little larger.

This has been a life-saving help! Struggling with a new health challenge and having this water bottle in reach is a huge help. Easg tk wash, no loose or awkwarx fitting parts, keeps water ice cold as long as I need. I chose the smaller of the 2 sizes because I have trouble gripping things- especially when full of water. I think my family was relieved when I learned to use the carry-loop after 3 loud drops, steel-on-tile!

I really like this water bottle. It’s the perfect size not too big not too small. And the color is really pretty. It does actually keep my cold water cold unlike another one I had bought. But this one does what it says and it’s real easy to clean it doesn’t have a straw. It’s a big enough nozzle. I would buy another one.
I love this water bottle! It does not drip and keeps my water cold even in the hot car. Love the color!
Great water bottle, the only thing is it leaks from the lid, ugh! Also, too big to fit in cup holder. Otherwise good quality.

review_title: Exactly What I Was Looking For
body_en: This Iron Flask 40oz insulated water bottle was exactly what I was looking for. I work in public safety and am not always near the station to refill my water bottle and wanted something that would allow me a couple refills but keep the water cold until I needed it. This does exactly that. I used a 20oz shaker bottle as a water bottle, so this gives Iron Flask bottle gives me two refills until I need to fill it up again. It is the perfect size to keep on my passenger seat without taking up much room at all. I have not had any issues with the bottle leaking and it is very good quality. the bottle came with three different lids. One is just a standard lid that stays attached to the bottle when unscrewed and is stainless steel. There is a straw lid, with a silicone straw that goes into the bottle and a plastic straw on the plastic lid for drinking. The third is a plastic lid like a standard coffee thermal drinking lid. I have only used the stainless steel lid as I only use this to hold extra water to refill my other water bottle since I add a water flavor to it. All three lids have a handle source for easy carrying of the water bottle. I drop this thing all the time and it still holds up really well. Of course it is going to scratch or dent when you drop it, it isn't a magic water bottle. But it has not affected the lids or seals in any way. I like to put stickers on my metal water bottles anyways, so nothing a fun sticker cant cover up! I do not put hot liquids in this water bottle, so I cannot speak to how well it keeps liquids hot, but it keeps my water nice and cold so I wouldn't have any doubt in its ability to keep liquids warm for as long as it says. I would purchase more of this product in the future if I needed.

review_title: Be careful it will dent!! but overall a great price and great cup overall!
body_en: Great price, keeps it very cold for days!!!, and great size. It might not be your typical brand but it works just as great! Do be careful, although it’s a great cup and keeps everything cold af, it will dent if you don’t take care of it properly or if u drop it really hard. I lost one cup at worked, dented another pretty bad, but 3rd times a charm.

This is the 2nd time purchasing this product. After 2 years I lost the 1st one but can tell you this product is extremely well-made, keeps ice overnight and liquids nice and cold. Never chipped, color never faded, and the cap and straws remained intact. Would recommend to all.

review_title: Still useable after being run over by a tractor.
body_en: I rarely write reviews for any product I purchase. However, I felt obliged to write this review based upon the quality of this bottle. Today, while cutting one of my fields for a new cattle pasture, I noticed that this bottle had fallen off my tractor and had been run over. I assumed the bottle had been destroyed, but after picking it up from the field, I saw that it was only slightly dented. Other than the small dent, the bottle is still completely useable. Again, I ran over this bottle with a mid-sized tractor used for farming. Not many things remain functionable after that, so I am very impressed! I should also note that the bottle keeps ice and liquids cold for a long time, even when outside in the summer heat all day. I will absolutely be purchasing again.

review_title: Keeps ice & water COLD for hours!
body_en: Large container, very nice. Keeps ice & water for hours! Purchased for my husband, he's happy with it. Only downside (for me) is that it's quite heavy.

We love our Iron Flask products. They are sturdy and keep drinks cold for longer than my Stanley. Easy to clean with the right long handled brush or filling with hot soapy water and shaking. Where the straw connects to the lid can start to turn black over time, even with regular, good washing. The 40 ounce does not fit in the cupholder of my 2024 VW Atlas, I blame VW for that for changing the cup holder size between my 2019 and 2024. We used the smaller sizes at our wedding and they were great to keep our beer cold. I have bought for friends and they are obsessed with their tumblers.

The clip handle is perfect, I love the color! It fits in my car cupholder as well, not perfect but it stays standing up! It doesn't spill easily so far in my experience and I've been carrying it everywhere with me. :)
Great water bottle, keeps water cold, doesn’t leak. Overall easy to clean

pot. Stays hot to warm for a very long time. It is also robust and easy to clean. There are three different closures, one is simply a screw cap with a ring that you can attach to the jug so that the lid doesn't fall down or get lost. The other one is a wide, fixed, foldable drinking suction straw, when unfolded it looks a bit like the sippy cups from back then, there is a plastic straw on the bottom that you can replace, which is very easy, a replacement straw is included. It's also tight when folded, nothing leaks, it's been used a few times. The other closure is similar to the lids on these Coffee to Go plastic cups. And also a flap closure that keeps it tight. I've only tried it once so far because I don't like this type of drinking. All in all, I am very happy with the pot and don't regret the purchase.
It holds the temperature very well, the replaceable caps are also very useful and tight
Perfect bottle, iced water 24 hrs...very Top
A great bottle. Very happy with the purchase and service. Thank you
Sturdy and well made. Keeps water amazingly fresh over time. Advise.

review_title: Second Yeti Item and I'm obsessed
body_en: I absolutely love this YETI water bottle! The neon yellow color is incredibly vibrant and stands out in the best way it's. I easy to spot whether I'm at the gym, in the office, or outdoors. Performance-wise, it does exactly what you'd expect from YETI. It keeps my water cold for hours, even on hot days, and I often still have ice left long after filling it. The chug cap is one of my favorite features. As the name suggests, it's perfect for taking big sips without spilling. The mouthpiece feels very similar to drinking from a regular plastic water bottle, which makes it comfortable and natural to use. It's a small detail that makes a big difference, especially if you're constantly reaching for your bottle throughout the day. Overall, this is a high-quality, well-designed bottle that's durable, practical, and looks great. If you're considering it, I highly recommend it!

I've been using this YETI tumbler daily for the past three years, and it's exceeded my expectations. It keeps my coffee hot for several hours during my morning commute and my iced drinks cold well into the afternoon. The stainless steel construction feels extremely durable, and the powder-coated finish still looks new despite regular use. The lid fits securely and is easy to clean. It is a bit more expensive than some alternatives, but the quality and performance make it worth the investment. I would definitely buy another one.

review_title: Great for taking on the go anywhere and everywhere
body_en: Excellent. Great screw on top for easier cleaning and putting ice in it. Stays cold. Doesn't get dented...holds plenty of water. Easy to hold...I can go on and on...bottom line, I just love my bottle and yes, I do recommend!

I couldn’t be happier with my YETI Rambler 36 oz Bottle; it has quickly become my absolute go-to for daily hydration. The vacuum insulation is incredibly effective, keeping my water ice-cold for days even when left in a sweltering hot car. I love the Chug Cap design because it lets me drink quickly without spilling, and the entire lid is genuinely leakproof so I can toss it in my bag without a second thought. Plus, the stainless steel construction feels practically indestructible and handles everyday drops and dings like a champ. It is worth every single penny if you want a reliable, durable bottle that actually delivers on its promises.

review_title: Keeps drinks cold, love that it's totally enclosed
body_en: Love this rambler. It's my favorite Yeti of all those I have. Love that I don't need a straw and it keeps my drink super cold, even in the hot summer temps. I was given a smaller rambler, but knew I had to have a bigger one for my needs! The colors are great too. Very original.
Love my yeti 💞water stays cold for long period of time, temp can hit 100 degrees and the ice wont melt fast at all🙌🏼

Husband loves this item. He is an avid hiker, and this bottle was recommended by another hiker and has met all expectations. Keeps water cold, even on very hot days and easy to carry in backpack. Highly recommend.

First of all, the color is beautiful - perhaps not quite as brilliant as in the photos, but it is delightful. This second one I received was a replacement for the first one that was sent, which seemed to have some damage to the interior lining (presumably a manufacturing flaw). This replacement bottle has a seamless and flawless interior lining, for which I am grateful; however, the outside has a slight dent in it. I'm not sure if that is because of packaging/shipping issues or if it was sent out that way. I do know the bottle was sent in a bag, not a box, so it is very possible there was damage done during shipping. I'm a bit disappointed, but not to the point of returning this one. Still, I think from now on, I will order any YETI item directly from YETI since it will hopefully be packaged better for shipping. As for the product itself, it is a nice size, the handle makes it easy to carry, and I like the chug cap very much. review_title: 26 oz. Encool bottle: Keeps ice water very cold; very well designed. Very happy!
body_en: I purchased this bottle hoping it would keep my water cold throughout each day as we traveled in hot environments in our car. So when I received this bottle, I did a "cold test" in my home. I totally filled the bottle with ice, then finished it off by filling the remaining spaces with water. The ice was still there that night. The next day (Day 2), I checked it in the morning: still a lot of ice. I checked it again that night (still a very large "clump" of ice). The following day (Day 3), I again checked in the morning to find there were still a few little ice cubes still floating in the bottle. WOW! When I will be traveling in a hot environment in our car for an upcoming trip, I expect the bottle to at least keep the ice and water cold throughout each day of travel. I will do the same thing every day of our trip to ensure I have something cold to sip. Good job, Encool! I am very pleased! So pleased that I immediately purchased a 2nd bottle for my husband! It feels like it is made of great quality. The handle is wide enough for my four fingers to grasp. Something I hadn't noticed is that the handle area closest to the bottle lid isn't just a 90-degree angle; it is made with a 45-degree angle at each side so your fingers rest more comfortably when holding the bottle. The lid has both the straw-sip and the chug options, and work great. I turned the full bottle on its side all night and there were no leaks. This may just be the perfect water bottle for us! Update after 1.5 weeks of hot environment travel: These water bottles were the only ones among our group of travelers that kept the water cold, They worked so well, we didn't even have to fill the entire bottle with ice and then fill the remaining spaces with water. Instead, we were able to put about 1/3 of the space as ice, and the rest as water. Still, by the end of the day, ice remained--even after drinking all the water. I ended up leaving the chug and straw features open through the day to try to melt the ice on the first few days before I began changing the ice to water ratio. We love these bottles. They are perfect for us! Also, the "boots" we purchased from Amazon fit perfectly and worked perfectly: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D7D4MYYK?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_fed_asin_title&th=1

review_title: Great overall! Just inspect the quality before use

After one month of use, it has one dent (shown in photo) but that’s from the bottle accidentally being dropped on a concrete floor. Thankfully it doesn’t affect how it sits or anything. This thing is still very durable without being heavy. The only issue I’d bring up (shown in photo) is that the plastic of the drinking spout is kind of rough on the edges of the hole. It almost cut my lip the first time I used this (I wasn’t very careful inspecting it the first time I used it), and I have to pull off tiny flecks of plastic from it once in a while to make sure I’m not drinking any of the flecks. Really not ideal, but I prefer a plastic spout to a rubber one that could break. Even so, I figured it was worth mentioning, especially since a water bottle this size is often purchased for kids to use. (Also! Be sure the drinking spout is empty before you close it; if you don’t, the spout will leak a tiny bit of water when moved.) Having said all this, I still really like this water bottle. I wanted something small but durable for travel that kept cold water cold, in a bottle without a lot of loud branding on it. This one is super sturdy, with amazing insulation, in a convenient size, and in a really lovely neutral color! Recommended, if you can look past the rough plastic bit. Be sure to inspect it before using it!

review_title: Falls short to Yeti but still nice!
body_en: I wanted this Stanley to be my reason to turn away from Yeti. I love the modern design, the all black, the non-fixed handle that can be tightened to be more fixed/harder to move, and the 50 oz capacity. It was nice to see that the bottle had 4 extra oz of capacity at the same price as Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. I need to drink lots of water throughout the day and the large capacity is awesome. The lightness was originally a selling point for me; while it can hold an astonishingly large 50 oz, since the bottle is relatively light in weight, it doesn’t feel too heavy to carry a full bottle around. However, where it excels in lightness it falls short in quality. It is glaringly lower quality than Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. This Stanley has thinner metal leading to poorer insulation. What frustrated me the most was realizing how much thinner the coating was compared to Yeti; I accidentally dinged it with a fork while heating up my lunch and chipped it! I’ve dropped my Yetis dozens of times and hit them with everything from forks and knives to granite countertops and haven’t had an issue with them chipping under light use. I even noticed it will take on light scratches from the plastic buckles on my lunch box if I let them touch while in my bag. Seriously poor coating. However, getting back to the pros, the leak resistance is great and when properly closed you can rest assured you won’t have spillage or leakage. Also the straw on this bottle is much nicer than the straws on Yeti bottles; less resistance and simply easier to sip. In the end, it’s a great water bottle that has a cool modern look and a huge capacity. Overall this comes in at 4/5 stars with only one star being lost to the thinner metal and thinner coating. I would still suggest getting the Yeti 46 oz instead for the thicker metal and coating as it will likely last longer and endure more.

The Rose Quartz color is accurate to photos — a soft, muted dusty pink. Not hot pink, not beige. Genuinely pretty. Worth the money if you actually use a tumbler daily. review_title: Great Bottle with Minor Design Flaws - 4/5 Stars
body_en: I've been using the WATERSY 1 gallon insulated bottle for about six months, and it's held up remarkably well. Build Quality & Durability: This bottle is built like a tank. I've dropped it multiple times, including on the cap, and nothing has broken or cracked. The handle is solid and shows no signs of wear even with daily use. The insulation works excellently - it keeps water cold for the advertised 48 hours, which is perfect for long hikes or all-day events. Ease of Use: The wide mouth opening makes filling, emptying, and cleaning incredibly easy. You can fit your entire hand inside for thorough cleaning, and ice cubes go in without any hassle. No concerns about mold or buildup in hard-to-reach areas. The Drinking Challenge: Here's where it gets tricky - tilting a full gallon of liquid to drink from the mouth can feel heavy and awkward. The air displacement while drinking creates a loud gurgling sound that can be disruptive in quiet settings like offices or meetings. A metal straw option would solve both issues and make this bottle perfect. The Bottom Plate Problem: The rubber on the bottom sits slightly higher than the metal rim, which creates two annoying issues. When you set it down on hard surfaces, it makes a bell-like ringing sound. Worse, the exposed metal rim will scratch tables, desks, and countertops because the bottle is so heavy. I've had to start using a placemat to protect my furniture. Bottom Line: Despite the drinking awkwardness and bottom plate design flaw, this is still an excellent water bottle for anyone who needs serious hydration capacity and temperature retention. Just be prepared to use a coaster and maybe invest in a separate metal straw. The durability and insulation quality make it worth the minor inconveniences.
