review_title: Functions well, stays cold, very easy to clean
body_en: Functionality is really good. It’s solid. I like the two handles, and how the side handles fold in. It’s very easy to clean because I can get my big oven kit of a hand in the bottle. I like how it has a wide lid The complaint is that it does not stay cold for long. It’s not insulated very well. I have to add a lot of ice to keep it cold. Overall it’s decent. Best one I’ve had in a while. Just wish it would stay cold longer. Edit: I recently changed my review as the company reached out and felt that the one I received may have been malfunctioning. Now with new bottle it seems to hold the temp longer. I really really like this as it’s not a massive bottle, easy to carry, and very easy to clean.

review_title: Unique dual handles and perfect for tracking my water at work
body_en: I bought this sixty four ounce bottle to bring to work so I can track exactly how much water I am drinking throughout the day. I work indoors and having this huge capacity helps me hit my daily hydration goals without making constant trips to refill it. I am personally not a straw person so I just took the straw attachment off right away and it still functions perfectly without it. I make sure to wash the bottle out with regular dish soap and dry it completely after every single use and so far I have not seen any signs of rust or corrosion on the stainless steel interior. It seals up really tight and I have had absolutely no issues with leaking unless I accidentally overfill the water past the threading on the lid. The most impressive part of the design has to be the dual handles. Having a solid handle on the side plus another sturdy one on the top makes lugging a half gallon jug around incredibly easy. It has a very unique look and I actually get a lot of compliments on it from my coworkers. It keeps my drinks ice cold all day long and every time I take a sip I just think to myself now that is some high quality H2O. If you need a massive bottle that is actually built well and easy to carry around this is definitely the one to get.

really keeps the water cold for so long and ever since I got this, I have been drinking more water than ever. Making my goal for hydration a lot easier. Color is pretty and i think it’s worth the price bc it’s so convenient. There’s a straw, but there’s also a feature where I can pour without having to change lids all the time. The handle is sturdy for carrying it around during my walks

review_title: Almost PERFECT - Spout Orientation not ideal
body_en: Here's my updated review: Meoky customer service reached out to me and went to extraordinary measures to address my concerns. While they can't fix the orientation of the spout, they absolutely made things right! So here's what I would say - if you're considering buying one of these bottles, understand that it is very likely that the spout orientation will not be as shown in the pictures. That being said, the bottle is still functional and it keeps ice COLD. I filled it with ice on a Sunday and there was still ice in the jug on Thursday! And you can have absolute confidence that the customer service is top notch! I'm not sure I can give this a full 5-stars because of the spout orientation difference compared to the product photos, but if I could, I would definitely give a 4.5 stars! __________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Original Review: I love everything about this EXCEPT that the lid is not oriented how the pictures and videos show. I’m not sure of this is a one-off mistake on the item we received or if they’re all like that. Here’s why it’s important - the spout should be opposite the handles so that you can grip the handles in one hand and pour into a cup or bottle that you’re holding with the other. Also, that is the orientation needed to actually use the really cool feature of having flat molded spots to position the jug on a flat surface and pour without it rolling. With the inner lid being oriented 90 degrees in the wrong direction, the only options for screwing the lid on result in the pour spout being on the wrong position to use this, which means you have to use both hands to pour and it will not out if laid down on a picnic table or other flat surface. Other than that it kept ice frozen for 96+ hrs but the spout location is a deal breaker. Trying to decide if we should order another one to see if it’s a single mistake or just order a different brand.

review_title: Fantastic design kept my ice for 36hrs
body_en: Revised Review: 5 Stars My first bottle had a flaw in it, and the insulation did not keep things cold for more than 7 hours. The company contacted me and asked to send me a replacement without my asking them to do so. I am pleased to report that the replacement bottle kept my ice for 36hrs which is fantastic for an insulated bottle of this size. The handles are sturdy and offer easy ways to handle the jug for drinking through the well-designed cap or sturdy built-in straw. This is the best of all the large insulated water jugs I have tried, and I highly recommend it. Past Review: 3-Stars If this had better quality insulation and kept the ice for more than 7 hours, I would give it five stars. I have other insulated jugs that literally keep my ice as ice for days without melting all the way. Purchased for its wide mouth feature to more easily capture ice from machines.

This is great. My husband said it had ice in it.Even after a full day and overnight in a truck in our metal building. It isn't the most convenient to drink out of but it is good as a cooler Type item or something to use to pour.

review_title: Triple Insulated Tank built to last with features galore
body_en: I was excited to get this large-scale insulation bottle and it didn't let me know down. The Material was solid quality and sturdy, well designed and functioned as expected. We initially tested it with "ice" packed to the brim and checked it 36 hours later, with very little melt at all. We then tried hot tea and it last 24 hours fine. Later we took it on a camping trip to test its useability. I appreciated the dual handle system so we could hang/hold the bottle from different angles without any leaking (I preferred the vertical handle grip because of its ability to hang on hooks or branches, my wife seemed to enjoy the sturdier grip of the horizontal hold). We also both liked the smaller touches: a. multifunctional lid which allowed both a twist on cap and a flip-up spout. b. flat ridges on side allowing the bottle to rested on its side without rolling c. Contouring on the shell for easier gripping Overall. a great buy that met and exceeded our expectations.

review_title: Starts off excellent, then deteriorates, loses insulation, and NO support from MEOKY company
body_en: I really like this! I pored over so many listings to find a product that had everything I wanted: steel construction, a top handle, a pair of folding side grip handles, a combination stray and spout opening, no-drip, and insulated. This has it all. It's honestly a beast of a jug, which is perfect for the gym. My only critique would be the insulation: it's adequate but not spectacular. If I fill the jug with cold water and a handful of ice today, then by tomorrow when I wake up the ice will be melted and the water more tepid than cold. But for same-day use, it'll keep your drinks cold without problem! Edit: All of the above is accurate...UNTIL you wash it. I ran it through a dishwasher on low heat with no heat dry, but even that seems to have destroyed its internal insulation. Less than a year old, and not only does it fail to keep anything cold anymore, it seems to actually accelerate warming! If I fill this with one-third ice before adding water, it now remains cold until early afternoon, by which time the ice has melted and the water is tepid, if not room temperature. That's when you discover that the company, MEOKY, offers no support whatsoever. Their website claims 24/7 support, but they do not respond to repeated emails. They promote a Facebook support page, which has many customer inquiries for years, with not one single response from the company to ANY of them. They have an Instagram, where they did reply to me to reaffirm that they have product support, and then not one single response since then, contradicting that pledge. This is exactly the design I want in a water bottle, but I won't buy from this company again because they haven't earned my loyalty. There are identical clones of this bottle, and I'll buy those instead as a replacement.
Excellent I like its performance I take it to work

review_title: Excellent Insulated Water Bottle, but Check the Size for Cup Holders
body_en: The CamelBak Chute Mag Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle has been a great everyday water bottle. It holds a generous amount of water, making it easy to stay hydrated throughout the day without constantly needing refills. Despite its larger capacity, it fits in my backpack without any issues and is easy to carry wherever I go. The stainless steel construction feels durable, and the bottle is simple to clean thanks to its wide opening. The magnetic cap is also a nice feature, keeping the cap out of the way while drinking and providing a secure, leak-resistant seal when closed. The vacuum insulation performs very well. It keeps cold drinks cold for a long time and does an equally good job of maintaining the temperature of hot beverages. Whether I'm carrying ice water or coffee, it does an excellent job of retaining the temperature. The only downside is the size. If you plan to use this bottle in your vehicle, be aware that it will not fit in the cup holders of most cars. That isn't a dealbreaker for me since I usually carry it in my backpack, but it's something to consider before purchasing. Well-made, durable insulated water bottle that performs exactly as expected. If cup holder compatibility isn't a priority, it's an excellent choice for everyday use, travel, work, or outdoor activities.

This bottle is awesome, full stop. The build is solid and looks good, this bottle keeps the temperature of my drinks for hours. I saw a review that said that it leaks if you shake it but I think that person didn't snug the lid and cap sufficiently. I was determined to get it to leak, I filled it up with water, and I put it in my pannier, on the rear rack of my ebike and drove almost 20 miles on trails and single track, and, not a drop leaked, and I even put it in my pannier upside down. All in all, I'd give it 5 stars, and I love the captive cap !! Nice touch with the magnet too, it keeps the cap stowed while you drink.

This bottle is excellent. The vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for hours and the stainless steel build feels durable and premium. It’s easy to carry, doesn’t leak, and the design makes it perfect for everyday use or outdoor activities. A reliable, high quality bottle that delivers exactly what you’d expect.

review_title: Sturdy, durable, holds temperature well, and easy to drink from
body_en: I have a larger Camelbak insulated stainless steel water bottle, but wanted a smaller one for my daily walks. It's perfect. The handle on the lid makes it easy to carry when I'm out walking, and the smaller size means I'm carrying less weight. I chose the stainless steel bottle over plastic to cut down on consumption of microplastics and PFAs. (The lid is still plastic, but overall, there's less plastic.) The stainless steel has the added benefit of not picking up odors or emitting that plastic-y smell that some water bottles have. And the double-wall construction keeps my drink cool for a surprisingly long time, even in a hot car. The lid design is great for drinking on the go; the spout is wide enough to get a good gulp of water without spilling the whole thing when you're on the move. The magnet holds the spout's lid in place when you want to leave it open -- while you're driving, for instance. And I have never had any problem with leakage when the lid and the spout cover are both screwed on properly. Judging by my larger bottle, which I have had for a year, the stainless Camelbaks are quite durable. Even the enamel(?) finish is pretty durable. I have dropped my bigger one several times, and it still shows only minor scratches and a barely-visible, tiny dent. Cleaning is easy -- much easier than the Camelbaks with a straw. The bottle has a wide mouth, so it's easy to get a bottle brush inside. The lid requires a smaller brush to get into the crevices, but it's not difficult. (Not like cleaning the straw and bite spout on the straw models!) I've had Camelbaks for years, beginning with the straw-and-bite-spout, plastic bottle models. These stainless ones are my favorites. I rarely go out without it.

CamelBak Chute Mag 40oz Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle in Black has truly impressed me as an outdoor enthusiast and as someone who places a premium on being hydrated while on the run. This water bottle has effortlessly become my constant companion, guaranteeing that no matter where my travels take me, I will always have access to a refreshing drink. The CamelBak Chute Mag's sophisticated simplicity immediately drew my attention. The sleek, black stainless steel exterior makes a bold statement in any environment. The matte finish gives it a subtle sophistication and provides a secure grip, both of which are essential for use in the great outdoors. The bottle's shape is ideal; I can carry it with one hand and store it in a discrete location in my backpack. Whether I'm out on a mountain trail or running errands in town, my CamelBak Chute Mag is never far from my side. This water bottle's magnetic grip is one of its most distinctive features. The powerful magnet built into the cap keeps it firmly in place so you never have to use one hand to hold the cap while using the other to sip. This seemingly trivial but brilliant design feature has revolutionized the ease with which I can keep myself hydrated on the go. Not only is it easy to fill and clean thanks to the large mouth of the cap, but the rounded sides also make it comfortable to drink from. The leak-proof construction of the cap has saved me from a number of potential mishaps in my bag and vehicle. The CamelBak Chute Mag's superior insulating properties set it apart from the rest of the pack. The stainless steel body of this water bottle is vacuum insulated, so even in the hottest weather, your drink will stay ice cold for hours. Recently, I went on a hike in the heat and was blown away by how cool my water stayed for about twenty-four hours. I did the same thing on a frigid morning with some hot beverages, and they kept nice and toasty all day. This revolutionary ability to maintain temperature means that I can always enjoy my chosen beverage at the perfect degree. The CamelBak Chute Mag meets the high standards of durability expected of outdoor equipment. This water bottle is made from durable 18/8 stainless steel, so it can survive the abuse of camping trips. It has been accidentally dropped onto rough ground and brushed up against rough surfaces without suffering any damage. The powder coating not only adds to the bottle's aesthetically pleasing design but also serves as an additional barrier against wear and tear. The CamelBak Chute Mag is notable for being environmentally friendly. This water bottle is made of stainless steel, making it a more eco-friendly option than disposable plastic bottles. By choosing a reusable bottle instead of a disposable one, I've helped curb wasteful single-use plastic bottle use. The high quality of the bottle's construction ensures that it will meet my hydration demands and my ethical obligations to the planet for many years to come. Last but not least, the CamelBak Chute Mag 40oz Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle in Black has become an indispensible accessory for my vigorous daily routine. I was not expecting it to be as stylish or as well insulated or as long lasting or as committed to sustainability as this product is. This water bottle has never failed to provide me with the promised refreshment, convenience, and style, whether I'm climbing summits, riding through trails, or simply navigating the demands of daily life. The CamelBak Chute Mag is, without a shadow of a doubt, one of the best accessories I've ever purchased.

review_title: Very small, keeps things cold/hot for a long time, not the best lid/cap.
body_en: This is a nice bottle. I bought it to see if it would work as a replacement for my much bigger 64 Oz water bottle. It did not. I drink way too much water for this size to do anything for me, so I stopped using it 90% of the time. That said, it does function rather well and did keep my water ice cold longer than needed, so it is a good water bottle with a good seal and I didn't notice any metallic taste, but as I said I am used to my 64 Oz insulated bottle so I never minded any taste if there were one. The lid for this is not the best. If you're just doing water then it's not a huge deal, but if you're doing anything else, like coffee or hot chocolate, then you're going to need to scrub the whole thing out thoroughly after use which is mildly annoying. Cleaning aside I just don't like the cap for this bottle. It feels cheap and like it could break any any time. The odd hinge design is not satisfying to use because you can't absentmindedly flip it open. You have to consciously pull it up and out at the right angle in line with the strange sideways angled accordion mechanism. Overall, not terrible and it works well as a liquid storage device. But once you're used to a 64 Oz bottle these tiny bottles get emptied after one and a half sips. Also, I would definitely change the lid/cap for anything else because the stock one is bad.

review_title: Now part of my standard travel kit
body_en: CamelBak makes some of the best water bottles on the market, and this one is no different. Sturdy construction and an intelligent design make it easy to use, transport and fill. In my experience, it's absolutely leak-proof. The magnetic top kept water from leaking even when I forgot to screw it closed and it was knocked over. That was a wonderful surprise, especially as it was full at the time. The handle on the lid is perfect for attaching to my pack or sling with a simple velcro strap, making it uniquely versatile. It comes in a wide variety of colors and sizes and truly offers something for everyone.

I have the plastic version of this bottle, and this insulated stainless version is very similar. The screw top is the same (tight seal and no leaking), and the spout is easy to drink from. This bottle is heavier than the plastic bottle, but when I add some ice cubes it keeps my water cold all day. Totally worth carrying the extra weight! It's a little taller than the plastic version but still fits in my car cup holder. I chose a dark blue color and it looks great!

review_title: Brilliant bottle that keeps water ice cold for hours, outperforms most others!
body_en: This has become my favourite water bottle by far. It’s solid, well built and the magnetic cap design makes it incredibly easy to use day to day. I’ve got quite a few bottles at this point but this one stands out, I even did a fair bit of research before buying and it outperformed most of the competition, apart from maybe Yeti (though that one’s a lot bulkier). I’ve taken this on holiday and left it out in the sun to the point that the outside was too hot to touch, but the water inside was still ice cold. The wide mouth makes it easy to clean or put ice in when needed, and there's no odd taste from the plastic lid either. It’s properly leakproof and durable, and I’ve recommended it to a few people already. Unfortunately, CamelBak seem to have changed the design recently and the newer version doesn’t perform quite as well. Real shame, as the original was spot on. If you can still find this older version, it’s an easy recommendation.
Keeps the drinks cold for a very long time, is extremely stable and even after several uses the bottle is still like new, it stays tight even if there are carbonated drinks inside.

This bottle is very good but this model is too big and heavy for everyday use. Does not fit standard car holders, backpack sides, etc. For everyday use, a slightly smaller model is better. If the goal is just to carry a lot of water in specific situations, it's worth it.

I tried a lot of drinking and/or insulated bottles - there was always something: leaking, poor insulating properties, bulky, heavy, metallic aftertaste, difficult to clean, not a visual highlight, lid in the way when drinking or no lid lock (dropping/losing), etc. Not so with the Camelbak Chute Mag 600 ml Vacuum in black. It is absolutely sealed. In all situations. Also carbonated (no explosion). The small lid can only be attached loosely, for example when you are sitting at your place. The small lid is then closed for transport - and is completely sealed. The magnetic function keeps the opened lid out of your face and on the opposite side. The lid cannot be lost because it is connected. The wide neck opening, i.e. at the top of the bottle neck where the lid construction is screwed on, allows for convenient filling or the insertion of ice cubes - and of course easy cleaning. Tasteless lid, seals and bottle body. No aftertaste. Nothing. Zero. The dimensions fit into all side pockets, backpack pockets and accessory pockets found at home. Only the carrying handle can cause problems, depending on the construction of the bag and if the bag completely encloses the bottle. The black, continuous powder coating (unlike the previous model) gives it an elegant look. A real eye-catcher, as the lid also looks elegant and has a good feel. No painting errors, and on my bottle no bright spots from underused paint. According to the print on the bottom of the bottle, the cap and vessel are dishwasher safe (see photo). All of my drinking bottles are cleaned by hand. I therefore cannot comment on this point. But the design allows for easy disassembly and assembly into the two parts lid and container and easy cleaning. My drinking bottle is only filled with cold water - carbonated and non-carbonated. The insulation performance should be longer for cold drinks than for hot drinks. I can only speak for cold drinks and the bottle shines here too. And all this without exchanging temperature with the outer bottle shell. No sweating on the outside, no heat transport inside (during the period of a “normal” empty drink). The search is over. I hope the bottle continues to maintain its standard, because it is not cheap, even if, like so many things, it is unfortunately made in China. But it's worth the price. At least so far - and if not, the rating will be adjusted. 5 stars because nothing more is possible. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

If you are looking for a bottle that does not leak water, maintains the temperature without problems, is of very good quality, can be put in the dishwasher and does not have a metal mouth, do not hesitate. I have been using it daily for several months and it is like new. The exterior has suffered several collisions with metal objects and does not have a single scratch. The plastic of the cap is very good and does not take on any smell or taste. The magnetic part is super useful. After trying several brands I would not hesitate to repeat with this one.

The color is exactly as pictured. Keeps my water cold all day and the perfect size for all day use. Very durable and sleek looking. I wish the handle was the same material as the rest of the bottle but it’s not a big deal. Especially considering the price is more reasonable than most nicer water bottles! Highly recommend!

Just replaced my Rocky Mountain Tumbler with Stanley 30oz. I had to return the Stanley as all the hype said it kept drinks cold 9 plus hours, not, in a few it was lukewarm. Now the Simple Modern 40oz tumbler, has kept not only it cold, there is still ice left after 24 hrs. I would highly recommend this product love, the straws, the handle makes it easy to hold, love it, plus they come in over 20 colors.

Keeps my water ice-cold all day long! The handle is super comfortable to hold, and it fits perfectly in my car cup holder. No leaks and it looks great. 10/10 recommend! Definitely better and colder than Stanley

I've waited awhile before I wrote a review because I wanted to see how it held up. I've used this tumbler for over 2 months now without any problems. It isn't as tall as most 30 oz. tumblers, so when it's in the car cup holder it isn't blocking any of the controls knobs. I like that the lid screws on and the the only way it can leak is thru the straw. It keeps ice all day long. I didn't buy this for hot drinks so I can't give a honest review on how long drinks will stay hot. The 3 things I was looking for height, handle and how long ice will last and I'm happy with those 3 things. I bought this color of cup because it was a good deal. I hope they get in a better selection of colors now that I know how well I like this tumbler.

Let me start off by saying that I'm not an influencer, nor have I received anything in return for this honest review. I also gave this tumbler a solid month of daily use before I put in my 2 cents. Also, the pictures were taken in broad daylight. The picture of me holding it upside down is the only time it leaked, but, ya know, I'm holding it full of water, upside down, and even then, only a tiny bit escaped. Through the straw, not the lid, mind you. When the straw was removed and I held it upside down, droplets escaped, one by one. I didn't purchase this for any other reason than to reduce my beverage goblin tendencies, and to support my laziness in regards to washing excess dishes. I bought this because I was tired of having a car cup and a house cup. My house cup is my favorite, it also holds 40 oz, but doesn't fit any cup holder because it's essentially a tank (I copped it on clearance at Walmart 2 years ago for like, $6, and it's the tits). HOWEVER, it really sucks to not be able to take it everywhere, and it's definitely not spill proof. So I had that tank for the house, and my 8 year old 30 oz Yeti for the vehicle, since it fits. I've never used a Stanley so I cannot compare, though I do own the Simple Modern 64oz summit, had it for years, and it's stood the test of time and regular use, both outdoor and indoor. But it's not practical because, although it's very well made, it's massive, heavy, handle-less, and rolls out of the passenger seat onto the floor and out of reach, leaving me parched and annoyed. This tumbler is well-made, from the unit itself to the lid and straw, and the price point is beyond reasonable. I'd have paid $40 for it because of how well it's preformed. The handle is sturdy and comfortable, and it supports the full weight of 40 oz of ice water easily. I've dropped it several times and the powder coating hasn't chipped, nor has the metal dinged. Although most wouldn't think if it, it is SO nice to decide where I want the straw to be in regards to where and how I'm sitting and what hand I'm reaching for it with. It washes up easily. It's not obnoxiously large and it's overall appearance is low-key. It keeps my tea cold and fresh for 2 days indoors. I've left it filled with ice water in my vehicle for 2 days (in early June in the south, mind you). I got super thirsty after a grocery run and took a sip. It was room temperature, if not a skosh cool, but in no way was it warm, even though the cup itself was. It's fallen out of a backseat cup holder and laid on the floor for well over an hour without my knowledge, and although a few drops escaped from the straw, the carpet of my vehicle was dry, and the tumbler was still full of ice water. And, ya know, it keeps you hydrated because you can always keep that thang on you. I ordered the almond color. It's really more of a very light beige. Or coffee that's mostly creamer. A lot lighter than you'd think. It's definitely that boring popular aesthetic hue that everyone's so into, so if that's what you're going for, it's spot on. All in all, I really really REALLY like this tumbler and I'd definitely recommend it. Then again, Simple Modern products haven't ever really let me down, so it's not a huge shocker.

review_title: Love this sleek modern soothing water bottle!
body_en: Received my new bottle today and I love it! It’s sleek, lightweight, easy to carry, pretty and keep my water ice cold! Can’t wait to place it in my Tesla cup holder. It has a long thin bottoms so it should fit in any cup holder snugly! I think it’s fantastic! Will write another update if things change. Great deal on Amazon prime right now! So give it a try!

I wanted something to take my smoothies to work that would include a straw, but also not have a zillion little crevices to clean up around the lid and straw each night. This has fit the bill perfectly. It's a good size, not excessively priced, and has help up well overall to daily use. I do see a bit of wear in the straw, but again, this is over three months of almost daily use. It keeps my smoothie cold all morning and I've gotten several complements on it. It's not going to be fully waterproof, but I think that's obvious from the construction. The lid seals well, however, and I am happy with my purchase.
Love this tumbler and the color! Does not leak. Keeps drinks cold for at least 24 hours.
Excellent, it looks very cute and keeps cold for a long time
We have 2 integrated straws. Keeps water cold for hours and doesn't leak
There are no spills on this when tilted side ways. Color is nice and keep my water chilled for a long time.
The thermos is incredible and of excellent quality

review_title: Good quality simple design tumbler that keeps water cold for days!
body_en: All i can say is WOW WOW WOW! my water stays cold for days, there is still ice 24 hours later! and i love the simple design, leak proof, and color, easy to clean and easy to hold, does not slip on table. I made some research on which tumbler to get for cold water duration and i decided on simple modern.

Good value for the money, stays relatively cool I would say this is an acceptable small water bottle for the gym or similar Not enough water for all day use Appearance is good, very portable, good color and material, overall quality

review_title: Does exactly what you need it to do
body_en: Does everything you need it to do. I've had this for some time now and don't have anything bad to say about it. It's keeps everything cold for over a day, it doesn't leak, it has a carry handle, it's got a nice mouth spout. Grab yourself one.
Great water bottle for the cheap price. Huge size, keeps ice all day when working outside. Doesn’t leak and durable
keeps temperatures overnight very well: hot or cold. bottle is goof quality and extra spout/cover is a plus. would buy again
Very nice water bottle. Solid built of stainless steel materia. Keeps water cold as described. Easy to carry and not too heavy.
I love this thing! It's a good size and the opening is large enough to add ice cubes. It keeps my water cold for two days!

Finally! A water bottle wtih a clear mouthpiece. So much easier to keep clean. And performance wise, it doesn't get any better than these. Keeps water nice and cold even in 100 degree heat. I have two and I love them. Wish I could order replacement lids though.
Great for the price. Got it as a gift for my brother and he loves it. Kept his drink cold all day.

Great water bottle! Keeps drinks cold for hours, and the insulation really works. I like that it comes with both a straw lid and a spout lid — super convenient for different situations. It feels sturdy, doesn’t leak, and is perfect for the gym or on the go. Clean design too. Definitely worth it 👍
Bought these for my laser business. They're great quality and come out nice n clean on my laser.

I bought a set of 4 and I only received 2 bottles with 2 place settings, is this normal? The product seems perfect, good quality, I have to return my order to recommend a set of 4. Hoping to receive 4 bottles with cutlery. I wonder if the set includes 2 bottles and 2 cutlery! I will change my rating after receiving an explanation for my order.
Good bottle that keeps cold, carries well with the handle, good size that holds a lot... but doesn't fit anywhere in any cup holder...
insulated, good size, good price. the size is perfect for my workout. the water also stays warm throughout the night.

review_title: Built Like a Tank, Looks Even Better!
body_en: I’ve gone through a lot of water bottles over the years, and this one from CamelBak is hands-down one of the best I’ve owned. First off, the build quality is unreal—this thing feels solid, durable, and ready to take a beating. Whether it’s riding around in the truck, getting knocked over, or going with me on long days, it holds up without a problem. The insulation is legit too. Keeps my water cold for hours, even sitting out, which is huge for me. No weird taste, no sweating on the outside—just does exactly what you want it to do. No joke I've left ice in this thing and left it at work came back the next day still with ice in it. The handle is a game changer. Makes it easy to carry around without worrying about dropping it, and it feels sturdy, not flimsy like some other bottles. The lid seals tight, no leaks at all, and it’s easy to open and close without fighting it. And honestly, the look? Clean. Simple. That matte green finish looks great and doesn’t feel cheap at all. If you want a bottle that’s reliable, tough, and actually looks good doing it—this is it. Worth every penny.

review_title: Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black, Secure Leak Resistant Lid. Holds Ice for Many Hours. Nice!
body_en: CamelBak Thrive Chug Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black - CamelBak I purchased this forty-ounce insulated stainless steel water bottle to keep cold water handy during long days out without needing constant refills. Pulling it out of the thin paper shipping bag, the matte black powder-coat finish gives it a sleek look, and the integrated rubber bumper on the bottom keeps it firmly grounded. Filling it up with cold tap water and a few ice cubes is easy thanks to the wide neck opening. The double-wall vacuum insulation does a fantastic job holding temperature. I filled it up in the morning, and the water stayed ice-cold all day long without sweating on the outside or leaving wet rings on my wooden desk. Even the next day, both the ice and water were still in the bottle. The chug-style spout cap unscrews smoothly and tethered out of the way, making it easy to take quick, large gulps without fighting a narrow straw or a clunky latch. Carrying forty ounces of liquid has some weight, but the soft-grip handle built into the lid makes it comfortable to haul around. The screw-on lid seals down tight against the mouth rim, so I can toss it onto the passenger seat of my car without worrying about slow leaks dripping onto the upholstery. The silicone boot on the base is a great touch—it dampens noise whenever I set it down on a hard countertop and protects the steel bottom from getting dented if it takes a hard knock. Paying around thirty-eight dollars for a solid daily water bottle feels reasonable given the heavy stainless steel construction and reliable thermal performance. Running the whole assembly through the dishwasher after a long day makes cleanup completely effortless without ruining the outer finish. The forty-ounce body is definitely on the bulkier side, so it won't fit into standard automotive cup holders, but the extra capacity is worth the trade-off. It holds plenty of water to get through an entire afternoon without stopping for top-offs. Pros: ✅ Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold all day without sweating ✅ Rubber bumper base prevents clanking and protects against bottom dents ✅ High-flow chug spout makes drinking fast and mess-free ✅ Built-in carry handle feels sturdy and comfortable in hand ✅ A reasonable value Cons: ❌ Large 40-ounce diameter is too wide to fit standard car cup holders ❌ Metal exterior can dent if roughly handled ❌ Tall thin profile reduces stability and can lead to tips/spills -- keep it closed and away from electronics

I've been using this bottle daily for a few months, and it still doesn't leak! I prefer to chug rather than use a straw and this bottle has a great top for chugging. It keeps my water cold for a long time and is very easy to carry and clean. I like that it has a rubber bottom and is very quiet when placed on a hard surface. I would definitely recommend and would buy again.

review_title: Everything you need in a water bottle
body_en: Just received my new water bottle and it's fantastic! * Keeps water cold, even after many hours * Is lighter in weight than my previous stainless steel water bottle, not sure how that's possible at the same size * Love that the cap snaps open and stays open after unscrewing it * Nice features: silicone mouthpiece, rubberized bottom built in, comfy silicone carrying handle * Beautiful color

Nice and cute water bottle, as well love its soft color. Not heavy. Has soft silicone bottom pad, carry on handle and silicone bottle neck. Leakproof - checked. Overall liked this bottle and would recommend it for purchase. Did not expect and was a bit surprised. Just be ready if you choose this item:: 1) I expected 32oz to be smaller, than actual size turned out similar to 50oz bottle. I believe it explains by insulated body. 2) Weld seam is inside that may rust over time.

Love this bottle! It keeps drinks cold for a long time, doesn't leak, and is easy to carry. The chug lid provides great water flow, making it perfect for workouts, hiking, or everyday use. The Sky Blue color is beautiful, and the quality is exactly what I expect from CamelBak. My only complaint is the shipping time. It took a full 25 days to arrive, which was much longer than expected. Other than that, the product itself is excellent.

So happy! I wanted a chug top that was able to be opened with one hand, not black so I could see when gross things started growing on it, and bonus this isn’t plastic (it’s silicone.) I’m surprised by some features I wasn’t looking for. The base isn’t metal so it’s not making a sound when I put it down on a counter, or sliding around. The top has a gentle pop to it so when opened it fully opens getting out of the way. It fits in my car cup holder, which is a must for me. And has a nice capacity. I don’t drink cold liquids, so can’t comment on the insulation. And I rarely open the whole lid since I don’t add ice, but it’s great access for cleaning. I love the blue color, and love that the lid is blue too. No hiding any grime! At first the spout seemed too small to me (smaller than what I’m used to) but it actually works quite well, and is growing on me. All around fantastic water bottle! It’s taken me so long to find the right one. It’s clear CamelBak has taken user feedback to up their game here.
High quality and great value. Keeps water cold. Easy to open and close. Does not leak. No straw needed.
ótima qualidade
This brand of bottles looks very durable and keeps the cold very well.

review_title: Can’t fault it. The last water bottle you’ll ever buy.
body_en: Well worth the cost, this is a quality item that’s going to last for years. Pleasant tactile experience, leakproof, perfect size for a 1 hour workout. The handle is useful, the spout feels nice to drink from, and there is no germy internal straw to get lost in the dishwasher! The insulation is terrific too. I pour in a hydration tablet and cold filtered water from the fridge when I pack my gym bag. Hours later when I use it, it’s still refreshing and cool throughout the session. Cannot fault. I have had so many different flasks and bottles over the years, but this one ticks every box. Delivery cost/time from the US stock was pretty quick too, only a few days in my case.

be warned the bottles are not remotely the same colour as advertised, i was expecting a dark moss green professional looking bottle and waht has arrived is an incredibly feminine pale pastel green bottle

Large thermos flask. Keeps cool. The handle is practical. Spout is just wide enough to drink from, made of a pleasant material. Can be put in the dishwasher. Unfortunately, the outside scratches easily.

review_title: A DETAILED REVIEW OF THIS MASTERPIECE OF A WATER BOTTLE
body_en: Edit: a few months later and I have to say I’m still quite impressed. One thing is, is that it leaked two times, and I don’t mean dripped a little- I mean the whole water bottle spilled out into my bag. I realised that it was because the white rubber piece on the inside of the cover was not in correctly. BUT- both times I had washed my water bottle earlier that day and took all the pieces apart and I guess I didn’t put it back together well enough. I think this issue should be addressed because a few things in my bag became ruined because of this spill. The reason I’m keeping my review at five stars is because it might be my fault, like I explained before, that the rubber piece was not secured. Edit #2: almost a yr later and I have to say I’m still quite impressed. One thing I noticed though was that sometimes I would be nervous to hold my water bottle by the plastic handle for fear that it would crack but I have to say that never happened . It’s a wonderful durable bottle that I feel will be able to last at least another yr and more. It obviously has some scratches and dents from a yrs worth of use but I’d definitely say it’s scratch and dent resistant, bc from t amount of times I dropped or kicked it it should not look as good as it does. Still recommend if u want a cute, durable, long lasting water bottle that doesn’t cost an arm and a leg. This water bottle is great. In this review I’ll discuss: -quality a. How long it stays cold b. Product material c. How well it holds up -color -what sets this water bottle apart from others QUALITY: A. I like my water cold and this bottle does the trick. I keeps my water at the temperature I want for the whole day (depending on the amount of ice cubes I put in) and then some. I was working out and I desperately needed I drink. Noticing my ello nearby I grabbed it and chugged. But I was surprised that the water was cold. I had filled it up on Friday and this was the next Sunday. The water was actually cold like it had been sitting in the fridge. That Friday I filled it about 3 quarters of the way with ice cubes. B. The metal feels of high quality. The outside of the bottle has a mostly smooth slightly bumpy - really very slightly - feel to it. It’s been in my bag when I dropped it on hard floor out of carelessness or anger and it has not even a slight dent. It’s rolled on cement floor, been kicked down, and has not a scratch. The only thing that concerns me is the cover. The cover is made of plastic and it does feel a bit thin. I have played with cover a lot (I fidget with anything I can get my hands on) and it’s still perfect. I’ve had this water bottle for a few months now. C. In A and B I’ve included everything I have to say about how well this masterpiece of a water bottle has been holding up, but here’s a summery: I’ve had this for a few months now and it’s been dropped, kicked over, knocked over, rolled around, played with, and more I’m sure, and it’s perfect. Not a dent or a scratch. Works as well as when I got it. COLOR: I got the bottle with the blue base and pink and orange cover and it looks exactly the same in person as it did in the picture. With all the different patterns to choose from, you’re sure to find one that you love. I’ve got so many compliments on the pastel color and overall aesthetic look of the bottle. WHAT SETS THIS BOTTLE APART FROM OTHERS: I’ll get straight to the point: it’s the cover. The cover has a unique design that cannot be compared to any other water bottle. Firstly, it has a spout, giving you the option of drinking from a straw. But you also have a chugging option because of the way the whole cover can flip up easily. Second (and this is a big one), is that because the cover can flip up easily without you having to unscrew it, it lets you fill up your water bottle with as many ice cubes as you please without having to spend 5 minutes every morning trying to screw it closed. And that’s what really sets it apart from other water bottles; the genius design of the cover.

The water capacity is 32 oz and i filled it to the top. The straw is plastic but perfect. The quality is perfect about this water bottle not too much to clean and just straw, lid, and insulated bottle. The temperature retention stays cool I filled my water bottle up at 6 pm and it is 8:25 am it is still cold. I believe on the packaging it says stays cool for 32 hours. The appearance is perfect I love how it isn’t so bulky and and it is portable because it has a handle that you can carry it around or tie something to the strap and go. I’m happy with my color I chose and it is very bright since I love pink! I am happy and a regular customer I love my new insulated water bottle!

review_title: Great design and keeps water COLD!
body_en: I love these bottles. The design is very convenient for chugging and refilling ant refill fountains, and the mouth is wide so you can hold it under the ice dispenser. Keeps ice solid overnight - the more you use the longer it stays. I don’t use the straws so I don’t insert mine and can actually tilt the bottle up to drink from the sip part which is nice for working out or drinking on the move. The 22 oz and smaller fit in car cup holders. The only issue is, because I use them so often, the plastic tab on the top clear cover that inserts into the lid broke off and now it won’t stay closed. These have a lifetime warranty so I just filed a claim through their website and they sent me replacement lids with zero hassle. Awesome customer service!!!

review_title: Wonderful water bottle but a bit finicky
body_en: I have had this bottle for a year now and really love it, Ello just needs to work on a few things. I had the bottle for like 6 months ish until, like other reviewers, the plastic latch on the lid broke. I used the water bottle every day so there was definitely a ton of wear on the latch but that should be expected in a water bottle and so the latch needs to be made more durable. I reached out to customer service who kindly sent me another lid. Since getting that lid, in the last 4 months, I'v started getting leaks! The rubber gasket that keeps the pop up lid sealed jumps out of its position whenever the bottle is opened so if you don't remember to triple check that it's positioned properly you will spill the entire contents of the bottle (also an issue noted with other reviewers). Weird bc I didn't have this issue w the first bottle. Customer service is again sending me another lid (note they do have a limited lifetime warranty). I am still pretty committed to this bottle regardless of the above issues if that tells you how much I like it anyway! The color is cute, the metal is high quality, the insulation keeps water cold for several days. I love the pop lid/straw design of the top and it's so unique I don't want to get any other bottle. Even if the above issues are irritating I'd still probably just buy another one and hope it doesn't have issues bc I do like it so much!

review_title: I've purchased 7 of them! I know what I'm talking about!
body_en: Do not buy any other water bottle. This is the best out there! I have purchased seven of them. I lost two black ones awhile back. They never appear in Lost and Founds because they are too good. People keep them when found!!! The next three I purchased were green and a blue one. The blue one was for a gift! Yes, I lost one green one but still holding out hopes to find it. One green stopped working correctly. The plastic top that covers the mouthpiece stopped latching closed. Then I dropped it and the lid cracked. I went online to find a replacement lid. But the one I received was not the same, so I returned it and ordered TWO more water bottles light green. PRO: The lid is important. Its Flip to Fill means you just pop open the top and you can add ice and water without having to twist the whole lid off. As you know, if you have ice, the straw is hard to twist the lid and stay connected. This is the best feature of the water bottle. CON: It is too wide to fit in my water bottle holder on my bike. It would be great to have a slim choice. Additionally--(if that's a word)-I purchased a water bottle holder with straps that can go over the shoulder or around the waist. I really don't want to lose another one! I usually wait until I can find one that goes on sale for 18.00 and buy that color. Do not buy the replacement lids on Amazon. Even though they say Flip to fill, they are not. Go on the products website. They have the exact lid. It costs the same once you add in the tax and shipping fee. The water bottles cost more on the the products site so better pricing on Amazon.

review_title: My Favorite Water Bottle—The Pop & Fill Lid Is a Game Changer
body_en: I’ve tried a lot of insulated water bottles, and this is easily my favorite brand. The Pop & Fill lid is the reason I keep coming back. You don’t have to completely remove the lid to refill it—just pop it open to add ice, water, or your favorite drink. It’s so much more convenient than traditional bottles. As a breastfeeding mom, I especially appreciate that I can open it and drink with one hand while holding my baby. That alone makes it worth it for me. The insulation keeps my drinks cold for hours, it’s leakproof, and it’s become my go-to bottle for everyday use and travel. The only thing to know is that the 32 oz version is a little too large for most cup holders, but that’s pretty typical for bottles this size. I also own the 22 oz version, which fits much better in cup holders if that’s important to you. Overall, I absolutely love this bottle and recommend it to anyone looking for a high-quality insulated water bottle—especially busy parents.

review_title: I loved it.... but it broke
body_en: Pros: very functional and cute! Cons: not durable. This water bottle is incredibly cute and worked perfectly for making drinks at home and transporting them to the office without worrying about it leaking in my backpack. The top fully opening without unscrewing the lid made adding ice and drink mixes super easy! I even sent pics of it to my friends cuz of how cute the colors are. Being able to toss it in the dishwasher was a huge plus too. BUT. I bought this in May, probably used it less than 30 times... but the lid has already broken. The latch on the clear lid broke off, so there's no way to stop it from leaking out of the mouth piece. This means I can't use it for its intended purpose (carrying it in my backpack). I wasn't rough with it either, I never dropped it, I only used the clear lid when it was on my backpack so I didn't stress the latch frequently, and it was placed very carefully in my dishwasher away from other items... this was just a cheap product. So I can't recommend this product, because it ended up costing me about $1 per use and that's frankly ridiculous. I am very sad :/

review_title: Best water bottle EVER-till it wasn't.
body_en: I searched for years for a decent water bottle that met a very specific criteria and wasn't crazy in price. During that time, I also tried several that didn't meet their promises. I was so excited to find this model that surprisingly checked all the boxes and I loved it even more than I thought I would, until one of the most important features failed randomly after a couple of months. I travel frequently for work so having a spill proof bottle, that doesn't sweat, and keeping my hands as far from where my mouth goes is important for my line of work too. But having a lid that locks was an absolute non negotiable! When out of the blue one day I noticed my lid was open. I thought maybe I just forgot to close it, push it close. NOPE! The little nubbin that holds the lock shut broke off while sitting on my table. I LOVED this water bottle and I hesitate to buy another after this experience and seeing many others. There's no replacement tops available to buy from them and the knock offs don't fill without removing the top. Am I going to pay $25 to have a second cup without a lid, no! This cup was so easy to wash, carry, fill and drink from. No having to risk my safety or set a lid down on random counters, in airports, train stations, construction sites, public bathrooms, or labs to fill. No concern about a random persons germs, dirt, or a toxic substance being placed in or on my drink. No sweating, keeps drinks cold, no weird plastic taste. I'm honestly devastated.
Wanted something heavy duty but this leaks everytime I use it.
I like the bottle overall but after about 2 months of use, I noticed the top rubber section is full of mould and very difficult to clean. No good…

We got this for usage in the car as it fits perfectly in the cup holder compartment. However the rubber that should prevent the water from leaking, gets shifted everytime it’s opened to be refilled. You can’t tell till it leaks. I’m just thankful we’ve always had only water in them for sweet drinks leaking anywhere is a disaster to clean up.

Was skeptical about the material at first but i really like the convenience of the hatch and also the spout being removable for easy washing. Been using this for a month and it's pretty good, and a bit more affordable than some other brands.

review_title: Cuestión de ecología, cero botella de platico.
body_en: Just like the photograph, very practical and pretty, zero leaks.

review_title: On point and has every feature you could need.
body_en: This bottle is perfect for what I use it for! I work for the Railroad so I am very hard on my things and they need to last. This is extremely sturdy and made with high-quality durable parts. I have only used it for cold drinks because I don’t need any type of hot drink for 12 hours, but it does keep very cold and keeps ice floating around up to 48 hours without sweating or building condensation. Despite how heavy and awkward it can get when you are putting 128 ounces of fluid into it on top of its already solid construction, I find it very easy to carry, move, and drink from. The included flip top handle is great and can be adjusted up or down. The handles on the side are also great for carrying it and if you are not wanting to use them, they fold into the bottle itself. I think having both options for a straw and for a chug cap is an awesome feature that I didn’t realize the handiness of before I bought it. It has been perfect for filling up at home and especially at the gas station or wherever you get your drinks from. I believe out of every bottle I researched to buy, which was quite a few, the opening on this one was the widest allowing you to add many different types of ice or fill it using different types of spouts and machines at the gas station. Adding to that, so far the height has been just right. You can slide it under spouts or ice machines without having to tip it at an awkward angle. If you make sure you are properly tightening the top, the cap, and pushing the straw all the way down then you will have zero leakage at all. You can flip it around, roll it around in the car, or simply hold it upside down and it does not leak a drop. I searched for quite a while for a water bottle that met all of my needs and had all the features I wanted. I liked quite a few, but they all had something that I would’ve had to settle for or didn’t like. This one includes everything that I was wanting plus it is extremely affordable for all that it does. It is 1/2 up to even 1/4 the price of other insulated gallon jugs that do not have the same features. Finally, their customer service is responsive and cares about the customer. I left an email with pictures and videos on a Friday because I thought my jug was leaking. They responded within a day or two, which was still over the weekend, and made a detailed markup of my pictures respectfully showing me that I was more than likely using it incorrectly and causing the leaks. However, they told me I didn’t even need to try the solutions they recommended if I didn’t want to and if I wanted a replacement, refund, or anything else they would be more than happy to oblige. 100% recommend to buy

This water bottle is simply awesome. So many well-thought-out features! I love how big it is - it holds a gallon! It is really solidly built. The double handles on the side are really sturdy, but fold completely away. There are small cleats on one side so the bottle can be stable when placed on its side on a level surface. The lid is really nicely designed. It tightens down in about a half turn and seals tightly. It includes a pour nozzle with a captured cap, so you can't lose it. And the flip-up sipper makes for easy access whenever you're thirsty, no lifting or pouring needed. But the BEST part is inside. The inside is a seamless stainless steel liner, evidently double-wall. There are no penetrations of any sort, so no place for bacteria to collect, and absolutely easy to clean. And, IT WILL KEEP LIQUIDS COOL FOR THREE DAYS! I'm not kidding. I routinely mix up almost a gallon of Gatorade in it, add some ice, and drop in a frozen water bottle. I've sipped on one for three days, and when it was empty there were still chunks of ice in it! If you work outdoors, or in an un-air conditioned shop (I do both) this water bottle is a life saver!

The perfect jug when you need a lot of water. This jug will stay super cold overnight. A little heavy, but does not leak a drop. Share with your partner and still have enough left to drink for you a very good purchase.

I do HVAC work, so a lot of time spent in the hot sun, hot attics, etc. so I drink a lot of water, and this bottle gets me through just about every single day. It does a really great job at keeping beverages cold. I had it in a 130+ degree attic for like 4 hours and it was still ice cold by the time I was done. I have it sitting in direct sunlight outside for multiple hours quite often, and same deal. Not only that, but it’s sturdy. The handle is super robust and doesn’t feel like it’s gonna break or come loose at all, and I’ve dropped this bottle (while full of water) onto rocks, pavement, concrete, you name it, and aside from minor scratches it doesn’t show any signs of damage, even the smallest dent in the metal or crack in the plastic. It is very heavy when full, but that’s pretty obvious considering it holds a gallon. A cool feature that I want to point out too is the feet it has on the side to prevent rolling. It’s about time somebody did something like this. I can leave it sitting on the side and it won’t roll away, if I drop it and it starts rolling it’ll stop pretty quickly. I love that feature. I highly recommend this bottle!!

review_title: Good water bottle but not good for keeping water cold.
body_en: Pretty sturdy and has a good weight to it! It's actually a decent size. I was expecting to be much larger but it's the perfect size. I really like the 2-in-1 straw spout lid, as well as the dual handles. The wide mouth and stainless steel makes cleaning a breeze. I got the midnight black color and it looks great! So far, no scuffs and/or dents (even though I dropped it a couple times already.. oops). I have yet to try using its stands and probably won't unless I'm out camping. The only thing that disappointed me was the fact that it doesn't actually keep ice water cold for 36 hours. I filled it up with ice and after about 5ish hours, the majority was melted. By the 10th hour, it was lukewarm. I do find myself hydrating much more so not a big deal! Water is water!

If there was an option for 10 stars, this bottle would get them!! I bought this for my son to use at work, and he’s thrilled with it! He filled it completely with ice and water at 11:30 on Friday morning, and it’s now 10:30 pm on Monday, and the ice is still going strong! He also loves the attention to details, that most bottles don’t have, such as the ability for both left and right handed people to use. My son is a leftie, so he really loves this! There are many more great features, that are outlined on an insert that comes with the bottle. It’s also made in the USA, and comes with a lifetime warranty.

review_title: Does not keep ice water cold for more than a few hours
body_en: I bought this to take to work and have ice cold water I can fill out as I sit in my office, which is inside and AC controlled. The product states it will keep liquids cold for up to 3 days. This is not the case at all. I filled it up with cool water from my fridge, added plenty of ice in it, and the ice is melted within hours while sitting inside my house. I even filled it up the night before work with more ice and it was completed melted the next morning at 6am while sitting inside on my counter. The bottle is actually freezing cold to the touch on the outside, which leads me to think it is either defective or there is simply no insulation. No way it could keep anything hot or cold for very long. I ensure the lid was secured, and that the flip up lid was clicked closed. Hopefully the seller can make this right or I will be requesting a refund. Will update review after I hear back. Ice was completely melted within 1-2 hours while being inside at 70 degrees. Very disappointed.

review_title: THE BEST WATER JUG HANDS DOWN !
body_en: Great company, superior product to anything I have tried before ( I did try a lot of jugs) and they have the best next level customer service. I was in a rush to find a new water jug that I can carry with me everyday, so I came across Powcan on amazon and I immediately liked everything about it, the color that I picked looks amazing in person, it’s called deepsea. I ended up buying the 128oz jug. I got my package in the mail the other day and the color, design, and the quality is amazing, after using it for a day or two, I figured the 64oz would be much more convenient for me to carry around everywhere I go. So I reached out to their support team and asked if I can exchange the one that I have with a 64oz one. A gentleman named Alex reached back to me and had a great attitude, and was very understanding, awesome guy. He offered to send me a free 64oz jug and he mentioned that I can keep the 128oz one. He shipped it immediately and got here in 3 days. Amazing quality, material is top notch and very sturdy. I pour cold water in there, and it stays cold pretty much all day with no issues, no leakage, there isn’t a weird after taste to my water after it sits in there for a while. I’m very happy with both jugs, the big one for long road trips, and the smaller one is for day to day carry.

review_title: A very good, well-designed insulated water bottle.
body_en: I wasn't sure if this one gallon size might be too big for me or not. But it turns out it's not. It's a perfect size to last me for my long days at work. I sometimes work 12 hours or more. It doesn't leak at all and it's got a wide mouth for cleaning. Along with a sipping straw and another screw on cap for pouring it into my smaller Yeti water bottle. It has solid fold away plastic handles for carrying and for pouring. Thats a very nice addition. I couldn't get the lid on where the spout would be on the opposite side of the fold out handles. The threads would never line up to achieve this. But then it occurred to me, it's designed this way. It's better to have the pour spout at a 90° angle on either the right or the left side of the fold out handles. That way you can actually see the water pouring, so you don't spill it. And it doesn't feel awkward or lopsided when you're pouring, which you might think it would. If it was the full 180 degrees from the handles your view would be blocked and you're likely to miss your container or glass. That was well thought out. It does a very good job keeping water cold for at least 24 hours. I put cold water in it in the morning along with a tray of ice cubes and when I get home late that evening I'll usually have just a little bit of water left and still some ice. By the next morning if I haven't drank it all, the water is still cold. The metal swing down carry handle is very sturdy and strong. I have no worries about that breaking. The bottle is also designed so that you can lay it on it side and it won't roll. I honestly can't think of anything else that they could have done to improve it. It has everything I'm looking for in an insulated water bottle. I'm pretty sure most of these insulated stainless steel water bottles all keep liquids cold for roughly the same length of time. In fact I read on a website where they've tested many many different insulated water bottles and they say the same thing. So save yourself some money and buy a good one like this Powcan.

review_title: Es Importante Resaltar Que Es Un Peso Pesado
body_en: Excellent Thermos, I use it outside, I work in heavy machinery... and it keeps the water cold all day even though the weather is very hot and so is the machine, excellent thermal insulation

I’m very happy with this insulated water bottle. The large capacity is great because it holds enough fluids to last throughout the day without needing frequent refills. It also does an excellent job keeping drinks cold all day, even when spending time outside on a hot day. The straw feature is especially useful when the bottle is full, since it can get quite heavy to lift for every sip. Being able to drink through the straw makes it much more convenient. My only suggestion for improvement would be the carrying handle. I wish the main handle were built into the body of the bottle, similar to the side handle, rather than attached to the lid. Other than that, it’s a great water bottle and has worked very well for me.

review_title: Muy resistente a condiciones de trabajo
body_en: Very good water vase, very resistant to the field area

Purchased for my gym obsessed boyfriend. He drinks at least a gallon of water everyday and the single use gallons he had to replace every week just weren’t the best thing to use. This has a super wide mouth so it is super easy to clean, and the handles aren’t hollow so you don’t need to worry about mold getting in those. Keeps water cold all day, if you leave ice in it in the morning it will be mostly melted by the evening but it will still be ice cold. For me it’s really heavy but my boyfriend doesn’t have the same issue and thinks the weight is a good trade off for the product. The handles aren’t hollow great and he loves the option for a straw (since it is heavy when full) and the ability to chug.

These are my favorite water bottles! I travel a lot for work and have a family always on the go. These bottles stand up to being knocked around, tipped over, thrown in bags, backpacks, purses, under airplane seats, thwon in the front seat, and they don't leak. review_title: This water bottle REFUSES to break OR spill!

I was WRONG! This is, hands down, THE BEST WATER BOTTLE I HAVE EVER OWNED. I have had it for over a year now, and I tote it with me on the daily, always on the move walking from class to class on a large outdoor college campus. There are THREE things that make this the best water bottle in the world: 1. It is HARD TO DROP, even for me! I just hook my finger through that little bendy hooky thing up top, close my fist, and that sucker stays on me! I walk everywhere with this thing, and when I'm holding it through the loop, it is basically UNDROPPABLE! When I'm drinking from it, the little hand indentation up at the top of the water bottle is a very comfortable fit, and even when the bottle is full and heavy, it feels very balanced. 2. WHEN I drop it, it DOESN'T BREAK! Let's face it: I am forgetful and clumsy. There are times when I don't hold the bottle the undroppable way. There are times when the bottle is sitting on my desk and I accidentally swipe it off. There was even this one time when I threw it into the air and then failed to catch it. But through all these drops, this bottle has not cracked yet. And a couple of my drops have been when the bottle was fullish. That being said, I haven't had TOO many major drops (thanks to the bottles undroppableness) so I wouldn't try pushing your luck with this one. But alot can be said just from the fact that this bottle has survived a year of daily use with ME, a certified water bottle destroyer. 3. IT DOESN'T LEAK! This bottle has something that's hard to find these days: A TOP THAT ACTUALLY WORKS! I have NEVER experienced a single leak with this bottle - NOT EVEN ONE! I throw my bottle into my bookbag all the time, with precious lecture notes and expensive textbooks, some of which are rented and must be returned, and I can do so with FULL CONFIDENCE that my water bottle will not leak on them! I'm not talking the side pocket of my bookbag, I am talking in the main zipper with all of my other stuff. I make ZERO EFFORT to be careful when the bottle is in my bookbag. All day long that bookbag bumps into desks, walls, people, gets turned upside down, gets thrown on the floor, sat on, turned upside down, etc. This sucker doesn't leak. And that's it. THREE things that go into making the PERFECT WATER BOTTLE. This water bottle also has the added benefit of having a killer price (I was happy to pay the price I paid for it even when I was still assuming it was nothing special). It also holds 40 ounces of water, which is kind of a large amount of water compared to most water bottles. I bought this bottle with ZERO EXPECTATIONS, and it has turned out to be one of my favorite buys from Amazon to date. It definitely sparks joy in my life! Thank you, Pogo water bottles. You have created something of VALUE.

review_title: Very Aesthetically Pleasing, Doesn't Leak, Easy to Carry Around
body_en: I love this water bottle. I had been lugging around a 64oz bottle that could barely fit in the side pockets of my backpack, and while it was nice to have during 12 hour shifts, I got sick of it. I got the purple bottle with the chug lid. The color is beautiful, the design of the bottle is very cute and elegant, and the actual hole you drink from is much more desireable to me than the straws/nips a lot of bottles use nowadays. Even though it is only 32oz, I find that I don't mind refilling it once a day to get in my 64oz. I actually prefer it to a 64oz bottle, since I know I'll be getting fresh, cool water after the first fill runs out. I've seen some comment that you can't actually "chug" with this bottle...well, of course you can't! The bottle isn't the thin, bendable plastic that you get with the water bottles from the store...it's sturdy!! And while you can't "chug," you can most certainly get some big gulps in! I'm not a slow water drinker. I don't want tiny sips, I want to get that +64oz in! This bottle is definitely good for that. You can easily get 4oz, and even more, in a single gulp. Haha, I even did it now, just to be sure... I really love this thing. It is exactly what I was looking for, and the price is great. The lid is also very easy to open and close, but still very sturdy and secure. It also seems quite easy to clean, though I haven't had to do so just yet. For those who have seen mold growth on their water bottles...you must wash these things at LEAST once a week, if not more often, especially if you wear anything on your lips like chapstick, lipstick, etc. Even the slight bit of backwash from out filthy human mouths is enough to contaminate the insides of the bottle. If you live in a warmer climate, this is especially true and will result in the bacteria from your backwash contaminating the bottle resulting in the growth of things like mold. It has happened to me before and I was absolutely mortified. Another reason I prefer chug lids as opposed to straws...the things are a hell of a lot easier to clean. No hidden crevices harboring disgusting human bacteria...lol. I definitely recommend this water bottle for those of you looking to increase your intake. Very pretty, convenient, and simple to clean with the chug lid.

body_en: Perfect tee shirt. Finally! My husband is SO hard to please when it comes to buying plain tee shirts, and it gets worse every year. How we've stayed married 40 years is beyond me. But getting to the point, I ordered this one because I actually liked the color (I ordered the dark green). When it got here, I just tossed it to him and said, "Here's a new shirt, hope you like it, please give it a try. PLEASE." I nearly fell over when he walked up later and said, "I like it!" I immediately made him repeat that statement with our son in the room to witness it. Even considered recording it but didn't want to press my luck. But I did take a picture, which I attached here. Also attached an up-close photo of the fabric of the shirt, because it's not the usual tee shirt fabric; it's unusually soft (the color in the photo looks wonky, but it's just because the lighting in the laundry room was unusually yellowish, don't pay attention to that). He actually does like it, not only because it fits, but he loves the color too. I did good! The color looks really good on him (It must be "curmudgeon green"?) and it fits him well, too. I think it must be extra long without really saying it it, because most of his shirts seem a little shorter than this one. That might be another reason he likes it. I don't know. I do know two things for sure: I'm ordering more for him for Christmas, and also, the material IS softer than the normal tee shirts he's used to and I think that also has something to do with why he likes it. So if that helps you ladies (and guys) out there, great! It certainly has helped me, and will at Christmas too.

What Stood Out The classic crew-neck style makes this shirt easy to pair with jeans, joggers, or other casual bottoms. The black color is especially versatile, and the simple design works well as either a standalone shirt or a layering piece. What Didn't There's nothing particularly distinctive about the design—it's very much a basic everyday tee. If you're looking for something with a more fitted or stylish cut, this may feel a little plain. I ordered this Soft Crew-neck T-shirt by Coofandy in size M for my son to add to his casual outfits for this fall and winter. His experience with it is good. He says that the long-sleeve tee feels comfortable; the quality is decent, and the dark grey color is perfect for matching with any color pants or even shorts, and for wearing it alone or with a layer depending on the temperature. review_title: Comfortable, Great Fit, and Holds Up Well
body_en: I’m really happy with this COOFANDY long-sleeve T-shirt. The material is soft, comfortable, and feels great against the skin. The sizing was accurate, and it fits me really well without being too tight or too loose. I’ve washed it several times already, and so far it has held up very well. It hasn’t shrunk, and the color still looks great with no noticeable fading. The stitching and overall quality also feel solid. It’s a nice casual shirt that works well on its own or layered under a jacket or hoodie. It’s comfortable enough to wear all day and has a clean, simple look that goes with just about anything. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the quality, fit, and comfort. I highly recommend it!

review_title: It’s a timeless, long sleeve T-shirt, using a modern fabric and classic design...
body_en: I enjoy wearing this longsleeve T-shirt. The shirt fits very well. The shirt has a good fit front to back and a nice drape and length that falls far enough below the waist, just like it should. The sleeves are full length and end in a doubled over design that mirrors the crewneck up top. The neck style is the standard opening and the shirt gives a good appearance, especially when worn under a short sleeve boxy type shirt. It’s a nice style and an attractive material. I ordered my long sleeve tee in the dark gray extra large size which has turned out to be quite versatile. The shirt can be worn tucked inside the pants or worn outside… It can also be worn by itself or as an under layer for a dressier appearance. The shirt can be worn just about anywhere. The material is a smooth cotton-polyester blend. It feels very soft and the dye is applied evenly and consistently. I think the t-shirt represents a good value, especially for the price charged. It’s a timeless, long sleeve T-shirt, using a modern fabric and classic design.

review_title: A Solid Everyday Shirt, But Don't Expect Soft
body_en: This is a nice long sleeve tee in a blue that matches the listing well. The large fits my husband like it should, and he's comfortable wearing it around the house and for running errands. It's 100% cotton, which is always a plus, and the construction feels solid. That said, I wouldn't call this shirt soft. The listing leans into that word, but the fabric is a little heavier than a typical t-shirt — comfortable, yes, but soft isn't the word I'd reach for. It's more of a sturdy everyday cotton tee than a buttery-soft lounge shirt. He washed and dried it before the first wear and it fit perfectly after, so no shrinkage issues there. The price is fair for a well-made 100% cotton long sleeve tee. A good basic for daily wear, just set your texture expectations accordingly.

review_title: Comfortable, Great Fit, and Excellent Everyday Shirt
body_en: This long-sleeve T-shirt is an easy five-star purchase. The first thing I noticed was how soft and comfortable the cotton fabric feels. It’s lightweight enough for everyday wear while still providing just the right amount of warmth for cooler days. The fit is excellent and true to size. It has a flattering, modern look without being too tight or too loose, making it comfortable to wear all day. Whether I’m relaxing at home, heading out, or layering it under a jacket, it fits well and looks great. The quality is better than I expected. The stitching is well done, the fabric feels durable, and it has held up nicely after washing without shrinking or losing its shape. The classic crew neck design also makes it easy to pair with jeans, joggers, or shorts for a casual, versatile outfit. Overall, this is a high-quality basic shirt that delivers exactly what you’re looking for—comfort, a great fit, and dependable everyday style. I’m very happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-made long-sleeve T-shirt.

This tee shirt is very comfortable. The fabric is a mid weight that feels nice on your skin and should protect against the chill in cooler weather. It’s a cotton / polyester blend with the comfort of cotton and yet has a little bit of stretchiness. It is nicely finished with quality stitching, quality collar and cuffs, and looks very nice on its own. It looks great after washing with little to no wrinkles and no shrinkage. I normally wear a size medium or large shirt depending on the style and cut. I ordered a medium in this shirt and it fits perfectly except that I wish the sleeves were about an inch longer. It fits loosely without looking baggie.
